be able to swim: After taking lessons at the pool all summer, my little sister is finally able to swim across the pool by herself.
在游泳池上了一整個夏天的課之後，我的小妹終於會游泳，能自己游過整個泳池了。
be able to help: If you have trouble with your science homework tonight, I am able to help you after dinner.
如果你今晚的自然作業有困難，晚餐後我能幫忙你。
not be able to come: Mary has a bad cold, so she will not be able to come to our party on Saturday night.
瑪麗得了重感冒，所以她星期六晚上不能來我們的派對。
as soon as you are able: Please call me back as soon as you are able, because I need to talk to you about the trip.
請你一能夠就回電給我，因為我需要和你談談這次旅行的事。
be absent from school: Jack was absent from school for three days last week because he had a high fever.
傑克上週因為發高燒，缺課了三天。
be absent from work: My father was absent from work yesterday because he had to take my grandmother to the hospital.
我爸爸昨天缺勤，因為他必須帶我奶奶去醫院。
absent from the meeting: Our class leader was absent from the meeting this morning, so the teacher asked me to take notes for her.
我們班長今天早上沒出席會議，所以老師請我幫她做筆記。
an absent look: Peter had an absent look on his face during the math class because he was thinking about the basketball game.
彼得在數學課上一臉心不在焉的表情，因為他正想著籃球比賽。
an active child: My cousin is an active child who never sits still and loves to run around the park every afternoon.
我的表弟是個活潑的小孩，他從來坐不住，而且喜歡每天下午在公園裡跑來跑去。
take an active part in: Every student should take an active part in the school fair, so please sign up for a job today.
每個學生都應該積極參與學校園遊會，所以請今天就報名一項工作。
an active life: My grandfather leads an active life, and he goes hiking every weekend and swims in the river in summer.
我爺爺過著活躍的生活，他每個週末都去健行，夏天還會在河裡游泳。
be active in sports: Lisa is very active in sports, and she plays on both the basketball team and the volleyball team at school.
麗莎非常熱衷運動，她在學校同時參加籃球隊和排球隊。
be afraid of dogs: My little brother is afraid of dogs, so he always holds my hand when we walk past the park.
我的小弟弟怕狗，所以我們走過公園時他總是牽著我的手。
be afraid of making mistakes: Don't be afraid of making mistakes when you speak English, because everyone makes mistakes when they learn something new.
說英文時不要怕犯錯，因為每個人學新東西時都會犯錯。
be afraid to speak: The new student was afraid to speak in front of the class, so she only said her name in a small voice.
這位新同學不敢在全班面前說話，所以她只用小小的聲音說了自己的名字。
When my brother asked if he could play computer games before dinner, Mom shook her head and said, I'm afraid not.
當我弟弟問晚餐前可不可以玩電腦遊戲時，媽媽搖搖頭說：恐怕不行。
When Lisa asked me if the math test was really going to be tomorrow, I sadly answered, I'm afraid so.
當麗莎問我數學考試是不是真的在明天時，我難過地回答：恐怕是這樣。
I'm afraid I can't: Thank you for inviting me to your birthday party, but I'm afraid I can't go because I have to visit my grandmother.
謝謝你邀請我參加你的生日派對，但恐怕我沒辦法去，因為我必須去探望奶奶。
look alike: The two sisters look so alike that even their teachers sometimes call them by the wrong names at school.
這兩姊妹長得很像，連老師在學校有時都會叫錯她們的名字。
think alike: My best friend and I always think alike, so we often choose the same food and the same movies.
我和我最好的朋友想法總是一樣，所以我們常常選同樣的食物和同樣的電影。
young and old alike: The night market is popular with young and old alike, because everyone can find something delicious there.
這個夜市老少皆同都很喜歡，因為每個人都能在那裡找到好吃的東西。
treat everyone alike: Our teacher treats everyone alike in class, so no student feels that she likes some of us more.
我們老師在班上對每個人一視同仁，所以沒有學生覺得她比較喜歡某些人。
alike 只放在 be/look 之後: The two brothers are so alike that people often say they look alike in every old family photo.
這兩兄弟非常相像（alike 放在 are 之後），大家常說他們在每張舊家庭照片裡看起來都很像（alike 放在 look 之後）。
like 可放名詞前: The two sisters look alike, and both of them sing like birds when they take a shower in the morning.
這兩姊妹長得很像，而且她們兩個早上洗澡時都唱得像鳥一樣（like 放在名詞 birds 前面）。
stay alive: The two lost boys stayed alive for two days on the mountain by drinking rain water and eating wild fruit.
那兩個迷路的男孩靠著喝雨水和吃野果，在山上活下來了兩天。
keep the dream alive: Although he lost the game again, Kevin kept the dream alive and practiced even harder for the next match.
雖然凱文又輸了比賽，他仍讓夢想不滅，並且更努力地為下一場比賽練習。
come alive: The quiet old street comes alive at night when the food stands open and music fills the air.
這條安靜的老街到了晚上，小吃攤開張、音樂響起時，就變得有活力。
be alive and well: After the big earthquake, we were happy to hear that our uncle in Tainan was alive and well.
大地震之後，我們很高興聽到住在台南的叔叔安然無事。
the happiest man alive: When his daughter was born last night, my brother smiled and said he was the happiest man alive.
昨晚女兒出生時，我哥哥笑著說他是世上最快樂的人。
alive 不放名詞前: The fish in the bucket is still alive, so Grandpa quickly puts it back into the river.
桶子裡的魚還活著（alive 只作補語，放在 is 之後），所以爺爺趕快把它放回河裡。
a living thing: Every living thing needs water to stay alive, so we should keep our rivers and lakes clean.
每一種生物都需要水才能活下來，所以我們應該保持河流和湖泊乾淨。
live music: The restaurant has live music on Friday nights, and the whole place comes alive when the band starts playing.
這家餐廳星期五晚上有現場音樂，樂團一開始演奏，整個地方就變得有活力。
a live show: We watched a live show of the baseball game on TV, and the crowd came alive when our team scored.
我們在電視上看棒球比賽的現場直播，我們的球隊得分時，觀眾都興奮起來了。
leave me alone: I was so tired after the long test that I asked my noisy little brother to leave me alone for an hour.
長長的考試之後我累壞了，所以我請吵鬧的小弟弟別管我一個小時。
let alone: My grandmother cannot read English, let alone write a long email to her friend in America.
我奶奶看不懂英文，更不用說寫一封長長的電子郵件給她在美國的朋友了。
live alone: Since my grandfather lives alone in the country, we visit him every Sunday and bring him fresh food.
因為我爺爺獨居在鄉下，我們每個星期天都去探望他，並帶新鮮的食物給他。
all alone: When the lights went out during the storm, the little girl sat all alone in her room and waited for her mom.
暴風雨中停電時，小女孩獨自一人坐在房間裡等媽媽。
alone in the dark: Nobody likes to be alone in the dark, so Dad always leaves a small light on in the hall at night.
沒有人喜歡獨自在黑暗中，所以爸爸晚上總是在走廊留一盞小燈。
alone 單獨（不一定寂寞）: Jenny likes to study alone in the library on weekends because it is quiet and she can think better.
珍妮週末喜歡單獨在圖書館讀書（alone 只是單獨，不一定寂寞），因為那裡很安靜，她可以想得更清楚。
lonely 寂寞（感覺）: After his best friend moved to another city, Peter felt lonely even when he was not alone at school.
最好的朋友搬到另一個城市之後，彼得就算在學校不是單獨一人，也覺得寂寞（lonely 帶有情緒）。
be alone but not lonely: My aunt says she is alone but not lonely, because she enjoys reading and her two cats keep her company.
我阿姨說她獨處但不孤單，因為她喜歡閱讀，而且她的兩隻貓陪著她。
ancient history: Our history teacher loves ancient history, and she tells us exciting stories about old kings and princes every week.
我們的歷史老師熱愛古代歷史，她每週都講古時候國王和王子的精彩故事給我們聽。
an ancient city: Last summer my family visited an ancient city in Japan, where many temples are more than one thousand years old.
去年夏天我家人去日本參觀了一座古城，那裡許多寺廟都有一千多年的歷史。
in ancient times: In ancient times, people did not have clocks, so they looked at the sun to know the time of day.
在古代，人們沒有時鐘，所以他們看太陽來知道一天的時間。
an ancient car: My uncle still drives an ancient car that makes a loud noise, and it often stops in the middle of the road.
我叔叔還在開一輛會發出很大噪音的老舊的車，而且它常常在路中間熄火停下來。
Mom was angry with me because I forgot to feed the dog and came home late after basketball practice.
媽媽生我的氣，因為我忘了餵狗，而且籃球練習後很晚才回家。
The teacher was angry at the dirty floor in our room, so she made everyone stay and clean it up after school.
老師對我們教室髒髒的地板很生氣，所以她讓每個人放學後留下來打掃乾淨。
be angry about the news: Many people were angry about the news that the park would be closed and turned into a parking lot.
許多人為公園將被關閉並改成停車場這個消息感到生氣。
get angry easily: My older brother gets angry easily when he is hungry, so we always eat lunch before we go shopping together.
我哥哥肚子餓的時候容易生氣，所以我們一起去逛街前總是先吃午餐。
make sb. angry: Playing loud music late at night will make the neighbors angry, so please turn it down after ten o'clock.
深夜播放很大聲的音樂會惹鄰居生氣，所以十點以後請把音量關小。
angry 生氣的（形容詞）: An angry man shouted at the bus driver because the bus was twenty minutes late this morning in the rain.
一位生氣的男人對公車司機大吼，因為今天早上下雨，公車晚了二十分鐘。
angrily 生氣地（副詞）: The angry coach shouted angrily at the players because they were not listening to him during the practice.
生氣的教練對球員們生氣地大吼，因為他們練習時沒有在聽他說話。
anger 怒氣（名詞）: Dad was so angry that he hit the table in anger when he saw the broken window in the living room.
爸爸看到客廳破掉的窗戶時非常生氣，氣得在怒氣中用手打桌子。
mad 生氣的（口語）: Mom is still mad at me for breaking her favorite cup, and she gets angry again every time she sees it.
媽媽還在為我打破她最喜歡的杯子而對我生氣（口語用 mad at），每次看到那個杯子她就又生氣了。
one after another: The students went up to the stage one after another to get their prizes from the principal last Friday.
上週五學生們一個接一個走上台，從校長手中領取獎品。
one another: The students in our class help one another with homework, so nobody feels left behind before a big test.
我們班的學生在功課上彼此幫忙，所以大考前沒有人覺得被落下。
in another ten minutes: The train will leave in another ten minutes, so we have just enough time to buy some drinks and snacks.
火車再過十分鐘就要開了，所以我們剛好有時間買一些飲料和點心。
that's another story: Tom is great at playing basketball, but when it comes to studying for tests, that's another story.
湯姆很會打籃球，但說到準備考試，那就是另一回事了。
another cup of tea: Grandma smiled and asked if I would like another cup of tea while we waited for the rain to stop.
奶奶笑著問我在等雨停的時候要不要再一杯茶。
another + 單數: This pen does not work anymore, so could you please give me another one from your pencil box?
這支筆不能寫了，可以請你從你的鉛筆盒再給我另一支嗎？（another 加單數）
other + 複數: I finished one book this week, and now I want to read another, but other people have borrowed all the good ones.
我這週讀完了一本書，現在想再讀另一本，但其他人（other 加複數）已經把好書全借走了。
the other 兩者中另一: I have two cats; one is black and the other is white, and I want to get another one next year.
我有兩隻貓，一隻是黑的，另一隻（兩者中的另一個）是白的，而且我明年還想再養一隻。
others: Some students in our school like math, others like English, and another group likes nothing but PE class.
我們學校有些學生喜歡數學，其他的喜歡英文，另一群則只喜歡體育課。
any time: You can call me any time if you have questions about the homework, because I am always happy to help.
如果你對作業有問題，隨時都可以打電話給我，因為我總是很樂意幫忙。
in any case: It may rain this afternoon, but in any case we will still have the picnic inside the school gym.
今天下午可能會下雨，但無論如何我們還是會在學校體育館裡舉行野餐。
at any moment: The sky is getting dark and the wind is strong, so the rain could start at any moment now.
天空越來越暗，風也很強，所以現在隨時可能開始下雨。
not any more: My brother does not play computer games any more because he wants to spend more time on his studies.
我哥哥不再玩電腦遊戲了，因為他想花更多時間在學業上。
any day now: My sister's baby is coming any day now, so everyone in the family is excited and keeps checking the phone.
我姊姊的寶寶隨時都可能出生，所以全家人都很興奮，一直在看手機。
without any trouble: Thanks to the clear map, we found the small restaurant without any trouble and had a wonderful dinner there.
多虧了清楚的地圖，我們毫無困難地找到了那家小餐廳，並在那裡吃了一頓美好的晚餐。
any 用於問句與否定句: Do you have any brothers or sisters at home, or are you the only child in your family?
你家裡有任何兄弟姊妹嗎（問句用 any），還是你是家裡唯一的小孩？
some 用於肯定句與請求: Would you like some tea with your cake, or don't you want any drinks right now?
你想要一些茶配蛋糕嗎（請求用 some），還是你現在不想要任何飲料（否定句用 any）？
fall asleep: I was so tired after the long trip that I fell asleep on the sofa before the movie even started.
長途旅行後我累到在電影還沒開始前就在沙發上入睡了。
be fast asleep: When Dad came home at midnight, the children were already fast asleep in their beds with the lights off.
爸爸半夜回家時，孩子們已經關了燈在床上睡得很熟了。
be sound asleep: The baby was sound asleep in the car, so Mom drove slowly and turned the radio off.
寶寶在車裡熟睡，所以媽媽開得很慢，還把收音機關掉。
half asleep: Jack was still half asleep when he got on the bus, so he almost missed his stop near the school.
傑克上公車時還半睡半醒，所以他差點錯過學校附近的那一站。
asleep 不放名詞前: The cat is asleep on the warm chair by the window, and nobody wants to wake it up.
貓在窗邊溫暖的椅子上睡著了（asleep 只作補語，不放名詞前），沒有人想叫醒它。
a sleeping baby: Please speak quietly because there is a sleeping baby in the next room, and he just fell asleep.
請小聲說話，因為隔壁房間有一個睡著的嬰兒，他才剛睡著。
sleepy 想睡的: I always feel sleepy after lunch, and sometimes I even fall asleep during the first class in the afternoon.
我午餐後總是覺得想睡，有時候甚至在下午第一節課就睡著了。
be available for sale: The new phone will be available for sale next Friday, and many people plan to line up early at the store.
這款新手機下週五就有售，很多人打算早早到店裡排隊。
be available on the Internet: The answers to the workbook are available on the Internet, but our teacher wants us to try the questions first.
習作的答案在網路上可取得，但老師希望我們先自己試著做題目。
not available right now: I am sorry, but the doctor is not available right now, so could you come back after three o'clock?
很抱歉，醫生現在沒空，可以請你三點以後再來嗎？
Are you available tonight?: Are you available tonight, because our group needs to finish the science report before the class tomorrow morning?
你今晚有空嗎？因為我們這組需要在明天早上上課前完成自然報告。
the only seat available: The theater was almost full, so I took the only seat available in the first row and looked up at the screen.
電影院幾乎坐滿了，所以我坐了第一排唯一的空位，抬頭看著螢幕。
a backward step: Taking a backward step, the boy watched the big dog carefully and then slowly walked away from it.
男孩退一步，小心地看著那隻大狗，然後慢慢地走開。
walk backward: In PE class, the teacher asked us to walk backward across the gym without looking behind us, and it was fun.
體育課時，老師要我們不回頭看地往後走穿過體育館，真的很好玩。
backward and forward: The little boy moved backward and forward on the swing in the park until his mother called him home for dinner.
小男孩在公園的鞦韆上來回地搖著，直到媽媽叫他回家吃晚餐。
count backward: On New Year's Eve, everyone in the square counted backward from ten and cheered when the clock hit twelve.
跨年夜時，廣場上每個人從十開始倒數，當時鐘指到十二點時大家歡呼起來。
a bad cold: Lisa caught a bad cold after playing in the rain, so she stayed in bed for two days.
麗莎在雨中玩耍後得了重感冒，所以她在床上躺了兩天。
bad weather: Because of the bad weather, the school sports day was put off until next Wednesday afternoon.
因為壞天氣，學校運動會延到下週三下午舉行。
go bad: The milk went bad because someone left it on the table all day instead of putting it in the refrigerator.
牛奶變壞了，因為有人把它放在桌上一整天，而沒有放進冰箱。
a bad habit: Biting your nails is a bad habit, so my mother always tells me to stop when she sees me doing it.
咬指甲是壞習慣，所以我媽媽每次看到我在咬，就會叫我停下來。
feel bad about: I feel bad about forgetting my best friend's birthday, so I am going to buy her a special gift today.
我對忘了最好朋友的生日感到難過，所以今天我要買一個特別的禮物給她。
not bad: I got eighty points on the English test, which is not bad because the test was really difficult this time.
我英文考了八十分，這還不錯，因為這次的考試真的很難。
too bad: It is too bad that you cannot come to the show with us, because your favorite singer will be there.
真可惜你不能和我們一起去看表演，因為你最喜歡的歌手會在那裡。
a bad tooth: Peter has a bad tooth because he eats too much candy, so his mom took him to the dentist today.
彼得因為吃太多糖果而有一顆蛀牙，所以他媽媽今天帶他去看牙醫。
be bad at math: I am bad at math, so my older sister helps me with my homework every night after dinner.
我數學不好，所以我姊姊每天晚餐後都幫我做功課。
be bad for your health: Eating too much fast food is bad for your health, so try to have more vegetables and fruit every day.
吃太多速食對健康不好，所以每天盡量多吃蔬菜和水果。
be bad with names: My uncle is bad with names, so he often calls my friends by the wrong names when they visit us.
我叔叔記不住名字，所以我朋友來家裡時，他常常叫錯他們的名字。
basic needs: Food, water, and a safe place to sleep are basic needs that every person in the world should have.
食物、水和一個安全的睡覺地方是每個人都應該擁有的基本需求。
basic English: My grandmother is learning basic English at the center near our home so that she can talk to foreign visitors in the night market.
我奶奶在我們家附近的中心學基礎英語，這樣她就可以在夜市和外國遊客聊天。
the basic idea: The basic idea of the game is simple, and you just have to find the hidden eggs before the other team does.
這個遊戲的基本概念很簡單，你只要在另一隊之前找到藏起來的蛋就好。
basic skills: Reading, writing, and using a computer are basic skills that students need to learn before they finish school.
閱讀、寫作和使用電腦是學生在畢業前需要學會的基本技能。
a beautiful day: It was such a beautiful day that our family decided to ride bikes along the river instead of staying home.
那天天氣好極了，所以我們家決定沿著河邊騎腳踏車，而不是待在家裡。
a beautiful voice: Amy has a beautiful voice, so her friends asked her to sing a song at the Christmas party this year.
艾美有美妙的聲音，所以朋友們請她今年在聖誕派對上唱一首歌。
a beautiful goal: In the last minute of the soccer game, Kevin scored a beautiful goal and the whole school cheered loudly.
足球賽的最後一分鐘，凱文踢進一顆漂亮的進球，全校都大聲歡呼。
beautiful weather: We had beautiful weather during our trip to the beach, so we swam in the sea every morning and afternoon.
我們去海邊旅行時一直是好天氣，所以我們每天早上和下午都在海裡游泳。
a big mouth: Don't tell Jack your secret, because he has a big mouth and the whole class will know about it by lunch.
不要把你的祕密告訴傑克，因為他是個大嘴巴，午餐前全班就都會知道了。
a big day: Tomorrow is a big day for my sister because she will play the piano on stage for the first time in the evening.
明天對我姊姊來說是重要的日子，因為她晚上要第一次在舞台上彈鋼琴。
a big fan of: My father is a big fan of baseball, and he never misses a game when his favorite team plays on TV.
我爸爸是棒球的鐵粉，只要他最喜歡的球隊在電視上比賽，他從不錯過。
a big eater: My brother is a big eater, so Mom always cooks three bowls of rice just for him at dinner.
我哥哥是個食量大的人，所以媽媽晚餐總是只為他就煮三碗飯。
my big brother: My big brother is in high school now, and he teaches me math whenever I have trouble with it.
我哥哥現在念高中，每當我數學有困難時，他就教我。
a big deal: Getting a B on one small quiz is not a big deal, so stop worrying and get ready for the next one.
一次小考拿到 B 不是什麼大事，所以別再擔心了，準備好下一次考試吧。
a big decision: Choosing a high school is a big decision, so talk with your parents and teachers before you decide.
選擇高中是個重大決定，所以在決定之前先和你的父母和老師談談。
think big: Our teacher always tells us to think big, because small dreams will never take us very far in life.
我們老師總是告訴我們要有遠大想法，因為小小的夢想永遠不會帶我們在人生中走得很遠。
a bitter cold wind: A bitter cold wind blew across the playground this morning, so we all wore thick coats and warm gloves.
今天早上一陣刺骨的寒風吹過操場，所以我們都穿著厚外套、戴著溫暖的手套。
a bitter lesson: Losing all my money on the trip taught me a bitter lesson, and now I keep my wallet in a safe place.
旅行時弄丟所有的錢給了我一個慘痛的教訓，現在我都把皮夾放在安全的地方。
bitter tears: The old man cried bitter tears when he heard that his small shop would have to close after forty years.
當老先生聽到他開了四十年的小店必須關門時，他流下了苦澀的淚水。
to the bitter end: Our team was losing by twenty points, but the players kept fighting to the bitter end and never gave up.
我們的球隊落後二十分，但球員們直到最後都持續奮戰，從未放棄。
black tea: My grandmother drinks a cup of hot black tea with a little milk every morning before she reads the newspaper.
我奶奶每天早上看報紙前都會喝一杯加一點牛奶的熱紅茶。
black coffee: My father likes black coffee without any sugar or milk, but I think it tastes too bitter for me.
我爸爸喜歡不加糖也不加牛奶的黑咖啡，但我覺得對我來說太苦了。
a black eye: Tom got a black eye when the basketball hit his face during the game, so he put some ice on it.
湯姆比賽時被籃球打到臉，眼睛被打到瘀青，所以他在上面冰敷。
black and blue: After falling off his bike, Jerry was black and blue all over, but luckily he did not break any bones.
從腳踏車上摔下來後，傑瑞全身遍體鱗傷，但幸運的是他沒有骨折。
in black and white: Before you rent the apartment, make sure everything you agreed on is in black and white so there are no problems later.
在你租下公寓之前，要確定你們同意的所有事項都白紙黑字寫下來，這樣以後才不會有問題。
a blank look: When the teacher asked Jason about yesterday's homework, he just gave her a blank look because he had forgotten all about it.
當老師問傑森昨天的作業時，他只給了她一個茫然的表情，因為他完全忘了這件事。
fill in the blanks: In the first part of the English test, we had to fill in the blanks with the correct words from the box.
英文考試的第一部分，我們必須用方框裡正確的字來填空。
a blank page: The art teacher gave each of us a blank page and asked us to draw our favorite place in the city.
美術老師給我們每個人一張空白頁，請我們畫出城市裡自己最喜歡的地方。
my mind went blank: When I stood up to give my speech in front of the school, my mind went blank and I forgot every word.
當我站起來在全校面前演講時，我腦中一片空白，忘了每一個字。
a blank check: The rich man gave his son a blank check, so the boy could write any number he wanted on it.
那位有錢人給了兒子一張空白支票，所以男孩可以在上面寫下任何他想要的數字。
turn a blind eye to: The teacher cannot turn a blind eye to students who cheat on tests, so she always watches the class carefully.
老師不能對考試作弊的學生視而不見，所以她總是仔細地看著全班。
be blind to the danger: The boys were blind to the danger of swimming in the river after the heavy rain, so their teacher stopped them.
男孩們看不見大雨過後在河裡游泳的危險，所以他們的老師阻止了他們。
the blind: Our school club raised money for the blind, and we used it to buy books that they can read with their fingers.
我們學校社團為盲人募款，我們用這些錢買了他們可以用手指閱讀的書。
a blind date: My aunt went on a blind date last Saturday, and she said the man was kind and funny but talked too much.
我阿姨上週六去了一場相親約會，她說那個男人善良又風趣，但話太多了。
blind love: Her blind love for the famous singer made her spend all her money on tickets to his shows and his pictures.
她對那位名歌手盲目的愛讓她把所有的錢都花在他的表演門票和照片上。
feel blue: Whenever I feel blue after a bad day at school, I listen to my favorite songs and call my best friend.
每當我在學校過了糟糕的一天而心情憂鬱時，我就聽我最喜歡的歌，然後打電話給我最好的朋友。
out of the blue: Out of the blue, my old friend from my first school called me last night, and we talked for over an hour.
昨晚我以前小學的老朋友突如其來地打電話給我，我們聊了一個多小時。
once in a blue moon: My uncle lives in America, so we only see him once in a blue moon, usually at Chinese New Year.
我叔叔住在美國，所以我們千載難逢才見他一次，通常是在農曆新年。
a blue sky: After three days of rain, we finally woke up to a blue sky and went out to play basketball in the park.
下了三天雨之後，我們終於在藍天下醒來，並出門到公園打籃球。
be bored with the movie: We were so bored with the movie that we left the theater early and went to get some ice cream instead.
我們對那部電影感到很無聊，所以我們提早離開電影院，改去買冰淇淋。
a boring movie: It was such a boring movie that half of the people in the theater were bored and fell asleep before the end.
那是一部很無聊的電影，電影院裡一半的人都覺得無聊，還沒結束就睡著了。
bored 人感到無聊: I'm bored because there is nothing to do on this rainy Sunday, so let's play a board game together.
這個下雨的星期天沒事做，我覺得很無聊，所以我們一起玩桌遊吧。
boring 事物令人無聊: This TV show is boring, and I'm already bored after only ten minutes, so let's watch something else.
這個電視節目很無聊（事物令人無聊），才十分鐘我就已經覺得無聊了（人感到無聊），所以我們看別的吧。
get bored easily: My little sister gets bored easily, so she never finishes a book and always wants to play a new game.
我的小妹很容易覺得無聊，所以她從來沒讀完一本書，而且總是想玩新的遊戲。
a boring class: Many students fell asleep in the boring class because the teacher only read from the book for fifty minutes.
很多學生在那堂無聊的課上睡著了，因為老師五十分鐘都只照著書本念。
a boring person: Nobody wants to sit next to Fred at lunch because he is a boring person who only talks about his homework.
午餐時沒有人想坐在弗雷德旁邊，因為他是個無趣的人，只會談他的功課。
boring work: Washing dishes every night is boring work, but my mother says it teaches me to help out at home.
每天晚上洗碗是乏味的工作，但我媽媽說這能教我在家幫忙。
It's so boring to wait in the long line at the post office, so I always bring a book to read.
在郵局排長長的隊好無聊，所以我總是帶一本書來讀。
a boring speech: The principal gave a boring speech for thirty minutes, and most of the students stopped listening after the first five.
校長講了三十分鐘無聊的演講，大部分學生在前五分鐘之後就不聽了。
be born in 2010: My little cousin was born in 2010, and she is now a student at the same school as me in Taipei.
我的小表妹二〇一〇年出生，她現在和我在台北念同一所學校。
be born to be a star: Everyone says Amy was born to be a star because she sings and dances so well on the school stage.
大家都說艾美天生是明星，因為她在學校舞台上唱歌跳舞都很棒。
a born leader: Kevin is a born leader, so the students in his class chose him to be the class leader for the second year.
凱文是天生的領導者，所以班上的學生第二年又選他當班長。
born and raised in Taiwan: Although my mother is from Japan, I was born and raised in Taiwan and I speak Chinese better than Japanese.
雖然我媽媽來自日本，但我在台灣出生長大，而且我的中文說得比日文好。
be born with: Some people are born with a good sense of music, but most of us have to practice hard to play well.
有些人生來就有很好的音樂感，但我們大多數人必須努力練習才能演奏得好。
be brave enough to: Mary was brave enough to tell the teacher the truth about the broken window, even though her friends were angry.
瑪麗夠勇敢去告訴老師窗戶破掉的真相，即使她的朋友們很生氣。
a brave face: Although he was very nervous before the big game, the young player showed a brave face to the whole team.
雖然大賽前他非常緊張，這位年輕球員仍對全隊展現出勇敢的表情。
put on a brave face: My sister put on a brave face when she said goodbye at the airport, but I knew she wanted to cry.
我姊姊在機場道別時強裝勇敢，但我知道她想哭。
the brave: Every year on this day, our town holds a big party to remember the brave who saved people from the big fire.
每年的這一天，我們鎮上都會舉辦大型活動，紀念那些從大火中救人的勇者。
a bright student: Emma is a bright student who always understands new math ideas quickly and helps her friends after class.
艾瑪是個聰明的學生，她總是很快就懂新的數學概念，而且下課後會幫助朋友。
a bright future: If you work hard and keep learning, you will have a bright future no matter which job you choose.
如果你努力並持續學習，不論你選擇什麼工作，都會有光明的未來。
a bright idea: Jenny had a bright idea for the school fair, so we decided to sell cookies and lemon tea that we make ourselves.
珍妮為園遊會想了一個好點子，所以我們決定賣自己做的餅乾和檸檬茶。
a bright smile: The little girl gave her grandfather a bright smile when he brought her a puppy as a birthday present.
當爺爺帶一隻小狗來當生日禮物時，小女孩給了他一個燦爛的笑容。
the bright side: We lost the game, but look on the bright side, because now we have more time to practice for the finals.
我們輸了比賽，但看看好的一面，因為現在我們有更多時間為決賽練習。
bright colors: Children usually like bright colors like red and yellow, so the new kindergarten was painted in those colors.
小孩通常喜歡紅色和黃色這類鮮豔的顏色，所以新的幼兒園就漆成了那些顏色。
bright and early: We got up bright and early on Sunday to catch the first train to the mountains for our hiking trip.
星期天我們一大早就起床，去搭第一班往山上的火車，展開健行之旅。
a broad smile: Dad had a broad smile on his face when he saw my report card, because my grades were much better this time.
爸爸看到我的成績單時臉上露出開懷的笑容，因為我這次的成績好多了。
broad shoulders: The swimmer has broad shoulders and strong arms because he practices in the pool for three hours every day.
這位游泳選手有寬闊的肩膀和強壯的手臂，因為他每天在泳池練習三小時。
a broad view: Traveling to different countries gives you a broad view of the world and helps you understand other people better.
到不同的國家旅行能給你對世界廣闊的視野，並幫助你更了解其他人。
brown bread: My mother buys brown bread instead of white bread because she says it is better for our health.
我媽媽買全麥麵包而不買白麵包，因為她說全麥麵包對我們的健康比較好。
brown rice: Grandpa eats brown rice with every meal because the doctor told him it is healthier than white rice.
爺爺每餐都吃糙米，因為醫生告訴他糙米比白米更健康。
brown sugar: The sweet soup tastes better with a little brown sugar, so my aunt always adds some when she cooks it.
這道甜湯加一點紅糖更好喝，所以我阿姨煮的時候總是會加一些。
get brown in the sun: After a week at the beach, my skin got brown in the sun, and my friends almost did not know me.
在海邊待了一週後，我的皮膚曬黑了，朋友們差點認不出我。
be busy with homework: I was busy with homework all weekend, so I did not have time to watch my favorite TV show.
我整個週末都忙著做功課，所以沒有時間看我最喜歡的電視節目。
be busy doing: Mom is busy cooking dinner in the kitchen right now, so please help your little brother with his homework.
媽媽現在正忙於在廚房做晚餐，所以請你幫弟弟做功課。
a busy street: Our school is on a busy street, so the teachers always tell us to be careful when we cross the road.
我們學校在一條熱鬧的街道上，所以老師總是告訴我們過馬路時要小心。
a busy day: After a busy day of classes and club practice, I was so tired that I went to bed at nine.
經過忙碌的一天的上課和社團練習後，我累到九點就上床睡覺了。
I have tried to call the restaurant three times to book a table, but the line is busy every time.
我已經打了三次電話到餐廳想訂位，但每次電話都忙線中。
keep busy: After my grandfather stopped working, he kept busy by growing vegetables and teaching kids to play chess.
我爺爺退休後，靠著種菜和教小朋友下西洋棋來保持忙碌。
busy 忙的（人、街道、電話）: It was a busy day at the night market, and the busy shop owners did not have time to sit down.
那天夜市是忙碌的一天，忙碌的店老闆們連坐下來的時間都沒有（busy 形容人、街道、電話）。
business 生意（名詞）: My uncle is always busy because he does business with many stores in Japan and travels there every month.
我叔叔總是很忙，因為他和日本很多商店做生意（business 是名詞），而且每個月都去那裡。
busily 忙碌地（副詞）: The busy waiters worked busily in the restaurant because more than a hundred people came for lunch on Sunday.
忙碌的服務生們在餐廳裡忙碌地工作（busily 是副詞），因為星期天有一百多人來吃午餐。
crowded 擁擠的: The train was so crowded this morning that I could not find a seat, and the busy station was full of people too.
今天早上火車非常擁擠，我找不到座位，而忙碌的車站也擠滿了人。
keep calm: When the fire alarm rang, our teacher told us to keep calm and walk slowly to the playground in a line.
火災警報響起時，老師告訴我們要保持冷靜，排成一列慢慢走到操場。
calm down: My little brother cried for an hour after losing his toy, but he finally calmed down when Mom gave him some cookies.
我的小弟弟弄丟玩具後哭了一個小時，但媽媽給他一些餅乾後，他終於冷靜下來了。
the calm sea: We sat on the beach and watched the calm sea in the evening, and the setting sun turned the water gold.
傍晚我們坐在沙灘上看著平靜的海，落日把海水染成了金色。
a calm voice: Even though the children were shouting, the nurse spoke in a calm voice and told them everything would be fine.
雖然孩子們在大叫，護士仍用平靜的聲音說話，告訴他們一切都會沒事。
stay calm: It is important to stay calm during an earthquake, so get under a strong table and cover your head.
地震時保持鎮定很重要，所以要躲到堅固的桌子下並保護頭部。
be careful of cars: Be careful of cars when you ride your bike to school, because the road near the market is always busy.
你騎腳踏車上學時要小心車子，因為市場附近的路總是很繁忙。
be careful with money: My parents taught me to be careful with money, so I always save half of my pocket money every month.
我的父母教我用錢要小心，所以我每個月總是存下一半的零用錢。
be careful about what you say: You should be careful about what you say to Lisa today, because she is still sad about losing the game.
你今天對麗莎說話要小心，因為她還在為輸了比賽而難過。
be careful not to fall: The floor in the bathroom is wet, so please be careful not to fall when you go in to take a shower.
浴室的地板是濕的，所以你進去洗澡時請小心別跌倒。
Be careful!: Be careful, the soup is very hot and you might burn your tongue if you drink it too fast right now.
小心！湯很燙，如果你現在喝太快，可能會燙到舌頭。
careful 小心的（形容詞）: My father is a careful driver who always slows down near schools and never uses his phone in the car.
我爸爸是個小心的駕駛，他在學校附近總是減速，在車上也從不用手機。
carefully 小心地（副詞）: Mom is a careful driver, and she always drives carefully when it rains because the roads become wet and dangerous.
媽媽是個小心的駕駛，下雨時她總是小心地開車（carefully 是副詞），因為路面會變得又濕又危險。
care 照顧／在乎（名詞、動詞）: Take care of yourself and be careful on the mountain roads, Grandma said as we got into the car.
我們上車時，奶奶說：要好好照顧自己（take care），山路上要小心。
careless 粗心的: Tom is a careless boy who often loses his pens, but his older brother is careful and never loses anything.
湯姆是個粗心的男孩，常常弄丟筆，但他哥哥很小心，從來不會弄丟任何東西。
a careless mistake: I made a careless mistake on the math test by writing the wrong number, so I lost five points.
我在數學考試中寫錯了數字，犯了一個粗心的錯誤，所以被扣了五分。
careless driving: Careless driving causes many accidents every year, so drivers should never look at their phones on the road.
粗心開車每年造成許多事故，所以駕駛人在路上絕對不應該看手機。
be careless about: Jack is careless about his things, so he leaves his jacket and water bottle somewhere at school almost every week.
傑克對自己的東西漫不經心，所以他幾乎每週都把外套和水壺忘在學校某個地方。
careless with money: My cousin is careless with money, and he spends all of his pocket money on games in the first week.
我表哥很亂花錢，他在第一個星期就把所有零用錢都花在遊戲上。
central Taiwan: My grandmother and grandfather live in central Taiwan, where the weather is warm and the farmers grow lots of sweet fruit.
我的爺爺奶奶住在中台灣，那裡天氣溫暖，農夫們種了很多甜美的水果。
the central idea: After reading the story twice, we talked about the central idea and why the writer gave it a sad ending.
讀了兩遍故事之後，我們討論了它的中心思想，以及為什麼作者給它一個悲傷的結局。
central heating: Our house in Japan has central heating, so every room stays warm when it snows outside in winter.
我們在日本的房子有中央暖氣，所以冬天外面下雪時，每個房間都很溫暖。
play a central part: Practice plays a central part in winning a basketball game, so our coach asks us to pass the ball more.
練習在贏得籃球比賽中扮演核心角色，所以教練要我們多傳球。
be certain of success: Amy practiced the piano every night for a month, so she was certain of success before the big show.
艾咪一個月來每晚都練鋼琴，所以在大型表演前她確信會成功。
be certain that: I am certain that Tom will pass the English test because he has studied hard for two weeks.
我確定湯姆會通過英文考試，因為他已經努力讀書兩個星期了。
make certain: Before you leave the house, please make certain that all the windows are closed and the lights are off.
你出門前，請確認所有的窗戶都關好，燈也都關掉了。
for certain: Nobody knows for certain when the rain will stop, so we should bring our umbrellas to the park today.
沒有人能確定地知道雨什麼時候會停，所以我們今天去公園應該帶傘。
a certain Mr. Lin: A certain Mr. Lin called the office this morning and said he wanted to talk to our teacher about the trip.
某位林先生今天早上打電話到辦公室，說他想和我們的老師談談旅行的事。
certain people: Certain people in my class never bring their homework, so the teacher often gets angry with them in the morning.
我班上某些人從來不帶作業，所以老師早上常常對他們生氣。
to a certain degree: To a certain degree, I agree with my mother, but I still think I am old enough to go camping alone.
在某種程度上我同意媽媽的話，但我還是覺得自己已經夠大，可以獨自去露營。
cheap and nice: The noodles at the night market are cheap and nice, so my family eats there almost every Friday night.
夜市的麵便宜又好，所以我們家幾乎每個星期五晚上都去那裡吃。
a cheap trick: Hiding my shoes before the race was a cheap trick, and I was really angry at my brother for a day.
在比賽前把我的鞋子藏起來是個低級的把戲，我整整一天都在生弟弟的氣。
talk is cheap: You always say you will study harder, but talk is cheap, so show me your test score next week.
你總是說你會更努力讀書，但光說不練沒有用，下週把你的考試成績拿給我看吧。
cheap 便宜的（物）: Linda bought a cheap bag at the night market for only two hundred dollars, and it looks quite nice.
琳達在夜市只花兩百元買了一個便宜的包包，而且看起來還不錯。
low 低的（價格）: The shop sells these cheap shoes at a low price, so many students buy them before the school year starts.
這家店以低的價格賣這些便宜的鞋子，所以很多學生在開學前都會去買。
expensive 貴的（物）: My uncle drives an expensive car, but he still buys cheap lunch boxes from the small store near his office.
我叔叔開一輛昂貴的車，但他還是在辦公室附近的小店買便宜的便當。
high 高的（價格）: That cheap watch broke in a week, but my sister paid a high price for hers and it still works well.
那支便宜的手錶一個星期就壞了，但我姊姊花高的價格買的那支還是好好的。
childish 幼稚的（負面）: Crying loudly in the restaurant because you did not get ice cream is childish behavior for a twelve-year-old boy.
因為沒吃到冰淇淋就在餐廳裡大哭，對一個十二歲的男孩來說是幼稚的行為。
childlike 天真的（正面）: My grandfather has a childlike smile when he plays with his dog, but he is never childish at work.
我爺爺和他的狗玩的時候有著天真的笑容，但他在工作上從不幼稚。
Don't be so childish and share the cookies with your little sister, or Mom will take them all away.
別這麼幼稚，把餅乾分給你妹妹，不然媽媽會把餅乾全部拿走。
chubby cheeks: The baby has chubby cheeks and big round eyes, so everyone on the bus wants to say hello to her.
這個寶寶有圓胖的臉頰和又大又圓的眼睛，所以公車上每個人都想跟她打招呼。
a chubby baby: My aunt showed us a picture of her chubby baby, and we all laughed because he looked like a little ball.
阿姨給我們看她胖嘟嘟的寶寶的照片，我們都笑了，因為他看起來像顆小球。
get chubby: Our cat is getting chubby because my little brother gives her too many snacks after school every day.
我們的貓變圓潤了，因為我弟弟每天放學後都給她太多零食。
classical music: My father listens to classical music in the car on the way to work because it helps him feel calm.
我爸爸上班途中會在車上聽古典音樂，因為那能幫助他放鬆。
classical 古典的: Judy has learned classical dance since she was five, and she will dance on stage at the school show.
茱蒂從五歲起就學古典舞蹈，她將在學校表演的舞台上演出。
a clear sky: There is a clear sky tonight without any clouds, so we can see hundreds of stars from the roof.
今晚天空晴朗，沒有任何雲，所以我們可以從屋頂看到數百顆星星。
a clear voice: The new singer has a clear voice, and everyone in the hall could hear every word of her song.
這位新歌手有清楚的聲音，大廳裡的每個人都能聽到她歌曲的每一個字。
make it clear: The teacher made it clear that we must hand in our reports before Friday, or we will lose points.
老師講清楚了，我們必須在星期五前交報告，否則會被扣分。
be clear about: Are you clear about the rules of the game, or do you want me to explain them one more time?
你對遊戲規則清楚了嗎？還是要我再解釋一次？
clear water: The river near my grandmother's house has clear water, and we can see small fish swimming near the rocks.
我外婆家附近的河有清澈的水，我們可以看到小魚在石頭旁游來游去。
Is that clear?: Put your phones in your bags and do not talk to anyone during the test, is that clear?
把手機放進書包，考試時不要和任何人說話，清楚了嗎？
keep clear of: Please keep clear of the big dog next door because it barks loudly and sometimes tries to bite people.
請遠離隔壁那隻大狗，因為它會大聲叫，有時還會想咬人。
a clear answer: When I asked Dad if we could go to Japan this summer, he did not give me a clear answer.
當我問爸爸今年夏天可不可以去日本時，他沒有給我明確的答案。
a clever idea: Using an old box to make a bed for the cat outside was a clever idea, and the cat loves it.
用舊箱子幫外面的貓做一張床是個聰明的點子，而且那隻貓很喜歡。
a clever trick: The magician did a clever trick with three cups and a ball, and nobody could tell where the ball went.
魔術師用三個杯子和一顆球表演了一個高明的把戲，沒有人看得出球到哪裡去了。
be clever at math: Kevin is clever at math, so his friends often ask him for help before the big test on Monday.
凱文擅長數學，所以同學們常在星期一大考前請他幫忙。
be clever with one's hands: My grandmother is clever with her hands, and she can make a beautiful dress from old clothes in two days.
我奶奶手很巧，她能在兩天內用舊布做出一件漂亮的洋裝。
a cloudy day: It was a cloudy day, so we did not go to the beach and watched a movie at home instead.
那天是陰天，所以我們沒去海邊，而是在家看了一部電影。
cloudy water: After the heavy rain, the small pond behind our school was full of cloudy water, and we could not see the fish.
大雨過後，我們學校後面的小池塘裡滿是混濁的水，我們看不到魚。
a cloudy memory: I only have a cloudy memory of my first day at school, but I remember that I cried a lot.
我對上學第一天只有模糊的記憶，但我記得我哭了很久。
cloudy skies: We saw cloudy skies when we woke up, so my mother told us to bring our raincoats to school.
我們醒來時看到陰沉的天空，所以媽媽叫我們帶雨衣去學校。
a cold look: When I came home late again, my father gave me a cold look and did not say a word at dinner.
當我又晚回家時，爸爸給了我一個冷漠的眼神，晚餐時一句話也沒說。
catch a cold: Wear your jacket when you go out tonight, or you may catch a cold in this windy and wet weather.
今晚出門要穿外套，不然在這種又颳風又濕的天氣裡你可能會感冒。
have a bad cold: Mary has a bad cold, so she stayed in bed all day and could not come to the party.
瑪莉得了重感冒，所以她整天躺在床上，無法來參加派對。
give sb. the cold shoulder: After the fight, Jenny gave Tom the cold shoulder for a week and did not even look at him in class.
吵架之後，珍妮冷落湯姆一個星期，在教室裡連看都不看他一眼。
in cold blood: In the movie, the bad man killed the old king in cold blood, and all the children covered their eyes.
電影裡，壞人冷血地殺了老國王，所有的小孩都遮住了眼睛。
cold feet: Peter wanted to sing on stage at the school show, but he got cold feet and ran back to his seat.
彼得想在學校表演的舞台上唱歌，但他臨陣退縮，跑回了座位。
cold 冷（形容詞）: It's cold outside this morning, so my mother asked me to wear a warm coat and a hat to school.
今天早上外面很冷，所以媽媽要我穿暖和的大衣、戴帽子去學校。
a cold 感冒（名詞）: Ben has a cold today, so he is drinking hot water and will not play basketball with us after school.
班今天感冒了，所以他在喝熱水，放學後不會和我們打籃球。
cool 涼爽／酷: It was a cool day in October, not cold at all, so we rode our bikes to the river for a picnic.
那是十月一個涼爽的日子，一點也不冷，所以我們騎腳踏車到河邊野餐。
a colorful life: My grandmother had a colorful life because she lived in five countries and worked as a nurse, a cook, and a teacher.
我奶奶過了多彩多姿的生活，因為她住過五個國家，當過護士、廚師和老師。
a colorful story: Grandpa told us a colorful story about his trip to the mountains, and we all listened with big eyes.
爺爺跟我們講了一個關於他山上之旅的生動故事，我們都睜大眼睛聽著。
colorful fish: We saw many colorful fish swimming in the clear sea water when we visited Green Island last summer.
去年夏天我們去綠島時，看到許多色彩鮮豔的魚在清澈的海水裡游來游去。
be comfortable with: Lily is not comfortable with speaking English in front of the class, so she always speaks in a small voice.
莉莉對在全班面前說英文感到不自在，所以她總是小聲地說。
make yourself comfortable: Please come in and make yourself comfortable on the sofa while I get you a cup of tea from the kitchen.
請進來，在沙發上請隨意，我去廚房幫你倒杯茶。
a comfortable chair: Dad bought a comfortable chair for his study, and now he reads the newspaper there for an hour every evening.
爸爸為他的書房買了一張舒服的椅子，現在他每天晚上都在那裡看一小時的報紙。
feel comfortable: I feel comfortable when I wear my old T-shirt and shorts at home after a long day at school.
在學校待了一整天後，回家穿上舊T恤和短褲時，我感到很舒適。
a comfortable life: My parents work very hard every day because they want to give my sister and me a comfortable life.
我父母每天都很努力工作，因為他們想給我和姊姊舒適的生活。
common sense: It is just common sense to look both ways before you cross a busy street, but many people forget to do it.
過繁忙的馬路前先看看兩邊只是常識，但很多人都忘了這麼做。
have much in common: Jack and I have much in common because we both love baseball, comic books, and chocolate ice cream.
傑克和我有很多共同點，因為我們都喜歡棒球、漫畫和巧克力冰淇淋。
a common mistake: Spelling the word Wednesday wrong is a common mistake, so check your sentences carefully before you hand them in.
把「星期三」這個英文字拼錯是常見的錯誤，所以交作業前要仔細檢查你的句子。
a common cold: The doctor said it was just a common cold, so I only needed to rest and drink more warm water.
醫生說那只是普通感冒，所以我只需要休息、多喝溫水。
the common people: In the old days, only kings and rich men could go to school, and the common people could not read.
在古代，只有國王和有錢人能上學，一般人都不會讀書識字。
common knowledge: It is common knowledge that Mr. Wang is the most serious teacher in our school, so no one talks in his class.
王老師是我們學校最嚴格的老師，這是眾所周知的事，所以沒有人在他的課上講話。
a complete stranger: My mother told me never to get into a car with a complete stranger, even if he says he knows her.
媽媽告訴我絕對不要和完全不認識的人上車，即使他說他認識她。
a complete surprise: The birthday party was a complete surprise to Helen because her friends had kept the plan secret for two weeks.
這場生日派對對海倫來說完全出乎意料，因為她的朋友們把計畫保密了兩個星期。
a complete set: Jason finally got a complete set of the comic books after he saved his pocket money for half a year.
傑森存了半年的零用錢後，終於買到了一整套的漫畫。
complete silence: There was complete silence in the room when the teacher walked in with our test papers in her hand.
當老師手裡拿著我們的考卷走進來時，教室裡一片完全的寂靜。
be convenient for you: If it is convenient for you, could we meet at the library at three instead of two this Saturday?
如果對你方便的話，這個星期六我們可以改在三點而不是兩點在圖書館見面嗎？
at a convenient time: Please call me back at a convenient time this week, because I want to ask you about the English homework.
請這週在方便的時間回電給我，因為我想問你英文作業的事。
a convenient store: There is a convenient store right next to our apartment, so we can buy milk and bread at any time.
我們的公寓旁邊就有一家便利的商店，所以我們隨時都能買到牛奶和麵包。
It's convenient to: It's convenient to take the MRT to school because the station is only a five-minute walk from my house.
搭捷運上學很方便，因為捷運站離我家只要走五分鐘。
convenient 方便的（事物作主詞）: We live near the train station and a big supermarket, so it's convenient for shopping and traveling every day.
我們住在火車站和大超市附近，所以每天購物和出門都很方便。
convenience store 便利商店: Tina works at a convenience store near the school, and it is very convenient for students to buy drinks there.
蒂娜在學校附近的便利商店工作，學生去那裡買飲料非常方便。
conveniently 方便地: Our new house is conveniently located near the MRT station, so it is convenient for Dad to get to work.
我們的新家方便地位於捷運站附近，所以爸爸上班很方便。
comfortable 舒服的: The hotel was in a convenient place near the beach, and each room had a comfortable bed and a big window.
這家飯店位於海邊附近方便的地點，每間房都有舒服的床和大窗戶。
stay cool: When the fire alarm rang, our teacher told us to stay cool and walk out of the building slowly.
火警鈴響時，老師要我們保持冷靜，慢慢走出大樓。
a cool guy: Everyone thinks Jack is a cool guy because he plays the guitar well and is always kind to new students.
大家都覺得傑克是個很酷的人，因為他吉他彈得很好，而且總是對新同學很友善。
Cool!: Cool, I can't believe you got tickets to the baseball game, so can I go with you on Saturday?
酷！我真不敢相信你拿到了棒球賽的門票，星期六我可以跟你一起去嗎？
keep cool: Try to keep cool during the English test, because you will make fewer mistakes when you are not nervous.
英文考試時試著保持冷靜，因為不緊張時你犯的錯會比較少。
a cool drink: After running around the park for an hour, we sat under a tree and enjoyed a cool drink together.
在公園跑了一個小時後，我們坐在樹下，一起享用冷飲。
cool colors: My sister painted her room in cool colors like blue and green because they make her feel calm and happy.
我姊姊把房間漆成藍色和綠色這類的冷色，因為它們讓她感到平靜又放鬆。
the correct answer: Only three students in our class wrote the correct answer to the last math question on the test yesterday.
我們班只有三個學生在昨天的考試中寫出最後一題數學的正確答案。
correct the mistakes: The teacher asked us to correct the mistakes in our writing and hand it in again before Friday morning.
老師要我們改正作文裡的錯誤，並在星期五早上前再交一次。
That's correct, the biggest city in Japan is Tokyo, and you will get one more point for your team today.
沒錯，日本的首都是東京，你們這隊今天會再多得一分。
be crazy about baseball: My little brother is crazy about baseball, so he watches every game on TV and sleeps with his glove.
我弟弟瘋狂愛上棒球，所以他看電視上的每一場比賽，還抱著手套睡覺。
go crazy: The fans went crazy when the singer walked on the stage and started singing their favorite song.
當歌手走上舞台開始唱他們最愛的歌時，粉絲們都發瘋了。
drive sb. crazy: The loud noise from the road work outside is driving me crazy, and I cannot finish my homework at all.
外面馬路施工的噪音快把我逼瘋了，我根本沒辦法寫完作業。
a crazy idea: Swimming in the river in the middle of winter sounds like a crazy idea, but my cousins do it every year.
在冬天中旬去河裡游泳聽起來像個瘋狂的想法，但我的表哥們每年都這麼做。
like crazy: We studied like crazy the night before the final exam, so we were all very tired the next morning.
期末考前一晚我們拚命地讀書，所以第二天早上我們都很累。
be crowded with people: The night market was crowded with people on Saturday night, so it took us an hour to buy dinner.
星期六晚上夜市擠滿人，所以我們花了一個小時才買到晚餐。
a crowded bus: I had to stand on a crowded bus for forty minutes this morning, so my legs are very tired now.
今天早上我在擠滿人的公車上站了四十分鐘，所以現在我的腿好累。
get crowded: The swimming pool gets crowded in the afternoon, so my father always takes us there early in the morning.
游泳池下午會變得擁擠，所以爸爸總是一早就帶我們去。
crowded 擠滿人的（地方）: We waited in a crowded room at the hospital for two hours, and there was no place to sit down.
我們在醫院一間擠滿人的房間裡等了兩小時，連坐下的位子都沒有。
a crowd 一群人（名詞）: A big crowd stood in front of the stage, so the square was crowded and we could not see the singer.
一大群人站在舞台前面，所以廣場擠滿了人，我們看不到歌手。
busy 繁忙的: Our school is on a busy street, so the sidewalk is always crowded with students and parents at four o'clock.
我們學校位於一條繁忙的街道上，所以四點時人行道上總是擠滿了學生和家長。
full 滿的: We saw a full bus pass by without stopping, and the next one was just as crowded as the first.
我們看到一輛滿的公車沒停就開過去了，下一輛和第一輛一樣擠滿了人。
be cruel to animals: Do not be cruel to animals, because they feel pain just like we do when someone hits them.
不要對動物殘忍，因為有人打它們時，它們和我們一樣會感到痛。
a cruel joke: Telling Amy that her cat was dead was a cruel joke, and she cried a lot before she found out the truth.
告訴艾咪她的貓死了是個殘酷的玩笑，她在知道真相前哭了很久。
cruel words: Jenny said some cruel words to her best friend when she was angry, and now she feels very sorry.
珍妮生氣時對她最好的朋友說了一些傷人的話，現在她覺得很抱歉。
be curious about: My little sister is curious about everything, so she asks my parents at least fifty questions every day.
我妹妹對每件事都很好奇，所以她每天至少問我爸媽五十個問題。
a curious look: The little boy gave the robot a curious look and then slowly walked up to touch its big round head.
小男孩用好奇的表情看著機器人，然後慢慢走過去摸它又大又圓的頭。
a curious thing: A curious thing happened last night because all the lights in our house went out and came back on by themselves.
昨晚發生了一件奇怪的事，我們家所有的燈都熄了，然後又自己亮了起來。
current events: Our teacher asks us to read the newspaper every morning so that we can talk about current events in class.
老師要我們每天早上看報紙，這樣我們才能在課堂上討論時事。
the current year: In the current year, our school has more than one thousand students, and it will build a new library soon.
今年我們學校有超過一千名學生，而且很快就要蓋一座新的圖書館。
current news: My father likes to watch the current news on TV at seven every evening before he eats dinner with us.
爸爸喜歡每天晚上七點在電視上看最新消息，然後再和我們一起吃晚餐。
at the current time: At the current time, we do not have enough players for a basketball team, so we need three more students.
目前我們的籃球隊人數不夠，所以還需要三名學生。
a cute dog: My neighbor has a cute dog with short legs and long ears, and it runs to me every time I come home.
我鄰居有一隻短腿長耳朵的可愛的狗，每次我回家它都會跑過來找我。
a cute boy: The girls in my class think the new student is a cute boy because he has a nice smile and bright eyes.
我班上的女生都覺得新同學是個帥氣的男孩，因為他有迷人的笑容和明亮的眼睛。
Don't be cute with me, young man, because I know you did not clean your room like you said.
年輕人，別跟我耍小聰明，因為我知道你並沒有像你說的那樣打掃房間。
a cute idea: Making a birthday card with photos of our whole class was a cute idea, and our teacher loved it very much.
用全班的照片做一張生日卡片是個很妙的點子，老師非常喜歡。
cute 可愛的（小孩、動物）: Grandma gave me a cute puppy for my birthday, and it follows me around the house all day long.
奶奶送我一隻可愛的小狗當生日禮物，它整天在家裡跟著我到處跑。
pretty 漂亮的（女生）: Everyone says my sister is a pretty girl, but I think she was cuter when she was a baby with chubby cheeks.
大家都說我姊姊是個漂亮的女生，但我覺得她還是有圓胖臉頰的寶寶時更可愛。
lovely 可愛的／美好的: It was a lovely day, so we took our cute little dog to the park and played there all afternoon.
那是個美好的日子，所以我們帶著可愛的小狗去公園玩了整個下午。
handsome 英俊的: My aunt married a handsome man last year, and their baby is the cutest child I have ever seen.
我阿姨去年嫁給一個英俊的男人，他們的寶寶是我見過最可愛的小孩。
daily life: Phones have become an important part of our daily life, and most people check them many times a day.
手機已成為我們日常生活重要的一部分，大多數人一天會看好幾次。
a daily newspaper: My grandfather reads a daily newspaper at the breakfast table every morning before he goes for a walk in the park.
我爺爺每天早上都在早餐桌上看日報，然後才去公園散步。
daily needs: After the big earthquake, many people sent food, water, and clothes to help with the daily needs of the families there.
大地震後，許多人送食物、水和衣服去幫助當地家庭的日常需求。
daily 每日的／每天（形容詞與副詞同形）: Dad buys a daily paper at the station every morning, and he also checks the news daily on his phone.
爸爸每天早上在車站買一份日報，他也每天在手機上看新聞。
every day 每天（副詞片語）: I practice the piano for thirty minutes every day, so my daily practice has helped me play much better.
我每天練鋼琴三十分鐘，所以每日的練習讓我彈得好多了。
everyday 日常的（形容詞）: Cooking, washing, and taking the bus are all part of everyday life, and we do them daily without thinking much.
煮飯、打掃和搭公車都是日常生活的一部分，我們每天做這些事都不太多想。
day 一天（名詞）: It rained all day, so I stayed home and did my daily reading on the sofa with a cup of tea.
星期天下了一整天的雨，所以我待在家裡，在沙發上一邊喝茶一邊做每日的閱讀。
be dangerous for kids: The deep end of the pool is dangerous for kids, so little children must always swim with their parents next to them.
游泳池的深水區對小孩危險，所以小孩子一定要有父母在旁邊才能游泳。
be dangerous to swim here: It is dangerous to swim here because the water moves very fast, and two people were hurt last summer.
在這裡游泳很危險，因為水流得很快，去年夏天有兩個人受傷了。
a dangerous dog: There is a dangerous dog behind that fence, so do not put your hand through it or go too close.
那道圍牆後面有一隻危險的狗，所以不要把手伸過去，也不要靠太近。
dangerous driving: The police stopped the man for dangerous driving because he was going too fast and talking on his phone.
警察因為那個男人危險駕駛而攔下他，因為他開得太快還邊講電話。
dangerous 危險的（形容詞）: The mountain road to my grandmother's village is a dangerous road, so my father always drives very slowly there.
到我外婆村子的山路是一條危險的道路，所以爸爸在那裡總是開得很慢。
danger 危險（名詞）: The little cat was in danger when it climbed up the tall tree, so a kind man helped it come down.
小貓爬上高高的樹時處於危險中，所以一個好心人幫它下來。
be in danger 處於危險中: Many sea animals are in danger because people throw too much trash into the ocean every single day.
許多海洋動物處於危險中，因為人們每天都把太多塑膠丟進海裡。
endanger 危及（動詞）: Driving after drinking can endanger lives, so my father never touches beer when he has to drive us home.
喝酒後開車會危及生命，所以爸爸要開車載我們回家時從不碰啤酒。
a dark secret: In the story, the old man has a dark secret that he has never told anyone, not even his own wife.
故事裡，老人有一個不可告人的秘密，他從沒告訴過任何人，連自己的太太也沒有。
dark chocolate: My mother likes dark chocolate because it is not too sweet, but my brother and I always choose milk chocolate.
媽媽喜歡黑巧克力，因為它不太甜，但我和哥哥總是選牛奶巧克力。
get dark: It gets dark very early in winter, so we have to finish our basketball game before five thirty.
冬天天黑得很早，所以我們必須在五點半前打完籃球。
after dark: My parents do not let me ride my bike in the park after dark because there are not many street lights.
我父母不讓我天黑後在公園騎腳踏車，因為那裡路燈不多。
in the dark: When the power went out, we sat in the dark for an hour and told funny stories to each other.
停電時，我們在黑暗中坐了一個小時，互相講好笑的故事。
a dark side: Everyone has a dark side, and even my kind grandmother gets really angry when someone lies to her.
每個人都有黑暗面，就連我善良的奶奶在有人對她說謊時也會非常生氣。
dark glasses: The movie star wore dark glasses and a big hat at the airport so that nobody would know who she was.
這位電影明星在機場戴著墨鏡和大帽子，這樣就沒人知道她是誰。
keep sb. in the dark: My parents kept me in the dark about the trip to Japan, so I only found out on the morning we left.
父母對我隱瞞了去日本旅行的事，所以我直到出發那天早上才知道。
dead tired: After the long walk up the mountain, we were all dead tired and fell asleep as soon as we got home.
走了很久的山路後，我們全都累死了，一回家就睡著了。
a dead end: We followed the small road for ten minutes, but it was a dead end, so we had to turn around.
我們沿著那條小路走了十分鐘，但那是一條死路，所以我們只好掉頭。
the dead: Every year in April, many families in Taiwan go to the mountains to remember the dead and clean their resting places.
每年四月，臺灣許多家庭會上山追思死者，並清掃他們安息的地方。
the phone is dead: I wanted to call my mother after the game, but my phone was dead, so I borrowed one from my coach.
比賽後我想打電話給媽媽，但我的電話不通，所以我向教練借了一支。
dead silence: There was dead silence in the room after the teacher asked who broke the window, and nobody looked up.
老師問是誰打破窗戶後，房間裡一片死寂，沒有人抬起頭來。
in the dead of night: A loud noise woke me up in the dead of night, but it was only my cat knocking over a cup.
深夜時一聲巨響把我吵醒，但那只是我的貓把杯子撞倒了。
drop dead: The old farmer worked in the hot sun every day, and the doctor said he could drop dead without more rest.
老農夫每天在大太陽下工作，醫生說如果不多休息，他可能會突然倒下死亡。
dead 死的（形容詞）: The fish in my bowl is dead because I forgot to feed it when I was away at summer camp.
我魚缸裡的魚死了，因為我去夏令營時忘了餵它。
die 死（動詞）: Two of my fish died last night because the water was too dirty, and now the third one looks dead too.
我有兩條魚昨晚死了，因為水太髒，現在第三條看起來也死了。
death 死亡（名詞）: The death of our old dog made the whole family sad, and my sister could not believe he was really dead.
我們老狗的死亡讓全家都很難過，我姊姊無法相信它真的死了。
dying 快死的: In the movie, a dying man gave his son a letter and asked him to read it only after he was dead.
電影裡，一個快死的男人把一封信交給兒子，要他在自己死後才讀。
turn a deaf ear to: My brother turned a deaf ear to Mom's advice about the test, and now he is sorry about his low score.
我哥哥對媽媽關於考試的建議充耳不聞，現在他對自己的低分感到後悔。
the deaf: My cousin is learning sign language because she wants to become a teacher for the deaf after college.
我表姊正在學手語，因為她大學畢業後想成為聽障者的老師。
be deaf to: The boss was deaf to all our ideas during the meeting, so we stopped talking and just listened to him.
老闆在會議中對我們所有的想法都不聽，所以我們不再說話，只聽他講。
go deaf: My grandfather is slowly going deaf, so we have to speak loudly and clearly when we talk to him.
我爺爺慢慢變聾了，所以我們和他說話時必須說得大聲又清楚。
Dear Mr. Lin: I began my letter with Dear Mr. Lin because he was my English teacher in high school for three years.
我的信以「親愛的林先生」開頭，因為他是我國中三年的英文老師。
Oh dear!: Oh dear, I left my wallet on the bus again, and now I have no money for lunch today.
哎呀！我又把皮夾忘在公車上了，現在我今天沒錢吃午餐了。
cost sb. dear: Not studying for the final exam cost Tom dear, because he had to go to summer school for a whole month.
沒有為期末考讀書讓湯姆付出高昂的代價，因為他必須去上整整一個月的暑期學校。
hold sb. dear: My grandmother holds all of us dear, and she keeps our pictures on the wall of her living room.
奶奶珍愛我們每一個人，她把我們的照片掛在客廳的牆上。
dear friends: Dear friends, thank you all for coming to my birthday party tonight and for bringing such wonderful gifts.
親愛的朋友們，謝謝你們今晚來參加我的生日派對，還帶來這麼棒的禮物。
deep in thought: Grandpa sat deep in thought by the window for an hour, so we did not want to ask him about dinner.
爺爺在窗邊沉思了一個小時，所以我們不想問他晚餐的事。
take a deep breath: Before the big speech, Lisa took a deep breath, smiled at the judges, and walked slowly up to the stage.
演講比賽前，麗莎深呼吸一口氣，對評審微笑，然後慢慢走上舞台。
a deep sleep: The baby fell into a deep sleep after drinking milk, so the whole house was quiet for two hours.
寶寶喝完牛奶後熟睡了，所以整個屋子安靜了兩個小時。
a deep voice: My uncle has a deep voice, so he always plays the king or the father in our family plays at New Year.
我叔叔有低沉的聲音，所以在我們家過年的話劇裡，他總是演國王或爸爸。
deep down: Jack says he does not care about the game, but deep down he really wants to win for his team.
傑克說他不在乎這場比賽，但在內心深處他真的很想為球隊贏得勝利。
in deep trouble: Mike was in deep trouble when his mother found out that he had lied about the test for two weeks.
當麥克的媽媽發現他為了考試的事說謊兩個星期時，他深陷麻煩。
a deep sea: Strange fish live in the deep sea where there is no light, and we learned about them in science class today.
奇怪的魚生活在沒有光的深海裡，我們今天在自然課上學到了它們。
deep feelings: Even after ten years apart, the two old friends still had deep feelings for each other and talked all night.
即使分開十年，這兩位老朋友仍對彼此有深厚的感情，聊了一整晚。
a delicious smell: A delicious smell came from the kitchen, so we ran downstairs and found Mom baking chocolate cookies for us.
一陣香味從廚房飄來，所以我們跑下樓，發現媽媽在幫我們烤巧克力餅乾。
look delicious: The cakes in the window look delicious, but they are too expensive, so we can only buy one to share.
櫥窗裡的蛋糕看起來很好吃，但太貴了，所以我們只能買一個來分。
delicious food: My grandmother cooks delicious food every Sunday, so all my aunts and uncles come to her house for lunch.
奶奶每個星期天都煮美食，所以我所有的阿姨和叔叔都會來她家吃午餐。
be different from: Life in a small town is very different from life in Taipei because everything there is slower and quieter.
小鎮的生活和臺北的生活很不同，因為那裡的一切都比較慢也比較安靜。
in different ways: People say thank you in different ways, and in Japan they bow their heads instead of shaking hands.
人們以不同方式說謝謝，在日本他們會低頭鞠躬，而不是握手。
make a difference: Turning off the lights when you leave a room is a small thing, but it can make a difference to our planet.
離開房間時關燈是件小事，但它對我們的地球是有影響的。
a different story: Reading about swimming in a book is easy, but getting into the cold water yourself is a different story.
在書上讀游泳很容易，但自己跳進冷水裡就是另一回事了。
at different times: My brother and I leave home at different times in the morning because his school starts an hour earlier than mine.
我和哥哥早上在不同時間出門，因為他的學校比我的早一小時開始上課。
be difficult for me: Math is difficult for me, so I spend an hour on it every night and ask my teacher many questions.
數學對我來說很難，所以我每晚花一小時讀數學，還問老師很多問題。
It's difficult to say who will win the game tonight because both teams have played very well this year.
很難說今晚誰會贏這場比賽，因為兩隊今年都打得非常好。
a difficult child: My aunt says my cousin was a difficult child because he cried all night and never wanted to eat vegetables.
阿姨說我表弟小時候是個難帶的小孩，因為他整晚哭，又從來不想吃蔬菜。
a difficult time: My family had a difficult time after Dad lost his job, but we helped each other and got through it.
爸爸失業後我們家經歷了一段艱難的時期，但我們互相幫助，撐過去了。
be difficult to please: My grandfather is difficult to please, so we always ask Mom for help before we buy him a birthday present.
我爺爺很難討好，所以我們買生日禮物給他之前總是請媽媽幫忙。
difficult 困難的（形容詞）: We had a difficult test in science today, and more than half of the class could not finish it in time.
我們今天的自然考試很困難，班上超過一半的人沒能及時寫完。
difficulty 困難（名詞）: Mark has difficulty in remembering English words, so the test was very difficult for him and he got a low score.
馬克在記英文單字方面有困難，所以這次考試對他來說很困難，他得了低分。
hard 難的／努力的: The last one was a hard question, so difficult that even the best student in our class got it wrong.
最後一題是個難題，難到連我們班最好的學生都答錯了。
hardly 幾乎不: The test was so difficult that there were hardly any students who finished all the questions before the bell rang.
這次考試太困難了，幾乎沒有任何學生在鈴響前寫完所有題目。
a diligent student: Amy is a diligent student who always finishes her homework early and reads an extra book every week.
艾咪是個勤奮的學生，她總是早早寫完作業，每週還多讀一本書。
be diligent in: My father is diligent in his work, so his boss often asks him to teach new workers how to do things.
我爸爸勤於工作，所以他的老闆常常請他教新員工怎麼做事。
diligent work: After three months of diligent work, the students finally finished the big model of our city for the school fair.
經過三個月勤奮的工作，學生們終於完成了為校慶製作的城市大模型。
a direct flight: There is a direct flight from Taipei to Tokyo every morning, so we do not have to change planes anywhere.
每天早上都有從臺北到東京的直飛航班，所以我們不必在任何地方換機。
a direct answer: When I asked my brother if he broke my phone, he would not give me a direct answer and just looked away.
當我問哥哥是不是他弄壞我的手機時，他不給我直接的回答，只是把頭轉開。
a direct line: The hotel room has a direct line to the front desk, so you can call them any time you need help.
飯店房間有一條可直撥櫃台的電話，所以你需要幫助時隨時可以打給他們。
I will be direct with you because we are good friends, and I think your new plan will not work.
因為我們是好朋友，我就對你直說了，我覺得你的新計畫行不通。
a dirty trick: Changing the time on the other team's clock before the game was a dirty trick, and the coach made them say sorry.
比賽前把對手隊的時鐘調亂是卑鄙的手段，教練要他們道歉。
a dirty joke: Our teacher got angry when a boy told a dirty joke in class, and she made him stand outside for ten minutes.
有個男生在課堂上講黃色笑話，老師很生氣，叫他到外面站十分鐘。
dirty words: My mother never lets us use dirty words at home, and we must put a coin in a box if we do.
媽媽從不讓我們在家說髒話，如果說了就必須放一枚硬幣進箱子裡。
dirty money: In the movie, the police found a bag of dirty money under the bed of the man who stole cars.
電影裡，警察在賣毒品的男人床底下發現一袋黑錢。
get one's hands dirty: Our teacher is not afraid to get her hands dirty, and she planted the vegetables in the school garden with us.
我們的老師不怕弄髒手親自動手，她和我們一起在學校菜園種蔬菜。
a dirty look: Lisa gave her brother a dirty look when he ate the last piece of cake that she was saving for later.
當弟弟吃掉她留著晚點吃的最後一塊蛋糕時，麗莎給了他一個不滿的眼神。
a dishonest man: Everyone in the village knew he was a dishonest man because he sold old fruit and said it was fresh.
村裡每個人都知道他是個不誠實的人，因為他賣老掉的水果還說是新鮮的。
be dishonest with: Do not be dishonest with your parents about your grades, because they will find out and be even angrier later.
不要在成績的事上對父母不誠實，因為他們會發現，之後會更生氣。
dishonest ways: The man got rich in dishonest ways, so the police came to his big house and took him away one morning.
那個男人用不正當的手段致富，所以有一天早上警察來到他的大房子把他帶走了。
a distant cousin: At the wedding, I met a distant cousin from Tainan who I had never seen before, and we became friends.
在婚禮上，我遇到一位從臺南來、以前從沒見過的遠房表親，我們成了朋友。
in the distant past: In the distant past, people in Taiwan did not have cars or phones, and they walked for days to visit family.
在遙遠的過去，臺灣的人們沒有車也沒有電話，他們要走好幾天才能去探望家人。
a distant look: When the teacher asked Tom a question, he had a distant look on his face because he was thinking about lunch.
老師問湯姆問題時，他臉上帶著心不在焉的表情，因為他正在想午餐。
the distant future: Nobody knows what school will be like in the distant future, but I think students may study at home with computers.
沒有人知道遙遠的未來學校會變成什麼樣子，但我想學生可能會在家用電腦學習。
keep a distance: The doctor told us to keep a distance from sick people, so we sat far away from the man who was coughing.
醫生告訴我們要和生病的人保持距離，所以我們坐得離那位咳嗽的男子很遠。
feel dizzy: After I ran around the playground five times under the hot sun, I began to feel dizzy and had to sit down.
我在大太陽下繞操場跑了五圈後，開始覺得頭暈，不得不坐下來。
make sb. dizzy: The bus went up and down the mountain road so many times that it made my little sister dizzy and sick.
公車在山路上上上下下好多次，讓我小妹頭暈又想吐。
a dizzy height: We stood on the top floor of Taipei 101, and from that dizzy height the cars below looked like little toys.
我們站在台北101的頂樓，從那令人頭暈的高度往下看，車子看起來像小玩具。
double the price: The shop near the night market sells the same shoes at double the price, so my mom buys them on the Internet instead.
夜市附近那家店賣同樣的鞋子卻是兩倍價格，所以我媽改成在網路上買。
a double room: When my parents and I traveled to Tainan, we stayed in a double room because it was cheaper than two rooms.
我和爸媽去台南旅行時，我們住雙人房，因為那比兩間房便宜。
a double bed: My grandmother and grandfather have slept in the same double bed for forty years, and they still say it is comfortable.
我的奶奶和爺爺在同一張雙人床上睡了四十年，他們仍然說那張床很舒服。
double check: Before you hand in your English test, please double check your answers because small mistakes can cost you points.
交英文考卷之前，請再檢查一次你的答案，因為小錯誤可能會讓你失分。
see double: After Jack hit his head on the door, he started to see double, so his dad took him to the hospital right away.
傑克撞到門之後開始看到重影，所以他爸爸馬上帶他去醫院。
a double meaning: The last line of the poem has a double meaning, so our teacher asked us to read it again and think carefully.
這首詩的最後一行有雙重意義，所以老師要我們再讀一次並仔細思考。
feel down: When it rains for a whole week and I cannot play basketball with my friends, I always start to feel down.
當連續下一個星期的雨，我不能和朋友打籃球時，我總是開始心情低落。
the system is down: We could not buy train tickets on the Internet this morning because the system was down for more than two hours.
今天早上我們無法在網路上買火車票，因為系統當機了超過兩小時。
be down with a cold: Mary was down with a cold for three days last week, so she missed the school trip to the zoo.
瑪麗上週因感冒病倒了三天，所以錯過了去動物園的校外教學。
Prices are down at the fruit market this week because the weather is good and there are lots of bananas.
這星期水果市場的價格下跌了，因為天氣好，香蕉很多。
down and out: The old man in the park was down and out, so my mother gave him some bread and a warm drink.
公園裡那位老先生窮困潦倒，所以我媽媽給了他一些麵包和一杯熱飲。
Down with…!: The students held up signs and shouted Down with homework on weekends, but the teachers only laughed at them.
學生們舉著牌子大喊打倒週末作業，但老師們只是笑他們。
a dumb question: Our teacher always says there is no such thing as a dumb question, so do not be afraid to ask in class.
我們老師總是說沒有所謂蠢問題這種事，所以不要怕在課堂上發問。
play dumb: When Mom asked who ate the last piece of cake, my brother tried to play dumb, but there was cream on his face.
媽媽問誰吃了最後一塊蛋糕時，我弟弟想裝傻，但他臉上有奶油。
a dumb idea: Riding a bike down the stairs was a dumb idea, and now Peter has a broken arm and cannot write for a month.
騎腳踏車下樓梯是個愚蠢的點子，現在彼得手臂斷了，一個月不能寫字。
the deaf and dumb: My aunt works at a school for the deaf and dumb, and she teaches the children to talk with their hands.
我阿姨在一所聾啞人士的學校工作，她教孩子們用手說話。
dumb 啞的／笨的（口語）: Leaving your phone on the bus was a dumb move, but luckily the driver found it and called your mother.
把手機留在公車上是個笨舉動，但幸運的是司機找到了並打電話給你媽媽。
stupid 笨的: I am not dumb, but I made a stupid mistake on the math test because I did not read the question carefully.
我不笨，但我在數學考試上犯了一個笨錯誤，因為我沒有仔細讀題目。
silent 沉默的: The boy is not dumb and can talk well, but he kept silent when the teacher asked who broke the window.
那個男孩不是啞的，說話說得很好，但老師問誰打破窗戶時，他保持沉默。
an early bird: My grandfather is an early bird who gets up at five every morning to walk in the park before breakfast.
我爺爺是個早起的人，每天早上五點起床，在早餐前去公園散步。
in the early morning: In the early morning, the streets near my school are quiet, and I can hear the birds singing in the trees.
在清晨，我學校附近的街道很安靜，我可以聽到鳥在樹上唱歌。
in his early twenties: My cousin is in his early twenties, and he just started his first job at a computer company in Taipei.
我表哥二十出頭，剛在台北一家電腦公司開始他的第一份工作。
early spring: In early spring, the weather is still a little cold, but the flowers in our school garden start to open.
初春時天氣還有點冷，但我們學校花園裡的花開始開了。
at the earliest: The shop told us the new phone will arrive next Friday at the earliest, so we have to wait one more week.
店家告訴我們新手機最早下星期五到，所以我們得再等一個星期。
an early start: We want to make an early start tomorrow because the mountain road is busy and the drive takes three hours.
我們明天想早早出發，因為山路很擁擠，而且開車要三個小時。
an early breakfast: Dad made us an early breakfast at six so that we could catch the first train to the beach in time.
爸爸六點就為我們做了早早的早餐，好讓我們能及時趕上去海邊的第一班火車。
early in the morning: Early in the morning, my mother goes to the market to buy fresh fish and vegetables before the crowds come.
一大早，我媽媽就去市場買新鮮的魚和蔬菜，趁人潮還沒來。
an early night: I have a big test tomorrow, so I plan to have an early night and go to bed before ten o'clock.
我明天有一個大考，所以我打算早點睡，十點前就上床。
be early for: Linda is always early for school because she likes to read quietly at her desk before the other students arrive.
琳達上學總是提早到，因為她喜歡在其他學生到之前在座位上安靜地看書。
the early bird: My mother says the early bird catches the worm, so she wakes me up at six to study English every day.
我媽媽說早起的鳥兒有蟲吃，所以她每天六點叫我起床讀英文。
an early death: The famous singer had an early death at thirty, and his fans still visit his old house every year.
這位有名的歌手三十歲就早逝了，他的歌迷每年仍會去參觀他的老家。
early summer: In early summer, we like to eat cold noodles and watch the sun go down by the river after school.
初夏時，我們喜歡放學後吃涼麵，並在河邊看太陽下山。
early 早的／早地（形容詞與副詞同形）: I get up early on Sundays to help my dad wash the car before the sun gets too hot.
我星期天都早起幫爸爸洗車，趁太陽還沒變得太熱。
soon 不久之後: You left for the store quite early, so please come back soon, because dinner will be ready in twenty minutes.
你很早就去商店了，所以請快點回來，因為晚餐二十分鐘後就好了。
be early for class: Ken is always early for class, so he has time to copy the notes from the board before the bell rings.
肯上課總是提早到，所以他有時間在鐘響前抄黑板上的筆記。
take it easy: Take it easy and get some rest tonight because the doctor said your cold will get better in a few days.
放輕鬆，今晚好好休息，因為醫生說你的感冒幾天內就會好。
easy money: Some people think selling things on the Internet is easy money, but my uncle says it takes a lot of hard work.
有些人認為在網路上賣東西是容易賺的錢，但我叔叔說那需要很多努力。
an easy life: My grandmother has an easy life now because she lives near the sea and spends her days reading and walking.
我奶奶現在過著安逸的生活，因為她住在海邊，每天看書和散步。
go easy on: Please go easy on your little brother when you play chess, because he is only seven and just learned the rules.
你和小弟下棋時請對他寬容一點，因為他才七歲，剛學會規則。
easier said than done: Everyone says it is easy to stop eating sweets, but as we all know, that is easier said than done.
每個人都說停止吃甜食很簡單，但我們都知道，那是說比做容易。
Cooking rice is easy for me because I have helped my mother in the kitchen since I was eight years old.
煮飯對我來說很簡單，因為我從八歲起就在廚房幫媽媽的忙。
an easy chair: After a long day at work, my father likes to sit in his easy chair by the window and read the newspaper.
工作一整天後，我爸爸喜歡坐在窗邊的安樂椅上看報紙。
be easy to use: This new washing machine is easy to use, so even my grandfather can wash his clothes without any help.
這台新洗衣機很好用，所以連我爺爺都能不用任何幫忙就洗衣服。
easy 形容詞: The English test today was an easy test, so most of the students finished it in less than twenty minutes.
今天的英文考試是個簡單的考試，所以大部分學生不到二十分鐘就寫完了。
easily 副詞: The questions were easy for Amy because she studied hard, so she passed the final exam easily and made her parents proud.
這些題目對艾咪來說很簡單，因為她很用功，所以她輕鬆地通過了期末考，讓父母很驕傲。
Easy does it when you carry the hot soup to the table, or you will burn your hands and drop the bowl.
端熱湯到桌上時要慢慢來，不然你會燙到手，還會把碗摔了。
my elder brother: My elder brother is three years older than me, and he always helps me with my math homework after dinner.
我哥哥比我大三歲，他總是在晚餐後幫我做數學作業。
an elderly man: An elderly man with white hair sat next to me on the bus, so I helped him carry his heavy bags.
一位白髮的老人在公車上坐在我旁邊，所以我幫他拿沉重的袋子。
the elderly: Our class visits the elderly in the hospital every month, and we sing songs and talk with them for an hour.
我們班每個月去醫院探望老年人，我們唱歌並和他們聊一小時。
older than me: My elder sister Amy is only a little older than me, but she acts like a mother and tells me what to do.
我姊姊艾美只比我大一點，但她卻像媽媽一樣告訴我該做什麼。
elder 只放名詞前: My elder sister lives in Taichung now, but she comes home every weekend to have dinner with our family.
我姊姊現在住在台中，但她每個週末都回家和家人吃晚餐。
older 可比較: People think Peter is my elder brother because he is older, but we are actually in the same class at school.
大家以為彼得是我哥哥，因為他比較大，但其實我們在學校是同班。
an electric fan: It was so hot last night that we turned on the electric fan and still could not fall asleep.
昨晚實在太熱了，我們開了電風扇卻還是睡不著。
electric light: Long ago people used candles at night, but today almost every home in Taiwan has electric light in each room.
很久以前人們晚上用蠟燭，但今天台灣幾乎每個家庭每個房間都有電燈。
an electric shock: Never touch a broken light with wet hands, because you may get an electric shock and hurt yourself badly.
千萬不要用濕手去碰壞掉的燈，因為你可能會觸電並嚴重受傷。
an electric car: My uncle bought an electric car last month because it is quiet and does not make the air dirty.
我叔叔上個月買了一輛電動車，因為它很安靜，而且不會弄髒空氣。
the electric bill: Our electric bill was very high this summer, so Dad asked us to turn off the air conditioner when we go out.
我們今年夏天的電費帳單很高，所以爸爸要我們出門時關掉冷氣。
or else: You must finish your homework before nine, or else Mom will not let you watch TV this weekend.
你必須在九點前完成作業，否則媽媽這個週末不會讓你看電視。
something else: I do not want pizza again tonight, so let us try something else, like noodles or fried rice.
今晚我不想再吃披薩了，所以我們試試別的東西吧，像是麵或炒飯。
anything else?: The waiter brought our drinks and asked, Would you like anything else, and we ordered a piece of cake.
服務生送來我們的飲料並問：還要別的嗎？我們點了一塊蛋糕。
someone else: This is not my bag, so it must belong to someone else who sat at this table before us.
這不是我的包包，所以它一定是屬於在我們之前坐這張桌子的別人。
nothing else: There was nothing else in the box except an old photo of my grandmother on her wedding day.
箱子裡除了一張我奶奶結婚那天的舊照片之外，沒別的東西。
what else: We have already packed our clothes and shoes for the trip, so what else do we need to bring?
我們已經為這趟旅行打包好衣服和鞋子了，那還有什麼需要帶的呢？
everyone else: Everyone else in my family likes hot food, but I always ask for the dish without any pepper.
我家其他每個人都喜歡吃辣，但我總是要求菜裡不要放任何辣椒。
an empty promise: He said he would help me move on Sunday, but it was an empty promise and he never showed up.
他說星期天會幫我搬家，但那只是空頭支票，他從來沒出現。
empty words: Saying sorry again and again is just empty words if you do not change the way you act.
如果你不改變你的行為，一次又一次說抱歉只是空話。
on an empty stomach: The doctor told me not to take this medicine on an empty stomach, so I ate some bread first.
醫生告訴我不要空腹吃這個藥，所以我先吃了一些麵包。
feel empty: After my best friend moved to another city, I began to feel empty every time I walked past her house.
我最好的朋友搬到另一個城市後，每次走過她家我都開始感到空虛。
an empty seat: The movie theater was so crowded that we could not find an empty seat and had to stand at the back.
電影院太擠了，我們找不到空位，只好站在後面。
empty the trash: It is my job to empty the trash every evening, and my sister has to wash the dishes after dinner.
每天晚上倒垃圾是我的工作，而我姊姊必須在晚餐後洗碗。
an energetic boy: Jack is such an energetic boy that he plays basketball for two hours after school and still wants to run.
傑克是個精力充沛的男孩，他放學後打了兩小時籃球還想去跑步。
be energetic about: My grandmother is very energetic about gardening, and she wakes up at five to water her flowers every day.
我奶奶對園藝充滿熱情，她每天五點起床為她的花澆水。
feel energetic: After a good sleep and a big breakfast, I always feel energetic and ready for the whole school day.
睡個好覺又吃了一頓豐盛的早餐後，我總是感到有活力，準備好迎接整天的學校生活。
be old enough to: My little brother is not old enough to ride a bike to school alone, so Mom takes him every morning.
我弟弟還不夠大，不能自己騎腳踏車上學，所以媽媽每天早上帶他去。
have enough money for: I have saved for six months, and now I finally have enough money for the new phone I want.
我存了六個月的錢，現在終於有足夠的錢買我想要的新手機了。
Mom said enough is enough when my brother and I kept fighting over the TV, and she turned it off.
當我和弟弟一直為了電視吵架時，媽媽說夠了就是夠了，然後她把電視關掉。
more than enough: We cooked more than enough food for the party, so everyone took some home in boxes after it ended.
我們為派對準備的食物綽綽有餘，所以派對結束後每個人都用盒子裝了一些帶回家。
not good enough: My drawing was not good enough for the art show, so I spent the whole weekend making it better.
我的畫作不夠好，無法參加美術展，所以我花了整個週末把它改得更好。
enough + 名詞: If we leave now, we will have enough time to buy tickets and find our seats before the movie starts.
如果我們現在出發，就會有足夠的時間買票，並在電影開始前找到座位。
形容詞 + enough: This box is big enough to hold all my books, but it is too heavy for me to carry alone.
這個箱子夠大可以裝下我所有的書，但它太重了，我一個人搬不動。
be equal to the job: Our new teacher is young, but she is equal to the job and handles forty noisy students very well.
我們的新老師很年輕，但她能勝任這工作，把四十個吵鬧的學生管得很好。
equal rights: In the past women could not vote in many countries, but today they fight for equal rights everywhere.
過去在許多國家女性不能投票，但今天她們在各地為平等的權利而奮鬥。
an equal chance: Every student should have an equal chance to join the school team, no matter how rich or poor they are.
不論貧富，每個學生都應該有加入校隊的平等機會。
Our teacher often tells us that all men are equal, so we should treat every person in our class with respect.
我們的老師常告訴我們人人平等，所以我們應該尊重班上每一個人。
equal pay: My aunt works as hard as the men in her office, so she asks for equal pay for the same work.
我阿姨和辦公室裡的男人一樣努力工作，所以她為相同的工作要求同工同酬。
an evil smile: The bad man in the movie gave an evil smile before he locked the door and turned off all the lights.
電影裡的壞人在鎖上門並關掉所有燈之前，露出了邪惡的笑容。
good and evil: Many old stories are about the fight between good and evil, and the good side usually wins in the end.
許多古老的故事都是關於善與惡的爭鬥，而善的一方通常最後會贏。
an evil eye: In the story, the old woman had an evil eye that could turn anyone who looked at her into stone.
在故事裡，那個老婦人有一隻邪惡之眼，能把任何看她的人變成石頭。
evil thoughts: The young prince had evil thoughts about taking the king's gold, but his kind sister stopped him in time.
年輕的王子有奪取國王黃金的邪念，但他善良的姊姊及時阻止了他。
an excellent idea: Having a picnic by the river this Saturday is an excellent idea, because the weather will be sunny and cool.
這個星期六去河邊野餐是個絕佳的點子，因為天氣會晴朗又涼爽。
an excellent job: The students did an excellent job on the school play, and everyone in the hall stood up and cheered loudly.
學生們在學校話劇中表現出色，禮堂裡的每個人都站起來大聲歡呼。
Excellent!: When I told my father that I got full marks on the math test, he shouted Excellent and gave me a hug.
當我告訴爸爸我數學考了滿分，他大喊太棒了，並給了我一個擁抱。
be excellent at: Lisa is excellent at drawing, so our class asked her to make a big picture for the school sports day.
麗莎非常擅長畫畫，所以我們班請她為學校運動會畫一張大圖。
excellent 優秀的（形容詞）: Kevin is an excellent student who always finishes his homework early and helps the others who do not understand.
凱文是一位優秀的學生，總是早早完成作業，並幫助其他不懂的人。
excellently 出色地（副詞）: Although she only started learning the piano two years ago, Judy played excellently at the school show last night.
雖然茱蒂兩年前才開始學鋼琴，她昨晚在學校表演上演奏得非常出色。
excellence 卓越（名詞）: My parents want me to go to a school of excellence, so I study hard every night to get in.
我父母希望我進一所卓越的學校，所以我每晚用功讀書以便考進去。
perfect 完美的: Jenny is an excellent student, and this time she even got a perfect score on the hard English test.
珍妮是一位優秀的學生，這次她甚至在很難的英文考試中拿到了完美的滿分。
be excited about the trip: The whole class is excited about the trip to Kenting next week, and we talk about it every day at lunch.
全班都對下週去墾丁的旅行感到興奮，我們每天午餐時都在聊這件事。
get excited: My dog gets excited every time he hears the door open, because he thinks someone is coming to play with him.
我的狗每次聽到門打開都會變得很興奮，因為他以為有人要來跟他玩。
an excited crowd: An excited crowd waited outside the store for hours, because the new game would go on sale at ten.
興奮的群眾在店外等了好幾個小時，因為新遊戲將在十點開賣。
too excited to sleep: The night before my first trip to Japan, I was too excited to sleep and kept checking my bag.
我第一次去日本旅行的前一晚，興奮得睡不著，一直檢查我的行李。
excited 人感到興奮: I am so excited because my favorite singer is coming to Taipei, and my dad bought two tickets for us.
我好興奮，因為我最喜歡的歌手要來台北，而且我爸買了兩張票給我們。
exciting 事物令人興奮: Last night we watched an exciting game between two strong teams, and nobody knew who would win until the end.
昨晚我們看了兩支強隊之間一場令人興奮的比賽，直到最後沒人知道誰會贏。
an exciting day: Saturday was an exciting day for us because we rode horses in the morning and swam in the sea after lunch.
星期六對我們來說是刺激的一天，因為我們早上騎馬，午餐後在海裡游泳。
exciting news: When the teacher told us the exciting news that we won first place, the whole class jumped up and shouted.
當老師告訴我們得到第一名這個令人振奮的消息時，全班都跳起來大叫。
an exciting trip: Climbing the mountain in the rain was an exciting trip, and we even saw a family of monkeys near the top.
在雨中爬山是一次刺激的旅程，我們甚至在山頂附近看到一家子猴子。
the most exciting part: The most exciting part of the movie came at the end, when the boy finally found his lost dog.
電影最精采的部分出現在結尾，男孩終於找到了他走失的狗。
an expensive mistake: Leaving the car window open on a rainy night was an expensive mistake, because the seats were all wet and dirty.
在下雨的夜晚沒關車窗是個代價高昂的錯誤，因為座位全濕了又髒。
an expensive taste: My aunt has an expensive taste, so she only wears clothes from the most famous shops in Taipei.
我阿姨的品味很昂貴，所以她只穿台北最有名商店的衣服。
be too expensive for: This new phone is too expensive for a student like me, so I will wait until the price goes down.
這支新手機對像我這樣的學生來說太貴了，所以我要等到價格下降再買。
be expensive to run: Big old houses are expensive to run, because you have to pay a lot for water, lights and heat every month.
又大又舊的房子維護費很高，因為你每個月得為水、電燈和暖氣付很多錢。
expensive 昂貵的（物）: My father wears an expensive watch that my mother gave him last Christmas, so he takes very good care of it.
我爸戴著一支昂貴的手錶，是我媽去年聖誕節送他的，所以他非常愛惜它。
high 高的（價格用 high 不用 expensive）: We do not say the jacket is expensive because of its price; we say the price is high, as my teacher told me.
我們不說夾克因為價格而昂貴；就像老師告訴我的，我們說價格很高。
cost 花費（動詞）: This bag looks expensive, and it really costs a lot, so I will save my money for a few more months.
這個包包看起來很貴，而且它真的花費很多，所以我會再多存幾個月的錢。
dear 昂貴的（英式）: My grandfather from England never says expensive; he says the fruit is too dear this year and buys fewer apples.
我英國的爺爺從不說 expensive，他說今年水果太貴了，然後少買一些蘋果。
an extra ten minutes: The teacher gave us an extra ten minutes to finish the test because the first bell rang too early.
老師多給我們額外十分鐘完成考試，因為第一次鈴聲響得太早了。
extra money: Kevin washes his neighbor's car every Sunday to make some extra money for the computer game he wants.
凱文每個星期天幫鄰居洗車，賺一些額外的錢買他想要的電腦遊戲。
at no extra cost: At this restaurant you can have more rice and soup at no extra cost, so hungry students love eating here.
在這家餐廳你可以不另外收費就多拿飯和湯，所以餓肚子的學生很愛來這裡吃。
an extra pair of shoes: Remember to bring an extra pair of shoes to the beach, because your feet will get wet and full of sand.
記得多帶一雙鞋去海邊，因為你的腳會弄濕而且滿是沙子。
extra large: This T-shirt is extra large, so it fits my tall brother well but looks like a dress on me.
這件T恤是特大號，所以很適合我高高的哥哥，但穿在我身上像一件洋裝。
work extra hours: My mother has to work extra hours this month because her office is busy, so I cook dinner for my little brother.
我媽這個月必須加班，因為她的辦公室很忙，所以我幫弟弟煮晚餐。
a fair price: The old man sold us the fresh fish at a fair price, so we went back to his shop the next week.
那位老先生以公道的價格把新鮮的魚賣給我們，所以我們下週又回到他的店。
fair play: Our coach always tells us that fair play is more important than winning, so we never cheat in a game.
我們的教練總是告訴我們公平競爭比贏更重要，所以我們比賽時從不作弊。
fair weather: The farmers hope for fair weather this week, because they need to pick all the rice before the next big rain.
農夫們希望這週天氣好，因為他們需要在下一場大雨前收割完所有的稻子。
fair hair: The new girl from Germany has fair hair and blue eyes, and everyone in the class wants to be her friend.
從德國來的新女生有一頭金髮和藍眼睛，班上每個人都想和她做朋友。
a fair share: We all worked on the project together, so everyone should get a fair share of the prize money.
我們大家一起完成了這個計畫，所以每個人都應該得到獎金中應得的一份。
It's not fair!: My brother gets to stay up late on school nights, but I have to go to bed at nine, and it's not fair!
我哥哥上課日的晚上可以晚睡，我卻得九點上床，這不公平！
fair enough: When Tom said he could not come to the party because his grandmother was sick, I said fair enough and wished her well.
