當湯姆說他奶奶生病所以不能來派對時，我說有道理，並祝她早日康復。
a fair chance: If you practice every day, you have a fair chance of getting into the school basketball team next year.
如果你每天練習，明年就有相當大的機會進入學校籃球隊。
fair 公平的／白皮膚的（形容詞）: Basketball is a fair game only when both teams follow the same rules and nobody tries to cheat or hurt others.
只有當兩隊遵守相同的規則、沒有人試圖作弊或傷害別人時，籃球才是一場公平的比賽。
a fair 市集（名詞）: There will be a book fair at our school next Friday, and students can buy new books at half price.
下週五我們學校會有一場書展，學生可以用半價買新書。
fare 車資: Do not mix up fair and fare; the bus fare from my house to school is only fifteen dollars each way.
不要把 fair 和 fare 搞混；從我家到學校的公車車資單程只要十五元。
a false alarm: We all ran out of the building when the bell rang, but it was a false alarm and there was no fire.
鈴響時我們全部跑出大樓，但那只是虛驚一場，根本沒有火災。
false teeth: My grandfather takes out his false teeth before he goes to bed and puts them in a glass of water.
我爺爺睡前會把假牙拿出來，放進一杯水裡。
a false friend: A false friend is nice to you only when he needs something, and he leaves when you are in trouble.
假朋友只在需要你的時候對你好，當你遇到麻煩時他就走了。
a false name: The man used a false name when he checked into the hotel, so the police could not find him at first.
那名男子入住飯店時用了假名，所以警察一開始找不到他。
true or false: The first part of the English test is true or false, and you only need to write T or F for each sentence.
英文考試第一部分是是非題，你只需要為每個句子寫T或F。
false hope: The doctor did not want to give the family false hope, so he told them the truth about the old man's health.
醫生不想給這家人虛假的希望，所以他告訴他們老先生健康的真實情況。
be famous for its food: Tainan is famous for its food, so many visitors go there just to eat the noodles and the sweet soup.
台南以食物聞名，所以很多遊客去那裡只是為了吃麵和甜湯。
be famous as a writer: My uncle is famous as a writer in Taiwan, and his new book about trees is in every bookstore now.
我叔叔在台灣以作家身分聞名，他關於樹的新書現在每家書店都有。
a famous saying: There is a famous saying that practice makes perfect, so I play the piano for an hour every day.
有一句名言說練習造就完美，所以我每天彈一小時鋼琴。
world-famous: Taipei 101 is a world-famous building, and people from all over the world come to see it on New Year's Eve.
台北一零一是世界聞名的建築，跨年夜時世界各地的人都來看它。
famous 有名的（正面）: A famous singer visited our school last week and sang three songs with us in the gym.
一位有名的歌手上週來我們學校，並在體育館和我們一起唱了三首歌。
well-known 眾所周知的: The singer is famous, and it is a well-known fact that she gives half of her money to poor children.
這位歌手很有名，而且她把一半的錢捐給貧窮孩童是眾所周知的事實。
popular 受歡迎的: A famous singer is known to many people, but a popular singer is one that many people really like.
有名的歌手是很多人知道的歌手，而受歡迎的歌手是很多人真的喜愛的歌手。
fame 名聲（名詞）: Many young people want to be famous and dream of fame and fortune, but my grandmother says a happy family is worth more.
許多年輕人想出名，夢想名聲與財富，但我奶奶說幸福的家庭更有價值。
a fancy restaurant: My parents took us to a fancy restaurant for Grandma's birthday, and the waiters wore black suits and white gloves.
我父母帶我們去一家高級餐廳慶祝奶奶的生日，服務生穿著黑西裝戴著白手套。
fancy clothes: The movie star arrived in fancy clothes covered with gold and shining stones, and everyone took pictures of her.
那位電影明星穿著綴滿黃金和閃亮寶石的華麗衣服到場，每個人都為她拍照。
a fancy car: My neighbor drives a fancy car that costs more than a house, but he still parks it on the street.
我的鄰居開一輛比房子還貴的豪華轎車，但他還是把車停在路邊。
nothing fancy: For dinner tonight we are having nothing fancy, just some rice, an egg and the vegetables from our garden.
今晚的晚餐沒什麼特別的，只有一些飯、一顆蛋和我們菜園裡的蔬菜。
fancy dress: At the Halloween party everyone came in fancy dress, and my friend Ben dressed up as a giant yellow banana.
萬聖節派對上每個人都穿著變裝服裝來，我朋友班打扮成一根巨大的黃香蕉。
a fantastic idea: Having a class picnic on the last day of school is a fantastic idea, and I think everyone will want to come.
在學期最後一天辦班級野餐是個絕妙的點子，我想每個人都會想來。
look fantastic: You look fantastic in that blue dress, and the new short hair makes you look much younger than before.
你穿那件藍色洋裝看起來超棒，新剪的短髮讓你看起來比以前年輕許多。
a fantastic story: My grandfather told us a fantastic story about a dragon that lived in the lake and gave gold to kind children.
我爺爺跟我們說了一個奇幻的故事，關於一隻住在湖裡、會送黃金給善良孩子的龍。
have a fantastic time: We had a fantastic time at the beach last weekend, and we stayed until the sun went down behind the hills.
上週末我們在海邊玩得很開心，一直待到太陽落到山丘後面。
fashionable clothes: My sister spends all her money on fashionable clothes, but she says she needs them for her new job.
我姊姊把所有的錢都花在時髦的衣服上，但她說新工作需要這些衣服。
a fashionable area: Xinyi is a fashionable area in Taipei with many tall buildings, big stores and coffee shops full of young people.
信義區是台北一個時尚的區域，有許多高樓、大商店和滿是年輕人的咖啡店。
It's fashionable to: It is fashionable to carry a small bag over one shoulder this year, and almost every girl at school has one.
今年單肩背小包包很流行，學校裡幾乎每個女生都有一個。
a fashionable word: My little brother keeps saying a fashionable word he learned on the Internet, but my grandmother has no idea what it means.
我弟弟一直在說一個他在網路上學到的流行用語，但我奶奶完全不知道那是什麼意思。
fast food: Eating fast food like hamburgers and fries every day is bad for you, so my mom only lets me have it once a month.
每天吃像漢堡和薯條這樣的速食對你不好，所以我媽一個月只讓我吃一次。
a fast car: My uncle loves to drive a fast car on the highway, but my aunt always tells him to slow down.
我叔叔喜歡在高速公路上開跑得快的車，但我阿姨總是叫他慢一點。
hold fast to: When the strong wind came, the little girl held fast to her father's hand so she would not fall.
當強風吹來時，小女孩緊握著爸爸的手，這樣才不會跌倒。
fast friends: Mary and I became fast friends on the first day of high school, and we still eat lunch together every day.
我和瑪麗在高中第一天就成了死黨，我們至今每天還是一起吃午餐。
a fast learner: Jason is a fast learner, so he could play three songs on the guitar after only one week of lessons.
傑森是個學得快的人，所以他只上了一週的課就能用吉他彈三首歌。
I ran all the way to the bus stop because I thought I was late, but then I found that my watch is fast.
我以為自己遲到了就一路跑到公車站，後來才發現我的錶快了。
fast 快的／快地（形容詞與副詞同形）: My brother can run fast, so he is always the first one to finish the race on our school sports day.
我哥哥跑得很快，所以在學校運動會上他總是第一個跑完比賽。
fast 快速（速度）: We took a fast train from Taipei to Kaohsiung, and the trip took less than two hours in total.
我們從台北搭快速列車到高雄，整趟旅程總共不到兩小時。
quick 迅速（短時間）: Mom did not read my homework fast; she just took a quick look at it and found two small mistakes in my math.
媽媽並沒有快速地讀我的作業，她只是快速看了一下，就發現我數學有兩個小錯誤。
early 早: My grandfather does not walk fast, but he gets up in the early morning every day and goes to the park.
我爺爺走得不快，但他每天一大早起床去公園。
a fat chance: My brother thinks he can win the race against the school's best runner, but I think there is a fat chance of that.
我哥哥認為他能在比賽中贏過學校最厲害的跑者，但我覺得機會渺茫。
fat cats: In the news story, the fat cats in big companies made lots of money while the workers got very little pay.
在那則新聞報導中，大公司裡有錢有勢的人賺了很多錢，而工人卻只拿到很少的薪水。
a fat book: The teacher asked us to read a fat book with over five hundred pages during the summer vacation.
老師要我們在暑假期間讀一本超過五百頁的厚厚的書。
get fat: If you eat cake every night and never exercise, you will get fat and your clothes will not fit anymore.
如果你每天晚上吃蛋糕又從不運動，你會變胖，衣服也會穿不下。
low fat: My mother always buys low fat milk at the supermarket because she says it is better for our hearts.
我媽總是在超市買低脂牛奶，因為她說這對我們的心臟比較好。
my favorite subject: English is my favorite subject because the teacher plays games with us and we learn new songs every week.
英文是我最喜歡的科目，因為老師跟我們玩遊戲，我們每週還學新歌。
a favorite with children: The old man who sells ice cream near our school is a favorite with children, because he always gives them extra.
在我們學校附近賣冰淇淋的老先生很受小孩喜愛，因為他總是多給他們一些。
a favorite among fans: The young singer is a favorite among fans because she stops to talk with them and signs every photo after her shows.
這位年輕歌手是粉絲最愛，因為她表演後會停下來和粉絲聊天，並在每張照片上簽名。
What's your favorite?: We have chocolate, strawberry and mango ice cream here, so what's your favorite, and I will buy it for you.
我們這裡有巧克力、草莓和芒果冰淇淋，你最喜歡哪個？我買給你。
a female doctor: When I was sick last week, a female doctor with a kind voice checked my throat and gave me some medicine.
上週我生病時，一位聲音溫柔的女醫師檢查了我的喉嚨，並給我一些藥。
female students: In our class the female students sit on the left side of the room, and the boys sit on the right.
在我們班上女學生坐在教室左邊，男生坐在右邊。
male and female: Both male and female students can join the school soccer team this year, so my sister signed up right away.
今年男和女學生都可以加入學校足球隊，所以我姊姊馬上就報名了。
a female voice: When I called the restaurant, a female voice answered the phone and asked how many people were coming for dinner.
我打電話給餐廳時，一個女聲接起電話，問有多少人要來吃晚餐。
a few friends: I only have a few friends at my new school, but we eat lunch together and help each other with homework.
我在新學校只有幾個朋友，但我們一起吃午餐，也互相幫忙做作業。
few friends: Tom has few friends in class because he never talks to anyone and always plays games on his phone alone.
湯姆在班上幾乎沒有朋友，因為他從不跟任何人說話，總是獨自玩手機遊戲。
quite a few: Quite a few students in our class wear glasses, because they read in the dark and look at their phones too much.
我們班上相當多學生戴眼鏡，因為他們在暗處看書，手機也看太多了。
only a few: Only a few people came to the park for the morning run, because it was cold and the sky was dark.
只有少數人來公園參加晨跑，因為天氣很冷，天空也很暗。
the last few days: It has rained every day for the last few days, so our school sports day was moved to next month.
最近幾天每天都下雨，所以我們學校的運動會延到下個月了。
a few more minutes: Can you wait a few more minutes, because I need to finish this email before we leave for the movie.
你可以再等幾分鐘嗎？因為我需要在我們出發去看電影前寫完這封電子郵件。
few and far between: Good restaurants are few and far between in this small mountain town, so we cooked our own dinner at the hotel.
在這個小山城裡好餐廳很稀少，所以我們在飯店自己煮晚餐。
few / a few 用於可數: I borrowed a few books from the library this afternoon, and I plan to read all of them during the long weekend.
今天下午我從圖書館借了幾本書，我打算在長週末期間把它們全部讀完。
little / a little 用於不可數: I ate a few cookies and drank a little water after the race, because my mouth was very dry.
比賽後我吃了幾片餅乾，喝了一點水，因為我的嘴巴很乾。
fewer 較少（可數）: There are fewer cars on the road on Sunday morning, so my father likes to drive to the market early.
星期天早上路上的車比較少，所以我爸喜歡早點開車去市場。
less 較少（不可數）: I have fewer holidays and less time to play computer games this year because of the big test in May.
因為五月的大考，我今年假日比較少，玩電腦遊戲的時間也比較少。
the final exam: The final exam is next week, so the library is full of students who read quietly until it closes at nine.
期末考就在下週，所以圖書館裡滿是安靜讀書直到九點關門的學生。
the final answer: After thinking for ten minutes, Jenny wrote down the final answer, and the teacher said it was correct.
經過十分鐘的思考，珍妮寫下了最終答案，老師說它是正確的。
the final score: The final score of the basketball game was 68 to 65, so our class won by only three points.
籃球比賽的最終比分是68比65，所以我們班只贏了三分。
make a final decision: My parents will make a final decision about our summer trip after they talk to my grandmother this weekend.
我爸媽這個週末和奶奶談過之後，會對我們的暑假旅行做出最後決定。
the finals: Our school team practiced hard every day because they wanted to play in the finals next month.
我們校隊每天努力練習，因為他們想在下個月打進決賽。
in the final minute: Nobody thought we could win, but Kevin shot the ball in the final minute and we won the game.
沒有人認為我們能贏，但凱文在最後一分鐘投進了球，我們贏了比賽。
When my teacher asked if I was still sick, I told her I'm fine, thanks, and went back to my seat.
老師問我是不是還在生病時，我告訴她我很好，謝謝，然後回到座位上。
a fine day: It was a fine day with blue sky, so my family decided to ride bikes along the river.
那是個好天氣，天空藍藍的，所以我們一家決定沿著河邊騎腳踏車。
fine art: My sister studies fine art at a university in Taipei, and she paints beautiful pictures of the sea.
我姊姊在台北的一所大學學美術，她畫出很美的海景畫。
a fine line: There is a fine line between being funny and being rude, so be careful when you make jokes about friends.
搞笑和無禮之間只有一條細微的界線，所以拿朋友開玩笑時要小心。
If you cannot come to my birthday party on Saturday, that's fine, because we can meet another day.
如果你星期六不能來我的生日派對，那沒問題，因為我們可以改天見面。
fine words: The salesman used many fine words about the phone, but my father still did not believe him and left.
那位店員對那支手機說了很多漂亮的話，但我爸爸還是不相信他，就離開了。
pay a fine: Amy forgot to return her library books on time, so she had to pay a fine of thirty dollars.
艾美忘了準時還圖書館的書，所以她必須付三十元的罰款。
get a fine for speeding: My uncle drove too fast on the highway last night and got a fine for speeding from the police.
我叔叔昨晚在高速公路上開太快，被警察因超速罰款。
fine 好的（形容詞）: Although I fell off my bike this morning, I am fine now and can still play basketball after school.
雖然我今天早上從腳踏車上摔下來，但我現在很好，放學後還能打籃球。
a fine 罰款（名詞）: Dad parked the car in front of the hospital gate for ten minutes and got a parking fine.
爸爸把車停在醫院大門前十分鐘，就收到了一張停車罰款單。
fine 罰款（動詞）: The man was fined NT$600 because he threw his garbage on the street near the night market.
那名男子因為在夜市附近把垃圾丟在街上而被罰款六百元。
at first: At first I did not like my new school, but now I have many good friends in my class.
起初我不喜歡我的新學校，但現在我在班上有很多好朋友。
first of all: First of all, please wash your hands before dinner, and then help me put the dishes on the table.
首先，請在晚餐前洗手，然後幫我把盤子放到桌上。
the first floor: The school library is on the first floor, so we do not need to take the stairs to get there.
學校圖書館在一樓，所以我們不需要爬樓梯就能到那裡。
love at first sight: My grandfather says it was love at first sight when he met my grandmother at a dance fifty years ago.
我爺爺說五十年前他在舞會上遇見奶奶時，那是一見鍾情。
first come, first served: The free ice cream at the new store is first come, first served, so we should get there early.
新店的免費冰淇淋是先到先得，所以我們應該早點到。
in the first place: Why did you buy such an expensive game in the first place if you did not have enough money?
如果你錢不夠，一開始為什麼要買這麼貴的遊戲？
the first time: This is the first time my little brother has flown on an airplane, so he is very excited today.
這是我弟弟第一次搭飛機，所以他今天非常興奮。
first thing in the morning: Mom waters the plants on the balcony first thing in the morning, even before she makes breakfast for us.
媽媽一早第一件事就是幫陽台上的植物澆水，甚至在幫我們做早餐之前。
first-hand: Our teacher lived in Japan for five years, so she gave us first-hand information about Japanese schools.
我們老師在日本住了五年，所以她給我們關於日本學校的第一手資訊。
a foggy morning: On a foggy morning, drivers should turn on their lights and go slowly because they cannot see far.
在有霧的早晨，駕駛人應該開燈並慢慢開，因為他們看不遠。
a foggy idea: I only have a foggy idea of what the teacher said, because I was too sleepy in class.
我對老師說的只有模糊的想法，因為我在課堂上太困了。
When Mom asked where my brother put the car keys, I said I don't have the foggiest idea.
媽媽問我弟弟把車鑰匙放在哪裡時，我說我一點也不知道。
a foolish mistake: Leaving my umbrella on the bus was a foolish mistake, and I got all wet in the heavy rain.
把雨傘留在公車上是個愚蠢的錯誤，我在大雨中全身都淋濕了。
look foolish: I did not want to look foolish in front of my friends, so I practiced the dance many times at home.
我不想在朋友面前看起來很傻，所以我在家練了很多次舞。
be foolish enough to: Jack was foolish enough to swim in the river during the typhoon, and the police had to save him.
傑克傻到在颱風期間去河裡游泳，警察只好去救他。
It's foolish to: It's foolish to spend all your money on video games when you still need to buy new school books.
當你還需要買新課本時，把所有錢花在電動遊戲上很愚蠢。
a foreign language: Learning a foreign language takes time, so you should practice speaking English with your friends every day.
學外語需要時間，所以你應該每天和朋友練習說英文。
foreign countries: My aunt has visited many foreign countries, and she always brings back interesting gifts for us.
我阿姨去過許多外國，而且她總是帶回有趣的禮物給我們。
a foreign teacher: We have a foreign teacher from Canada this year, and she teaches us English songs every Friday afternoon.
我們今年有一位來自加拿大的外籍教師，她每週五下午教我們英文歌。
foreign food: My brother loves to try foreign food, so he often orders Italian pizza and Korean noodles for dinner.
我弟弟很喜歡嘗試異國食物，所以他常點義大利披薩和韓式麵條當晚餐。
be foreign to me: Cooking is foreign to me because my mother always makes dinner, but I want to learn this summer.
煮飯對我來說很陌生，因為總是我媽媽做晚餐，但我今年夏天想學。
foreign 外國的（形容詞）: Linda has a foreign friend from France, and they talk on the phone in English every Sunday night.
琳達有一位來自法國的外國朋友，他們每週日晚上用英文講電話。
a foreigner 外國人（名詞）: I was nervous when I talked to a foreigner for the first time, but he was very kind.
我第一次和外國人說話時很緊張，但他人很好。
abroad 在國外（副詞）: My cousin wants to study abroad in a foreign country next year, so she is saving money and learning English.
我表姊明年想去外國留學（在國外讀書），所以她正在存錢並努力學英文。
overseas 海外的: Overseas students at my uncle's university come from many foreign countries, and some of them speak three languages.
我叔叔大學的海外學生來自許多外國，其中有些人會說三種語言。
a formal dress: My sister bought a formal dress for her friend's wedding, and she looked beautiful in it.
我姊姊為朋友的婚禮買了一件正式禮服，她穿起來很漂亮。
formal English: When you write to your teacher, you should use formal English and not the short words you use with friends.
寫信給老師時，你應該用正式英語，而不是你和朋友之間用的簡短字詞。
a formal letter: Our teacher taught us how to write a formal letter to ask the principal for a new basketball court.
我們老師教我們如何寫一封正式信函，向校長請求一座新的籃球場。
a formal party: It was a formal party at a big hotel, so everyone wore nice clothes and ate dinner quietly.
那是在大飯店舉行的正式派對，所以每個人都穿著漂亮的衣服，安靜地吃晚餐。
formal education: My grandfather never had much formal education, but he taught himself to read and loves books.
我爺爺沒受過多少正規教育，但他自學閱讀，而且很愛看書。
the former president: The former president visited our city yesterday, and many people stood on the street to see him.
前總統昨天來我們的城市參觀，很多人站在街上看他。
my former teacher: I met my former teacher at the supermarket yesterday, and she still remembered my name after three years.
我昨天在超市遇到我以前的老師，三年後她還記得我的名字。
in former times: In former times, people in this village walked two hours to school because there were no buses.
從前，這個村子的人要走兩小時去上學，因為那時沒有公車。
the former and the latter: Tea and coffee are both popular here, but the former is cheaper and the latter smells better.
茶和咖啡在這裡都很受歡迎，但前者比較便宜，後者比較香。
a former student: A former student of our school is now a famous singer, and she will sing at our school party.
我們學校一位以前的學生現在是有名的歌手，她將在學校派對上唱歌。
look forward to: We are all looking forward to the school trip next week because we will visit a famous water park.
我們都很期待下週的校外教學，因為我們將去一座有名的水上樂園。
move forward: The line at the movie theater moved forward slowly, and we finally bought our tickets after thirty minutes.
電影院的隊伍慢慢地向前進，三十分鐘後我們終於買到了票。
step forward: When the teacher asked who broke the window, Peter stepped forward and said he was sorry.
老師問是誰打破窗戶時，彼得向前一步，說他很抱歉。
put the clock forward: Dad put the clock forward ten minutes so that my little brother would not be late for school again.
爸爸把時鐘調快十分鐘，這樣我弟弟就不會再上學遲到了。
from this day forward: From this day forward, I will get up at six every morning and run in the park before school.
從今天起，我每天早上六點起床，上學前先去公園跑步。
a big step forward: Getting eighty points on the English test was a big step forward for Tom, who used to fail.
英文考八十分對湯姆來說是一大進步，他以前常常不及格。
be frank with you: To be frank with you, your drawing is not very good yet, but you can get better with practice.
對你坦白說，你的畫還不太好，但多練習就會進步。
to be frank: To be frank, I do not like the new uniform because the color is too dark for summer.
坦白說，我不喜歡新制服，因為顏色對夏天來說太深了。
a frank answer: I asked my best friend about my singing, and she gave me a frank answer that hurt a little.
我問我最好的朋友我唱歌唱得如何，她給了我一個坦率的回答，讓我有點受傷。
frankly speaking: Frankly speaking, the movie was boring, and I almost fell asleep in the middle of it.
坦白地說，那部電影很無聊，我在中間差點睡著。
free time: In my free time, I like to play the guitar and listen to music with my older brother.
空閒時間我喜歡彈吉他，和哥哥一起聽音樂。
for free: The new bakery near our school gave away small cakes for free on its opening day last Sunday.
我們學校附近的新麵包店上週日開幕時免費送小蛋糕。
a free seat: The bus was so crowded that I could not find a free seat, so I stood all the way home.
公車太擠了，我找不到空位，所以我一路站回家。
feel free to ask: If you do not understand the homework, feel free to ask me after class, and I will explain it again.
如果你不懂作業，有問題隨便問我，下課後我會再解釋一次。
set the bird free: The little girl opened the cage and set the bird free because she wanted it to fly home.
小女孩打開鳥籠放鳥自由，因為她希望它能飛回家。
free of charge: The museum is free of charge for students on Wednesdays, so let's go there together after school.
博物館每週三對學生免費，所以我們放學後一起去吧。
Are you free tonight?: I want to know if you are free tonight, because I have two tickets for the new movie at seven.
我想知道你今晚有空嗎，因為我有兩張七點新電影的票。
a free country: In a free country, people can say what they think and choose the job they like.
在自由的國家，人們可以說出自己的想法，也可以選擇喜歡的工作。
sugar-free: My grandmother buys sugar-free cookies because the doctor told her to eat less sweet food.
我奶奶買無糖餅乾，因為醫生告訴她要少吃甜食。
duty-free: At the airport, my mother bought some duty-free chocolate and tea for her friends in the office.
在機場，我媽媽買了一些免稅的巧克力和茶給辦公室的朋友。
be free from pain: After taking the medicine for two days, my grandfather is finally free from pain and can walk again.
吃了兩天藥後，我爺爺終於沒有疼痛，可以再走路了。
be free of worry: During summer vacation, I am free of worry because there are no tests and I can sleep late.
暑假期間我無憂無慮，因為沒有考試，而且我可以睡到很晚。
be free to go: The teacher said we were free to go after we washed the floor and closed all the windows.
老師說我們洗完地板、關好所有窗戶後就可以自由離開。
break free: The dog broke free from its rope and ran across the park to play with the children.
那隻狗從繩子掙脫，跑過公園去和孩子們玩。
freezing cold: It was freezing cold on the mountain last night, so we wore three jackets and drank hot soup.
昨晚山上冷得要命，所以我們穿了三件夾克，喝了熱湯。
It's freezing!: I shouted it's freezing when the cold wind came in, and then I quickly closed the window.
冷風吹進來時我大喊冷死了，然後趕快把窗戶關上。
the freezing point: Water turns into ice when the temperature goes below the freezing point, which is zero degrees.
當溫度降到冰點以下時，水會結成冰，冰點是零度。
freezing weather: Because of the freezing weather in Japan, we could not go outside, so we stayed in the hotel and played cards.
因為日本嚴寒的天氣，我們無法出門，所以我們留在飯店玩牌。
fresh air: After studying for three hours, I opened the window to get some fresh air and felt much better.
讀了三小時書後，我打開窗戶吸點新鮮空氣，感覺好多了。
fresh water: Fish that live in the sea cannot live in fresh water, so do not put them in the river.
住在海裡的魚不能在淡水裡生活，所以不要把它們放進河裡。
a fresh start: After moving to a new city, my family hoped for a fresh start, and we soon made new friends.
搬到新城市後，我們一家希望有個新的開始，很快就交到了新朋友。
fresh news: The teacher came in with fresh news about the sports day, and everyone in the class became excited.
老師帶著運動會的最新消息走進來，班上每個人都興奮起來。
a fresh idea: Our group needed a fresh idea for the science project, so Mary suggested making a robot from old boxes.
我們這組的科學專題需要新鮮的點子，所以瑪麗建議用舊箱子做機器人。
fresh from college: My new English teacher is fresh from college, and she is only four years older than my sister.
我的新英文老師剛從大學畢業，她只比我姊姊大四歲。
fresh fish: Grandpa goes to the market early every morning because he wants to buy fresh fish for our dinner.
爺爺每天早上很早去市場，因為他想買新鮮的魚當我們的晚餐。
be fresh out of: We are fresh out of milk, so could you go to the store on the corner and buy two bottles?
我們牛奶剛用完，你可以去轉角的商店買兩瓶嗎？
be friendly to strangers: My dog is friendly to strangers, so he never barks at the new neighbors who visit our house.
我的狗對陌生人很友善，所以他從不對來我們家拜訪的新鄰居吠叫。
be friendly with the neighbors: My parents are friendly with the neighbors, and we often share food with them during the holidays.
我爸媽和鄰居很友好，我們常常在假日和他們分享食物。
a friendly smile: The new student gave me a friendly smile on the first day, and we became good friends soon.
新同學在第一天給了我一個友善的微笑，我們很快就成了好朋友。
a friendly game: Our class played a friendly game of basketball with Class 302 yesterday, and nobody cared who won.
我們班昨天和302班打了一場籃球友誼賽，沒有人在意誰贏。
user-friendly: This new phone is very user-friendly, so even my eighty-year-old grandmother can use it to take photos.
這支新手機非常容易使用，所以連我八十歲的奶奶都能用它拍照。
eco-friendly: Our family tries to be eco-friendly, so we always bring our own bags and bottles when we go shopping.
我們家努力做到環保，所以我們購物時總是帶自己的袋子和瓶子。
friendly 友善的（形容詞，雖 -ly 結尾）: The friendly dog next door always runs to the gate to say hello when I come home from school.
隔壁那隻友善的狗總是在我放學回家時跑到門口打招呼。
in a friendly way 友善地: The old man at the store talked to us in a friendly way and gave each of us a free candy.
店裡的老先生友善地和我們說話，還給了我們每人一顆免費的糖。
friend 朋友（名詞）: A good friend will tell you the truth even when it is hard to hear, so listen to Amy.
好朋友即使在真話很難聽的時候也會告訴你，所以聽聽艾美的話。
friendship 友誼（名詞）: My mother and her high school friend have kept a close friendship for more than twenty years.
我媽媽和她的高中朋友維持了超過二十年親密的友誼。
be full of water: After the heavy rain last night, the big pot in the garden was full of water this morning.
昨晚大雨過後，花園裡的大鍋子今天早上裝滿了水。
a full moon: There was a full moon on the night of the Moon Festival, and we ate moon cakes in the park.
中秋節那晚有一輪滿月，我們在公園裡吃月餅。
at full speed: The train ran at full speed through the fields, and we arrived in Tainan in less than two hours.
火車全速穿過田野，我們不到兩小時就到了台南。
I'm full, so I cannot eat another piece of cake, but thank you for the wonderful dinner.
我吃飽了，所以我不能再吃一塊蛋糕，但謝謝你美好的晚餐。
a full name: Please write your full name at the top of the test paper before you begin to answer the questions.
開始回答問題之前，請在考卷的最上面寫下你的全名。
a full day: We had a full day at the zoo, and my little sister fell asleep in the car on the way home.
我們在動物園度過充實的一天，我小妹在回家的車上睡著了。
in full: My father paid for the new refrigerator in full, so we do not need to pay the store again next month.
我爸爸全額付清了新冰箱的錢，所以我們下個月不必再付錢給店家。
be full of oneself: Nobody likes to sit with Jason because he is full of himself and only talks about how great he is.
沒有人喜歡和傑森坐在一起，因為他自以為是，只會談他自己有多厲害。
a full house: The school play had a full house on Friday night, and some parents even had to stand at the back.
週五晚上的學校話劇客滿，有些家長甚至得站在後面。
full-time: After my little brother was born, my mother stopped working and became a full-time mom at home.
我弟弟出生後，我媽媽停止工作，成為在家的全職媽媽。
a funny smell: There was a funny smell in the kitchen, and then we found some old fish behind the refrigerator.
廚房裡有一股奇怪的味道，然後我們在冰箱後面發現了一些壞掉的魚。
a funny feeling: I had a funny feeling that someone was following me, so I walked faster and called my mother.
我有一種奇怪的感覺，覺得有人在跟著我，所以我走快一點並打電話給我媽媽。
Stop laughing at Ben because he fell down and hurt his knee, and it's not funny at all.
不要再笑班了，他跌倒傷了膝蓋，這一點都不好笑。
Funny you should say that, because I was just thinking about going to the same restaurant for dinner tonight.
真巧你這麼說，因為我剛才正想著今晚去同一家餐廳吃晚餐。
funny stories: My grandfather tells funny stories about his childhood, and we always laugh until our stomachs hurt.
我爺爺講他童年的有趣故事，我們總是笑到肚子痛。
feel funny: I began to feel funny after eating the old sandwich, so I went to see the school nurse.
吃了那個放很久的三明治後我開始覺得不舒服，所以去看了校護。
be funny about: My sister is funny about her desk, and she gets angry if anyone moves even one pencil on it.
我姊姊對她的書桌很奇怪，只要有人動了上面的一支鉛筆，她就會生氣。
It's funny that: It's funny that Tom and I wore the same blue T-shirt to the party without telling each other.
奇怪的是，湯姆和我沒有互相告知，卻穿了同一件藍色T恤去派對。
funny business: The teacher watched us closely during the test because she did not want any funny business from anyone.
考試時老師仔細地看著我們，因為她不希望任何人做不正當的事。
a funny bone: My uncle has a great funny bone, and his jokes make everyone at the family dinner laugh.
我叔叔很有幽默感，他的笑話讓家庭聚餐上的每個人都大笑。
funny money: The shop owner looked at the bill closely because he was afraid it might be funny money.
店主仔細地看那張鈔票，因為他擔心那可能是假鈔。
funny 好笑的／奇怪的: Peter told a funny joke in class, and even the teacher could not stop laughing for a minute.
彼得在課堂上講了一個好笑的笑話，連老師都笑了一分鐘停不下來。
fun 好玩的（名詞／形容詞）: We had a lot of fun at the beach yesterday, and my uncle told funny stories while we ate watermelon.
我們昨天在海邊玩得很開心，我叔叔在我們吃西瓜時講了有趣的故事。
interesting 有趣的（引起興趣）: This book about animals is interesting and also funny, so I finished it in two days and read it again.
這本關於動物的書很有趣，也很好笑，所以我兩天就讀完，又讀了一遍。
in general: In general, students in my class like PE more than math, but a few of them love numbers.
一般來說，我們班的學生比較喜歡體育課而不是數學課，但有幾個人很愛數字。
the general public: The new park by the river will open to the general public next month, and it is free.
河邊的新公園下個月將對一般大眾開放，而且是免費的。
a general idea: Before you read the whole story, look at the pictures to get a general idea of what happens.
在你讀完整個故事之前，先看圖片，對發生的事有個大致的概念。
general knowledge: My brother is good at general knowledge, so he always wins the quiz games on TV at home.
我哥哥的常識很好，所以他在家看電視益智節目時總是答對。
as a general rule: As a general rule, my parents do not let me play computer games on school nights.
一般而言，我爸媽不讓我在上學日的晚上玩電腦遊戲。
the general manager: My aunt is the general manager of a hotel in Taichung, and she works very hard every day.
我阿姨是台中一家飯店的總經理，她每天都非常努力工作。
be generous with money: My grandfather is generous with money, and he often buys gifts for all the children in our family.
我爺爺花錢大方，常常買禮物給家裡所有的小孩。
be generous to the poor: Mrs. Lin is generous to the poor, and she gives rice and warm clothes to them every winter.
林太太對窮人很慷慨，每年冬天都送米和保暖的衣服給他們。
a generous gift: My uncle gave me a generous gift of five thousand dollars for my birthday, so I bought a new bike.
我叔叔送我五千元當生日厚禮，所以我買了一輛新腳踏車。
a generous heart: Our teacher has a generous heart, and she always forgives students who say sorry for their mistakes.
我們老師有寬大的心，她總是原諒為錯誤道歉的學生。
It's generous of you to: It's generous of you to share your lunch with me when I forgot my lunch box at home.
我把便當忘在家裡時，你真大方，願意和我分享你的午餐。
a gentle voice: The nurse spoke to the sick child in a gentle voice, and he soon stopped crying and fell asleep.
護士用溫柔的聲音對生病的孩子說話，他很快就不哭了，然後睡著了。
a gentle wind: A gentle wind blew across the lake in the evening, and it felt cool after the hot afternoon.
傍晚一陣微風吹過湖面，在炎熱的下午之後感覺很涼爽。
be gentle with the baby: Mom told my little brother to be gentle with the baby and not to touch her face with dirty hands.
媽媽告訴弟弟對嬰兒要輕柔，不要用髒手摸她的臉。
a gentle man: My grandfather is a gentle man who never shouts, and all the children in the village love him.
我爺爺是個溫文的男人，從不大吼，村裡所有的小孩都愛他。
be glad to hear that: I was glad to hear that my best friend passed the test, because she had studied so hard.
很高興聽到我最好的朋友通過了考試那件事，因為她讀得非常努力。
be glad about: Everyone in my family is glad about the new baby, and my grandmother has already bought many small clothes.
我們家每個人都為新寶寶感到高興，奶奶已經買了很多小衣服。
When the new teacher walked in, I stood up and said glad to meet you, and she smiled at me.
新老師走進來時，我站起來說很高興認識你，她對我微笑。
If you need someone to carry the boxes to the music room, I'd be glad to help you after lunch.
如果你需要有人把箱子搬到音樂教室，我很樂意午餐後幫忙你。
be glad of: After walking in the hot sun for an hour, we were glad of a cold drink and a cool place to rest.
在烈日下走了一小時後，我們為能喝到冷飲和找到涼快的地方休息而高興。
a gold ring: My grandmother gave my mother a gold ring on her wedding day, and now she wants to give it to me.
我奶奶在我媽媽結婚那天送她一個金戒指，現在她想把它給我。
gold prices: Gold prices went up a lot this year, so my aunt sold her old necklace and made some money.
今年金價漲了很多，所以我阿姨賣掉她的舊項鍊，賺了一些錢。
a heart of gold: Our bus driver has a heart of gold, and he always waits for students who run late in the morning.
我們的公車司機有一顆金子般的心，他總是等早上跑來遲到的學生。
as good as gold: My little cousin was as good as gold at the restaurant, and she sat quietly through the whole dinner.
我的小表妹在餐廳非常乖，整頓晚餐都安靜地坐著。
gold 黃金（名詞）／黃金製的: My father got a gold watch from his company after working there for twenty-five years.
我爸爸在公司工作二十五年後，得到了一支金錶。
golden 金色的／珍貴的: The little girl in the picture has long golden hair and blue eyes, and she is holding a white cat.
圖片裡的小女孩有一頭金色長髮和藍眼睛，她抱著一隻白貓。
a golden chance: Winning the trip to Japan was a golden chance for Lisa to practice the Japanese she learned at school.
贏得日本之旅對麗莎來說是一個大好機會，可以練習她在學校學的日文。
the golden rule: My grandmother says the golden rule is to treat other people the way you want them to treat you.
我奶奶說金科玉律就是用你希望別人對待你的方式去對待別人。
golden hair: The doll on my sister's bed has golden hair, and she has kept it since she was five years old.
我姊姊床上的娃娃有一頭金髮，她從五歲就一直留著它。
the golden age: Many people say the golden age of our town was fifty years ago, when the trains brought visitors every day.
很多人說我們小鎮的黃金時代是五十年前，那時火車每天都帶來遊客。
golden years: My grandfather and grandmother enjoy their golden years by growing vegetables and taking walks in the park every evening.
我的爺爺奶奶種菜、每天傍晚在公園散步，享受他們的晚年。
a golden rule: A golden rule in our class is that you must listen when another student is speaking.
我們班的一條金科玉律是，別的學生在說話時你必須聽。
a good deal of: It took a good deal of time to finish the science report, so I stayed up until midnight.
完成科學報告花了大量的時間，所以我熬夜到半夜。
for good: After the big fight last year, my uncle left the company for good and started his own small shop.
去年大吵一架之後，我叔叔永遠離開了那家公司，開了自己的小店。
be good at: Jenny is good at drawing, so our class asked her to make the big picture for the school fair.

湯姆每個星期天早上都洗他的車；房子前面那輛紅車是他的。
himself 他自己: Nobody helped Jack with his science homework; he did it himself and got the best grade in the class.
沒有人幫傑克做他的自然作業；他自己做的，還拿到全班最好的成績。
feel homesick: During the first week of summer camp, the little boy began to feel homesick and cried before bed every night.
夏令營的第一週，那個小男孩開始想家，每晚睡前都哭。
be homesick for Taiwan: After living in America for two years, my cousin is homesick for Taiwan and misses the night markets most.
在美國住了兩年後，我表哥很想念台灣，最想念的是夜市。
get homesick: Many students get homesick when they first move to the big city, but they usually feel better after a month.
許多學生剛搬到大城市時會開始想家，但通常一個月後就會好轉。
You should always be honest with your parents, even when you break something and are afraid they will be angry.
你應該永遠對父母誠實，即使你打破了東西，害怕他們會生氣。
to be honest: To be honest, I did not like the movie very much, but the popcorn and the music were great.
老實說，我不太喜歡那部電影，但爆米花和音樂很棒。
an honest mistake: The waiter gave us the wrong drinks, but it was an honest mistake, so we just smiled and said thank you.
服務生送錯了飲料，但那是無心之過，所以我們只是微笑說謝謝。
honest work: My grandfather sold vegetables in the market for forty years, and he always said honest work makes a happy life.
我爺爺在市場賣了四十年的菜，他總是說正當的工作帶來快樂的生活。
an honest answer: When the teacher asked who broke the window, Ben gave an honest answer and said he did it by accident.
當老師問是誰打破窗戶時，班給了一個誠實的回答，說是他不小心弄破的。
Honestly!: Honestly! You left your lunch box at home again, and this is the third time this week.
真是的！你又把便當盒忘在家裡了，這已經是這週的第三次了。
honest 誠實的（形容詞）: Everyone trusts Sam because he is an honest boy who never tells lies, even when the truth gets him in trouble.
大家都信任山姆，因為他是個誠實的男孩，從不說謊，即使說實話會讓他惹上麻煩。
honestly 老實說（副詞）: Honestly, I did not study for the test last night because I fell asleep on the sofa after dinner.
老實說，我昨晚沒有準備考試，因為晚餐後我在沙發上睡著了。
honesty 誠實（名詞）: My mother always tells me that honesty is the best policy, so I told the teacher I forgot my homework.
我媽媽總是告訴我誠實為上策，所以我告訴老師我忘了帶作業。
truthful 說實話的: When Mom asked about the broken cup, honest little Lily gave a truthful answer and said she dropped it while washing dishes.
當媽媽問起破掉的杯子時，誠實的小莉莉說了實話，說是她洗碗時弄掉的。
horrible weather: We had horrible weather on our trip to the mountains, with cold wind and rain every single day.
我們去山上旅行時天氣糟透了，每一天都有冷風和雨。
a horrible smell: There was a horrible smell coming from the kitchen because someone forgot the fish in the trash can for three days.
廚房傳出難聞的臭味，因為有人把魚忘在垃圾桶裡三天。
feel horrible: I felt horrible after eating too much ice cream at the party, so I went to bed early without dinner.
派對上吃太多冰淇淋後我感覺很糟，所以我沒吃晚餐就早早上床睡覺。
a horrible dream: Last night I had a horrible dream about a big dog chasing me, and I woke up at three in the morning.
昨晚我做了一個可怕的夢，夢到一隻大狗追我，我在凌晨三點醒來。
look horrible: You look horrible this morning; did you stay up all night playing computer games again?
你今天早上看起來很糟；你又熬夜整晚玩電腦遊戲了嗎？
hot news: Everyone at school is talking about the hot news that our basketball team will play in the national final.
學校裡每個人都在談論熱門新聞：我們的籃球隊要打全國決賽了。
a hot topic: The new school uniform has become a hot topic, and students talk about it at lunch every day.
新校服成了熱門話題，學生們每天午餐時都在討論。
in hot water: Jason is in hot water with his mother because he broke her favorite glass bowl while playing ball in the house.
傑森惹上麻煩了，因為他在家裡玩球時打破了媽媽最喜歡的玻璃碗。
hot dogs: At the baseball game, my dad bought us two hot dogs and a large drink, and we had a wonderful time.
在棒球賽上，爸爸買了兩個熱狗和一杯大飲料給我們，我們玩得很開心。
a hot temper: My uncle has a hot temper, so he often shouts at the TV when his favorite team is losing.
我叔叔脾氣火爆，所以當他最喜歡的球隊輸球時，他常對著電視大吼。
be hot on: My little sister is hot on drawing these days, and she fills a new notebook with pictures every week.
我妹妹最近熱衷於畫畫，每週都畫滿一本新的筆記本。
a hot seller: This small bag is a hot seller at the night market, and the shop sells more than one hundred every night.
這個小包包是夜市的暢銷品，那家店每晚賣出超過一百個。
strike while the iron is hot: The teacher says we should strike while the iron is hot and review the new words right after class.
老師說我們應該打鐵趁熱，下課後馬上複習新單字。
hot 熱的／辣的（形容詞）: Be careful with the hot soup, because my grandmother just took it off the stove a minute ago.
小心那碗熱湯，因為我奶奶一分鐘前才剛把它從爐子上端下來。
warm 溫暖的: It was a warm day in March, not a hot one, so we took off our jackets and had a picnic in the park.
那是三月裡溫暖的一天，不算熱，所以我們脫下外套，在公園野餐。
heat 熱（名詞）／加熱（動詞）: First, heat the water in the pot until it is hot, and then put in the noodles and cook them for three minutes.
首先把鍋裡的水加熱到變熱，然後放進麵條，煮三分鐘。
human beings: Human beings need clean water, fresh air, and enough food, but many people around the world do not have them.
人類需要乾淨的水、新鮮的空氣和足夠的食物，但世界上許多人都沒有這些。
a human being: A robot can do many things quickly, but it cannot love or laugh like a human being can.
機器人能快速做很多事，但它不能像一個人那樣去愛或笑。
human nature: It is human nature to want more, so some people keep buying new things even when they do not need them.
想要更多是人性，所以有些人即使不需要也一直買新東西。
human rights: Every child has the right to go to school; this is one of the most basic human rights in the world.
每個孩子都有上學的權利；這是世界上最基本的人權之一。
the human body: In science class, we learned that the human body has more than two hundred bones and needs water every day.
在自然課上，我們學到人體有超過兩百根骨頭，而且每天都需要水。
Do not feel so bad about the wrong answer; everyone is human, and even the teacher makes mistakes sometimes.
不要為答錯題這麼難過；人都會犯錯，就連老師有時也會出錯。
be only human: The doctors work very hard, but they are only human and need to rest and eat like everyone else.
醫生們工作非常辛苦，但他們也只是凡人，和大家一樣需要休息和吃飯。
a humble home: My grandmother lives in a humble home near the rice fields, but her door is always open to friends.
我奶奶住在稻田旁一個簡陋的家，但她的大門總是為朋友敞開。
a humble beginning: The famous singer had a humble beginning; she sang on the street for money when she was a young girl.
這位知名歌手有個卑微的起點；她小女孩時曾在街頭唱歌賺錢。
be humble about: Although Jenny won the national piano prize, she is humble about it and never talks about her success.
雖然珍妮贏了全國鋼琴獎，她對這件事很謙虛，從不談自己的成就。
in my humble opinion: In my humble opinion, the school should start classes later so that students can get enough sleep every night.
依我拙見，學校應該晚一點開始上課，這樣學生每晚才能有足夠的睡眠。
hot and humid: It is hot and humid in Taipei in July, so we stay inside with the fan on and drink cold tea.
七月的台北又熱又潮濕，所以我們待在室內開著電風扇喝冰茶。
humid weather: Many people do not like the humid weather in summer because their clothes take two days to dry.
許多人不喜歡夏天潮濕的天氣，因為他們的衣服要兩天才會乾。
a humid climate: Taiwan has a humid climate, so bread goes bad quickly and we have to keep it in the refrigerator.
台灣有潮濕的氣候，所以麵包很快就會壞掉，我們必須把它放在冰箱裡。
a humorous story: Grandpa told us a humorous story about his first day at work, and everyone at the table laughed loudly.
爺爺跟我們說了一個關於他上班第一天的幽默故事，桌邊每個人都大笑。
a humorous writer: My favorite writer is a humorous writer, and her books about school life always make me laugh on the bus.
我最喜歡的作家是個幽默的作家，她寫校園生活的書總是讓我在公車上大笑。
a sense of humor: Our English teacher has a great sense of humor, so nobody feels sleepy in her class even on Monday morning.
我們的英文老師很有幽默感，所以即使是星期一早上，她的課也沒人覺得睏。
be hungry for success: The young player is hungry for success, so he stays on the field an hour after practice every day.
這位年輕球員渴望成功，所以每天練習結束後他還在球場上多待一個小時。
go hungry: Many children in poor countries go hungry every day, so our school collects money for them every winter.
貧窮國家的許多孩子每天都在挨餓，所以我們學校每年冬天都為他們募款。
hungry eyes: The little boy looked at the chocolate cake in the shop window with hungry eyes, but he had no money.
小男孩用渴望的眼神看著櫥窗裡的巧克力蛋糕，但他沒有錢。
be hungry for love: The old dog at the animal center is hungry for love, and it jumps up happily whenever a visitor comes.
動物中心那隻老狗渴望愛，每當有訪客來，它都會開心地跳起來。
hungry 餓的（形容詞）: After playing basketball for two hours, we were so hungry that we ate three bowls of noodles each.
打了兩小時籃球後，我們餓到每個人吃了三碗麵。
hunger 飢餓（名詞）: A long time ago, many people in the village died of hunger because the rain did not come for a whole year.
很久以前，村裡許多人死於飢餓，因為整整一年都沒有下雨。
hungrily 飢餓地（副詞）: The children ate hungrily after the long walk, and in ten minutes all the sandwiches on the table were gone.
長途步行後孩子們飢餓地吃著，十分鐘內桌上所有的三明治都吃光了。
be ill in bed: My grandfather has been ill in bed for a week, so I bring him hot soup and read him the newspaper.
我爺爺生病臥床已經一週了，所以我端熱湯給他，還念報紙給他聽。
fall ill: Two days before the big game, our best player fell ill and had to stay home with a high fever.
大賽前兩天，我們最好的球員生病了，只能發著高燒留在家裡。
be ill at ease: Mark felt ill at ease at the party because he did not know anyone, so he left before the cake came.
馬克在派對上覺得不自在，因為他不認識任何人，所以蛋糕還沒上他就離開了。
speak ill of: My mother taught me never to speak ill of others, even when they are not nice to me at school.
我媽媽教我永遠不要說別人的壞話，即使他們在學校對我不好。
ill 不放名詞前: We do not say an ill girl in English; instead, we say the girl is ill or she is sick.
英文裡我們不說 an ill girl；我們會說 the girl is ill 或 she is sick。
a sick man: A sick man sat alone in the hospital; he was too ill to walk, so the nurse brought him a blanket.
一位病人獨自坐在醫院裡；他病得走不動，所以護士拿了一條毯子給他。
sick 可放名詞前: The doctor visits the sick children every morning, and the ill ones who cannot get up get funny stories in bed.
醫生每天早上去探望病童，起不了床的病童就在床上聽有趣的故事。
feel sick: I was not ill, but I felt sick on the bus to the mountains, so my mother opened the window for me.
我沒有生病，但往山上的公車上我覺得想吐，所以媽媽為我打開窗戶。
It was impolite to the old lady when the boy pushed past her on the bus without saying sorry.
男孩在公車上推開老太太卻沒說抱歉，這對她很不禮貌。
My grandmother told me it's impolite to point at people on the street, even when they look very strange.
我奶奶告訴我，在街上指著別人是不禮貌的，即使他們看起來很奇怪。
an impolite question: Asking a woman how old she is or how much money she makes is an impolite question in many countries.
在許多國家，問一位女士幾歲或賺多少錢是不禮貌的問題。
be important to me: My old bike is important to me because my grandfather gave it to me on my birthday when I was ten.
我那輛舊腳踏車對我很重要，因為那是爺爺在我十歲生日時送給我的。
be important for health: Eating breakfast every morning is important for health, so my mother never lets us leave the house without it.
每天早上吃早餐對健康很重要，所以我媽媽從不讓我們沒吃就出門。
It's important that: It's important that you drink enough water on hot days, or you may get a headache in the afternoon.
在熱天喝足夠的水很重要，否則你下午可能會頭痛。
an important person: An important person is coming to our school next week, so the students are washing the windows and floors today.
下週有一位重要人物要來我們學校，所以學生們今天在洗窗戶和地板。
play an important part: Teachers play an important part in a child's life because they teach not only lessons but also how to be kind.
老師在孩子的生命中扮演重要角色，因為他們不只教課，也教孩子如何待人友善。
an impossible dream: Flying to the moon was once an impossible dream, but people did it more than fifty years ago.
飛到月球曾是個不可能的夢，但人們在五十多年前就做到了。

我的教練總是說沒有不可能的事，所以我持續練習，今年夏天終於學會游泳了。
It's impossible to: It's impossible to finish all this homework in one hour, so let's start with the math and do the rest tomorrow.
一小時內做完所有這些功課是不可能的，所以我們先從數學開始，剩下的明天做。
Getting up at five in the morning is impossible for my brother, because he always plays games until midnight.
早上五點起床對我弟弟是不可能的，因為他總是玩遊戲玩到半夜。
be independent of one's parents: After she found a job in Taipei, my cousin became independent of her parents and paid for everything herself.
在台北找到工作後，我表姊不再依賴父母，所有的開銷都自己付。
an independent country: In history class, we learned how the small island became an independent country after many years of fighting.
在歷史課上，我們學到那個小島如何在多年的戰鬥後成為一個獨立的國家。
an independent thinker: Our teacher wants each of us to be an independent thinker who asks questions instead of believing everything on the Internet.
我們老師希望我們每個人都成為獨立思考者，會提出問題，而不是相信網路上的一切。
become independent: When you go to college, you will have to become independent and learn to cook and wash your own clothes.
當你上大學時，你必須變得獨立，學會自己煮飯和洗衣服。
instant noodles: When my parents work late, my brother and I cook instant noodles with an egg and some vegetables for dinner.
當我爸媽工作到很晚時，我和哥哥會煮泡麵加一顆蛋和一些蔬菜當晚餐。
instant coffee: My father drinks a cup of instant coffee every morning because he has no time to make real coffee before work.
我爸爸每天早上喝一杯即溶咖啡，因為他上班前沒有時間煮真正的咖啡。
an instant success: The young singer's first song was an instant success, and millions of people listened to it in just one week.
這位年輕歌手的第一首歌一夕成功，短短一週內就有數百萬人聽過。
in an instant: The cat saw the mouse and, in an instant, it jumped off the sofa and ran across the kitchen floor.
貓看見老鼠，一瞬間就從沙發跳下來，跑過廚房的地板。
an intelligent student: Lisa is an intelligent student who understands new math ideas quickly and often helps the rest of the class.
麗莎是個聰明的學生，很快就能理解新的數學概念，而且常常幫助班上其他同學。
an intelligent answer: When the teacher asked why the sky is blue, Mike gave an intelligent answer that surprised the whole class.
當老師問天空為什麼是藍色時，麥克給了一個聰明的回答，讓全班都很驚訝。
an intelligent machine: An intelligent machine in the factory can learn from its mistakes and work faster than ten people together.
工廠裡的智慧機器能從錯誤中學習，而且工作起來比十個人一起還快。
be interested in music: My little sister is interested in music, so she practices the piano for an hour every day after school.
我妹妹對音樂有興趣，所以她每天放學後練一小時鋼琴。
get interested in: After watching a show about space, Ben got interested in the stars and asked his parents for a book about them.
看了一個關於太空的節目後，班開始對星星有興趣，向爸媽要一本關於星星的書。
an interested look: When Grandpa started talking about his trip to Japan, the children listened with an interested look on their faces.
當爺爺開始說起他的日本之旅時，孩子們臉上帶著感興趣的表情聽著。
interested 人感到有興趣: Thank you for telling me about the English club; I'm interested, so please tell me when the next meeting is.
謝謝你跟我說英文社的事；我有興趣，所以請告訴我下次聚會是什麼時候。
interesting 事物有趣: Our science teacher showed us how plants drink water; it's interesting, and now I want to grow some at home.
我們的自然老師示範植物如何喝水；這很有趣，現在我想在家裡種一些。
an interesting book: I found an interesting book about animals in the library, and I finished all three hundred pages in two days.
我在圖書館找到一本關於動物的有趣的書，兩天就讀完了三百頁。
be interested to know: I would be interested to know how you learned to speak English so well in only one year.
我很想知道你如何在短短一年內把英文學得這麼好。
an interesting idea: Planting a vegetable garden on the school roof is an interesting idea, and the principal said yes right away.
在學校屋頂上種菜園是個有趣的想法，校長馬上就答應了。
It's interesting that: It's interesting that my dog always knows when my father is coming home, even before his car arrives.
有趣的是，我的狗總是知道爸爸什麼時候要回家，甚至在他的車到之前就知道。
interesting people: On the train trip across Japan, we met many interesting people who told us stories about their small towns.
在橫越日本的火車旅行中，我們遇到許多有意思的人，他們跟我們講自己小鎮的故事。
find it interesting: Some students think history is boring, but I find it interesting because every story tells us something about today.
有些學生覺得歷史無聊，但我覺得它有趣，因為每個故事都告訴我們一些關於今天的事。
international news: My father watches the international news every night at nine because he wants to know what happens around the world.
我爸爸每晚九點看國際新聞，因為他想知道世界各地發生了什麼事。
an international school: My cousin goes to an international school in Taipei, so most of her classes are taught in English.
我表妹在台北上一所國際學校，所以她大部分的課都用英文教。
an international student: An international student from France joined our class this year, and he is teaching us some simple French words.
今年有一位來自法國的國際學生加入我們班，他正在教我們一些簡單的法文單字。
international trade: Taiwan is famous for international trade, and many things made here are sold in stores all over the world.
台灣以國際貿易聞名，許多在這裡製造的東西銷售到世界各地的商店。
its 它的（無撇號）: The little dog moved its tail happily when it saw my brother come home from school with a bag of snacks.
小狗看到我哥哥帶著一袋零食從學校回家時，開心地搖著它的尾巴。
it's: It's a cat, not a dog, so do not pull its tail or try to take it for a walk in the park.
它是一隻貓，不是狗，所以不要拉它的尾巴，也不要試著帶它去公園散步。
the cat and its tail: The cat and its tail moved slowly across the wall, and the birds in the tree flew away at once.
貓和它的尾巴慢慢地走過牆頭，樹上的鳥兒立刻飛走了。
be jealous of her sister: Mary is jealous of her sister because their parents always talk about how well she does at school.
瑪麗嫉妒她姊姊，因為他們的父母總是在談她姊姊在學校表現多好。
get jealous: My little brother gets jealous when I play with the neighbor's kids, so I always ask him to join us.
當我和鄰居的小孩玩時，我弟弟會變得嫉妒，所以我總是叫他一起加入。
a jealous husband: In the story, a jealous husband follows his wife to the market every day because he thinks she has a secret.
在故事裡，一個愛嫉妒的丈夫每天跟著妻子去市場，因為他認為她有秘密。
make sb. jealous: Jenny showed everyone her new phone to make her friends jealous, but nobody really cared about it.
珍妮向大家展示她的新手機想讓朋友嫉妒，但沒有人真的在意。
a kind of fruit: The farmer gave us a kind of fruit we had never seen before; it was purple outside and sweet inside.
農夫給了我們一種從沒見過的水果；它外面是紫色的，裡面很甜。
kind of tired: I am kind of tired after the long bus ride, so let's rest at the hotel before we go shopping.
長途巴士後我有點累，所以我們先在飯店休息，再去逛街吧。
all kinds of: The new supermarket near our school sells all kinds of fruit, from apples and bananas to strawberries from Japan.
我們學校附近的新超市賣各種的水果，從蘋果、香蕉到日本來的草莓都有。
What kind of: What kind of music do you like to listen to when you study, or do you need a quiet room?
你讀書時喜歡聽什麼樣的音樂，還是你需要安靜的房間？
something of the kind: My grandmother needed a small lamp for her bedroom, so I looked on the Internet and found something of the kind for her.
我奶奶的臥室需要一盞小燈，所以我上網找到了這類的東西給她。
nothing of the kind: People said the new teacher was mean and angry, but she was nothing of the kind; she was warm and funny.
大家說新老師又兇又愛生氣，但她完全不是這樣；她既溫暖又風趣。
one of a kind: My grandfather's old watch is one of a kind because he made it himself when he was a young man.
我爺爺的舊手錶是獨一無二的，因為那是他年輕時自己做的。
kind-hearted: Mrs. Chen is a kind-hearted woman who cooks hot meals for the old people on her street every Sunday.
陳太太是個善良的女人，每個星期天都為她那條街上的老人煮熱食。
be kind to animals: My little sister is always kind to animals; she feeds the street cats and never pulls our dog's tail.
我妹妹總是對動物很好；她餵流浪貓，而且從不拉我們家狗的尾巴。
It's kind of you to help me carry these heavy bags up the stairs; I could not do it alone.
你真好心幫我把這些重袋子搬上樓；我一個人做不到。
be kind enough to: The old man was kind enough to show us the way to the train station when we got lost in the city.
當我們在城裡迷路時，那位老先生好心地幫我們指路到火車站。
a kind heart: Our teacher has a kind heart; she bought lunch for a student who forgot his money and never told anyone.
我們的老師有一顆善良的心；她幫一個忘記帶錢的學生買了午餐，而且從沒告訴任何人。
kind words: A few kind words from my coach after the lost game made me feel much better that evening.
輸掉比賽後，教練的幾句好話讓我那天晚上好過許多。
kind 親切的（形容詞）: Mr. Brown is a kind man who always smiles at the children and gives them candy on their birthdays.
布朗先生是個親切的男人，總是對孩子們微笑，還在他們生日時送糖果。
a kind 種類（名詞）: A sheep dog is a kind of dog that helps farmers on the hills and can run for hours without getting tired.
牧羊犬是一種在山丘上幫助農夫、而且能跑好幾個小時都不累的狗。
kind of 有點（口語副詞）: It is kind of cold in the library this morning, so you may want to put your jacket back on.
今天早上圖書館裡有點冷，所以你可能會想把外套再穿上。
a large family: Jack comes from a large family with six children, so dinner at his house is always loud and fun.
傑克來自一個有六個孩子的大家庭，所以在他家吃晚餐總是又熱鬧又有趣。
a large number of: A large number of students joined the school trip to the zoo, so we needed three buses instead of two.
大量的學生參加了學校的動物園之旅，所以我們需要三輛公車而不是兩輛。
a large amount of: My brother drinks a large amount of water after every basketball game because he gets very thirsty.
我哥哥每次打完籃球都喝大量的水，因為他會非常口渴。
at large: The police said the man who stole the bikes is still at large, so please lock your bike every night.
警方說偷腳踏車的那個男人仍然逍遙法外，所以請每晚把你的腳踏車鎖好。
by and large: There were a few small problems on our trip, but by and large we had a great time in Japan.
我們的旅行中有幾個小問題，但大體上我們在日本玩得很開心。
a large size: This T-shirt is too small for my father, so could you please bring me a large size from the back?
這件T恤對我爸爸來說太小了，可以請你從後面拿一件大尺寸的給我嗎？
a large population: Taipei has a large population, so the MRT is always full of people in the morning and after work.
台北人口眾多，所以捷運在早上和下班後總是擠滿了人。
a large crowd: A large crowd waited outside the store before it opened because the new game was going on sale that day.
開店前就有一大群人在店外等候，因為那天新遊戲要開賣了。
large 大（尺寸、數量）: When I buy a drink at the night market, I always ask for a large size because I am always thirsty after school.
我在夜市買飲料時總是要大尺寸的，因為放學後我總是很渴。
big 大（口語；也指重要）: Tomorrow is a big day for my sister, not just a large test, because she will sing on stage in front of the whole school.
明天對我姊姊來說是重要的一天，不只是一次大考，因為她要在全校面前上台唱歌。
great 偉大／很棒: The large picture in the hall shows a great man who built our town's first school for poor children.
大廳裡那幅大圖畫畫的是一位偉大的人，他為窮困的孩子建了我們鎮上第一所學校。
a large meal: After the long soccer game, the hungry boys went home and had a large meal with rice, chicken, and soup.
漫長的足球比賽結束後，飢餓的男孩們回家吃了一頓有飯、雞肉和湯的大餐。
at last: We waited for the bus in the rain for almost an hour, and at last it came around the corner.
我們在雨中等公車等了快一個小時，終於它從轉角開過來了。
last night: Last night my family watched a funny movie together, so I went to bed much later than usual.
昨晚我家人一起看了一部有趣的電影，所以我比平常晚很多才上床睡覺。
the last thing I want: The last thing I want is to be sick on my birthday, so I am drinking warm water and sleeping early.
我最不想要的事就是生日那天生病，所以我正喝溫水並早點睡覺。
last but not least: Thank you to my teachers and my friends, and last but not least, thank you to my wonderful parents.
感謝我的老師和朋友們，最後但同樣重要的，感謝我很棒的父母。
the last minute: Jenny always finishes her homework at the last minute, so she often forgets to bring it to school.
珍妮總是在最後一刻才寫完作業，所以她常常忘記帶來學校。
the last word: In our family, Mom has the last word about dinner, so we eat what she decides to cook.
在我們家，晚餐吃什麼媽媽有最後決定權，所以她決定煮什麼我們就吃什麼。
last week: Last week our class went to the zoo, and we saw two baby elephants playing in the water.
上週我們班去了動物園，我們看到兩隻小象在水裡玩。
the last two years: Over the last two years, my little brother has grown ten centimeters, and now he is taller than me.
過去兩年裡，我弟弟長高了十公分，現在他比我還高了。
the night before last: The night before last, there was a big storm, and the strong wind blew down a tree near our school.
前天晚上有一場大暴風雨，強風吹倒了我們學校附近的一棵樹。
be the last to arrive: Peter is always the last to arrive at the party because he lives far away and comes by bus.
彼得總是最後到派對的人，因為他住得很遠，而且是搭公車來的。
last 最後的／上一個: I lost my umbrella last week, so my mother bought me a new blue one at the night market yesterday.
我上週弄丟了雨傘，所以媽媽昨天在夜市幫我買了一把新的藍色雨傘。
latest 最新的: Last night my father read the latest news on his phone and told us about the big storm coming this weekend.
昨晚我爸爸在手機上看了最新的新聞，並告訴我們這個週末要來的大暴風雨。
the last bus: If we miss the last bus tonight, we will have to walk home for more than one hour in the dark.
如果我們今晚錯過最後一班公車，就得在黑暗中走一個多小時的路回家。
the latest fashion: My sister spent all her money last month because she always wants to follow the latest fashion.
我姊姊上個月花光了所有的錢，因為她總是想追隨最新時尚。
later 稍後: I have to go to my last class now, so see you later at the park after dinner, all right?
我現在得去上最後一堂課了，所以晚餐後在公園稍後見，好嗎？
the latter 後者: Only the last two cakes are on the table, and I like the latter one because it has more chocolate.
桌上只剩最後兩個蛋糕，我喜歡後者那一個，因為它有比較多巧克力。
be late for school: Kevin was late for school this morning because his alarm clock did not ring and he missed the bus.
凱文今天早上上學遲到，因為他的鬧鐘沒有響，而且他錯過了公車。
the late Mr. Lin: The late Mr. Lin was our music teacher for twenty years, and everyone in the school loved his kind smile.
已故的林先生當了我們二十年的音樂老師，學校裡每個人都喜愛他親切的笑容。
in the late afternoon: We usually play basketball in the late afternoon because it is cooler and the sun is not so strong.
我們通常在傍晚打籃球，因為那時比較涼，太陽也沒那麼強。
in his late forties: My uncle is in his late forties, but he still runs five kilometers every morning before breakfast.
我叔叔快五十歲了，但他每天早上吃早餐前仍然跑五公里。
a late night: I had a late night finishing my science report, so I feel very tired and sleepy in class today.
我熬夜寫完了自然科學報告，所以今天上課我覺得非常累又想睡。
late at night: Please do not play loud music late at night because the neighbors next door need to sleep.
請不要在深夜播放大聲的音樂，因為隔壁的鄰居需要睡覺。
Tom finally said sorry to Mary a week after the fight, and she smiled and said better late than never.
湯姆在吵架一週後終於向瑪麗道歉，她笑著說遲到總比不到好。
be late with the rent: Mr. Wang lost his job in May, so he was late with the rent for two months and felt very worried.
王先生五月失業了，所以他房租遲繳了兩個月，覺得非常擔心。
sooner or later: If you keep eating candy and never brush your teeth, sooner or later you will have to see a dentist.
如果你一直吃糖又從不刷牙，遲早你得去看牙醫。
late 遲的／遲（形容詞與副詞同形）: Students who come late to class must stand at the door and say sorry to the teacher before sitting down.
上課遲到的學生必須站在門口向老師道歉，然後才能坐下。
lately 最近（副詞）: I have not seen you at the basketball court for weeks, so what have you been doing lately after school?
我好幾個星期沒在籃球場看到你了，你最近放學後都在做什麼？
the late 已故的: In the story, the late king was a kind man, and the people of the country still remember him with love.
故事裡，已故的國王是個仁慈的人，國家的人民仍然帶著愛懷念他。
the latest news: Have you heard the latest news about our school trip, because the teacher says we are going to Tainan.
你聽到有關我們學校旅行的最新消息了嗎？因為老師說我們要去台南。
the latest phone: Jack wants to buy the latest phone, but his parents say his old one still works well enough.
傑克想買最新款手機，但他父母說他的舊手機還夠好用。
at the latest: The teacher told us to hand in our book reports by Friday at the latest, or we will lose points.
老師告訴我們最遲星期五要交讀書報告，否則我們會被扣分。
the latest in: This small camera is the latest in a long line of popular things made by that famous Japanese company.
這台小相機是那家知名日本公司一系列受歡迎產品中的最新產品。
the former … the latter: Both Amy and Lisa are good singers, but the former likes pop music and the latter likes old songs more.
艾咪和麗莎都是很好的歌手，但前者喜歡流行音樂，後者比較喜歡老歌。
in the latter half of: Our team was losing at first, but we scored three goals in the latter half of the game and won.
我們隊一開始落後，但我們在比賽的後半進了三球並贏了比賽。
the latter 兩者中的後者: Dad showed me a red bike and a black bike, and I chose the latter one because it looked faster.
爸爸給我看一輛紅色腳踏車和一輛黑色腳踏車，我選了後者，因為它看起來比較快。
later 稍後（副詞）: Mom asked if I wanted to talk now or later, and I chose the latter, so please come later after dinner.
媽媽問我想現在還是稍後談，我選了後者，所以請晚餐後再稍後過來。
a lazy afternoon: On Sunday we spent a lazy afternoon at Grandma's house, drinking tea and watching the clouds go by.
星期天我們在奶奶家度過了一個悠閒的午後，喝茶並看著雲飄過。
a lazy day: After a week of tests, I just want a lazy day at home with no homework, no alarm, and lots of snacks.
考了一週的試後，我只想在家過一個悠閒的一天，沒有作業、沒有鬧鐘，還有很多零食。
a lazy eye: The doctor said my little cousin has a lazy eye, so she needs to wear special glasses every day.
醫生說我的小表妹有弱視，所以她每天都需要戴特殊的眼鏡。
be too lazy to: It was raining hard outside, and Ben was too lazy to walk to the store, so he stayed hungry.
外面雨下得很大，小班懶得走路去商店，所以他就一直餓著。
a lazy river: We sat in a big boat and let the lazy river carry us slowly past the green trees and small farms.
我們坐在一艘大船上，讓流速緩慢的河帶著我們慢慢經過綠樹和小農場。
at least: The movie starts at seven, so we should leave home at least thirty minutes early to find good seats.
電影七點開始，所以我們至少應該提早三十分鐘出門去找好位子。
not in the least: I thought the test would be hard, but I was not in the least worried after I studied all week.
我原以為考試會很難，但我讀了一整週的書後，一點也不擔心。
the least expensive: This is the least expensive shirt in the store, but it looks very nice and fits me well.
這是店裡最便宜的襯衫，但它看起來很好看，而且很合我身。
to say the least: The weather on our trip was terrible, to say the least, because it rained every single day.
至少可以這麼說，我們旅行時的天氣糟透了，因為每一天都在下雨。
least of all: Nobody wanted to clean the bathroom, least of all my little brother, who ran away to play games.
沒有人想打掃浴室，最不想的是我弟弟，他跑去打電動了。
least 最少（little 的最高級）: Among the three friends, Kate has the least money, but she is always the happiest one at lunch.
三個朋友之中，凱特的錢最少，但她在吃午餐時總是最快樂的那一個。
fewest 最少（可數）: Emily made the fewest mistakes on the spelling test and used the least time, so the teacher praised her.
艾蜜莉在拼字測驗中犯的錯誤最少，用的時間也最少，所以老師稱讚了她。
at least 至少: You need at least ten people to play this game, so let us call our friends and ask them to come over.
你需要至少十個人才能玩這個遊戲，所以我們打電話給朋友請他們過來吧。
at most 最多: The small room can hold at most ten students, so at least half of the class will have to wait outside.
這間小房間最多只能容納十個學生，所以班上至少有一半的人得在外面等。
on the left: When you walk into the library, the computer room is on the left and the reading room is on the right.
當你走進圖書館，電腦室在左邊，閱覽室在右邊。
turn left: Go straight for two blocks and turn left at the bank, and you will see the post office next to a park.
直走兩個街區，在銀行左轉，你就會看到郵局在公園旁邊。
the left hand: My brother writes with his left hand, so he always sits at the end of the table during dinner.
我哥哥用左手寫字，所以吃晚餐時他總是坐在桌子的尾端。
left over: There was some rice left over from dinner, so Mom made fried rice with eggs for our breakfast today.
晚餐有一些剩下的飯，所以媽媽今天早餐幫我們做了蛋炒飯。
be left behind: Nobody wants to be left behind on the school trip, so please stay close to the teacher at all times.
沒有人想在學校旅行時被遺留下來，所以請隨時待在老師附近。
I opened the cookie box after school, but nothing is left because my brother ate them all this morning.
放學後我打開餅乾盒，但什麼都沒剩，因為我哥哥今天早上全吃光了。
left-handed: My cousin is left-handed, so she has a special pen and a special desk that are easier for her to use.
我表妹是左撇子，所以她有一枝特別的筆和一張特別的桌子，讓她比較好用。
left 左邊的（形容詞）: Please write your name on the left side of the paper and the date on the right side before you start.
開始前，請在紙的左邊寫上你的名字，在右邊寫上日期。
left 離開（leave 的過去式）: Jason left the party early because he had a bad headache, and he went straight home to rest.
傑森因為頭很痛所以提早離開了派對，他直接回家休息。
left 剩下的: There are only two cookies left in the box, so you and your sister can each have one after lunch.
盒子裡只剩下兩塊餅乾，所以午餐後你和妹妹可以各吃一塊。
right 右邊的／正確的: Lily was the only one who got the right answer, and the students on the left side all got it wrong.
莉莉是唯一答對正確答案的人，而左邊的學生全都答錯了。
more or less: The two bikes look more or less the same, but the blue one is a little cheaper than the red one.
這兩輛腳踏車看起來差不多一樣，但藍色的比紅色的便宜一點。
less than ten: Our English club is small, and there are less than ten members, so everyone gets a chance to speak.
我們的英語社團很小，成員少於十人，所以每個人都有機會發言。
no less than: No less than fifty people came to Grandpa's birthday party, so we had to borrow chairs from the neighbors.
不少於五十個人來參加爺爺的生日派對，所以我們得向鄰居借椅子。
much less: My little brother cannot even ride a bike, much less drive a car, so stop asking him to take you.
我弟弟連腳踏車都不會騎，更不用說開車了，所以別再要他載你了。
less and less: Fewer students buy lunch at the school store now, and the shop is making less and less money each month.
現在在學校商店買午餐的學生變少了，店家每個月賺的錢也越來越少。
in less than a week: The doctor said my foot would get better in less than a week if I stayed home and did not run.
醫生說如果我留在家不跑步，我的腳不到一週就會好。
none the less: The walk up the mountain was long and hard, but we none the less enjoyed the beautiful view at the top.
爬山的路又長又辛苦，但我們仍然很享受山頂美麗的風景。
less 用於比較級: Getting good grades is important, but it is less important than being kind and honest to other people.
拿到好成績很重要，但它沒有對別人善良誠實那麼重要。
lesser 較小的: We visited a lesser known beach in the south, and there were only a few people swimming in the clear water.
我們去了南部一個較不為人知的海灘，清澈的水裡只有少數幾個人在游泳。
a light meal: I usually have a light meal before swimming because a big dinner makes me feel sick in the water.
我游泳前通常吃清淡的一餐，因為吃大餐會讓我在水裡感到不舒服。
a light sleeper: My mother is a light sleeper, so even the sound of a cat outside the window can wake her up at night.
我媽媽是個睡得淺的人，所以就連窗外貓的聲音也能在夜裡把她吵醒。
light rain: There was only light rain this morning, so we still walked to school without using an umbrella.
今天早上只有小雨，所以我們還是沒撐雨傘走路去學校。
light blue: Sandy painted her bedroom walls light blue because the color makes her feel calm and helps her sleep.
珊蒂把房間的牆漆成淺藍色，因為這個顏色讓她感到平靜，也幫助她入睡。
a light heart: After I finished all my tests on Friday, I walked home with a light heart and sang my favorite song.
星期五考完所有考試後，我帶著輕鬆的心情走回家，還唱著我最喜歡的歌。
light music: The restaurant plays light music during dinner, so the guests can talk and enjoy their food in peace.
這家餐廳在晚餐時間播放輕音樂，讓客人能安靜地聊天並享用食物。
make light of: Do not make light of a small cold, because it can become something more serious if you do not rest.
不要輕視小感冒，因為如果你不休息，它可能變成更嚴重的病。
a light touch: The baby was sleeping, so Mom gave his cheek a light touch and quietly closed the bedroom door.
寶寶在睡覺，所以媽媽輕輕一碰他的臉頰，然後安靜地關上房門。
travel light: When we go to Japan next month, I plan to travel light with only one small bag and two pairs of shoes.
下個月我們去日本時，我打算輕裝旅行，只帶一個小包包和兩雙鞋子。
light work: Watering the plants and feeding the fish is light work, so my little sister does it every morning.
幫植物澆水和餵魚是輕鬆的工作，所以我妹妹每天早上都做這件事。
light 輕的／淺色的（形容詞）: I only packed a light bag for the one-day trip, so it was easy to carry it up the hill.
這次一日遊我只打包了一個很輕的包包，所以把它背上山很容易。
light 燈／光（名詞）: It is getting dark in the living room, so please turn on the light before you start reading your book.
客廳越來越暗了，所以請在開始看書之前先把燈打開。
light 點燃（動詞）: When the power went out during the storm, Dad used a match to light a candle on the kitchen table.
暴風雨中停電時，爸爸用一根火柴點燃了廚房桌上的一根蠟燭。
lit 點燃（過去式）: It was very cold at the camp, so my uncle lit the fire, and its warm light made us feel better.
露營地非常冷，所以叔叔點燃了火，溫暖的火光讓我們感覺好多了。
be likely to rain: The sky is dark gray and the wind is getting stronger, so it is likely to rain before we get home.
天空灰暗，風也越來越強，所以我們回家前可能會下雨。
It's likely that: It is likely that our teacher will give us a surprise test tomorrow, so I am going to review tonight.
很可能我們老師明天會給我們一個突擊考試，所以我今晚要複習。
most likely: Mark is not answering his phone, so he is most likely still sleeping after staying up late last night.
馬克沒接電話，所以他很可能昨晚熬夜後還在睡覺。
be less likely to: Children who eat breakfast every day are less likely to feel tired or hungry during the morning classes.
每天吃早餐的孩子在早上上課時較不可能感到疲倦或飢餓。
a likely story: Ben said his dog ate his homework again, and the teacher laughed and said that was a likely story.
小班說他的狗又吃了他的作業，老師笑著說那是個聽起來不太可能的說法。
as likely as not: The traffic is always heavy on Friday evenings, so as likely as not we will be late for the movie.
星期五晚上交通總是很擁擠，所以我們很可能會趕不上電影。
likely 可能的（形容詞）: Will it snow in Taipei this winter, and the weather man said it is not likely because the city is too warm.
台北今年冬天會下雪嗎？氣象播報員說不太可能，因為城市太溫暖了。
probably 可能（副詞）: The sky is clearing up, so Dad will probably take us to the beach, and we are likely to swim all afternoon.
天空正在放晴，所以爸爸很可能會帶我們去海邊，而我們可能會游泳一整個下午。
like 像／喜歡: My little sister runs around the garden with her arms out like a bird, and she says she can fly.
我妹妹張開手臂像鳥一樣在花園裡跑來跑去，她說她會飛。
alike 相像的: Judy and her sister look so alike that even their teacher sometimes calls them by the wrong names in class.
茱蒂和她姊姊看起來如此相像，連她們的老師上課時有時都會叫錯名字。
a little: I am a little hungry, so let us buy some bread at the bakery before we walk to the train station.
我有一點點餓，所以在走去火車站之前，我們先到麵包店買些麵包吧。
little by little: Grandpa could not walk after he broke his leg, but little by little he got stronger and now he can jog.
爺爺摔斷腿後不能走路，但他一點一點地變強壯了，現在他可以慢跑了。
a little bird told me: A little bird told me that you got the highest score in the math test, so I bought you a cake.
有人告訴我你數學考試拿了最高分，所以我買了一個蛋糕給你。
my little sister: My little sister is only six years old, but she already knows how to read some easy English books.
我妹妹只有六歲，但她已經會讀一些簡單的英文書了。
a little while: Please wait here for a little while because the doctor is still talking with another patient inside.
請在這裡等一會兒，因為醫生還在裡面和另一位病人談話。
quite a little: We saved quite a little money by cooking at home instead of eating out every night this month.
這個月我們在家煮飯而不是每晚外食，省下了相當多的錢。
Little did I know: Little did I know that my friends were hiding behind the door to give me a surprise birthday party.
我一點也不知道我的朋友們躲在門後面，要給我一個驚喜的生日派對。
make little of: Do not make little of your brother's drawing, because he worked hard on it for two whole afternoons.
不要小看你弟弟的畫，因為他花了整整兩個下午努力畫它。
little 幾乎沒有（不可數）: I have little time to watch TV these days because I have to study for the big exam next week.
我這幾天幾乎沒有時間看電視，因為我得為下週的大考讀書。
a little 一些: If you have a little time after class, could you help me with these two hard math questions?
如果你下課後有一些時間，可以幫我看看這兩道難的數學題嗎？
few 幾乎沒有（可數）: Amy just moved to this little town, so she has few friends here and often feels lonely on weekends.
艾咪剛搬到這個小鎮，所以她在這裡幾乎沒有朋友，週末常常覺得寂寞。
small 小的（尺寸）: I keep old photos and little gifts in a small box under my bed and look at them when I am sad.
我把舊照片和小禮物放在床下的一個小盒子裡，難過時就會拿出來看。
little 小的（可愛、年幼）: A little girl in a pink dress was crying at the park because she could not find her mother.
一個穿粉紅色洋裝的小女孩在公園裡哭，因為她找不到她的媽媽。
a live fish: At the night market, we saw a man selling a live fish from a big tank of water next to his stand.
在夜市，我們看到一個男人在他攤位旁的大水槽裡賣活魚。
live on TV: The baseball game is live on TV tonight, so my whole family will watch it together in the living room.
今晚的棒球比賽在電視上直播，所以我全家會一起在客廳看。
live 活的／現場的（形容詞）: The coffee shop near our school has live music every Friday night, and many students go there to listen.
我們學校附近的咖啡店每週五晚上都有現場音樂，很多學生會去那裡聽。
live 住／活（動詞）: My grandmother and grandfather live in Taipei, and we take the train to visit them every month during the holidays.
我奶奶和爺爺住在台北，每個月假日我們都搭火車去看他們。
alive 活著的（補語）: The police found the little dog under the broken house after the storm, and everyone was happy that it was still alive.
暴風雨後警察在倒塌的房子下找到那隻小狗，大家都很高興它還活著。
living 活著的／生活的: We live in a small house, but our living room is big enough for the whole family to watch TV together.
我們住在一間小房子裡，但我們的客廳大到足以讓全家一起看電視。
the local people: When we visited the small fishing village, the local people were very friendly and showed us the best places to eat.
我們去那個小漁村時，當地人非常友善，還帶我們去最好吃的地方。
a local newspaper: My grandfather reads a local newspaper every morning because he wants to know what is happening in our town.
我爺爺每天早上都看地方報紙，因為他想知道我們鎮上發生了什麼事。
local food: On our trip to Tainan, we tried a lot of local food, and the beef soup was my favorite dish of all.
我們去台南旅行時嘗了很多當地食物，牛肉湯是我最喜歡的一道。
local time: It is nine in the morning in Taipei now, but the local time in New York is still eight at night.
現在台北是早上九點，但紐約的當地時間還是晚上八點。
a local train: We took a local train to the beach because it stops at every small station and the tickets are much cheaper.
我們搭區間車去海邊，因為它每個小站都停，而且車票便宜很多。
the locals: If you want to find a good restaurant in a new city, it is always a smart idea to ask the locals.
如果你想在新城市找到好餐廳，問本地人總是個聰明的主意。
a lonely road: We drove along a lonely road at night, and there were no houses, no cars, and no lights for many miles.
我們晚上開在一條荒涼的路上，好幾英里都沒有房子、沒有車，也沒有燈。
feel lonely: When my best friend moved to another city last year, I began to feel lonely at lunch time at school.
去年我最好的朋友搬到另一個城市後，我開始在學校午餐時間感到寂寞。
a lonely life: The old man lived a lonely life on the mountain for years, until a young family moved in next door.
這位老人在山上過了多年孤單的生活，直到一個年輕的家庭搬到隔壁。
a lonely island: In the movie, a boy is left on a lonely island after a storm and has to catch fish to stay alive.
電影裡，一個男孩在暴風雨後被留在一座孤島上，必須抓魚來活下去。
lonely 寂寞的（感覺）: Even though Grandma lives with us, she sometimes feels lonely because all her old friends have moved away.
雖然奶奶和我們住在一起，她有時仍感到寂寞，因為她所有的老朋友都搬走了。
alone 單獨的（狀態）: I like to be alone in my room after school for an hour, because quiet time helps me think clearly.
放學後我喜歡在房間裡單獨待一個小時，因為安靜的時間幫助我思考清楚。
loneliness 寂寞（名詞）: The old song is about the loneliness of a sailor who misses his family while he is far away at sea.
這首老歌是關於一位水手的寂寞，他在遙遠的海上想念著家人。
a long face: Why do you have a long face today, and did something bad happen at school or at your piano lesson?
你今天為什麼一臉不開心的表情？是學校或鋼琴課發生了什麼不好的事嗎？
a long time ago: A long time ago, people in this town walked many miles to get water from the river every single day.
很久以前，這個鎮上的人每天都要走很多英里到河邊取水。
before long: The sky is getting very dark, so before long it will start to rain, and we should go inside now.
天空越來越黑，所以不久就會開始下雨，我們現在應該進屋了。
in the long run: Eating vegetables may not be fun now, but in the long run it will keep your body strong and healthy.
現在吃蔬菜也許不好玩，但長遠來看它會讓你的身體強壯又健康。
so long: It was great to see you at the party tonight, so long for now, and call me when you get home safely.
今晚在派對上見到你真好，先說再見了，你平安到家後打電話給我。
as long as: You can play computer games tonight as long as you finish your homework and help wash the dishes first.
只要你先寫完作業並幫忙洗碗，今晚你就可以玩電腦遊戲。
all day long: On Sunday it rained all day long, so we stayed inside, baked cookies, and watched three old movies.
星期天下了整天的雨，所以我們待在室內烤餅乾，還看了三部老電影。
a long story: Why I came to school with wet shoes and a broken umbrella is a long story, so ask me at lunch.
我為什麼穿著濕鞋子、拿著壞雨傘來學校，說來話長，午餐時再問我。
take a long time: It can take a long time to learn to play the violin well, so you must practice a little every day.
學好小提琴可能要花很長時間，所以你必須每天練習一點。
a long way to go: My English is getting better, but I still have a long way to go before I can watch movies without reading.
我的英文越來越好了，但在我能不看字幕看電影之前，還有很長的路要走。
long ago: Long ago, there were no phones or computers, so people wrote letters and waited weeks for an answer.
很久以前沒有電話或電腦，所以人們寫信，然後等好幾週才有回音。
at long last: After three years of hard work and many failed tries, Dad at long last passed his driving test yesterday.
經過三年的努力和多次失敗的嘗試，爸爸昨天終於通過了駕照考試。
long 長的／長久（形容詞與副詞同形）: We cannot stay long at the party because my mother wants us home before nine o'clock on school nights.
我們不能在派對待太久，因為媽媽要我們在上學日晚上九點前回家。
long 渴望（動詞）: After two weeks at summer camp in the mountains, Eric began to long for home and his mother's cooking.
在山上的夏令營待了兩週後，艾瑞克開始渴望回家和媽媽做的菜。
length 長度（名詞）: The teacher asked us to measure the length of the long table with a piece of string and a ruler.
老師要我們用一條繩子和一把尺來測量那張長桌的長度。
at length 詳細地: At the meeting, the coach talked at length about the long game plan, so we did not get home until nine.
會議上，教練詳細地談了很長的比賽計畫，所以我們九點才到家。
a loud voice: Our teacher has a loud voice, so even the students in the back row can hear her clearly without trying.
我們老師的聲音很大，所以連後排的學生不用費力也能清楚聽見她說的話。
loud music: The boys next door play loud music every night, and my grandmother cannot sleep because of all the noise.
隔壁的男孩每晚都播很大聲的音樂，我奶奶因為這些噪音而無法入睡。
loud colors: My aunt likes to wear loud colors like bright pink and orange, so you can always find her in a crowd.
我阿姨喜歡穿亮粉紅和橘色這類太過鮮豔的顏色，所以你在人群中總能找到她。
out loud: The joke in the book was so funny that I laughed out loud in the quiet library, and everyone looked at me.
書裡的笑話太好笑了，我在安靜的圖書館裡大聲笑出來，大家都看著我。
read out loud: The teacher asked each student to read out loud one page of the story so we could practice speaking English.
老師請每位學生大聲念出故事的一頁，讓我們可以練習說英文。
a loud shirt: Uncle Ben wore a loud shirt with big yellow flowers to the wedding, and everyone kept looking at him.
班叔叔穿了一件有大黃花的花俏襯衫去婚禮，大家一直盯著他看。
loud 大聲的（形容詞）: There was a loud noise outside the window last night, and I was so scared that I could not sleep.
昨晚窗外有一聲很大的噪音，我嚇得睡不著。
loudly 大聲地（副詞）: You do not need to speak loudly on the phone, because the person on the other end can hear you very well.
你不需要在電話裡大聲說話，因為對方可以聽得很清楚。
aloud 出聲地: Every night before bed, my father reads a short story aloud to my little sister until she falls asleep.
每天晚上睡前，我爸爸都會出聲念一篇短篇故事給我妹妹聽，直到她睡著。
a lovely day: It was a lovely day with blue skies and a warm sun, so our class had lunch outside under the trees.
那是個美好的一天，有藍天和溫暖的太陽，所以我們班在樹下的戶外吃午餐。
lovely weather: We had lovely weather on our trip to the beach, so we swam, built sand castles, and played ball all day.
我們去海邊旅行時天氣很好，所以我們整天游泳、堆沙堡、玩球。
a lovely meal: Grandma cooked a lovely meal for the whole family on Sunday, with fish, soup, and a big chocolate cake.
奶奶星期天為全家煮了好吃的一餐，有魚、湯和一個大巧克力蛋糕。
What a lovely surprise!: What a lovely surprise to see you at my door, because I thought you were still on your trip to Japan!
在我家門口看到你真是好驚喜，因為我以為你還在日本旅行呢！
a lovely person: Mrs. Chen is a lovely person who always smiles and gives free fruit to the children who live near her.
陳太太是個很好的人，她總是微笑，還會免費送水果給住在她附近的孩子。
lovely 可愛的／美好的（形容詞，雖 -ly 結尾）: My neighbor has a lovely girl who always says good morning to everyone and helps her mother in the garden.
我鄰居有一個可愛的女孩，她總是向每個人說早安，還會在花園裡幫媽媽的忙。
love 愛（動詞、名詞）: My older sister is in love with a boy from her class, and she smiles every time he sends her a message.
我姊姊和班上的一個男孩在戀愛，每次他傳訊息給她，她都會微笑。
lovable 討人喜愛的: Our new puppy is a lovable boy with lovely brown eyes, so even my father, who never liked dogs, plays with him.
我們的新小狗是個討人喜愛的小傢伙，有著可愛的棕色眼睛，所以連從來不喜歡狗的爸爸也跟他玩。
lover 愛人（名詞）: My uncle is a big music lover, and he has more than five hundred old records in his small apartment.
我叔叔是個音樂愛好者，他的小公寓裡有超過五百張老唱片。
a low voice: The baby was finally asleep, so Dad spoke in a low voice and asked us to turn down the TV.
寶寶終於睡著了，所以爸爸低聲說話，要我們把電視轉小聲。
low prices: The new supermarket near the station has very low prices, so many families now do their shopping there.
車站附近的新超市價格很低，所以現在很多家庭都去那裡購物。
a low opinion of: My brother has a low opinion of that restaurant because the food was cold and the waiter was rude.
我哥哥對那家餐廳評價不好，因為食物是冷的，而且服務生很沒禮貌。
feel low: Judy has been feeling low since her cat died last week, so her friends are trying to cheer her up.
茱蒂自從上週她的貓死了之後就一直心情低落，所以她的朋友正試著讓她開心起來。
low season: We went to the beach in the low season, so the hotel was cheap and there were almost no other visitors.
我們在淡季去海邊，所以飯店很便宜，而且幾乎沒有其他遊客。
a low grade: Kevin got a low grade on his history test because he spent the whole weekend playing basketball with friends.
凱文歷史考試拿了低分，因為他整個週末都在和朋友打籃球。
run low on: We are running low on milk and eggs, so could you stop by the store on your way home from school?
我們的牛奶和雞蛋快用完了，所以你放學回家的路上可以順便去商店一下嗎？
in a low voice: The two girls talked in a low voice at the back of the library so they would not bother the other students.
兩個女孩在圖書館後面小聲地說話，這樣才不會打擾其他學生。
low in fat: This milk is low in fat and has no added sugar, so my mother says it is a healthy drink for us.
這款牛奶是低脂的，而且沒有加糖，所以媽媽說它是我們健康的飲料。
low 低的／低地（形容詞與副詞同形）: The birds were flying low over the river, and we watched them catch small fish with their mouths.
鳥兒低低地飛過河面，我們看著它們用嘴抓小魚。
lower 降低（動詞）: The shop owner agreed to lower the price of the bike by two hundred dollars, so I bought it right away.
店老闆同意把腳踏車的價格降低兩百元，所以我馬上就買了。
short 矮（人）: My uncle is a short man with a low voice, but he is the fastest runner in his office and always wins.
我叔叔是個聲音低沉的矮個子男人，但他是辦公室裡跑得最快的人，而且總是贏。
low 低（物、聲、價）: There is a low wall around the garden, so even the little children can climb over it to pick flowers.
花園周圍有一道低矮的牆，所以就連小孩子也能爬過去摘花。
be lucky to have you: You always listen to me and help me when I am sad, so I am lucky to have you as a friend.
你總是聽我說話，在我難過時幫助我，所以有你這個朋友我很幸運。
be lucky enough to: Tina was lucky enough to get the last ticket for the show, and she sat in the front row all night.
蒂娜幸運地買到表演的最後一張票，整晚都坐在第一排。
a lucky day: Today is my lucky day because I found fifty dollars on the street and got full marks on my English test.
今天是我的幸運日，因為我在街上撿到五十元，英文考試還拿了滿分。
a lucky number: Seven is my lucky number, so I always try to sit in seat number seven when I take a train.
七是我的幸運數字，所以搭火車時我總是試著坐七號座位。
Lucky you!: You got a free trip to Japan from a shopping game, so lucky you, and please bring me back some snacks!
你從一個購物遊戲中得到免費去日本的旅行，你真幸運，請幫我帶些零食回來！
a lucky guess: I did not know the answer to the last question, but I made a lucky guess and got the point anyway.
我不知道最後一題的答案，但我幸運地猜對了，還是拿到了那一分。
third time lucky: Sam failed his swimming test twice, but his coach said third time lucky, and he passed it last Friday.
山姆游泳測驗兩次沒過，但教練說第三次就會成功，他上週五真的通過了。
lucky 幸運的（形容詞）: Danny is a lucky boy because his grandmother bought him the new bike that he had wanted for a whole year.
丹尼是個幸運的男孩，因為奶奶幫他買了他想要了一整年的新腳踏車。
luckily 幸運地（副詞）: I forgot my umbrella at home this morning, but luckily the rain stopped just before I left the school.
我今天早上把雨傘忘在家裡了，但幸運地，雨剛好在我離開學校前停了。
luck 運氣（名詞）: Our teacher wished us good luck before the big exam and told us to stay calm and read each question carefully.
大考前老師祝我們好運，並告訴我們保持冷靜，仔細讀每一題。
Mom was mad at me because I came home two hours late and did not call her to say where I was.
媽媽生我的氣，因為我晚了兩個小時回家，也沒打電話告訴她我在哪裡。
be mad about baseball: My cousin is mad about baseball, and he watches every game on TV and knows the name of every player.
我表哥瘋狂愛棒球，他看電視上的每一場比賽，而且知道每個球員的名字。
go mad: If the baby keeps crying all night and I cannot sleep, I think I am going to go mad before Monday.
如果寶寶整晚一直哭，而我無法睡覺，我想我在星期一之前就會發瘋了。
drive sb. mad: The sound of my neighbor practicing the drums every evening is starting to drive me mad, so I need some quiet.
鄰居每天晚上練鼓的聲音開始把我逼瘋了，所以我需要一些安靜。
like mad: We were almost late for the train, so we ran like mad through the station and jumped on just in time.
我們差點趕不上火車，所以我們拚命地跑過車站，剛好及時跳上車。
a mad dog: Stay away from that strange dog on the corner because it may be a mad dog, and it could bite you.
離轉角那隻奇怪的狗遠一點，因為它可能是瘋狗，可能會咬你。
be mad with joy: When the teacher said our class won the first prize, the students were mad with joy and jumped around the room.
當老師說我們班贏得第一名時，學生們高興得發狂，在教室裡跳來跳去。
mad 生氣的（美式口語）: Do not be mad at your little brother, because he did not mean to break your favorite cup this morning.
