不要生你弟弟的氣，因為他今天早上不是故意要打破你最喜歡的杯子。
mad 瘋狂的: The old man in the story went mad after he lost all his money and his family in one terrible year.
故事中的老人在一個可怕的年頭裡失去了所有的錢和家人後就發瘋了。
angry 生氣的: My father was angry with me because I forgot to feed the dog, and he was also mad at my brother.
爸爸生我的氣，因為我忘了餵狗，他也生我哥哥的氣。
crazy 瘋狂的／迷戀: My sister is crazy about that Korean singer, and she is mad about his songs too, so she sings them all day.
我姊姊迷戀那位韓國歌手，她也瘋狂愛他的歌，所以整天都在唱。
a magic word: My mother says please is a magic word, because people will help you more when you use it in a kind way.
我媽媽說「請」是個有魔力的字，因為當你友善地使用它時，人們會更願意幫助你。
a magic show: We watched a magic show at the night market, and the man made a white bird come out of an empty hat.
我們在夜市看了一場魔術表演，那個人從空帽子裡變出一隻白鳥。
a magic moment: Seeing the sun come up over the sea on the first day of the year was a magic moment for my family.
在新年的第一天看著太陽從海上升起，對我家人來說是個神奇的時刻。
like magic: My headache went away like magic after I drank a cup of hot tea and slept for one hour in the afternoon.
我喝了一杯熱茶並在下午睡了一小時後，頭痛就像變魔術一樣消失了。
work like magic: My grandmother's hot lemon tea works like magic, so my cold is almost gone after only one day.
奶奶的熱檸檬茶效果神奇，所以我的感冒才一天就幾乎好了。
a magic touch: Aunt Lily has a magic touch in the kitchen, and every dish she cooks tastes better than restaurant food.
莉莉阿姨在廚房裡有一雙巧手，她煮的每道菜都比餐廳的菜好吃。
the main idea: After we read the story, the teacher asked us to write the main idea in one short sentence.
讀完故事之後，老師要我們用一個簡短的句子寫出主旨。
the main point: The main point of his speech was that we should save water every day, not only in summer.
他演講的重點是我們每天都應該節約用水，而不是只有在夏天。
the main course: For the main course, Dad ordered a big steak, but Mom chose fish with rice and vegetables.
主菜方面，爸爸點了一大塊牛排，媽媽則選了魚配米飯和蔬菜。
the main road: There was a lot of traffic on the main road this morning, so we took a small street instead.
今天早上主要道路上車很多，所以我們改走一條小街。
the main reason: The main reason I love this school is that my teachers are kind and always help me.
我喜歡這所學校的主要原因是老師們很親切，而且總是幫助我。
the main character: The main character in this movie is a brave girl who saves her village from a terrible storm.
這部電影的主角是一個勇敢的女孩，她把自己的村子從可怕的暴風雨中救了出來。
in the main: The trip had a few small problems, but in the main everyone enjoyed the three days in Japan.
這次旅行有一些小問題，但大體上大家都很享受在日本的那三天。
a major problem: Trash on the beach is a major problem here, so our class goes to clean it up every month.
海灘上的垃圾在這裡是個重大問題，所以我們班每個月都去清理。
a major city: Taipei is a major city in Taiwan, and millions of people live and work there every day.
台北是台灣的大城市，每天有數百萬人在那裡生活和工作。
a major change: Moving to a new country was a major change for Amy, but she made friends quickly at school.
搬到新的國家對艾咪來說是重大改變，但她在學校很快就交到朋友了。
the major part of: Lisa spent the major part of her weekend studying for the big English test on Monday morning.
麗莎把週末大部分的時間都花在準備星期一早上的英文大考上。
a major in English: My older brother is a major in English at college, and he wants to be a teacher one day.
我哥哥在大學主修英文，他希望有一天能當老師。
play a major part: Good sleep plays a major part in staying healthy, so try to go to bed before eleven.
良好的睡眠在保持健康上扮演重要角色，所以盡量在十一點前上床睡覺。
a male nurse: When I was in the hospital, a male nurse took care of me and told me funny stories.
我住院的時候，一位男護理師照顧我，還跟我說有趣的故事。
male students: In our class, the male students usually play basketball after lunch, while the girls like to talk.
在我們班上，男學生午餐後通常去打籃球，女生則喜歡聊天。
a male voice: When I picked up the phone, a deep male voice asked me if my father was at home.
我接起電話時，一個低沉的男聲問我爸爸在不在家。
many a time: Many a time my mother has told me to clean my room, but I always forget to do it.
媽媽好多次叫我整理房間，但我總是忘記去做。
how many: How many students in your class walk to school, and how many of them ride a bike?
你們班有多少學生走路上學，又有多少人騎腳踏車？
as many as: As many as five hundred people came to the school fair, so we sold all the cookies.
多達五百人來參加學校園遊會，所以我們把餅乾全部賣完了。
too many cooks: Six of us tried to make one cake together, but too many cooks in one small kitchen only made trouble.
我們六個人想一起做一個蛋糕，但人多手雜，在小廚房裡只是添亂。
so many: There were so many people at the night market that we could hardly walk or find a place to sit.
夜市裡有這麼多人，我們幾乎走不動，也找不到地方坐。
many thanks: Many thanks for helping me with my math homework last night; I finally understand the problems.
非常感謝你昨晚幫我做數學作業，我終於懂那些題目了。
many 很多（可數）: Jenny has many books on her shelf, and she reads one new story almost every week.
珍妮的書架上有很多書，她幾乎每週都讀一個新故事。
much 很多（不可數）: Do not say many water; we say much water because water is something we cannot count one by one.
不要說 many water；我們說 much water（很多水），因為水是無法一個一個數的東西。
a lot of 都可用: You can say a lot of time or a lot of books, so a lot of is easier than many or much.
你可以說 a lot of time（很多時間）或 a lot of books，所以 a lot of 比 many 或 much 更好用。
many of them: I met twenty new students in my class today, and many of them live in the same town as me.
我今天在班上認識了二十個新同學，他們當中許多人跟我住在同一個鎮上。
My aunt is married to a doctor from Tainan, and they have two cute children and a dog.
我阿姨和一位台南的醫生結婚，他們有兩個可愛的孩子和一隻狗。
get married: My cousin is going to get married next spring, so the whole family is busy planning the party.
我表哥明年春天要結婚，所以全家都忙著籌備派對。
a married couple: A married couple lives next door, and they often share the bread they make at home with us.
隔壁住著一對夫妻，他們常常把在家做的麵包分給我們。
married life: Grandpa says married life is not always easy, but he and Grandma have been happy for fifty years.
爺爺說婚姻生活不總是容易，但他和奶奶已經幸福了五十年。
be happily married: My parents have been happily married for twenty years, and they still hold hands when they walk.
我爸媽婚姻幸福已經二十年了，走路時還會牽手。
the newly married: The newly married sat at the front table, and everyone stood up to cheer and take pictures of them.
新婚夫婦坐在前面的桌子，大家都站起來為他們歡呼並拍照。
a marvelous idea: Having a picnic by the river on Sunday is a marvelous idea, so let's invite the whole class.
星期天去河邊野餐是個絕妙的想法，我們邀請全班一起去吧。
marvelous weather: We had marvelous weather on our school trip, with blue skies and a cool wind all day long.
校外教學那天我們遇上絕佳的天氣，整天都是藍天和涼風。
have a marvelous time: The kids had a marvelous time at the water park, and they did not want to go home at six.
孩子們在水上樂園玩得很開心，六點的時候都不想回家。
Marvelous!: Marvelous! You got full marks on the test, so tonight we are going out for ice cream.
太棒了！你考試拿到滿分，所以今晚我們要出去吃冰淇淋。
mass production: Because of mass production, a simple T-shirt is cheap today, and almost everyone can buy one.
因為大量生產，現在一件簡單的T恤很便宜，幾乎每個人都買得起。
the masses: The new bus line is cheap and fast, so it is popular with the masses in our city.
新的公車路線便宜又快，所以很受我們城市大眾的歡迎。
a mass of: There was a mass of dirty dishes in the sink after the party, so we all helped to wash them.
派對結束後水槽裡有大量的髒碗盤，所以我們全都幫忙洗。
the maximum speed: The maximum speed on this road is fifty, so Dad drives slowly when he passes the school.
這條路的最高速度是五十，所以爸爸經過學校時開得很慢。
a maximum of ten people: The small boat can take a maximum of ten people, so the rest of us must wait for the next one.
這艘小船最多只能載十人，所以我們其他人必須等下一艘。
get the maximum points: Kevin studied every night for a week and got the maximum points on his science test.
凱文連續一個星期每晚念書，科學考試拿到了最高分。
at the maximum: The walk from the station to the museum takes twenty minutes at the maximum, so we won't be late.
從車站走到博物館最多二十分鐘，所以我們不會遲到。
a medium size: This jacket comes in a medium size, which fits my brother well because he is not too tall.
這件夾克有中等尺寸，很適合我弟弟，因為他不算太高。
medium height: The man who found my wallet was of medium height and had short black hair and glasses.
撿到我皮夾的那個男人中等身高，有一頭黑色短髮，還戴著眼鏡。
cook on medium heat: Mom told me to cook the soup on medium heat for ten minutes and then add some salt.
媽媽叫我用中火煮湯十分鐘，然後加一點鹽。
a medium steak: My father always orders a medium steak at this restaurant because he thinks it tastes the best.
爸爸在這家餐廳總是點五分熟的牛排，因為他覺得那樣最好吃。
medium-sized: We stayed in a medium-sized hotel near the beach, and it had a small pool and a nice garden.
我們住在海邊附近一家中型的旅館，它有一個小泳池和漂亮的花園。
in the middle of the night: The baby woke up crying in the middle of the night, so Mom got up to give her some milk.
寶寶半夜哭著醒來，所以媽媽起床餵她喝一些牛奶。
the middle of the road: A small dog was sitting in the middle of the road, and all the cars had to stop and wait.
一隻小狗坐在路中央，所有的車子都得停下來等。
a middle school: My sister goes to a middle school near our house, and she walks there with her friends every morning.
我姊姊就讀我們家附近的一所國中，她每天早上和朋友走路去學校。
the Middle East: My uncle works in the Middle East, and he says it is very hot and dry there in summer.
我叔叔在中東工作，他說那裡夏天非常炎熱又乾燥。
middle age: My father is in middle age now, but he still plays basketball with us every Sunday afternoon.
我爸爸現在已是中年，但他每個星期天下午仍然和我們一起打籃球。
in the middle of doing: I was in the middle of doing my homework when my best friend called and asked me out.
我正在做作業的途中，我最好的朋友打電話來約我出去。
a middle class: Most families in our town belong to the middle class, so they have a car and take a trip every year.
我們鎮上大多數家庭屬於中產階級，所以他們有車，每年也會去旅行一次。
the middle child: Tom is the middle child in his family, with an older sister and a little brother who is five.
湯姆是家裡排中間的小孩，他有一個姊姊和一個五歲的弟弟。
a minor problem: A broken light on my bike is only a minor problem, and my dad can fix it in about ten minutes.
我腳踏車的車燈壞了只是個小問題，我爸爸大約十分鐘就能修好。
a minor change: The teacher made a minor change to the plan, so our class trip will start at nine instead of eight.
老師對計畫做了一個小改變，所以我們的校外教學將在九點出發，而不是八點。
a minor mistake: I made a minor mistake in my spelling test, so I got ninety-eight points instead of one hundred.
我在拼字測驗裡犯了一個小錯，所以我拿到九十八分，而不是一百分。
a minor in music: My cousin studies science at college and also has a minor in music because she loves the piano.
我表姊在大學念科學，同時也副修音樂，因為她喜愛鋼琴。
modern life: Modern life moves very fast, and many people check their phones more than one hundred times a day.
現代生活步調非常快，許多人一天看手機超過一百次。
modern art: We saw some modern art at the museum, and my little brother said the pictures looked like his own.
我們在博物館看了一些現代藝術，我小弟說那些畫看起來像他自己畫的。
a modern city: Taipei is a modern city with a fast train system, tall buildings, and free internet in many places.
台北是個現代化的城市，有快速的捷運系統、高樓大廈，很多地方還有免費網路。
modern English: Modern English is quite different from the English people spoke five hundred years ago in old books.
現代英語和五百年前人們在舊書裡所使用的英語相當不同。
modern times: In modern times, people can talk to friends on the other side of the world with just a phone.
在現代，人們只要用一支手機就能和世界另一端的朋友聊天。
once more: Let's practice the song once more before the show so that everyone remembers the words.
在表演前我們再把這首歌練一次，好讓每個人都記得歌詞。
more and more: More and more students in our school ride bikes to class because it is healthy and saves money.
我們學校越來越多學生騎腳踏車上課，因為這樣既健康又省錢。
no more: There is no more milk in the refrigerator, so I will go to the store before breakfast.
冰箱裡不再有牛奶了，所以我會在早餐前去商店買。
what's more: This restaurant is cheap and clean, and what's more, the owner gives free dessert to students.
這家餐廳便宜又乾淨，更重要的是，老闆還送學生免費甜點。
the more… the more…: The more you practice speaking English with your friends, the more comfortable you will feel in class.
你越常和朋友練習說英文，在課堂上就越自在。
all the more: Jack felt all the more nervous about the game because his whole family came to watch him play.
傑克對比賽更加緊張，因為他全家都來看他打球。
more than happy: If you need help with your science report, I would be more than happy to come over on Saturday.
如果你的科學報告需要幫忙，我非常樂意星期六過去一趟。
not… any more: My grandfather does not drink coffee any more because the doctor told him it was bad for his heart.
我爺爺不再喝咖啡了，因為醫生告訴他那對心臟不好。
one more time: The coach asked us to run around the field one more time before we could go home for dinner.
教練要我們再繞操場跑一次，然後才能回家吃晚餐。
more 更多（many/much 的比較級）: Peter has more books than I do, because he visits the bookstore every weekend with his mother.
彼得的書比我多，因為他每個週末都和媽媽去逛書店。
most 最多: Of all the students in our class, Mary has read the most books this year, more than fifty.
在我們班所有學生當中，瑪莉今年讀的書最多，超過五十本。
more than 超過: More than one hundred people came to our school show, so the hall was full before seven o'clock.
超過一百人來參加我們的學校表演，所以七點前大廳就坐滿了。
no more than 只不過: Don't be angry with my little brother; he is no more than a child and did not understand.
別對我小弟生氣，他只不過是個孩子，什麼都不懂。
most of the time: Most of the time my dad cooks dinner, but on Sundays we go out to eat as a family.
大部分時間都是我爸爸煮晚餐，但星期天我們會全家出去吃。
at most: The bus ride to the beach takes forty minutes at most, so we can still swim before lunch.
搭公車到海邊最多四十分鐘，所以我們午餐前還能游泳。
make the most of: We only have one day in Tainan, so let's make the most of it and visit the old temples early.
我們在台南只有一天，所以我們要善用時間，早點去參觀老廟。
most of all: I like this school for many reasons, but most of all because my teachers really care about us.
我喜歡這所學校有很多理由，但最重要的是老師真心關心我們。
for the most part: For the most part the weather was good on our trip, though it rained a little on the last day.
我們旅行時天氣大部分都很好，雖然最後一天下了一點雨。
the most important: The most important thing before a test is a good night of sleep, not studying until two in the morning.
考試前最重要的事情是晚上睡個好覺，而不是念書到凌晨兩點。
most people: Most people in Taiwan drink tea, but my mother likes coffee better in the morning to wake up.
台灣大多數人都喝茶，但我媽媽早上比較喜歡喝咖啡來提神。
at the most: The new game costs twenty dollars at the most, so you can buy it with your pocket money.
這款新遊戲最多二十元，所以你可以用零用錢買。
most 大多數（不加 the）: Most students in my class like English, but a few of them think math is more interesting.
我班上大多數學生喜歡英文，但有少數人認為數學比較有趣。
the most 最…（最高級）: Everyone says the mountain lake near my grandmother's house is the most beautiful place in Taiwan.
大家都說我奶奶家附近的山中湖是台灣最美的地方。
most of + 名詞: Most of us finished the race in under ten minutes, but Tom stopped to help a boy who fell.
我們當中大多數人在十分鐘內跑完比賽，但湯姆停下來幫助一個跌倒的男孩。
mostly 大多（副詞）: The people on the early morning bus are mostly students and workers, so it is usually very quiet.
早班公車上的人大多是學生和上班族，所以通常很安靜。
almost 幾乎: Almost all the students passed the test, and only two of them need to take it again next week.
幾乎所有學生都通過了考試，只有兩個人下週需要重考。
much better: I feel much better today after a long sleep, so I can go back to school tomorrow morning.
睡了一夜好覺後，我今天感覺好多了，所以明天早上可以回學校上課。
too much: Eating too much candy is bad for your teeth, so have an apple when you want something sweet.
吃太多糖果對牙齒不好，所以當你想吃甜的東西時就吃一顆蘋果吧。
so much: Thank you so much for the birthday card; the funny picture you drew made everyone in my family laugh.
非常感謝你的生日卡片，你畫的那張有趣的圖讓我全家都笑了。
how much: How much is this blue jacket, and do you have the same one in a bigger size for my brother?
這件藍色夾克多少錢？你們有同款更大尺寸的給我哥哥嗎？
much the same: The two schools look different, but the lessons and homework are much the same for the students.
這兩所學校看起來不同，但對學生來說課程和作業幾乎一樣。
not much of a: I am not much of a cook, so I usually make simple noodles when my parents are not home.
我算不上是個會做菜的人，所以爸媽不在家時我通常只煮簡單的麵。
make much of: Our teacher makes much of good manners, and she always thanks the students who help clean the room.
我們老師很重視好禮貌，她總是感謝幫忙打掃教室的學生。
Thank you very much for driving me to the hospital last night when I had a high fever.
非常感謝您昨晚在我發高燒時開車送我去醫院。
much too hot: It is much too hot to play basketball outside at noon, so let's wait until four o'clock.
中午在外面打籃球實在太熱了，我們等到四點再去吧。
as much as: My little sister eats as much as I do at dinner, even though she is only eight years old.
我妹妹晚餐吃得和我一樣多，雖然她才八歲。
not so much A as B: Tom's success was not so much luck as hard work, because he practiced every day for a year.
湯姆的成功與其說是運氣，不如說是努力，因為他整整一年每天練習。
very much 用於動詞後: I like this song very much, so I listen to it on the bus every morning on my way to school.
我非常喜歡這首歌，所以每天早上搭公車上學時都會聽。
much + 比較級: My brother runs much faster than I do, so he always wins when we race to the bus stop.
我哥哥跑得比我快多了，所以我們比賽跑到公車站時他總是贏。
my 我的（形容詞）: I left my bag on the bus this morning, and my lunch and my English book were inside it.
我今天早上把我的包包忘在公車上了，我的午餐和英文書都在裡面。
mine 我的東西: That blue bag by the door is mine, and the red one on the chair belongs to my sister.
門邊那個藍色的包包是我的東西，椅子上那個紅色的是我姊姊的。
myself 我自己: I made this cake by myself for Mother's Day, and Mom said it was the best gift ever.
我為母親節自己一個人做了這個蛋糕，媽媽說這是她收過最棒的禮物。
Oh my!: Oh my! I forgot my homework at home again, and the teacher is going to collect it in five minutes.
哎呀！我又把作業忘在家裡了，老師五分鐘後就要收了。
my goodness: My goodness, the kitchen is so dirty; did you boys cook something while we were out shopping?
我的天，廚房這麼髒，你們這些男孩是不是趁我們出去買東西時煮了什麼？
a narrow mind: A person with a narrow mind does not listen to new ideas, so it is hard to work with him.
心胸狹隘的人不聽新的想法，所以很難跟他一起工作。
a narrow road: The bus could not pass through the narrow road in the old town, so we got off and walked.
公車無法穿過老城區那條窄路，所以我們下車走路。
narrow-minded: My uncle used to be narrow-minded about music, but now he enjoys listening to new songs with me.
我叔叔以前對音樂心胸狹窄，但現在他喜歡和我一起聽新歌。
narrow down: We had ten ideas for our class trip, but after a long talk we narrowed them down to two.
我們的校外教學有十個點子，但經過長時間的討論後，我們把範圍縮小到兩個。
a national holiday: Next Monday is a national holiday, so there is no school, and my family plans to visit Grandma.
下星期一是國定假日，所以不用上學，我們家打算去看奶奶。
the national team: My cousin plays for the national team in baseball, and we always watch his games on TV together.
我表哥是棒球國家隊的球員，我們總是一起在電視上看他的比賽。
a national park: We hiked in a national park last weekend and saw many birds, tall trees, and a beautiful lake.
上週末我們在一座國家公園健行，看到許多鳥、高大的樹和一座美麗的湖。
the national flag: Every morning the students raise the national flag while the whole school sings together in the playground.
每天早上學生升國旗，全校則在操場上一起唱歌。
national news: My father watches the national news at seven every evening to learn what happened in Taiwan that day.
我爸爸每天晚上七點看國內新聞，了解台灣當天發生的事。
natural food: My mother buys natural food at the farmers' market because she thinks it is healthier for our family.
我媽媽在農夫市集買天然食物，因為她覺得這對我們家人比較健康。
a natural leader: Mary is a natural leader, so the students in her class chose her to lead the science fair team.
瑪莉是天生的領導者，所以班上的學生選她帶領科學展的團隊。
It's natural to feel sad when a good friend moves away, but you can still talk on the phone every day.
好朋友搬走時感到難過很自然，但你們還是可以每天講電話。
natural gas: We use natural gas to cook at home, so Mom always checks that the stove is off before bed.
我們家用天然氣煮飯，所以媽媽睡前總是確認爐子已經關了。
a natural smile: The man taking our class picture told us to give a natural smile instead of making a funny face.
幫我們拍班級照的人要我們露出自然的笑容，而不是做鬼臉。
die a natural death: My great-grandfather died a natural death at ninety-five, with all his children and their families around him.
我的曾祖父在九十五歲時自然死亡，所有的孩子和他們的家人都在他身邊。
a naughty boy: Danny is a naughty boy who hides his sister's shoes every morning just to make her late for school.
丹尼是個頑皮的男孩，他每天早上都把姊姊的鞋子藏起來，就為了讓她上學遲到。
be naughty: If you are naughty at Grandma's house, we will not take you to the zoo on Sunday.
如果你在奶奶家調皮，我們星期天就不帶你去動物園。
a naughty smile: The little girl gave her mother a naughty smile and then ran away with the last cookie.
小女孩對媽媽露出淘氣的笑，然後拿著最後一塊餅乾跑走了。
naughty words: Our teacher gets angry when students use naughty words in class, so be careful what you say.
當學生在課堂上說不雅的話時，我們老師會生氣，所以說話要小心。
in the near future: In the near future, I hope to visit Japan with my family and see the beautiful flowers in spring.
在不久的將來，我希望能和家人去日本，在春天看美麗的花。
a near miss: The taxi stopped just in time in front of the boy on the bike; it was a near miss.
計程車在騎腳踏車的男孩面前及時停下，真是差點出事。
near and far: People came from near and far to watch the big New Year's Eve show in the park last night.
昨晚人們從到處趕來公園看盛大的除夕表演。
the nearest station: Excuse me, could you tell me how to get to the nearest station from this hotel?
不好意思，你能告訴我從這家旅館要怎麼到最近的車站嗎？
draw near: As the test day drew near, Linda started to study harder and went to bed earlier.
隨著考試日接近，琳達開始更用功讀書，也更早上床睡覺。
near the end: The movie was near the end when my phone rang, and everyone in the theater looked at me.
電影接近尾聲時我的手機響了，電影院裡的每個人都看著我。
a near relative: My aunt is a near relative, so she comes to our house for every birthday and holiday dinner.
我阿姨是近親，所以每次生日和節日聚餐她都會來我們家。
near 靠近（形容詞、介係詞、副詞）: We live near the school, so I can walk there in five minutes and come home for lunch.
我們住在學校附近，所以我五分鐘就能走到學校，中午還能回家吃飯。
nearly 幾乎（副詞）: My homework is nearly done, so I will join you for basketball in about fifteen minutes.
我的作業幾乎做完了，所以大約十五分鐘後我會加入你們打籃球。
nearby 附近的: On hot summer evenings, my family likes to take a walk in a nearby park after dinner.
炎熱的夏天晚上，我們家喜歡晚餐後到附近的公園散步。
close to 接近: Close to and near have almost the same meaning, so you can say the box is close to the door.
close to 和 near 意思幾乎一樣，所以你可以說箱子靠近（接近）門邊。
It's necessary to: It's necessary to bring your student card tomorrow because the museum will check it at the gate.
明天帶學生證是必要的，因為博物館會在門口檢查。
be necessary for: Clean water and fresh air are necessary for good health, so we should protect rivers and forests.
乾淨的水和新鮮的空氣對健康是必要的，所以我們應該保護河川和森林。
if necessary: Bring an umbrella and a jacket, and if necessary, we can stop and wait at the station until the rain stops.
帶一把傘和一件夾克，如有必要，我們可以在車站停下來等到雨停。
a necessary evil: Homework is a necessary evil for students because it is boring, but it really helps us remember lessons.
作業對學生來說是無可避免的壞事，因為它很無聊，但真的能幫助我們記住課程。
necessary skills: Cooking, reading maps, and saving money are necessary skills for anyone who wants to travel alone.
煮飯、看地圖和存錢是任何想獨自旅行的人必要的技能。
a negative answer: I asked my mom if I could stay out late, but she gave me a negative answer right away.
我問媽媽我能不能晚點回家，但她馬上給了我否定的回答。
negative thinking: Negative thinking before a game will only make you play worse, so believe in yourself and have fun.
比賽前的負面思考只會讓你表現更差，所以要相信自己並且享受比賽。
a negative number: When the temperature drops below zero, we use a negative number to show how cold it is.
當溫度降到零度以下時，我們用負數來表示有多冷。
a negative sentence: To make a negative sentence in English, we often add not after do or does, as in I do not know.
要造英文否定句，我們常在 do 或 does 後面加上 not，例如 I do not know。
test negative: Jenny had a sore throat, but she tested negative for the flu, so she could go back to school.
珍妮喉嚨痛，但流感檢測陰性，所以她可以回學校上課了。
be nervous about the test: Many students are nervous about the test on Friday, so the teacher gave us an extra review class.
許多學生對星期五的考試感到緊張，所以老師多給我們上了一堂複習課。
get nervous: I always get nervous when I have to speak in front of the class, and my hands start to shake.
每當我必須在全班面前說話時，我總是會變緊張，手也開始發抖。
a nervous smile: The new student gave a nervous smile when the teacher asked him to introduce himself to everyone.
當老師請新同學向大家自我介紹時，他露出緊張的笑。
feel nervous: Do you feel nervous before a big game, or do you stay calm and just enjoy playing?
大比賽前你會感到緊張嗎？還是能保持冷靜，單純享受比賽？
make sb. nervous: Loud noises make my dog nervous, so we keep him inside the house during the New Year holiday.
大聲的噪音會讓我的狗緊張，所以新年假期時我們把他留在屋裡。
nervous 緊張的（形容詞）: Kate was so nervous on the first day of school that she forgot her own class number and seat.
凱特開學第一天緊張到忘了自己的班級號碼和座位。
nervously 緊張地（副詞）: The boy smiled nervously at the judges before he began to sing his song in the school show.
男孩在校園表演開始唱歌前，對評審緊張地笑了笑。
nerve 神經／勇氣（名詞）: Nobody in our class had the nerve to tell the teacher that she had written the wrong date on the board.
我們班沒有人有勇氣告訴老師她在黑板上寫錯了日期。
a new face: There is a new face in our class this week; her name is Emma and she just moved from Japan.
這週我們班上有一張新面孔，她叫艾瑪，剛從日本搬來。
as good as new: My brother fixed my old bike and painted it red, so now it looks as good as new.
我哥哥修好我的舊腳踏車，還把它漆成紅色，現在看起來跟新的一樣。
What's new?: Hi Ben, what's new with you? I heard you joined the school band and started learning the drums.
嗨，班，你有什麼新鮮事？我聽說你加入學校樂團，開始學打鼓了。
turn over a new leaf: After he failed the test, Jim decided to turn over a new leaf and study for an hour every night.
考試不及格後，吉姆決定改過自新，每天晚上念書一小時。
a new start: Moving to a new school was hard at first, but Amy saw it as a new start and made friends quickly.
剛開始轉學很難，但艾咪把它當作新的開始，很快就交到朋友。
be new to the job: Please be patient with Mr. Lin because he is new to the job and is still learning how everything works.
請對林先生有耐心，因為他對這工作還不熟，還在學習一切是怎麼運作的。
New Year's Eve: On New Year's Eve, my whole family gathers at Grandma's house for a big dinner and stays up until midnight.
除夕那天，我們全家聚在奶奶家吃大餐，一直熬夜到午夜。
the new kid: The new kid in our class is very quiet, so I asked him to sit with us at lunch today.
我們班新來的小孩很安靜，所以我今天邀他和我們一起吃午餐。
new blood: Our soccer team needs some new blood, so the coach is looking for younger players this season.
我們的足球隊需要一些新血，所以教練這一季正在尋找更年輕的球員。
next door: The family next door has a big brown dog, and it barks every time I ride my bike past their house.
隔壁那家人有一隻棕色大狗，每次我騎腳踏車經過他們家它都會叫。
next to: In class, Peter sits next to the window, so he often looks outside and misses what the teacher says.
在課堂上，彼得坐在窗邊，所以他常常往外看，而漏聽了老師說的話。
next time: I lost the game today, but next time I will practice more and try my best to win.
我今天輸了比賽，但下次我會多練習，盡力贏回來。
the next day: We arrived in Tainan late at night, and the next day we got up early to see the old city.
我們深夜抵達台南，第二天一早起床去看老城區。
next to nothing: Grandpa paid next to nothing for this old chair at the market, but it is strong and comfortable.
爺爺在市場買這把舊椅子幾乎沒花什麼錢，但它既堅固又舒服。
the next best thing: The store did not have the blue shoes in my size, so I bought the next best thing, a gray pair.
那家店沒有我尺寸的藍色鞋子，所以我買了次好的選擇，一雙灰色的。
The nurse called out Next, please, and the old man slowly stood up and walked into the doctor's room.
護理師喊道下一位，老先生慢慢站起來走進診間。
in the next few days: In the next few days, the weather will get colder, so remember to bring a warm coat to school.
在接下來幾天天氣會變冷，所以記得帶一件暖和的外套去學校。
next to impossible: Finding a seat on the train during Chinese New Year is next to impossible, so we booked tickets early.
農曆新年期間要在火車上找到座位幾乎不可能，所以我們提早訂了票。
next week 下週（不加 the）: Next week we have three tests, so I am going to stay home and study this weekend instead of going out.
下週我們有三場考試，所以這個週末我要留在家裡念書，而不是出去玩。
the next week 接下來的一週: After the big test, the next week was much easier, and we even watched a movie in English class.
大考過後，接下來的一週輕鬆多了，我們甚至在英文課上看了電影。
the following day 隔天: The following day means the next day, so after a rainy Saturday, the following day was sunny and warm.
the following day 就是隔天（the next day）的意思，所以在下雨的星期六之後，隔天天氣晴朗又溫暖。
Nice to meet you, Mrs. Brown; my mother has told me a lot about your delicious apple pie.
很高興認識您，布朗太太，我媽媽跟我說了很多關於您美味蘋果派的事。
a nice day: It is such a nice day today, so why don't we have lunch outside under the big tree?
今天天氣真好，我們何不在大樹下吃午餐呢？
nice and warm: After playing in the snow, we came inside and sat by the fire, and soon we were nice and warm.
在雪地裡玩過之後，我們進屋坐在火爐旁，很快就暖暖的很舒服。
Have a nice day!: The shopkeeper smiled, gave me my change, and said Have a nice day as I left the store.
店主微笑著把零錢給我，在我離開商店時說祝你有美好的一天。
Please be nice to your little sister and let her play the game with you and your friends.
請對你妹妹好一點，讓她和你跟朋友一起玩遊戲。
It's nice of you to carry my heavy bag all the way up the stairs to the music room.
你真好，幫我把重重的包包一路提上樓到音樂教室。
nice work: Nice work on your science report, Lucy; the pictures and the clear writing really helped me understand it.
露西，你的科學報告做得好，那些圖片和清楚的文字真的幫助我理解。
a nice guy: My sister's new friend Mark is a nice guy who always helps my mom wash the dishes after dinner.
我姊姊的新朋友馬克是個好人，晚餐後總是幫我媽媽洗碗。
nice-looking: The new teacher is young and nice-looking, and all the students like his funny English lessons.
新老師年輕又好看，所有學生都喜歡他有趣的英文課。
a noisy street: We live on a noisy street, so I sometimes cannot sleep well because of the cars and motorcycles.
我們住在一條吵鬧的街道上，所以有時我因為汽車和機車的聲音睡不好。
noisy neighbors: Our noisy neighbors sing and play loud music until midnight every Friday, so Dad finally went to talk to them.
我們吵鬧的鄰居每個星期五都唱歌、放很大聲的音樂到半夜，所以爸爸終於去找他們談。
a noisy classroom: When the teacher walked into the noisy classroom, all the students quickly sat down and became quiet.
當老師走進吵鬧的教室時，所有學生很快坐下安靜下來。
Don't be so noisy, kids; Grandpa is sleeping in the next room and he really needs some rest.
孩子們，別這麼吵，爺爺在隔壁房間睡覺，他真的需要休息。
noisy 吵鬧的（形容詞）: Our class is often noisy before the bell rings, but we are quiet as soon as the teacher comes in.
我們班在鐘響前常常很吵鬧，但老師一進來我們就安靜了。
noise 噪音（名詞）: Please do not make noise in the library because many students are reading and studying for tests.
請不要在圖書館製造噪音，因為很多學生正在閱讀和準備考試。
loud 大聲的: Noisy describes a place with many sounds, but loud describes one sound, like our music teacher's loud voice.
noisy 形容有很多聲音的吵鬧地方，而 loud 形容單一聲音很大聲，像我們音樂老師大聲的嗓音。
noisily 吵鬧地: The children played noisily in the yard all afternoon, so their mother could not sleep at all.
孩子們整個下午在院子裡吵鬧地玩，所以他們的媽媽完全沒辦法睡。
not at all: I was not at all tired after the long hike because the fresh mountain air made me feel strong.
長途健行之後我一點也不累，因為山上新鮮的空氣讓我覺得很有精神。
not… until: My father did not come home until ten last night because he had a lot of work to finish.
我爸爸昨晚直到十點才回家，因為他有很多工作要完成。
not only… but also: Our English teacher is not only kind but also funny, so everyone looks forward to her class.
我們的英文老師不只親切還很風趣，所以大家都期待她的課。
not… any longer: My grandfather does not drive any longer because his eyes are weak, so my dad takes him to the doctor every month.
我爺爺因為眼睛不好已經不再開車了，所以我爸每個月帶他去看醫生。
not… either: Jenny does not like hot food, and her little brother does not like it either, so their mom cooks simple dishes.
珍妮不喜歡吃辣，她的弟弟也不喜歡，所以他們的媽媽都煮簡單的菜。
Everyone keeps asking me if it will rain during our class picnic tomorrow, and I always answer them, I hope not.
大家一直問我明天班上野餐時會不會下雨，而我總是回答他們：希望不會。
not yet: Mom asked me if I had finished my homework, but I said not yet because I still had two pages of math.
媽媽問我作業做完了沒，但我說還沒，因為我還有兩頁數學。
Why not?: When Tom asked if he could join our basketball game after school, we all smiled and said, Why not?
當湯姆問他放學後能不能加入我們的籃球比賽時，我們都笑著說：為什麼不？
not… but: This yellow bike is not mine but my sister's, so you should ask her before you ride it to the park.
這台黃色腳踏車不是我的而是我姊姊的，所以你騎去公園前應該先問她。
not a few: Not a few students in our school take the bus every morning because their homes are far away from the city.
我們學校有不少學生每天早上搭公車，因為他們的家離市區很遠。
not much: There is not much milk left in the kitchen, so please buy a big bottle on your way home from school.
廚房裡的牛奶不多了，所以你放學回家的路上請買一大瓶。
not really: My friends think I love playing the piano, but not really, because my mother makes me practice every single day.
我的朋友以為我很愛彈鋼琴，但其實不盡然，因為是我媽媽要我每天練習。
an old friend: Yesterday my mother met an old friend from high school at the supermarket, and they talked for almost an hour.
昨天我媽媽在超市遇到一位高中時期的老朋友，她們聊了快一個小時。
the good old days: Grandpa often talks about the good old days when he played in the river with his brothers after school.
爺爺常常談起那些美好的往日，那時他放學後會和兄弟們在河裡玩。
an old hand: My uncle is an old hand at fixing cars, so people in our town always bring their broken cars to him.
我叔叔是修車的老手，所以我們鎮上的人都把壞掉的車送去給他修。
old age: In old age, my grandmother still walks to the park every morning and does exercise with her friends there.
到了老年，我奶奶每天早上還是走路到公園，和她的朋友們一起做運動。
an old joke: My dad told the same old joke about the chicken again at dinner, but nobody at the table laughed this time.
我爸在晚餐時又講了那個關於雞的老掉牙笑話，但這次餐桌上沒有人笑。
the old: Every Sunday, the students in our club visit the old at the care center and sing songs for them.
每個星期天，我們社團的學生會去安養中心探訪老人們，並為他們唱歌。
How old are you?: When the new student sat down next to me, I smiled and asked, How old are you, and where do you come from?
當新同學坐到我旁邊時，我微笑著問他：你幾歲？你從哪裡來？
ten years old: My little cousin is ten years old this year, so my aunt is planning a big birthday party for him next week.
我的小表弟今年十歲，所以我阿姨打算下星期為他辦一個大型的生日派對。
an old habit: Biting his nails when he is nervous is an old habit of my brother, and he cannot stop it before a test.
我弟弟一緊張就咬指甲，這是他的老習慣，考試前他都停不下來。
old-fashioned: My grandmother thinks that wearing a short skirt to school is wrong, but my sister says that idea is old-fashioned.
我奶奶認為穿短裙去上學是不對的，但我姊姊說那種想法過時了。
When Mark said his dog ate his homework again, the teacher just shook her head and said, Same old story.
當馬克又說他的狗吃了他的作業時，老師只是搖搖頭說：老套了。
old 老的／舊的: An old man with white hair sits on the park bench every afternoon and gives the birds small pieces of bread.
一個白頭髮的老人每天下午都坐在公園的長椅上，給鳥兒一小塊一小塊的麵包。
older 較老的: My brother is three years older than me, so he always helps me with my English homework when I need it.
我哥哥比我大三歲，所以每當我需要時，他總是幫我做英文作業。
elder 哥哥姊姊的（名詞前）: My elder sister is five years older than my younger brother, and she works in a hospital in Taipei now.
我的姊姊比我弟弟大五歲，她現在在台北的一家醫院工作。
the elderly 老年人: On the train, young people should give their seats to the elderly because standing for a long time is hard for old people.
在火車上，年輕人應該把座位讓給老年人，因為長時間站著對老人來說很辛苦。
the only child: Amy is the only child in her family, so her parents give her all their love and buy her many toys.
艾咪是家裡的獨生女，所以她的父母把所有的愛都給她，還買很多玩具給她。
only one: There is only one cookie left in the box, so my brother and I decided to cut it in half and share.
盒子裡只剩一塊餅乾，所以我和弟弟決定把它切成兩半分著吃。
if only: If only I had studied harder for the math test last night, I would not feel so worried in class right now.
要是我昨晚數學考試有更努力讀書就好了，現在上課就不會這麼擔心了。
only too happy: When my teacher asked me to help the new student with English, I said I would be only too happy to help.
當老師請我幫新同學學英文時，我說我非常高興幫忙。
the only way: The only way to get better at swimming is to practice in the pool several times a week with a good coach.
游泳變厲害的唯一方法就是每週跟著好教練在泳池裡練習好幾次。
only yesterday: It was only yesterday that I lent you my favorite book, so please do not tell me you have lost it already.
就在昨天我才把我最愛的書借給你，所以請不要告訴我你已經弄丟了。
for members only: The sign on the door of the swimming pool says for members only, so we cannot go in without a card.
游泳池門上的牌子寫著會員限定，所以我們沒有卡就不能進去。
read-only: The file my teacher sent us is read-only, so I cannot change the words in it or add my own answers.
老師寄給我們的檔案是唯讀的，所以我不能更改裡面的字或加上自己的答案。
only 唯一的（形容詞）: Ken is the only one in our class who can speak Japanese, so the teacher asked him to help the visitors.
肯恩是我們班唯一一個會說日文的人，所以老師請他幫忙接待訪客。
only 只有（副詞）: Only ten students came to the school club meeting today because many of them had to study for tomorrow's big test.
今天只有十個學生來參加社團聚會，因為他們很多人要為明天的大考讀書。
alone 單獨: My aunt is the only person in her family who lives alone, and her small house is near the sea.
我阿姨是她家裡唯一一個單獨住的人，她的小房子就在海邊。
lonely 寂寞: When my best friend moved away, I was the only new student in class and felt lonely every day for weeks.
我最好的朋友搬走後，我是班上唯一的新學生，好幾個星期每天都覺得很寂寞。
an open door: When we got home from the market, we saw an open door and worried that someone had gone into our house.
我們從市場回到家時，看到一扇敞開的門，擔心有人進了我們家。
an open mind: Our teacher always tells us to keep an open mind when we meet people from different countries and learn about their food.
我們老師總是告訴我們，認識來自不同國家的人、了解他們的食物時，要保持開放的心胸。
in the open air: On sunny weekends, my family likes to have lunch in the open air at the park instead of eating at home.
天氣好的週末，我們家喜歡在公園的戶外吃午餐，而不是在家裡吃。
be open to ideas: Our new class leader is open to ideas, so you can tell her what you want to do for the school party.
我們的新班長願意接受意見，所以你可以告訴她你想在學校派對上做什麼。
open all night: The store near my house is open all night, so my dad can buy milk there even at two in the morning.
我家附近的商店整晚營業，所以我爸甚至在凌晨兩點都能去那裡買牛奶。
an open secret: It is an open secret that our English teacher is going to marry the music teacher at the end of this year.
我們的英文老師今年年底要和音樂老師結婚，這是一個公開的秘密。
an open question: Whether the school will build a new swimming pool next year is still an open question, so nobody knows the answer yet.
學校明年會不會蓋新游泳池還是個未決的問題，所以目前沒有人知道答案。
keep one's eyes open: When you walk through the night market, keep your eyes open because some people there might try to take your wallet.
當你走過夜市時要保持警覺，因為那裡可能有人會想拿走你的錢包。
wide open: The windows of the music room were wide open, so the cold wind blew in and all the papers flew off the desks.
音樂教室的窗戶大大敞開著，所以冷風吹了進來，所有的紙都從桌上飛走了。
open-minded: My grandmother is very open-minded for her age, and she even learned to use a smart phone to talk with us.
我奶奶以她的年紀來說心胸非常開放，她甚至學會用智慧型手機跟我們聊天。
open 開著的（形容詞）: The store is open from nine in the morning to ten at night, so we can go shopping after we finish dinner.
這家店從早上九點營業到晚上十點，所以我們吃完晚餐後可以去逛街。
open 打開（動詞）: It was so hot in the room that my mother asked me to open the door and let some fresh air come in.
房間裡太熱了，所以我媽媽叫我把門打開，讓一些新鮮空氣進來。
opened 打開（過去式）: When the gift box arrived in the morning, she opened it right away and found a pretty pink dress inside.
早上禮物盒送到時，她馬上就把它打開，發現裡面有一件漂亮的粉紅色洋裝。
close 關閉（動詞）: Please close the door when you leave the room, because the door is open now and the strong wind blows the papers everywhere.
離開房間時請把門關上，因為門現在是開著的，強風把紙吹得到處都是。
closed 關著的（形容詞）: We walked to the bakery for bread, but the store is closed on Mondays and is only open from Tuesday to Sunday.
我們走到麵包店買麵包，但這家店星期一關著，只有星期二到星期日才營業。
orange juice: Every morning my mother makes me a glass of fresh orange juice because she says it is good for my health.
每天早上我媽媽都幫我榨一杯新鮮的柳橙汁，因為她說這對我的健康很好。
an orange tree: There is an orange tree in my grandfather's garden, and every winter we pick the sweet fruit and share it with neighbors.
我爺爺的花園裡有一棵橙樹，每年冬天我們都會摘下甜甜的果實分給鄰居。
bright orange: My sister bought a bright orange bag for school, so I can always find her easily in a crowd of students.
我姊姊買了一個亮橙色的書包去上學，所以我總是能在一群學生中輕易找到她。
ordinary people: Ordinary people like my parents work hard every day and do not have time to watch a lot of TV at night.
像我父母這樣的普通人每天都努力工作，晚上沒有時間看很多電視。
an ordinary day: It started as an ordinary day at school, but then our teacher told us we would have a party in the afternoon.
這本來是在學校平凡的一天，但接著老師告訴我們下午要辦派對。
out of the ordinary: Seeing snow in Taipei in April is really out of the ordinary, so everyone ran outside to take pictures of it.
四月在台北看到雪真的很不尋常，所以大家都跑到外面拍照。
ordinary clothes: On Saturdays we can wear ordinary clothes to school instead of our uniforms, so most of us wear jeans and T-shirts.
星期六我們可以穿平常的衣服去學校而不用穿制服，所以我們大多穿牛仔褲和 T 恤。
nothing out of the ordinary: The police looked around the shop for an hour, but they found nothing out of the ordinary and went back to the station.
警察在店裡查看了一個小時，但沒發現什麼特別的，就回警局去了。
the other day: I met my old teacher the other day at the bookstore, and she still remembered my name after all these years.
前幾天我在書店遇到以前的老師，過了這麼多年她還記得我的名字。
each other: Lisa and I have known each other since we were five, and we still walk to school together every morning.
麗莎和我從五歲就認識彼此，現在每天早上還是一起走路上學。
every other day: My grandfather goes to the park to play chess every other day, and on the other days he reads at home.
我爺爺每隔一天就去公園下棋，其他的日子他就在家看書。
on the other hand: Living in the city is exciting, but on the other hand, the air is dirty and the houses cost a lot of money.
住在城市裡很刺激，但另一方面，空氣很髒，房子也要花很多錢。
other than: Other than a bowl of rice this morning, I have not eaten anything all day, so I am really hungry now.
除了今天早上的一碗飯，我整天什麼都沒吃，所以我現在真的很餓。
in other words: Tom did not do his homework and failed the test; in other words, he did not take his studies seriously this term.
湯姆沒做作業，考試也不及格；換句話說，他這學期沒有認真看待學業。
some… others…: Some students in my class like to play basketball after school, while others would rather stay inside and read comic books.
我們班有些學生喜歡放學後打籃球，而其他的學生寧願待在室內看漫畫。
the other side: The bus stop is on the other side of the street, so we have to wait for the green light and cross carefully.
公車站在街道的另一邊，所以我們得等綠燈再小心地過馬路。
one after the other: The students walked into the music room one after the other and sat down quietly before the teacher came in.
學生們一個接一個走進音樂教室，在老師進來之前安靜地坐好。
among other things: At the night market we bought, among other things, fried chicken, some sweet tea, and a cute hat for my sister.
在夜市裡，除了別的以外，我們還買了炸雞、一些甜茶，和一頂給我姊姊的可愛帽子。
the other 另一個（兩者中）: I have two pens on my desk; the blue one is mine, and the other one belongs to my friend Peter.
我桌上有兩支筆，藍色那支是我的，另一個是我朋友彼得的。
others 其他人／物: Some of my friends think summer is the best season, but others do not agree because they hate the hot weather.
我有些朋友認為夏天是最棒的季節，但其他人不同意，因為他們討厭炎熱的天氣。
the others 其餘的: Only Jim and I stayed to finish the picture, and the others left for lunch as soon as the bell rang.
只有吉姆和我留下來完成那張圖，其餘的人鐘聲一響就去吃午餐了。
our 我們的（形容詞）: Our school has a big library with many books, and we love to read there after lunch when it is quiet.
我們的學校有一間藏書很多的大圖書館，午餐後安靜的時候我們喜歡在那裡看書。
ours 我們的東西: That tall red building across from the park is ours, and my grandmother has lived on the second floor for years.
公園對面那棟高高的紅色建築是我們的，我奶奶在二樓住了很多年。
ourselves 我們自己: Our parents went to work early, so my sister and I made breakfast by ourselves and then washed the dishes together.
我們的父母很早就去上班了，所以我和妹妹自己做早餐，然後一起洗碗。
the outside world: My grandfather lives in a small village in the mountains, and he learns about the outside world from the radio every evening.
我爺爺住在山上的小村子裡，他每天晚上透過收音機了解外面的世界。
outside help: Our class wanted to build a big stage for the school show, but we could not finish it without outside help.
我們班想為學校表演搭一個大舞台，但沒有外來的幫助我們沒辦法完成。
an outside chance: Our basketball team is much weaker this year, so we only have an outside chance of winning the city game.
我們的籃球隊今年弱很多，所以在市賽中我們只有微小的獲勝機會。
outside work hours: My mother never answers emails from her boss outside work hours because she wants to spend the evening with the family.
我媽媽在工作時間以外從不回老闆的電子郵件，因為她想把晚上的時間留給家人。
think outside the box: When the old plan failed again, our teacher asked us to think outside the box and find a new way.
當舊的計畫又失敗時，老師要我們跳脫框架思考，找出新的方法。
outside 外面的／在外面（形容詞、副詞、介係詞）: The children are playing with the dog outside the house, and their mother is cooking dinner in the kitchen.
孩子們正在屋子外面和狗玩，而他們的媽媽正在廚房煮晚餐。
inside 裡面的: It was raining outside, so I looked inside the box under my bed and found the old photos of my family.
外面在下雨，所以我看了看床下箱子的裡面，找到了我們家的舊照片。
out 出去（副詞）: It is too cold outside to go out tonight, so let us stay home, order some pizza, and watch a movie on TV.
今晚外面太冷了不適合出去，所以我們就待在家裡，點些披薩，看電視上的電影吧。
the game is over: When the game is over, both teams will shake hands and then eat dinner together at a restaurant near the school.
比賽結束後，兩隊會握手，然後一起去學校附近的餐廳吃晚餐。
over and over: My little sister played the same song over and over on the piano until everyone in the house knew it by heart.
我妹妹在鋼琴上一再地彈同一首歌，直到家裡每個人都會背了。
all over the world: People all over the world love to eat Taiwanese food like beef noodles, so many visitors come to our night markets.
全世界的人都喜歡吃像牛肉麵這樣的台灣食物，所以很多觀光客來逛我們的夜市。
over the phone: My mother ordered a birthday cake for me over the phone this morning, and the shop will send it at six.
我媽媽今天早上透過電話幫我訂了一個生日蛋糕，店家會在六點送來。
over there: The library is over there next to the post office, so you only need to walk for about two more minutes.
圖書館就在那邊，郵局的旁邊，所以你只需要再走大約兩分鐘。
over the weekend: Over the weekend, my family drove to the beach in the south, and we swam in the warm sea for hours.
在週末期間，我們家開車去南部的海邊，在溫暖的海裡游了好幾個小時。
over a cup of tea: Every Sunday afternoon, my grandmother and her best friend talk about their families over a cup of tea in the garden.
每個星期天下午，我奶奶和她最好的朋友會在花園裡邊喝茶邊聊她們的家人。
be over 18: You have to be over 18 to drive a car in Taiwan, so my brother has to wait two more years to learn.
在台灣要超過十八歲才能開車，所以我哥哥還要再等兩年才能學。
get over: It took Mary a long time to get over the death of her cat, but her friends helped her feel better.
瑪莉花了很久才克服她的貓死掉這件事，但她的朋友幫她好起來了。
When the last test ended at noon on Friday, Jack threw his books in the air and shouted, It is all over!
星期五中午最後一科考試結束時，傑克把書丟向空中大喊：全都結束了！
over the years: Over the years, our small town has changed a lot, and now a big shopping center stands where the farm was.
多年來，我們的小鎮改變了很多，現在以前農場的地方變成了一座大型購物中心。
over 在…上方（不接觸）: There is an old stone bridge over the river near my school, and many people take pictures there in the spring.
我學校附近的河上有一座古老的石橋，春天時很多人在那裡拍照。
on 在…上（接觸）: I left my English book on the desk in the living room, so could you bring it over when you come upstairs?
我把英文課本放在客廳的桌子上了，你上樓的時候可以幫我帶過來嗎？
above 在…上方: When the plane flew above the clouds and over the sea, the sky became bright blue and the sun shone in.
當飛機飛到雲層上方、越過大海時，天空變成了亮藍色，陽光照了進來。
over 超過（數字）: Over 100 people came to our school show last night, so there were not enough chairs for everyone in the hall.
昨晚有超過一百人來看我們學校的表演，所以禮堂裡的椅子不夠所有人坐。
be over-weight: The doctor told my uncle that he is over-weight, so he has to eat less fried food and walk every day.
醫生告訴我叔叔他過重了，所以他必須少吃炸物，而且每天走路。
an over-weight bag: At the airport, my aunt had to pay extra money for an over-weight bag because she packed too many gifts for us.
在機場，我阿姨得為超重的行李多付錢，因為她帶了太多禮物給我們。
get over-weight: If you eat cookies and drink soda in front of the TV every night, you will get over-weight very quickly.
如果你每天晚上在電視機前吃餅乾、喝汽水，你很快就會變得過重。
study overseas: My cousin wants to study overseas after high school, so she practices English with a teacher on the computer three times a week.
我表姊想在高中畢業後出國讀書，所以她每週三次和線上老師練習英文。
overseas students: Our university has many overseas students from Japan and Korea, and they often cook food from their countries for us.
我們大學有很多來自日本和韓國的海外學生，他們常常煮他們國家的食物給我們吃。
an overseas trip: My parents are planning an overseas trip to Japan next winter, and I cannot wait to see snow for the first time.
我爸媽計畫明年冬天去日本海外旅行，我等不及第一次看到雪了。
go overseas: Before you go overseas, remember to bring your ticket, some money, and a warm coat for the cold weather there.
在你出國之前，記得帶機票、一些錢，還有一件保暖的外套以應付那裡寒冷的天氣。
overseas Chinese: Many overseas Chinese come back to Taiwan every year during Chinese New Year to spend time with their families.
很多海外華人每年農曆新年都會回台灣和家人共度時光。
a painful lesson: Losing my wallet on the train last month was a painful lesson, and now I always keep it in my front pocket.
上個月在火車上丟掉錢包是個慘痛的教訓，現在我總是把錢包放在前面的口袋裡。
a painful memory: Falling off the stage in front of the whole school is a painful memory, so Linda does not like to talk about it.
在全校面前從舞台上摔下來是一段痛苦的回憶，所以琳達不喜歡談這件事。
a painful decision: Selling the old family house was a painful decision for my grandmother, but she needed the money for the hospital.
賣掉老家對我奶奶來說是個痛苦的決定，但她需要那筆錢付醫院的費用。
painful to watch: Our team lost the game by thirty points, and it was really painful to watch, so many fans left before the end.
我們的隊輸了三十分，看了真的很難受，所以很多球迷在結束前就離開了。
turn pale: When the teacher said the test papers were ready, Ben turned pale because he had forgotten to study last night.
當老師說考卷準備好了的時候，班臉色發白，因為他昨晚忘了讀書。
look pale: You look pale this morning, so maybe you should stay home from school and drink a lot of warm water today.
你今天早上臉色蒼白，也許你今天應該留在家裡不去上學，多喝點溫開水。
pale blue: My mother painted the walls of my bedroom pale blue because she said the color would help me sleep well at night.
我媽媽把我房間的牆壁漆成淡藍色，因為她說這個顏色能幫助我晚上睡得好。
pale skin: People with pale skin should wear a hat and put on sun cream before they play on the beach in the summer.
白皮膚的人在夏天去海邊玩之前應該戴帽子、擦防曬乳。
go pale with fear: The little boy went pale with fear when he saw a big black dog running toward him in the empty park.
當小男孩看到一隻大黑狗在空蕩蕩的公園裡朝他跑來時，他嚇得臉色發白。
in the past: In the past, people in this town used to wash their clothes in the river, but now every family has a washing machine.
過去，這個鎮上的人習慣在河裡洗衣服，但現在每個家庭都有洗衣機。
the past few days: It has rained every day for the past few days, so the students could not play basketball outside after school.
過去幾天每天都下雨，所以學生們放學後沒辦法在外面打籃球。
past experience: From past experience, I know that the night market gets very crowded on Saturdays, so let us go on a Wednesday.
從過去的經驗我知道夜市星期六會非常擁擠，所以我們星期三去吧。
half past six: School starts at half past seven, so I have to get up at half past six every morning to catch the bus.
學校七點半開始上課，所以我每天早上必須六點半起床去趕公車。
walk past the store: Every day I walk past the store on my way to school, and the kind owner always waves and says good morning.
每天上學的路上我都會走過那家商店，親切的老闆總是揮手跟我說早安。
be past caring: After three teachers told Jim to be quiet, he was past caring and just kept talking to his friend in class.
三位老師都叫吉姆安靜之後，他已經不在乎了，還是繼續在課堂上和朋友講話。
a thing of the past: Writing letters by hand is a thing of the past for most young people, because now everyone sends short messages on the phone.
對大多數年輕人來說，手寫信已經是過去的事了，因為現在大家都用手機傳簡訊。
past 過去的／經過（形容詞、介係詞、名詞）: In the past, my grandfather walked ten miles to school every day, but now a school bus picks up the children.
過去我爺爺每天走十英里去上學，但現在有校車來接孩子們。
passed 經過（pass 的過去式）: Amy passed the English test with a high score because she studied hard every evening for the past two weeks.
艾咪英文考試以高分通過了，因為過去兩個星期她每天晚上都認真讀書。
go past: We go past the big park on the bus every morning, and sometimes we see old people doing exercise there.
我們每天早上搭公車都會走過那座大公園，有時候會看到老人家在那裡運動。
be patient with children: My aunt is always patient with children, so she is a great teacher at the kindergarten near our home.
我阿姨對小孩總是很有耐心，所以她在我們家附近的幼兒園是個很棒的老師。
Be patient!: Be patient! The bread will be ready in ten minutes, and it tastes much better when it comes fresh from the oven.
有耐心點！麵包十分鐘後就好了，剛從烤箱出來時吃起來好吃多了。
a patient teacher: Mr. Lin is a patient teacher who explains the same math problem again and again until every student understands it.
林老師是一位有耐心的老師，他會一再解釋同一道數學題，直到每個學生都懂為止。
a patient listener: My grandmother is a patient listener, so I always tell her my problems at school before I tell anyone else.
我奶奶是個有耐心的聽眾，所以我總是先把學校的煩惱告訴她，再告訴別人。
patient 有耐心的（形容詞）: My father is a patient man who never shouts at us, even when we break something or come home late.
我父親是個有耐心的人，就算我們弄壞東西或晚回家，他也從不對我們大吼。
a patient 病人（名詞）: The doctor's patients wait quietly in the small room, and a nurse calls their names one by one every ten minutes.
醫生的病人們安靜地在小房間裡等候，護士每十分鐘就叫一次名字，一個接一個。
patience 耐心（名詞）: After waiting for the late bus for an hour in the rain, my brother began to lose patience and decided to walk home.
在雨中等了一小時遲來的公車後，我哥哥開始失去耐心，決定走路回家。
a peaceful night: After the noisy party, my parents enjoyed a peaceful night at home with a cup of tea and a good book.
熱鬧的派對結束後，我爸媽在家裡享受了一個寧靜的夜晚，喝杯茶、看本好書。
a peaceful country: My teacher says Taiwan is a peaceful country, and many visitors from other places feel safe walking here at night.
我的老師說台灣是一個和平的國家，很多來自其他地方的訪客晚上在這裡走路都覺得很安全。
a peaceful mind: Sitting by the sea and listening to the waves gives my mother a peaceful mind after a long week at work.
坐在海邊聽海浪聲，讓我媽媽在漫長的一週工作後擁有平靜的心。
live a peaceful life: My grandmother and grandfather live a peaceful life on a small farm, where they grow vegetables and feed the chickens every morning.
我的爺爺奶奶在一座小農場過著平靜的生活，每天早上種菜、餵雞。
peaceful 和平的／平靜的（形容詞）: The small temple on the hill is a peaceful place, so many people go there to think quietly when they feel worried.
山丘上的小廟是個平靜的地方，所以很多人覺得煩惱時會去那裡安靜地思考。
peace 和平（名詞）: Our teacher asked us to draw a picture about world peace, so I drew children from many countries holding hands.
我們老師要我們畫一張關於世界和平的圖，所以我畫了來自許多國家的孩子手牽著手。
in peace 安靜地: My brother was angry after the game, so he closed his door and asked everyone to leave him in peace for a while.
我哥哥比賽後很生氣，所以他關上門，要大家讓他安靜地獨處一會兒。
calm 冷靜的: The park is usually peaceful, but when the alarm rang, the guard told everyone to stay calm and walk slowly to the gate.
公園通常很平靜，但警報響起時，警衛告訴大家要保持冷靜，慢慢走到大門。
a perfect day: Sunday was a perfect day for a picnic because the sky was blue, the wind was cool, and nobody had homework.
星期天是野餐的完美的一天，因為天空很藍、風很涼，而且沒有人有作業。
the perfect gift: A new pair of running shoes is the perfect gift for my brother because he joins the school race every spring.
一雙新的跑步鞋是給我哥哥最棒的禮物，因為他每年春天都參加學校的賽跑。
Perfect!: Perfect! You have finished all your homework before dinner, so now we have time to watch a movie together tonight.
太完美了！你在晚餐前就做完所有作業了，所以今晚我們有時間一起看電影。
practice makes perfect: My piano teacher always says practice makes perfect, so I play the same song for thirty minutes every evening.
我的鋼琴老師總是說熟能生巧，所以我每天晚上都練同一首歌三十分鐘。
the present perfect: Our English teacher taught us the present perfect today, and we wrote sentences about things we have done this year.
我們的英文老師今天教我們現在完成式，我們寫了一些關於今年做過的事情的句子。
a perfect stranger: A perfect stranger helped my grandmother carry her heavy bags up the stairs at the train station this morning.
今天早上有個完全不認識的人在火車站幫我奶奶把重重的袋子搬上樓梯。
a perfect fit: The blue dress my mother bought from the store was a perfect fit, so she wore it to my sister's wedding last Sunday.
我媽媽從店裡買的藍色洋裝完全合適，所以上星期天她穿著它去參加我姊姊的婚禮。
nobody is perfect: Nobody is perfect, so do not be too sad about the mistakes you made on the test; just learn from them next time.
沒有人是完美的，所以不要為考試上犯的錯太難過，下次從中學習就好。
a personal question: Asking a woman how much money she makes is a personal question, so you should not ask it when you first meet her.
問一位女士賺多少錢是個私人問題，所以你第一次見到她時不應該這樣問。
personal information: Never give your personal information, like your address or phone number, to a stranger you meet on the computer or on the street.
絕對不要把你的個人資料，像是地址或電話號碼，給在網路上或街上遇到的陌生人。
a personal computer: My father bought a personal computer for the family last month, so now I can do my homework and send emails at home.
我爸爸上個月為家裡買了一台個人電腦，所以現在我可以在家做作業和寄電子郵件。
The coach was angry with the whole team after the game, so do not take it personally when he shouts at you.
比賽後教練對整隊都很生氣，所以當他對你大吼時，別往心裡去。
for personal reasons: Our music teacher left the school for personal reasons last month, and a young new teacher takes her classes now.
我們的音樂老師上個月因個人原因離開學校，現在由一位年輕的新老師接她的課。
a personal trainer: My uncle wants to get thin before summer, so he goes to the gym with a personal trainer three times a week.
我叔叔想在夏天前變瘦，所以他每週三次和私人教練一起去健身房。
in the pink: After a month of running every morning and eating more vegetables, my father feels in the pink and never gets tired.
每天早上跑步、多吃蔬菜一個月後，我爸爸覺得身體健康，從不覺得累。
pink cheeks: The children came in from the snow with pink cheeks and cold hands, so their mother gave them hot chocolate.
孩子們從雪地裡進來，臉頰粉紅、手冰冷，所以媽媽給他們熱巧克力。
see pink elephants: My uncle drank too much beer at the party last night, and he joked that he could see pink elephants on the wall.
我叔叔昨晚在派對上喝了太多啤酒，他開玩笑說他喝醉看到牆上有粉紅色的大象幻象。
plain water: The doctor told me to drink eight glasses of plain water every day instead of soda or sweet tea from the store.
醫生告訴我每天要喝八杯白開水，而不是商店買的汽水或甜茶。
a plain T-shirt: For the school trip, everyone has to wear a plain T-shirt and blue jeans, so we can find our group easily.
學校旅行時每個人都要穿素色 T 恤和藍色牛仔褲，這樣我們就能輕易找到自己的小組。
plain English: The teacher explained the rules in plain English, so even the new students from Japan understood them right away.
老師用簡單易懂的英文解釋規則，所以就連來自日本的新生也馬上就聽懂了。
plain food: When my grandfather was sick last week, the doctor told him to eat plain food like rice and soup for a few days.
上星期我爺爺生病時，醫生要他吃幾天像白飯和湯這類清淡的食物。
It's plain that: It's plain that Tom did not sleep well last night, because he fell asleep three times during the first class this morning.
顯然湯姆昨晚沒睡好，因為他今天早上第一節課睡著了三次。
a plain face: The actor has a plain face, but his warm smile and kind heart make everyone in the theater love him.
這位演員長相平凡，但他溫暖的微笑和善良的心讓劇場裡的每個人都喜歡他。
plain and simple: The rules of this game are plain and simple: you throw the ball into the basket, and your team gets two points.
這個遊戲的規則清楚簡單：你把球投進籃框，你的隊就得兩分。
make it plain: Our teacher made it plain that anyone who comes to class late three times will have to stay after school.
我們老師說清楚了，任何人遲到三次就必須放學後留下來。
plain 平凡的／簡單的（形容詞）: The police officer wore plain clothes instead of his uniform, so nobody in the night market knew who he was.
那位警察穿著平常的衣服而不是制服，所以夜市裡沒有人知道他是誰。
a plain 平原（名詞）: We drove across the great plains for hours, and all we could see were cows, grass, and the wide blue sky.
我們開車穿越大平原好幾個小時，眼前只看得到牛、草地和寬闊的藍天。
plane 飛機: My family will travel to Japan by plane this winter, and from the sky we may see the wide plain below us.
我們家今年冬天要搭飛機去日本，從空中我們也許能看到下方寬闊的平原。
a pleasant surprise: Finding an old friend from kindergarten in my new class was a pleasant surprise, and we talked all through lunch.
在新班上發現幼兒園的老朋友是個驚喜，我們整個午餐時間都在聊天。
pleasant weather: We had pleasant weather for the whole school trip, so we could swim in the sea and play games on the beach.
整個學校旅行期間我們都有舒適的天氣，所以我們可以在海裡游泳、在沙灘上玩遊戲。
a pleasant evening: My family spent a pleasant evening at my uncle's house, where we ate hot pot and played cards until ten o'clock.
我們家在我叔叔家度過了一個愉快的夜晚，我們吃火鍋、玩牌到十點。
a pleasant voice: The new radio host has a pleasant voice, so many people like to listen to her show while they drive to work.
新的電台主持人有悅耳的聲音，所以很多人喜歡在開車上班時聽她的節目。
The shop owner is always pleasant to his customers, so people in our town like to buy their fruit from him.
這位店老闆對顧客總是很和善，所以我們鎮上的人都喜歡向他買水果。
be pleased with the gift: My grandmother was very pleased with the gift we gave her, because we made the photo book by ourselves.
我奶奶對我們送的禮物很滿意，因為那本相片書是我們自己做的。
be pleased to meet you: When my new teacher came into the room, she smiled at us and said she was pleased to meet all of us.
當我的新老師走進教室時，她對我們微笑，說她很高興認識我們大家。
be pleased about: Jack was pleased about his grades this term, because he got the highest score in English in his whole class.
傑克對他這學期的成績感到高興，因為他的英文拿到全班最高分。
Pleased to meet you, Mrs. Wang; my mother has told me many good things about your cooking and your garden.
很高興認識你，王太太；我媽媽跟我說了很多關於你的廚藝和花園的好話。
look pleased: Our coach looked pleased after the game because every player on the team ran hard and nobody made a big mistake.
比賽後我們的教練看起來很開心，因為隊上每個球員都很拼，而且沒有人犯大錯。
pleased 人感到高興: I'm pleased with my new bike because it is light and fast, and now I get to school ten minutes earlier.
我對我的新腳踏車很滿意，因為它又輕又快，現在我早十分鐘到學校。
pleasant 事物令人愉快: It was a pleasant day with a cool wind, so my family rode our bikes along the river and had a picnic.
那是個令人愉快的日子，有涼風，所以我們家沿著河騎腳踏車，還去野餐。
pleasing 討人喜歡的: The new girl in our class has a pleasing smile, and everyone wanted to sit next to her on the first day.
我們班的新女生有討人喜歡的微笑，第一天大家都想坐在她旁邊。
please 請／使高興（動詞）: To please the teacher, the students made the room clean before class and wrote a thank-you card on the board.
為了讓老師高興，學生們在上課前把教室打掃乾淨，還在黑板上寫了感謝卡。
be polite to the guests: My mother always tells me to be polite to the guests, so I say hello and bring them tea when they visit.
我媽媽總是告訴我要對客人有禮貌，所以他們來訪時我會打招呼並端茶給他們。
It's polite to say thank you when someone holds the door for you, so remember to do it every time.
有人幫你扶著門時說謝謝是有禮貌的，所以記得每次都要這麼做。
a polite smile: The waiter gave us a polite smile when we asked for more water, but we could see he was very tired.
當我們要更多的水時，服務生給了我們一個客套的微笑，但我們看得出來他非常累。
a polite way to say: Could you please be quiet is a polite way to say shut up, so use it when your friends talk too loudly.
「可以請你安靜一點嗎」是叫人閉嘴的有禮貌的說法，所以你的朋友講話太大聲時就用這句。
polite society: In the old movie, the rich young man learned the rules of polite society, like how to dance and hold a tea cup.
在那部老電影裡，有錢的年輕人學習上流社會的規矩，像是怎麼跳舞、怎麼拿茶杯。
polite 有禮貌的（形容詞）: Peter is a polite boy who always stands up and says good morning when a teacher walks into the room.
彼得是個有禮貌的男孩，每當老師走進教室，他總是站起來說早安。
politely 有禮貌地（副詞）: If you want to borrow your brother's bike, you should ask politely instead of just taking it from the yard.
如果你想借你哥哥的腳踏車，你應該有禮貌地問他，而不是直接從院子裡牽走。
politeness 禮貌（名詞）: My grandmother ate all the cake out of politeness, even though she does not like sweet food very much.
我奶奶出於禮貌把蛋糕全吃完了，雖然她其實不太喜歡甜食。
impolite 無禮的: Asking someone how heavy they are is an impolite question, so do not ask it even if you are just curious.
問別人有多重是個無禮的問題，所以就算你只是好奇也不要問。
a poor excuse: Saying the dog ate your homework is a poor excuse, and our teacher has heard it from students too many times.
說狗吃了你的作業是個蹩腳的藉口，而且我們老師已經從學生那裡聽過太多次了。
poor health: My grandfather has been in poor health since last winter, so he visits the doctor at the hospital every two weeks.
我爺爺從去年冬天開始健康不佳，所以他每兩個星期就去醫院看醫生。
be poor at sports: I am poor at sports, so I always come last in the race, but I am the best in my class at drawing.
我運動不好，所以賽跑總是最後一名，但我是班上畫畫最厲害的。
a poor memory: My brother has a poor memory, so he writes everything on little yellow papers and sticks them on his desk.
我哥哥記性差，所以他把所有事情寫在小黃紙上，貼在他的桌子上。
Poor you!: Poor you! You walked home in the heavy rain without an umbrella, so let me get you a towel and some hot soup.
你好可憐！你沒帶傘在大雨中走回家，讓我拿條毛巾和一些熱湯給你。
poor grades: Linda got poor grades in math last year, but after studying with her uncle every weekend, she is doing much better.
琳達去年數學成績很糟糕，但在每個週末跟她叔叔讀書之後，她現在好多了。
a poor family: Tom comes from a poor family, but he studies very hard and hopes to become a doctor to help his parents one day.
湯姆來自一個貧窮的家庭，但他非常用功，希望有一天能成為醫生來幫助他的父母。
the poor: Every winter our school collects warm coats and gives them to the poor in the city so they can stay warm.
每年冬天我們學校都會收集保暖的外套送給城裡的窮人，讓他們能保持溫暖。
poor weather: Because of the poor weather, the school trip to the mountains was put off until the sun comes back next week.
因為天氣惡劣，去山上的學校旅行延後到下週太陽出來時再舉行。
poor thing: The poor thing was standing in the rain without an umbrella, so I gave the little dog some food.
這可憐的小東西沒帶傘站在雨中，所以我給了那隻小狗一些食物。
be poor at drawing: My brother is poor at drawing, but he can sing very well and plays the guitar every night.
我哥哥不會畫畫，但他歌唱得很好，而且每天晚上都彈吉他。
be poor in health: My grandfather has been poor in health since last winter, so he goes to the doctor every week.
我爺爺從去年冬天開始就健康不好，所以他每個星期都去看醫生。
the rich and the poor: In many big cities, the rich and the poor live in very different parts of town and seldom meet.
在許多大城市裡，富人和窮人住在城裡很不同的區域，很少碰面。
pop music: Sandy likes to listen to pop music on the bus, because it makes her feel happy before school.
珊蒂喜歡在公車上聽流行音樂，因為那讓她在上學前心情愉快。
a pop star: When I was a child, I wanted to be a pop star and sing in front of thousands of people.
我小時候想成為一位流行歌星，在成千上萬的人面前唱歌。
a pop song: The band played a pop song at the school party, and everyone got up and danced.
那個樂團在學校派對上演奏了一首流行歌曲，大家都站起來跳舞。
pop culture: My teacher says that movies and comic books are an important part of pop culture in Taiwan.
我的老師說電影和漫畫書是臺灣流行文化裡重要的一部分。
a pop quiz: We had a pop quiz in math class this morning, and nobody knew about it before the bell rang.
今天早上數學課我們有一個隨堂小考，鐘響之前沒有人知道這件事。
be popular with students: Mr. Lin is popular with students because he tells funny stories and never gives too much homework.
林老師受學生喜愛，因為他會講有趣的故事，而且從不出太多功課。
be popular among young people: This new phone game is popular among young people, so you can see them playing it everywhere.
這款新的手機遊戲在年輕人中很受歡迎，所以你到處都能看到他們在玩。
popular music: My father does not understand popular music, but he still drives me to the big show every year.
我爸爸不懂流行音樂，但他每年還是開車送我去看那場大型表演。
popular culture: In our English class, we learned about popular culture in America, like baseball games and fast food.
在英文課上，我們學到美國的大眾文化，像是棒球比賽和速食。
the most popular: Fried chicken is the most popular food at our night market, so the line is always very long.
炸雞是我們夜市最受歡迎的食物，所以排隊的人總是很多。
a positive answer: When I asked my mom if we could get a dog, she finally gave me a positive answer.
當我問媽媽我們可不可以養一隻狗時，她終於給了我肯定的回答。
positive thinking: Positive thinking helped Jenny get through the hard test, because she believed she could do it.
正面思考幫助珍妮撐過那場困難的考試，因為她相信自己做得到。
be positive about: Our coach is positive about the game this weekend, because the team has practiced hard for months.
我們的教練對這個週末的比賽很有信心，因為球隊已經努力練習了好幾個月。
test positive: Two students tested positive for the flu, so the whole class had to stay home for a week.
兩個學生流感檢測陽性，所以全班必須在家待一個星期。
I'm positive that I left my keys on the kitchen table, so let's go back and look again.
我很確定我把鑰匙放在廚房的桌上了，所以我們回去再找一次吧。
as soon as possible: Please call your mother back as soon as possible, because she sounded worried on the phone just now.
請盡快回電給你媽媽，因為她剛剛在電話裡聽起來很擔心。
as much as possible: Before the big trip, Peter tried to save as much as possible by walking to school every day.
在這次大旅行之前，彼得每天走路上學，試著盡可能多存一點錢。
if possible: If possible, I would like to sit by the window, because I love to watch the clouds.
如果可能，我想坐在窗邊，因為我喜歡看雲。
It's possible that: It's possible that the bus will be late today, because it is raining hard and the roads are full.
今天公車有可能會晚到，因為雨下得很大，而且路上車很多。
do everything possible: The doctors did everything possible to help the sick boy, and he got better after two weeks.
醫生們盡一切可能幫助那個生病的男孩，他兩個星期後就好起來了。
the best possible: My parents want to give me the best possible education, so they work very hard every day.
我父母想給我最好的教育，所以他們每天都很努力工作。
make it possible: The new bridge makes it possible for the farmers to drive their fruit to the city in one hour.
這座新橋使農民能在一小時內把水果運到城裡成為可能。
possible 可能的（事物作主詞）: It's possible to walk to the beach from our hotel, but it is quite far on a hot day.
從我們的旅館走到海邊是可能的，但在大熱天走起來相當遠。
able 能夠的（人作主詞）: It is possible to swim across the river, but I'm not able to because I never learned how.
游過這條河是可能的，但我不能夠，因為我從來沒學過游泳。
It's possible for me to: It's possible for me to finish the report tonight if nobody talks to me for the next three hours.
如果接下來三小時沒有人跟我說話，我有可能今晚把報告寫完。
likely 很可能的: It is possible to see stars tonight, and it is likely to be clear because the wind blew the clouds away.
今晚有可能看到星星，而且很可能會是晴朗的，因為風把雲吹走了。
precious time: Do not waste your precious time on phone games; you have a big test coming next Monday.
不要把你寶貴的時間浪費在手機遊戲上，你下星期一有一場大考。
a precious stone: My grandmother wears a ring with a precious stone that her mother gave her many years ago.
我奶奶戴著一枚鑲有寶石的戒指，那是她媽媽很多年前送給她的。
precious memories: These old photos bring back precious memories of the summer we spent at the beach with Grandpa.
這些老照片帶回我們和爺爺在海邊度過那個夏天的珍貴回憶。
my precious: Come here, my precious, and give Grandma a big hug before you leave for school.
過來，我的寶貝，上學前給奶奶一個大大的擁抱。
precious little: We had precious little water left on the mountain, so we drank only a little each hour.
我們在山上剩下的水少之又少，所以每小時只喝一點點。
at present: At present, my sister is studying in Japan, but she will come home for the Chinese New Year.
目前我姐姐在日本讀書，但她農曆新年會回家。
the present time: At the present time, there are only two buses a day to the small village in the mountains.
現在每天只有兩班公車開往山上那個小村子。
be present at the meeting: All the parents were present at the meeting last night, and they talked about the school trip.
昨晚所有的家長都出席會議，他們討論了學校的旅行。
everyone present: Everyone present at the party sang the birthday song, and little Amy was too shy to look up.
在場的每個人都在派對上唱生日歌，小艾咪害羞得不敢抬頭。
for the present: For the present, we will keep the dog in the kitchen until we build a small house for it.
暫時我們會把狗養在廚房，直到我們為它蓋一間小屋子。
the present day: In the present day, most students use a phone to look up new words instead of a heavy dictionary.
當今大多數學生用手機查新單字，而不是用厚重的字典。
present 出席的／現在的（形容詞）: Only twenty students were present today, because the others were sick after the long rainy week.
今天只有二十個學生出席，因為其他人在漫長的雨週後生病了。
a present 禮物（名詞）: My aunt gave me a watch as a birthday present, and I wear it to school every day.
我阿姨送我一支手錶當生日禮物，我每天都戴著它去上學。
present 贈送（動詞）: The principal will present a gift to the best student at the end of the school year.
校長會在學年結束時贈送一份禮物給最優秀的學生。
absent 缺席的: Jack was absent from school yesterday because of a cold, but he was present again this morning.
傑克昨天因為感冒沒來上學缺席，但今天早上他又出席了。
pretty good: The weather is pretty good today, so let's ride our bikes to the park after lunch.
今天天氣相當好，所以我們午餐後騎腳踏車去公園吧。
pretty much: I have pretty much finished my homework, so I can watch a movie with you tonight.
我的功課差不多做完了，所以今晚我可以和你一起看電影。
pretty soon: The movie will start pretty soon, so please buy the popcorn and find our seats quickly.
電影很快就要開始了，所以請快點買爆米花，找到我們的座位。
pretty well: Although Ben only started learning Japanese last year, he already speaks it pretty well with his friends.
雖然班去年才開始學日文，但他已經能和朋友說得相當不錯了。
pretty cold: It is pretty cold outside this morning, so remember to wear your coat and a warm hat.
今天早上外面蠻冷的，所以記得穿上你的外套，戴一頂溫暖的帽子。
sitting pretty: Since his uncle gave him a big house and a car, Tony has been sitting pretty with no worries about money.
自從他叔叔送他一棟大房子和一輛車以後，東尼就處境優渥，不用擔心錢的問題。
pretty 漂亮的（形容詞）: A pretty girl in a yellow dress sat next to me on the train, and she smiled when I said hello.
一個穿黃色洋裝的漂亮女孩在火車上坐在我旁邊，我打招呼時她微笑了。
pretty 相當（副詞）: After running up the mountain for two hours, we were all pretty tired and sat down under a tree.
跑上山兩個小時後，我們都相當累，便坐在一棵樹下。
beautiful 美麗的（更正式）: A beautiful woman in a long white dress sang at the wedding, and some pretty flowers covered the stage.
一位穿著白色長裙的美麗女子在婚禮上唱歌，舞臺上鋪滿了漂亮的花。
handsome 英俊的（男）: The handsome man in the movie saves a pretty girl from the fire, and everyone in the theater cheered.
電影裡那個英俊的男人從火場救出一個漂亮的女孩，電影院裡的每個人都歡呼起來。
primary school: My little sister just started primary school this fall, and she is excited about her new friends.
我妹妹今年秋天剛上小學，她對新朋友感到很興奮。
the primary reason: The primary reason I joined the swimming club is that I want to be healthy and strong.
我加入游泳社的主要原因是我想變得健康又強壯。
primary colors: In art class, we learned that red, blue, and yellow are the primary colors, and we mixed them to make green.
在美術課上，我們學到紅、藍、黃是原色，我們還把它們混合做出綠色。
of primary importance: For a doctor, washing hands before seeing each patient is of primary importance, so they do it many times a day.
對醫生來說，在看每一位病人之前洗手是最重要的，所以他們一天要洗很多次。
a primary student: As a primary student, Lily already reads English books by herself and helps her friends in class with spelling.
身為一個小學生，莉莉已經能自己讀英文書，還會幫同學拼字。
a private school: My cousin goes to a private school in Taipei, and the students there have to wear a tie every day.
我表哥在臺北上一所私立學校，那裡的學生每天都得打領帶。
a private life: Famous singers often have no private life, because people take pictures of them everywhere they go.
有名的歌手常常沒有私生活，因為不管他們去哪裡，人們都會拍他們的照片。
in private: The teacher asked to speak to Mark in private after class, because she did not want the others to hear.
老師下課後要求和馬克私下談話，因為她不想讓其他人聽到。
a private talk: Dad had a private talk with my brother last night, and after that my brother went to bed early.
爸爸昨晚和我哥哥私下談話，之後我哥哥就早早上床睡覺了。
a private matter: Why Linda left the team is a private matter, so please do not ask her about it at lunch.
琳達為什麼離開球隊是她的私事，所以請不要在午餐時問她這件事。
private lessons: My parents pay for private lessons in piano twice a week, so I practice hard to make them happy.
我父母每週付兩次鋼琴家教課的錢，所以我努力練習讓他們開心。
keep it private: I will tell you my secret, but you must keep it private and never tell anyone at school.
我會告訴你我的秘密，但你必須保密，絕對不能告訴學校裡的任何人。
be proud of my son: I am so proud of my son, because he studied hard all year and passed the big test with top marks.
我為我兒子感到非常驕傲，因為他整年努力讀書，並以最高分通過了大考。
be proud to be: Amy says she is proud to be a nurse, even though she works long hours and often comes home late.
艾咪說她很自豪是一名護士，雖然她工作時間很長，而且常常很晚回家。
be too proud to ask: Kevin got lost in the city, but he was too proud to ask anyone for help, so he walked for hours.
凱文在城裡迷路了，但他太驕傲而不願向任何人求助，所以走了好幾個小時。
a proud moment: Winning the school race was a proud moment for Judy, and her whole family cheered from the side.
贏得學校賽跑對茱蒂來說是個自豪的時刻，她的全家人都在旁邊為她歡呼。
a proud man: Mr. Wang is a proud man who never says sorry, so his children do not like to talk with him.
王先生是個驕傲的人，從不道歉，所以他的孩子不喜歡和他說話。
proud parents: The proud parents took hundreds of pictures when their daughter walked on the stage to get her prize.
這對驕傲的父母在女兒走上舞臺領獎時拍了好幾百張照片。
proud 自豪的／驕傲的（形容詞）: A proud father stood by the door and smiled happily when his little girl played the piano for the first time.
當小女兒第一次彈鋼琴時，這位自豪的父親站在門邊開心地微笑。
proudly 自豪地（副詞）: Grandpa was so proud that he said proudly to everyone on the street that his grandson won first place.
爺爺非常自豪，他驕傲地對街上的每個人說他的孫子得了第一名。
pride 自豪（名詞）: Our class takes great pride in our clean room at school, and we are proud when visitors say nice things about it.
我們班以學校裡乾淨的教室為榮，當訪客稱讚它時我們都很驕傲。
be proud of 以…為榮: Your teacher is so proud of you for helping the new student who did not know anyone in the school.
你的老師很以你為榮，因為你幫助了那個在學校不認識任何人的新同學。
a public school: Most children in our town go to a public school, because it is free and close to their homes.
我們鎮上大部分的孩子都上公立學校，因為它是免費的，而且離家很近。
in public: Mary is afraid to sing in public, but she sings beautifully when she is alone in her room.
瑪莉害怕公開唱歌，但她一個人在房間裡時唱得很好聽。
the public: The new park will be open to the public next month, and families can have picnics there for free.
新公園下個月會對大眾開放，家庭可以免費在那裡野餐。
a public holiday: Next Monday is a public holiday, so all the banks and schools will be closed for the day.
下星期一是國定假日，所以所有的銀行和學校那天都會關閉。
public opinion: Public opinion was against the new road through the forest, so the city decided not to build it.
民意反對那條穿過森林的新路，所以市政府決定不蓋了。
a public phone: My phone was dead, so I used a public phone at the train station to call my mother.
我的手機沒電了，所以我用火車站的公共電話打給媽媽。
go public: The singer decided to go public with her story, and she told the newspaper everything about her hard life.
那位歌手決定公開她的故事，她把自己辛苦的人生全部告訴了報社。
public places: You should not talk loudly on the phone in public places like the library or the MRT.
你不應該在圖書館或捷運這類公共場所大聲講電話。
a public figure: As a public figure, the city leader has to be careful about what he says and does every day.
身為公眾人物，市政領導人每天都必須小心自己的言行。
public 公共的（形容詞）: Please keep public places clean, and always throw your trash into the trash can after your picnic.
請保持公共場所的乾淨，野餐後一定要把垃圾丟進垃圾桶。
the public 大眾（名詞）: The old castle on the hill is open to the public on weekends, and the tickets are cheap for students.
山丘上的古堡週末對大眾開放，學生票很便宜。
in public 公開地: Many people are nervous when they speak in public, so practicing in front of a mirror can help a lot.
很多人公開演講時會緊張，所以在鏡子前練習會有很大幫助。
private 私人的: What I talked about with my doctor is a private matter, not something to be shared in public.
我和醫生談的內容是私事，不是可以公開分享的事情。
a quick look: Can I take a quick look at your notes before the test, because I missed the last class?
考試前我可以快速看一眼你的筆記嗎，因為我上一堂課沒來？
a quick lunch: We only had time for a quick lunch at the train station, so we bought some rice balls and juice.
我們在火車站只有時間快速吃個午餐，所以買了幾個飯糰和果汁。
a quick learner: Jason is a quick learner; he learned how to ride a bike in one afternoon when he was six.
傑森是個學得快的人，他六歲時一個下午就學會了騎腳踏車。
be quick to: My grandmother is always quick to help when a neighbor is sick, and she often brings them hot soup.
鄰居生病時，我奶奶總是很快就去幫忙，而且常常帶熱湯給他們。
Be quick!: Be quick! The last bus leaves in five minutes, and we still have to run down the stairs.
快點！最後一班公車五分鐘後就開了，而我們還得跑下樓梯。
a quick question: I have a quick question about tomorrow's homework: do we need to write the answers in English?
我有一個關於明天功課的簡單小問題：我們需要用英文寫答案嗎？
a quick fix: Putting tape on the broken chair is only a quick fix, so Dad will buy a new one this weekend.
在壞掉的椅子上貼膠帶只是個快速解決辦法，所以爸爸這週末會買一張新的。
quick thinking: Thanks to the driver's quick thinking, the bus stopped just in time, and nobody on the road got hurt.
多虧司機反應快，公車及時停了下來，路上沒有人受傷。
the quickest way: The quickest way to the museum is by MRT, because the roads are always full of cars in the morning.
去博物館最快的方法是搭捷運，因為早上路上總是塞滿了車。
a quick shower: After the basketball game, I took a quick shower and ran to meet my friends at the night market.
籃球比賽結束後，我快速沖了個澡，然後跑去夜市和朋友碰面。
quick 快的（形容詞）: When the teacher asked who broke the window, Tom gave a quick answer and said it was the wind.
當老師問是誰打破窗戶時，湯姆很快地回答說是風吹的。
quickly 快速地（副詞）: Please answer quickly, because the game show host only gives you ten seconds for each quick question.
請快速回答，因為節目主持人每個小問題只給你十秒鐘。
quick 迅速（短時間內）: I sent an email to the hotel last night and got a quick reply this morning before breakfast.
我昨晚寄了一封電子郵件給旅館，今天早餐前就收到了迅速的回覆。
a quiet life: After thirty years in the busy city, my grandmother and grandfather moved to the country to enjoy a quiet life.
在忙碌的城市住了三十年後，我的祖父母搬到鄉下享受安靜的生活。
keep quiet: Please keep quiet in the library, because many students are studying hard for their exams.
請在圖書館裡保持安靜，因為很多學生正在為考試努力讀書。
a quiet street: We live on a quiet street with lots of trees, so I can hear birds singing every morning.
我們住在一條有很多樹的安靜街道上，所以每天早上我都能聽到鳥叫。
Be quiet!: Be quiet! The baby just fell asleep, and Mom will be angry if you wake her up again.
安靜！寶寶剛睡著，如果你又把她吵醒，媽媽會生氣的。
a quiet voice: The nurse spoke in a quiet voice to the sick child, and soon he stopped crying and fell asleep.
護士輕聲對生病的孩子說話，很快他就停止哭泣睡著了。
on the quiet: The two boys planned a surprise party for their mother on the quiet, and she never found out until the big day.
這兩個男孩暗中為媽媽計劃了一個驚喜派對，她直到那天才知道。
a quiet evening: After a long week at work, Dad likes to spend a quiet evening at home reading the newspaper.
工作了漫長的一週後，爸爸喜歡在家裡看報紙，度過寧靜的夜晚。
as quiet as a mouse: My little sister was as quiet as a mouse during the movie, because she did not want to miss a word.
我妹妹看電影時非常安靜，像老鼠一樣不出聲，因為她不想錯過任何一句話。
quiet 安靜的（形容詞）: I need a quiet room to study for the test, so please turn off the TV for an hour.
我需要一個安靜的房間來準備考試，所以請把電視關掉一小時。
quite 相當（副詞）: The food at this quiet little restaurant is quite good, so we come here every Sunday for lunch.
這家安靜的小餐廳食物相當好吃，所以我們每個星期天都來這裡吃午餐。
silent 無聲的／沉默的: The students kept silent when the teacher walked in, and the room stayed quiet for the whole class.
老師走進來時學生們保持沉默，整堂課教室都很安靜。
quietly 安靜地: Please speak quietly in the hospital, because the sick people in the rooms need a quiet place to rest.
請在醫院裡安靜地說話，因為病房裡的病人需要一個安靜的地方休息。
a rainy day: On a rainy day like this, I like to stay home, drink hot tea, and read a good book.
在像今天這樣的雨天，我喜歡待在家裡，喝熱茶，讀一本好書。
the rainy season: The rainy season in Taiwan usually starts in May, so remember to carry an umbrella in your bag.
臺灣的雨季通常從五月開始，所以記得在包包裡帶一把傘。
save for a rainy day: My grandmother always told me to save money for a rainy day, so I put some of my pocket money in the bank each month.
我奶奶總是告訴我要未雨綢繆存錢，所以我每個月都把一部分零用錢存進銀行。
rainy weather: Because of the rainy weather, the baseball game was moved to next Saturday afternoon, and the players went home.
因為下雨的天氣，棒球比賽被改到下星期六下午，球員們都回家了。
a rare chance: Meeting a famous writer is a rare chance, so Linda brought all his books for him to sign.
遇見一位名作家是個難得的機會，所以琳達帶了他所有的書請他簽名。
a rare animal: The black bear is a rare animal in Taiwan, and only a few people have ever seen one in the mountains.
黑熊在臺灣是稀有動物，只有少數人曾在山上看過。
a rare steak: My uncle likes his steak rare, but I think the meat is too red and I always order mine well done.
我叔叔喜歡吃一分熟的牛排，但我覺得那肉太紅了，我總是點全熟的。
rare books: The old man keeps hundreds of rare books in his study, and some of them are more than two hundred years old.
這位老先生在書房裡收藏了幾百本珍本書，有些已經超過兩百年了。
It's rare to see: It's rare to see snow in Taipei, so when it snowed on the mountain last year, everyone drove up to take pictures.
在臺北很少見到雪，所以去年山上下雪時，大家都開車上山拍照。
be ready for the test: Are you ready for the English test tomorrow, or do you want to study together at my house tonight?
你準備好明天的英文考試了嗎，還是你今晚想來我家一起讀書？
be ready to go: The kids were ready to go at six in the morning, because they were so excited about the trip to the zoo.
孩子們早上六點就準備好出發了，因為他們對去動物園的旅行感到非常興奮。
get ready: Get ready for bed now, because we have to leave early tomorrow to catch the first train to Tainan.
現在準備好上床睡覺，因為我們明天得早點出門搭第一班火車去臺南。
Ready, set, go!: The teacher shouted, Ready, set, go, and all the students ran as fast as they could toward the finish line.
老師大喊各就各位，預備，跑，所有學生都盡全力朝終點線跑去。
ready money: The small shop does not take cards, so bring some ready money with you if you want to buy that bag.
這間小店不收卡，所以如果你想買那個包包，身上要帶些現金。
a ready answer: Whenever Dad asks why I'm late, I always have a ready answer, but he never believes a word of it.
每當爸爸問我為什麼遲到，我總是有現成的答案，但他一個字也不相信。
ready-made: Mom was too tired to cook tonight, so we bought some ready-made dumplings at the store and heated them at home.
媽媽今晚太累不想做飯，所以我們在商店買了現成的水餃回家加熱。
Are you ready to order?: The waiter came to our table with a smile and asked, Are you ready to order, or do you need more time?
服務生微笑著走到我們桌邊問，可以點餐了嗎，還是你們需要多一點時間？
be always ready to help: Our neighbor Mrs. Chen is always ready to help, and she looks after my little brother when my parents work late.
我們的鄰居陳太太隨時樂於幫忙，我父母晚下班時她會照顧我弟弟。
a real friend: A real friend stays with you when you are sad, not only when you are having fun at a party.
真正的朋友在你難過時會陪著你，而不是只在你開派對玩得開心時出現。
in real life: In real life, people cannot fly like the heroes in the movies, so please be careful on the roof.
在現實生活中，人不能像電影裡的英雄那樣飛，所以在屋頂上請小心。
the real world: After he finished school, Jim found out that the real world was harder than he thought.
畢業後，吉姆發現現實世界比他想像的更困難。
for real: Are you leaving the team for real, or are you just angry because we lost the game yesterday?
你是真的要離開球隊，還是只是因為我們昨天輸了比賽而在生氣？
a real man: My grandfather says a real man keeps his word and takes care of his family no matter what happens.
我爺爺說真正的男子漢會守信用，而且不管發生什麼事都會照顧家人。
the real thing: This bag looks cheap, but the one in the store window is the real thing and costs ten times more.
這個包包看起來很便宜，但店裡櫥窗那一個是真品，價格貴十倍。
Get real!: Get real! You cannot pass the test if you only start studying the night before.
認清現實吧！如果你只在考試前一晚才開始讀書，是不可能通過的。
