real money: The money in the board game is just paper, but my brother thought it was real money and tried to buy candy with it.
桌遊裡的錢只是紙，但我弟弟以為那是真錢，還想拿去買糖果。
real 真實的（形容詞）: The movie is based on a real story about a dog that waited for its owner at the station for ten years.
這部電影是根據一個真實故事改編的，講一隻狗在車站等了主人十年。
really 真的（副詞）: The noodles at that little shop are really good, and the real reason I go there is the kind old owner.
那間小店的麵真的很好吃，而我去那裡真正的原因是那位和善的老闆。
true 正確的／忠實的: It is a true story, and the real people in it still live in a small town near Tainan today.
這是一個真實的故事，故事裡真實的人物如今還住在臺南附近的一個小鎮。
realize 意識到（動詞）: When I saw the real price on the ticket, I realized the truth: my brother had paid for my trip.
當我看到票上的真實價格時，我才意識到真相：我哥哥幫我付了旅費。
see red: Dad saw red when he found out that someone had hit his new car in the parking lot and driven away.
當爸爸發現有人在停車場撞了他的新車後逃走時，他勃然大怒。
a red face: Lily had a red face when the teacher read her love letter in front of the whole class.
當老師在全班面前讀出莉莉的情書時，她臉紅了。
in the red: The small restaurant has been in the red for months, so the owner may have to close it soon.
這家小餐廳已經負債好幾個月了，所以老闆可能很快就得關店。
red tape: It took my uncle six months to open his shop because of all the red tape at the city office.
由於市政府辦公室的種種繁文縟節，我叔叔花了六個月才開起他的店。
a red light: You must stop at a red light even if there are no other cars on the road late at night.
即使深夜路上沒有其他車，你在紅燈時也必須停下來。
roll out the red carpet: When the famous singer visited our town, the people rolled out the red carpet and gave her flowers at the station.
當那位名歌手來到我們鎮上時，人們隆重歡迎她，並在車站送她花。
turn red: Henry turned red when the pretty girl next to him asked for his phone number in front of his friends.
當坐在旁邊的漂亮女孩在朋友面前跟亨利要電話號碼時，他臉紅了。
a red letter day: The day my big brother came home from America was a red letter day for our whole family.
我大哥從美國回家的那一天，是我們全家的大日子。
red meat: The doctor told Grandpa to eat less red meat and more fish and vegetables for his heart.
醫生告訴爺爺為了心臟健康，要少吃紅肉，多吃魚和蔬菜。
regular customers: The old couple are regular customers at the noodle shop, so the owner always knows what they want to order.
這對老夫妻是麵店的常客，所以老闆總是知道他們要點什麼。
regular exercise: Regular exercise, like running three times a week, keeps my father healthy and helps him sleep well at night.
規律運動，像是每週跑步三次，讓我爸爸保持健康，也幫助他晚上睡得好。
a regular size: Do you want a large drink with your lunch, or is a regular size enough for you today?
你午餐要搭配大杯飲料，還是今天普通尺寸就夠了？
at regular times: The doctor said I should take this medicine at regular times, so I set an alarm for eight in the morning and eight at night.
醫生說我應該定時吃這個藥，所以我設了早上八點和晚上八點的鬧鐘。
regular verbs: Regular verbs like walk and play are easy to remember, because they all change in the same simple way.
像 walk 和 play 這樣的規則動詞很容易記，因為它們都用同樣簡單的方式變化。
a regular visitor: Mr. Brown is a regular visitor to our library; he comes in every Tuesday to read the newspaper.
布朗先生是我們圖書館常來的人，他每個星期二都來看報紙。
keep regular hours: To stay healthy during the school year, you should keep regular hours and go to bed before eleven.
為了在學年中保持健康，你應該作息規律，十一點前上床睡覺。
a regular guy: The movie star is just a regular guy at home; he cooks dinner and washes the dishes like everyone else.
那位電影明星在家只是個普通人，他像大家一樣做晚餐、洗碗。
be responsible to the boss: As the team leader, Jenny is responsible to the boss for finishing the project before the end of the month.
身為團隊領導者，珍妮要對老闆負責，在月底前完成這個專案。
a responsible person: Our class leader is a responsible person who always finishes her work on time and helps others with theirs.
我們的班長是個有責任感的人，她總是準時完成工作，還會幫助別人。
a responsible job: Being a doctor is a responsible job, because a small mistake could hurt a patient very badly.
當醫生是一份責任重大的工作，因為一個小錯誤就可能嚴重傷害病人。
hold sb. responsible for: The teacher held Mike responsible for the broken window, because he was the one who kicked the ball.
老師要麥克為打破的窗戶負責，因為踢球的人就是他。
the rich: In this city, the rich live in big houses on the hill, and the poor live near the old train station.
在這個城市，有錢人住在山丘上的大房子裡，窮人則住在舊火車站附近。
rich food: My doctor told me to stay away from rich food like fried chicken and cream cakes for a few weeks.
我的醫生告訴我這幾個星期要遠離炸雞和奶油蛋糕這類油膩的食物。
a rich voice: The old singer still has a rich voice, and everyone in the hall became quiet when he began his song.
這位老歌手仍有圓潤的聲音，當他開始唱歌時，大廳裡的每個人都安靜了下來。
a rich history: Tainan has a rich history, so you can see old temples and buildings on almost every street.
臺南有豐富的歷史，所以幾乎每條街上都能看到古老的廟宇和建築。
get rich quick: My cousin lost all his money because he believed a man who promised he could get rich quick.
我表哥相信了一個承諾能讓他快速致富的男人，結果賠光了所有的錢。
rich colors: The painter used rich colors like deep red and gold, and the picture seemed to warm up the whole room.
這位畫家使用了深紅和金色等濃郁的色彩，那幅畫彷彿讓整個房間都暖了起來。
a rich man: A rich man bought the old house by the river and turned it into a free library for the children in town.
一位有錢人買下河邊的老房子，把它變成鎮上孩子們的免費圖書館。
rich 有錢的／豐富的: Japan is a rich country with many big companies, but its people still work very long hours every day.
日本是一個有很多大公司的富裕國家，但人民每天仍然工作很長時間。
riches 財富（名詞）: The young singer dreamed of riches and fame, but after she became rich, she missed her quiet old life.
這位年輕歌手曾夢想財富與名聲，但在她變有錢之後，卻想念從前安靜的生活。
be rich in 富含: Spinach is rich in iron, so my mother cooks it for dinner at least twice a week for the whole family.
菠菜富含鐵質，所以我媽媽每週至少煮兩次給全家人當晚餐。
right now: I cannot talk right now because I am in the middle of a test, but I will call you back at noon.
我現在不能說話，因為我正在考試，但我中午會回電給你。
right away: When the fire alarm rings, leave the building right away and do not go back for your bags.
當火警鈴響起時，要立刻離開建築物，不要回去拿包包。
all right: Are you all right? You fell off your bike pretty hard, so let me take a look at your knee.
你沒事嗎？你從腳踏車上摔得挺重的，讓我看看你的膝蓋。
on the right: Walk down this street for five minutes, and you will see the post office on the right next to a bank.
沿著這條街走五分鐘，你會看到郵局在右邊，旁邊是一家銀行。
the right answer: Only three students got the right answer to the last math problem, because it was really difficult.
只有三個學生答對了最後一道數學題的正確答案，因為它真的很難。
the right person: Mrs. Lee is the right person to ask about Japanese food, because she lived in Tokyo for ten years.
李太太是請教日本食物的合適人選，因為她在東京住了十年。
turn right: Turn right at the second traffic light, and the hospital will be on your left after the bridge.
在第二個紅綠燈右轉，過了橋之後醫院就在你的左邊。
right here: Stay right here by the door and do not move, because Mom will come back from the store in two minutes.
就待在這裡門邊不要動，因為媽媽兩分鐘後就會從商店回來。
That's right, we have a math test on Friday, so you should start studying for it tonight.
沒錯，我們星期五有數學考試，所以你今晚就應該開始準備了。
be right about: You were right about the weather; it started raining at three, just like you said this morning.
你對天氣的看法是正確的，三點時開始下雨了，就像你今天早上說的一樣。
right in front of: The cat was sleeping right in front of the door, so we had to step over it to get inside.
那隻貓就睡在門的正前面，所以我們得跨過它才能進屋。
put things right: After the big fight with his sister, Jack bought her a cake to put things right between them.
跟姐姐大吵一架之後，傑克買了一個蛋糕給她，想把兩人之間的事情弄好。
right-handed: Most people in my class are right-handed, but my best friend writes and eats with her left hand.
我班上大多數人都是右撇子，但我最好的朋友用左手寫字和吃飯。
Right?: You are coming to the party on Saturday, right? Everyone is bringing some food to share.
你星期六會來派對，對吧？每個人都會帶一些食物來分享。
right 對的／右邊的（形容詞）: The teacher showed us the right way to hold a pen, and my writing became much better after that.
老師教我們握筆的正確方法，之後我的字變得好看許多。
right 立刻／正好（副詞）: I have to leave right now, because my mother is waiting for me in the car outside the school.
我現在必須馬上離開，因為我媽媽正在學校外面的車上等我。
a right 權利（名詞）: In Taiwan, people who are twenty years old have the right to vote and choose the leaders of the country.
在臺灣，年滿二十歲的人有投票的權利，可以選擇國家的領導人。
write 寫: Write a letter to your grandmother tonight, and make sure you spell her name right this time.
今晚寫一封信給你奶奶，這次一定要把她的名字拼對。
correct 正確的: Tom chose the correct answer for question five, but he was not right about the last two questions.
湯姆第五題選了正確答案，但最後兩題他沒答對。
all year round: The weather on this island is warm all year round, so the beaches are full of people even in January.
這座島上全年天氣溫暖，所以即使在一月，海灘上也擠滿了人。
a round trip: A round trip ticket from Taipei to Tainan costs about one thousand dollars by the fast train.
從臺北到臺南的高鐵來回票大約要一千元。
round the clock: The nurses at the hospital work round the clock, so there is always someone to help the patients at night.
醫院的護士全天候工作，所以晚上總是有人可以幫助病人。
a round face: My baby brother has a round face and big eyes, and everyone says he looks just like a little moon.
我的小弟弟有一張圓臉和大眼睛，大家都說他看起來像個小月亮。
the first round: Our school team won the first round of the basketball game, but we lost to a stronger team the next day.
我們學校的球隊贏了籃球比賽的第一回合，但隔天輸給了一支更強的隊伍。
round and round: The little dog ran round and round the tree in the park until it was too tired to move.
那隻小狗在公園裡繞著樹一圈又一圈地跑，直到累得動不了。
in round numbers: In round numbers, about three hundred students came to the school sports day, but I am not sure of the real number.
約略的整數來說，大約有三百個學生來參加學校運動會，但我不確定真正的數字。
round the corner: There is a small bookstore round the corner, so we can walk there after lunch and look for comic books.
轉角那裡有一家小書店，所以我們午餐後可以走過去找漫畫書。
round 圓的（形容詞）: My family likes to eat dinner at a round table because everyone can see each other and talk easily.
我家喜歡在圓桌吃晚餐，因為每個人都能看到彼此，聊天也很方便。
round 繞過（介係詞、: My uncle wants to travel round the world by ship one day, so he is saving money every month.
我叔叔希望有一天能搭船繞過世界旅行一圈，所以他每個月都在存錢。
a round 一回合（名詞）: Our basketball team won the first two games, and now we are ready for the final round next Saturday.
我們的籃球隊贏了前兩場比賽，現在我們準備好迎接下週六的最後一回合了。
around 周圍／大約: The movie starts at around ten, so let's meet in front of the theater at about a quarter to ten.
電影大約十點開始，所以我們大約九點四十五分在電影院前面見吧。
Don't be rude to the new student; she just moved here from Japan and does not know anyone yet.
不要對那位新同學沒禮貌，她剛從日本搬來，還不認識任何人。
rude words: Our teacher told Jack to stop using rude words in class because they make other students feel bad.
老師叫傑克別在課堂上說粗魯的話，因為那會讓其他同學很不舒服。
a rude shock: Losing the final game by one point was a rude shock to our team, and some players cried on the bus.
以一分之差輸掉決賽對我們隊來說是突如其來的打擊，有些球員在公車上哭了。
be sad about: Mary is still sad about losing her cat, so her friends are trying to cheer her up after school.
瑪麗還在為失去她的貓而難過，所以她的朋友們放學後努力讓她開心起來。
a sad story: My grandmother told us a sad story about a poor boy who had no shoes in winter, and we almost cried.
奶奶跟我們說了一個悲傷的故事，是關於一個冬天沒有鞋子的窮男孩，我們差點哭了。
sad news: When Dad came home with sad news about his job, nobody at the dinner table wanted to eat anything.
當爸爸帶著工作上的壞消息回到家時，餐桌上沒有人想吃東西。
feel sad for: I feel sad for the old man next door because his children never come to visit him on holidays.
我為隔壁的老先生感到難過，因為他的孩子從來不在節日時來看他。
It's sad that: It's sad that the old tree in front of our school will be cut down next week to make a parking lot.
令人難過的是，我們學校前面那棵老樹下星期就要被砍掉來蓋停車場了。
a sad face: Tom walked into the class with a sad face this morning, so I asked him what had happened at home.
湯姆今天早上帶著難過的表情走進教室，所以我問他家裡發生了什麼事。
Sad to say: Sad to say, our favorite noodle shop near the station closed last month, and we cannot eat there anymore.
很遺憾地說，我們最愛的車站附近那家麵店上個月關門了，我們再也不能去那裡吃了。
sad 難過的（形容詞）: Many students feel sad on the last day of summer vacation because they have to go back to school soon.
很多學生在暑假最後一天會感到難過，因為他們很快就要回學校上課了。
sadly 難過地／遺憾地（副詞）: Sadly, the little bird we found in the garden died before we could take it to the animal doctor.
很遺憾地，我們在花園裡發現的那隻小鳥，在我們帶它去看動物醫生之前就死了。
sadness 悲傷（名詞）: Her eyes were full of sadness when she said goodbye to her best friend at the airport last night.
昨晚她在機場和最好的朋友道別時，眼裡充滿了悲傷。
unhappy 不開心的: The movie made me sad because it has an unhappy ending, and the boy never finds his lost dog.
這部電影讓我很難過，因為它有個不開心的結局，男孩一直沒找到他走失的狗。
safe and sound: After the big typhoon, we were happy to hear that all our family members in Tainan were safe and sound.
大颱風過後，我們很高興聽到所有在台南的家人都平安無事。
a safe place: During an earthquake, the space under a strong table can be a safe place to hide until the shaking stops.
地震的時候，堅固的桌子底下可以是躲避的安全地方，直到搖晃停止。
play it safe: I didn't know the answer to the hard question, so I decided to play it safe and choose the easy one.
我不知道那道難題的答案，所以我決定求穩妥，選擇簡單的那一題。
to be on the safe side: It may not rain today, but to be on the safe side, you should take an umbrella to school.
今天可能不會下雨，但為了保險起見，你還是應該帶把傘去學校。
a safe trip: My aunt is flying to Korea tomorrow morning, so we all wished her a safe trip at dinner tonight.
我阿姨明天早上要飛去韓國，所以我們今晚吃晚餐時都祝她一路平安。
keep sth. safe: Please keep your money and tickets safe when you travel because it is very hard to get them back later.
旅行時請妥善保管你的錢和票，因為之後會很難找回來。
Lock the door every time you leave the house, even for a few minutes, because better safe than sorry.
每次離開家都要鎖門，即使只是幾分鐘，因為小心為上。
safe 安全的（形容詞）: Our school playground is a safe place for little kids because there are no cars and teachers watch them closely.
我們學校的操場對小孩子來說是安全的地方，因為沒有車子，而且老師會仔細看著他們。
safely 安全地（副詞）: The bus driver drove slowly in the heavy rain, and all the students arrived safely at the museum by noon.
公車司機在大雨中慢慢開，所有學生中午前都安全地抵達了博物館。
safety 安全（名詞）: Our teacher talked about road safety this morning and told us never to ride bikes without looking both ways first.
老師今天早上談到交通安全，告訴我們騎腳踏車前一定要先看看左右兩邊。
save 救／存（動詞）: Lisa wants to save money for a new phone and keep it in a safe place, so she brings lunch from home.
麗莎想存錢買新手機並放在安全的地方，所以她從家裡帶午餐。
a safe 保險箱（名詞）: My father keeps his watch and some gold rings in a safe in the bedroom so no one can steal them.
我爸爸把他的手錶和幾個金戒指放在臥室的保險箱裡，這樣就沒有人能偷走。
the same as: Your new bike is the same as mine, so let's put name cards on them or we might take the wrong one.
你的新腳踏車和我的一樣，所以我們在上面貼名牌吧，不然可能會牽錯。
all the same: The weather was cold and wet on Sunday, but all the same, we went to the beach and had a great time.
星期天天氣又冷又濕，但我們仍然去了海邊，而且玩得很開心。
at the same time: My sister likes to eat snacks and watch TV at the same time, so she often drops food on the sofa.
我姊姊喜歡同時吃零食和看電視，所以她常常把食物掉在沙發上。
When Peter said he was so hungry that he could eat three bowls of beef noodles, I laughed and said, Same here.
當彼得說他餓到可以吃三碗牛肉麵時，我笑著說：我也一樣。
the same old story: Every time my brother is late for dinner, he tells us the same old story about missing the bus.
每次我哥哥晚餐遲到，他都跟我們老調重彈，說他錯過了公車。
one and the same: I did not know that the famous writer and my mother's old friend from school were one and the same person.
我不知道那位有名的作家和我媽媽的學生時代老朋友竟然是同一個人。
Same to you!: When my teacher wished me a happy New Year at the school gate, I smiled and said, Same to you!
當老師在學校門口祝我新年快樂時，我微笑著說：你也一樣！
in the same way: My grandmother cooks rice in the same way her mother did many years ago, and it always tastes wonderful.
我奶奶用和她母親多年前同樣的方式煮飯，吃起來總是很棒。
the same day: Amy and I were born on the same day in the same hospital, so we have a birthday party together every year.
艾美和我在同一天、同一家醫院出生，所以我們每年都一起辦生日派對。
be scared of spiders: My little brother is scared of spiders, so he shouts and runs out of the room whenever he sees one.
我弟弟怕蜘蛛，所以每次看到一隻就會大叫並跑出房間。
be scared to death: When the lights suddenly went out during the storm last night, my little sister was scared to death.
昨晚暴風雨中燈突然熄滅時，我妹妹嚇死了。
get scared: The baby got scared when the big dog barked loudly, and she began to cry in her mother's arms.
大狗大聲吠叫時，寶寶受到驚嚇，開始在媽媽懷裡哭了起來。
a scared look: Jenny had a scared look on her face when the teacher called her name to answer the hard question.
當老師叫珍妮的名字回答那道難題時，她臉上出現驚恐的表情。
be scared to go: Kevin was scared to go to the dentist alone, so his mother went with him and held his hand.
凱文不敢一個人去看牙醫，所以他媽媽陪他去並握著他的手。
scared 人感到害怕: I'm scared when I walk home alone at night, so I always call my mom and talk to her on the way.
晚上一個人走回家時我會害怕，所以我總是打電話給媽媽，一路上和她聊天。
scary 事物令人害怕: We watched a scary movie about ghosts at Tim's house last night, and I could not sleep well after that.
昨晚我們在提姆家看了一部關於鬼的恐怖電影，之後我就睡得不太好。
afraid 害怕的（補語）: I am scared of the dark, and my sister is afraid of big dogs, so we always walk home together early.
我怕黑，而我姊姊害怕大狗，所以我們總是早早一起走回家。
frightened 受驚的: The children looked frightened when the thunder got louder, and even the teacher was a little scared too.
雷聲越來越大時，孩子們看起來受到驚嚇，連老師也有點害怕。
second hand: My watch is cheap, but it still has a second hand that moves around the face once every minute.
我的手錶很便宜，但它還是有一根秒針，每分鐘在錶面繞一圈。
second-hand clothes: My cousin often buys second-hand clothes at the night market because they are cheap and still look very nice.
我表姊常在夜市買二手衣，因為很便宜而且看起來還是很好看。
a second chance: Our teacher gave Ben a second chance to hand in his report after he said sorry for being late.
班說完遲交的抱歉後，老師給了他第二次機會交報告。
on second thought: I wanted to buy the blue jacket, but on second thought, the black one goes better with my jeans.
我本來想買那件藍色夾克，但再想一想，黑色那件比較搭我的牛仔褲。
second to none: When it comes to making dumplings, my grandmother is second to none among all the people in our town.
說到包水餃，我奶奶在我們鎮上所有人裡是首屈一指的。
every second day: The doctor told my grandfather to take a walk every second day, so he goes to the park on Monday and Wednesday.
醫生叫我爺爺每隔一天散步一次，所以他星期一和星期三去公園。
the second floor: The music room is on the second floor, right above the library, so please walk up the stairs quietly.
音樂教室在二樓，就在圖書館的正上方，所以請安靜地走樓梯上去。
in a second: Wait by the door and I will be back in a second; I just need to get my bag from the class.
在門口等一下，我馬上回來，我只是要去教室拿書包。
wait a second: Hey, wait a second! You forgot your lunch box on the kitchen table, and Mom made your favorite rice today.
嘿，等一下！你把便當盒忘在廚房桌上了，媽媽今天做了你最愛的飯。
second nature: After riding a bike to school for five years, turning left and right in traffic has become second nature to me.
騎腳踏車上學五年之後，在車陣中左轉右轉對我來說已經成了第二天性。
have second thoughts: Linda wanted to join the dance club, but she had second thoughts after hearing about the long practice hours.
琳達本來想加入舞蹈社，但聽說練習時間很長之後，她就改變心意了。
second 第二的（形容詞）: On the second day of our trip to Japan, we visited a beautiful old temple and ate noodles for lunch.
我們日本之旅的第二天，參觀了一座美麗的古老寺廟，午餐吃了麵。
a second 一秒（名詞）: It takes less than a second for the runner to leave the starting line after the teacher shouts Go.
老師喊「跑」之後，跑者離開起跑線所花的時間不到一秒。
secondly 第二（副詞）: First, wash the vegetables well, and secondly, cut them into small pieces before you put them in the pot.
首先，把蔬菜洗乾淨，第二，在放進鍋子前把它們切成小塊。
the second 兩者中第二個: There are two cakes on the table; the first one is for Mom, and the second is for my little brother.
桌上有兩個蛋糕，第一個是給媽媽的，兩者中的第二個是給我弟弟的。
a secondary school: My older sister studies at a secondary school in Taipei, and she takes the bus there every morning at seven.
我姊姊在台北的一所中學念書，她每天早上七點搭公車去上學。
be of secondary importance: For our team, winning is of secondary importance; having fun and helping each other matter the most.
對我們隊來說，獲勝是次要的，一起玩得開心和互相幫忙才是最重要的。
a secondary road: We took a secondary road through the mountains, so the trip was slower but the view was beautiful.
我們走了一條穿過山區的次要道路，所以路程比較慢，但風景很美。
a secondary reason: The main reason I joined the swimming club is to get stronger, and a secondary reason is to make new friends.
我加入游泳社的主要原因是想變強壯，次要原因是想認識新朋友。
a selfish man: Everyone says Mr. Wang is a selfish man because he never shares anything with his neighbors or helps them.
大家都說王先生是個自私的人，因為他從來不和鄰居分享任何東西，也不幫忙他們。
a selfish act: Taking the last piece of cake without asking anyone was a selfish act, and his sister was very angry.
沒問任何人就拿走最後一塊蛋糕是自私的行為，他姊姊非常生氣。
It's selfish to: It's selfish to play loud music late at night when your family and neighbors are trying to sleep.
當你的家人和鄰居想睡覺時，深夜播放大聲的音樂很自私。
Don't be selfish, Jimmy; let your little brother play with the new game for a while before dinner.
吉米，別自私，晚餐前讓你弟弟玩一下新遊戲吧。
be serious about: Amy is really serious about becoming a doctor, so she studies science for two hours every night after dinner.
艾美對成為醫生這件事非常認真，所以她每晚晚餐後都讀兩個小時的自然科學。
a serious problem: Air pollution is a serious problem in many big cities, so more people are starting to ride bikes to work.
空氣污染在許多大城市是嚴重的問題，所以越來越多人開始騎腳踏車上班。
Are you serious?: Are you serious? You really ate ten hamburgers at lunch, and now you still want to order a pizza?
你是認真的嗎？你午餐真的吃了十個漢堡，現在還想點披薩？
a serious face: The teacher walked in with a serious face, and we all knew that someone had broken a school rule.
老師帶著嚴肅的表情走進來，我們都知道有人違反了校規。
take sth. seriously: You should take the doctor's advice seriously and stop eating so much fried food every day.
你應該認真看待醫生的建議，別再每天吃那麼多油炸食物了。
serious music: My father enjoys serious music like Beethoven, but my sister only listens to pop songs on her phone.
我爸爸喜歡像貝多芬那樣的嚴肅音樂，但我姊姊只用手機聽流行歌。
a serious mistake: Forgetting to turn off the stove before leaving home is a serious mistake that can start a fire.
出門前忘了關爐火是個可能引起火災的嚴重錯誤。
be serious with: Mr. Lin is serious with his students about homework, so nobody in our class ever hands it in late.
林老師對學生的作業很認真，所以我們班沒有人會遲交。
several times: I have read this comic book several times, but I still laugh every time I look at the funny pictures.
這本漫畫我已經讀過好幾次了，但每次看到那些有趣的圖還是會笑。
several of them: There are twenty students in our class, and several of them live close enough to walk to school.
我們班有二十個學生，他們其中幾個住得很近，可以走路上學。
for several years: My family lived in Tainan for several years before we moved to Taipei when I was in grade three.
我家在台南住了好幾年，後來在我三年級時搬到台北。
several hundred: Several hundred people stood in line outside the store on Saturday to buy the new phone.
星期六有好幾百人在店外排隊買新手機。
in several ways: You can cook an egg in several ways, for example, you can boil it, fry it, or make it into egg soup.
雞蛋可以用好幾種方式來烹調，例如你可以水煮、煎，或是做成蛋花湯。
several 幾個（可數，多於兩個）: I borrowed several books from the library last week, and I have already finished reading three of them.
我上星期從圖書館借了幾本書，已經讀完其中三本了。
a few 一些（可數）: I bought several pens at the store, but I only need a few of them, so you can have the rest.
我在店裡買了幾枝筆，但我只需要其中一些，所以剩下的可以給你。
some 一些（可數、不可數）: We need several eggs and some milk for the cake, so please buy them at the supermarket on your way home.
做蛋糕需要幾顆蛋和一些牛奶，所以請你回家路上到超市買。
many 很多: Several students in my class play the piano, but many of them like sports more than music.
我們班有幾個學生會彈鋼琴，但他們之中很多人比較喜歡運動而不是音樂。
a sharp knife: Be careful with that sharp knife when you cut the apples, or you might hurt your fingers.
切蘋果時小心那把鋒利的刀，不然你可能會割傷手指。
a sharp turn: There is a sharp turn near the top of the mountain road, so the bus driver slowed down and drove very carefully.
山路靠近頂端有一個急轉彎，所以公車司機放慢速度，非常小心地開。
a sharp mind: My grandfather is eighty, but he still has a sharp mind and can do math faster than I can.
我爺爺八十歲了，但他的頭腦依然敏銳，算數學比我還快。
a sharp pain: After eating too much ice cream too fast, I felt a sharp pain in my head for about a minute.
吃太多冰淇淋又吃太快之後，我頭部感到一陣劇痛，大約持續了一分鐘。
at six o'clock sharp: The school bus leaves at six o'clock sharp every morning, so you will miss it if you are even one minute late.
校車每天早上六點整出發，所以只要晚一分鐘你就會錯過它。
sharp eyes: Eagles have sharp eyes, and they can see a small mouse on the ground from high up in the sky.
老鷹有敏銳的眼睛，從高空就能看見地上的一隻小老鼠。
a sharp tongue: Ann has a sharp tongue, and her words often hurt her friends even when she does not mean to.
安說話刻薄，她的話常常傷到朋友，即使她並不是有意的。
a sharp rise: There was a sharp rise in the price of vegetables after the typhoon, so my mother bought less this week.
颱風過後蔬菜價格急遽上升，所以我媽媽這星期買得比較少。
a sharp pencil: Please bring a sharp pencil and an eraser to the test tomorrow because we cannot use pens on the answer sheet.
明天的考試請帶一枝削尖的鉛筆和一塊橡皮擦，因為我們不能在答案卡上用原子筆。
look sharp: Ken always looks sharp in his white shirt and black pants when he goes to his piano lessons on Sunday.
肯星期天去上鋼琴課時，穿著白襯衫和黑長褲，總是看起來很帥。
in short: The movie was too long, the seats were hard, and the popcorn was cold; in short, we did not enjoy it.
電影太長、座位很硬、爆米花又冷掉了，簡而言之，我們並不喜歡。
be short of money: I am a little short of money this month because I bought a new bag, so I cannot join you at the movie.
我這個月有點缺錢，因為買了新包包，所以不能和你去看電影。
a short cut: If we take a short cut through the park, we can get to the train station in less than ten minutes.
如果我們走穿過公園的捷徑，不到十分鐘就能到火車站。
short for: My teacher told us that the word phone is short for telephone, and most people never use the long word.
老師告訴我們 phone 這個字是 telephone 的簡稱，大多數人從不說那個長的字。
a short time ago: A short time ago, there was only a small shop here, but now a big department store stands in its place.
不久前這裡只有一家小商店，但現在原地立著一間大百貨公司。
for short: Her full name is Elizabeth, but her friends and family all call her Liz for short.
她的全名是伊莉莎白，但她的朋友和家人都簡稱她為麗茲。
run short of: We are running short of rice at home, so Mom asked me to buy a bag at the supermarket after school.
我們家的米快用完了，所以媽媽叫我放學後去超市買一袋。
fall short of: Our class collected eight hundred dollars for the poor children, but that fell short of our goal of one thousand.
我們班為貧困的孩子募到八百元，但那未達到我們一千元的目標。
short on time: We are short on time, so let's finish the picture first and talk about the music for the show later.
我們時間不夠，所以我們先把圖畫完成，之後再討論表演的音樂。
a short temper: My uncle has a short temper, and he gets angry quickly when someone keeps him waiting for a long time.
我叔叔是個急性子，當有人讓他等很久時，他很快就會生氣。
in the short run: Studying all night before a test may help in the short run, but you will forget everything a week later.
考試前熬夜讀書短期內或許有幫助，但一星期後你就會全部忘光。
the long and the short of it: The long and the short of it is that we missed the last bus and had to walk home in the rain.
簡單地說，我們錯過了最後一班公車，只好在雨中走路回家。
a short story: Our English teacher reads us a short story every Friday afternoon, and then we talk about it in groups.
我們的英文老師每個星期五下午唸一篇短篇故事給我們聽，然後我們分組討論。
short 矮的／短的（人、物）: My brother is a short man, but he jumps very high and plays basketball better than most tall players.
我哥哥是個矮個子的男人，但他跳得很高，籃球打得比大多數高個子球員還好。
low 低的（物）: The coffee shop has a low table by the window, so even my short little brother can reach his cup easily.
那家咖啡店窗邊有一張矮桌子，所以連我矮小的弟弟都能輕鬆拿到他的杯子。
shortly 不久（副詞）: The rain stopped shortly after we got home, so my little sister wanted to go back out and play again.
我們到家不久後雨就停了，所以我妹妹想再出去玩。
shortage 短缺（名詞）: Because of the hot dry summer, there is a shortage of water in our town, so we cannot wash our cars.
因為炎熱乾燥的夏天，我們鎮上有水短缺的問題，所以我們不能洗車。
be shy of strangers: Our new puppy is shy of strangers, so it hides under the sofa whenever a visitor comes to the house.
我們的新小狗很怕生，每當有客人來家裡，它就躲到沙發底下。
be shy about speaking: Mark is shy about speaking English in front of the class, but he practices with his sister at home every night.
馬克不好意思在全班面前說英文，但他每晚在家和姊姊練習。
a shy smile: When the teacher praised her drawing, the little girl gave a shy smile and looked down at her desk.
當老師稱讚她的畫時，小女孩露出害羞的笑容，低頭看著她的桌子。
Don't be shy; come and join our game, because everyone here is friendly and wants to get to know you.
別害羞，來加入我們的遊戲吧，因為這裡的每個人都很友善，想認識你。
shy away from: My shy cat always shies away from the noisy machine and runs to the bedroom when Mom starts to clean the floor.
我害羞的貓總是避開吵鬧的機器，當媽媽開始清理地板時就跑到臥室去。
be too shy to: Peter was too shy to ask the pretty girl for her phone number, so his friend did it for him.
彼得太害羞而不敢向那位漂亮女孩要電話，所以他的朋友幫他問了。
shy 害羞的（形容詞）: Lily is a shy girl who seldom talks in class, but she writes beautiful stories in her notebook every day.
莉莉是個害羞的女孩，上課很少說話，但她每天都在筆記本裡寫出美麗的故事。
shyly 害羞地（副詞）: The little boy smiled shyly at his new teacher and then hid behind his mother's legs at the school gate.
小男孩在校門口害羞地對新老師微笑，然後躲到媽媽的腿後面。
shyness 害羞（名詞）: Joining the drama club helped Sam get over his shyness, and now he can speak on stage in front of hundreds.
加入戲劇社幫助山姆克服了害羞，現在他可以在數百人面前站上舞台說話。
quiet 內向安靜的: My cousin is a quiet boy who likes to read alone, but he is not shy; he just enjoys being by himself.
我表弟是個內向安靜的男孩，喜歡獨自看書，但他不害羞，他只是喜歡獨處。
be sick of homework: I am sick of homework this week because every teacher gave us a lot, and I have no time to play basketball.
這星期我厭倦功課了，因為每位老師都給了很多，我都沒時間打籃球。
be sick and tired of: My mother is sick and tired of picking up my dirty socks, so she said I must wash my own clothes now.
我媽媽對撿我的臭襪子厭煩透了，所以她說現在我必須自己洗衣服。
sick leave: My father took two days of sick leave last week because he had a high fever and a bad cough.
我爸爸上星期請了兩天病假，因為他發高燒又咳得很嚴重。
be homesick: During my first week at summer camp, I was so homesick that I called my mom every night before bed.
夏令營的第一個星期，我想家想到每天睡前都打電話給媽媽。
call in sick: Jenny had a bad headache this morning, so she called in sick and stayed in bed until noon.
珍妮今天早上頭很痛，所以她打電話請病假，在床上躺到中午。
be seasick: My sister was seasick on the boat to the small island, so she lay down and could not enjoy the view.
我姊姊在往小島的船上暈船，所以她躺下來，無法欣賞風景。
be carsick: I always get carsick on the long bus ride to my grandmother's house, so I try to sleep the whole way.
搭長途公車去奶奶家時我總是會暈車，所以我盡量整路都在睡覺。
sick to my stomach: After eating three hot dogs and a large soda at the night market, I felt sick to my stomach all night.
在夜市吃了三個熱狗和一大杯汽水之後，我整晚都反胃。
a sick joke: Making fun of the boy who hurt his leg was a sick joke, and nobody in the class laughed at it.
拿那個腿受傷的男孩開玩笑是個惡劣的笑話，班上沒有人笑。
worried sick: When Tom did not come home by midnight and did not answer his phone, his parents were worried sick.
湯姆到半夜還沒回家，也不接電話，他的父母擔心得要命。
sick 生病的（可放名詞前）: The nurse gave the sick child some medicine and a warm blanket, and he fell asleep in a few minutes.
護士給那個生病的小孩一些藥和一條溫暖的毯子，他幾分鐘後就睡著了。
ill 生病的（補語）: My grandfather has been ill for two weeks, and my sick aunt is in the same hospital, so we visit them together.
我爺爺已經病了兩個星期，而我生病的阿姨也在同一家醫院，所以我們一起去看他們。
be sick 生病／嘔吐: Jack was sick after the roller coaster ride, so we sat on a bench and gave him some water to drink.

look smart: You should look smart at the job interview tomorrow, so wear a clean white shirt and comb your hair.
你明天面試應該穿得體面一點，所以要穿乾淨的白襯衫並把頭髮梳好。
a smart card: You can use this smart card to pay for the bus, the train, and even a drink at the corner store.
你可以用這張晶片卡付公車、火車的錢，甚至在轉角的商店買飲料。
street smart: My cousin is street smart because he grew up in a big city and knows how to stay safe at night.
我表哥社會經驗豐富，因為他在大城市長大，知道晚上該怎麼保持安全。
a smart move: Buying the train tickets early was a smart move, because the prices went up a lot right before the holiday.
提早買火車票是聰明的一步，因為假期前票價漲了很多。
smart 聰明的／時髦的: Peter is a smart boy who finishes his homework fast and then helps his little brother with reading.
彼得是個聰明的男孩，他很快做完功課，然後幫弟弟練習閱讀。
clever 聰明的（反應快）: Using an old towel to clean the fan was a clever idea, and my smart sister thought of it first.
用舊毛巾清理電風扇是個聰明的點子，而且是我聰明的姊姊先想到的。
wise 有智慧的: The old farmer is a wise man, and even the smart young doctor in town comes to ask for his advice.
那位老農夫是個有智慧的人，連鎮上聰明的年輕醫生都來請教他。
intelligent 智力高的: Linda is an intelligent student who reads many books, but she is also smart enough to listen to others.
琳達是個智力很高的學生，讀很多書，但她也夠聰明，懂得傾聽別人。
bright 聰穎的（小孩）: The teacher says my little nephew is a bright kid, and he is so smart that he can already read simple stories.
老師說我的小外甥是個聰穎的孩子，他聰明到已經能讀簡單的故事了。
a sneaky trick: Hiding my shoes before the race was a sneaky trick, and I was angry at my brother for the whole day.
在比賽前把我的鞋子藏起來是個卑鄙的把戲，我整天都在生哥哥的氣。
a sneaky look: During the test, Jason took a sneaky look at Mary's paper, but the teacher saw him right away.
考試時，傑森偷偷瞄了一眼瑪麗的考卷，但老師馬上就看到他了。
be sneaky about: My sister was sneaky about eating the last piece of cake, so she washed the plate before anyone came home.
我姊姊偷偷吃掉最後一塊蛋糕，所以她在大家回家前就把盤子洗好了。
a snowy day: On a snowy day in Japan, we built a snowman in front of the hotel and then drank hot chocolate.
在日本一個下雪的日子，我們在飯店前堆了一個雪人，然後喝了熱巧克力。
snowy mountains: From the train window, we could see snowy mountains in the distance, and everyone took out their phones to take pictures.
從火車窗口，我們可以看到遠處白雪覆蓋的山，每個人都拿出手機拍照。
snowy white: The little rabbit at the pet shop was snowy white, and my sister wanted to take it home at once.
寵物店裡那隻小兔子雪白雪白的，我妹妹馬上就想把它帶回家。
social life: Since my brother started high school, his social life has become busy with club meetings and parties every weekend.
自從我哥哥上高中以後，他的社交生活變得很忙碌，每個週末都有社團聚會和派對。
social skills: Playing team sports can help children learn social skills, such as sharing, listening, and working with others.
參加團隊運動能幫助孩子學習社交技巧，例如分享、傾聽和與別人合作。
social studies: In social studies class this week, we learned about the history of Taiwan and drew a map of our city.
這星期的社會課，我們學了台灣的歷史，還畫了我們城市的地圖。
a social problem: Too much garbage on the beach has become a social problem, so our school will clean it up next month.
海灘上太多垃圾已經成為一個社會問題，所以我們學校下個月要去清理。
social class: In the old story, people from a different social class could not marry each other or even eat at the same table.
在那個古老的故事裡，不同社會階級的人不能結婚，甚至不能同桌吃飯。
a social animal: My teacher says a dog is a social animal, so it feels sad and lonely when it stays home alone all day.
老師說狗是社交動物，所以它整天獨自待在家時會覺得難過又孤單。
a sore throat: I had a sore throat this morning, so my mother made me a cup of warm honey water before school.
今天早上我喉嚨痛，所以媽媽在上學前幫我泡了一杯溫蜂蜜水。
sore eyes: After playing computer games for five hours, Tom had sore eyes and could not read the words on the board.
打了五個小時的電腦遊戲之後，湯姆眼睛酸痛，看不清黑板上的字。
a sore point: Do not ask Uncle Bob about his old job, because losing it last year is still a sore point for him.
別問鮑伯叔叔以前的工作，因為去年失去那份工作至今仍是他的痛處。
a sore loser: Nobody likes to play cards with Mike because he is a sore loser who gets angry every time he loses.
沒有人喜歡和麥克玩牌，因為他是個輸不起的人，每次輸了就生氣。
be sore about: My sister is still sore about missing the show, so please do not talk about the singer at dinner tonight.
我姊姊還在為錯過表演而惱火，所以今晚吃飯時請不要提那位歌手。
sore 酸痛的（部位）: Grandpa has a sore back from working in the garden all day, so he is lying on the sofa now.
爺爺在花園工作了一整天，背很酸痛，所以他現在正躺在沙發上。
painful 疼痛的: Amy got a painful cut on her finger while cooking dinner, and it was still sore the next morning.
艾美煮晚餐時手指被割了一道很痛的傷口，隔天早上還是很酸痛。
hurt 痛（動詞）: My leg hurts after the long race, and my feet are so sore that I can hardly walk up the stairs.
長跑之後我的腿很痛，腳也酸痛到幾乎沒辦法走上樓梯。
ache 隱痛（名詞、動詞）: Ben stayed home with a bad headache yesterday, and today his neck is still a little sore from lying in bed.
班昨天因為頭痛得很厲害待在家裡，今天因為躺在床上，脖子還有一點酸痛。
be sorry for the trouble: I am sorry for the trouble; my dog ran into your garden again and dug a big hole near your flowers.
很抱歉造成麻煩，我的狗又跑進你的花園，還在你的花旁邊挖了一個大洞。
be sorry about the loss: We were all sorry about the loss of our old school dog, so we planted a small tree for him.
我們都為失去學校那隻老狗感到難過，所以我們為它種了一棵小樹。
I feel sorry for Linda because she studied so hard for the test but still got a low score.
我很同情琳達，因為她為考試這麼用功，卻還是拿了低分。
I'm sorry to hear that your grandmother is in the hospital; please tell me if there is anything I can do.
聽到你奶奶住院了，我很遺憾，如果有什麼我能做的，請告訴我。
Sorry?: Sorry? I could not hear you because the music in this restaurant is too loud, so could you say that again?
什麼？餐廳裡的音樂太大聲了，我沒聽到，你可以再說一次嗎？
be sorry to say: I am sorry to say that our picnic is cancelled this weekend, because the weather report says a typhoon is coming.
很遺憾地說，這週末的野餐取消了，因為氣象報告說有颱風要來。
say sorry: After breaking his sister's favorite cup, Danny went to say sorry to her and bought her a new one.
丹尼打破了姊姊最喜歡的杯子之後，去跟她道歉，還買了一個新的給她。
a sorry sight: After the typhoon, the park was a sorry sight, with broken trees and garbage all over the wet ground.
颱風過後，公園是一片悲慘的景象，到處是斷掉的樹和散落在濕地上的垃圾。
go sour: The milk went sour because my brother left it on the kitchen table all afternoon in the hot weather.
牛奶變酸了，因為我弟弟在大熱天把它放在廚房桌上一整個下午。
a sour face: Lisa made a sour face when she found out that she had to clean the bathroom instead of going to the movies.
麗莎發現自己得打掃浴室而不能去看電影時，露出了一張不高興的臉。
sour grapes: When Mark said the winner's prize was not that great, we all knew it was just sour grapes.
當馬克說冠軍的獎品沒什麼了不起時，我們都知道那只是酸葡萄心理。
turn sour: The two best friends started to fight over a girl, and their friendship soon turned sour after that.
這兩個好朋友開始為了一個女孩爭吵，之後他們的友誼很快就變壞了。
sweet and sour: My favorite dish at the night market is sweet and sour chicken, and I order it almost every Friday night.
我在夜市最喜歡的菜是糖醋雞，我幾乎每個星期五晚上都點它。
the south of Taiwan: People in the south of Taiwan are very friendly, and the weather there is warm even in the winter months.
台灣南部的人非常友善，而且那裡即使在冬天的月份天氣也很溫暖。
South Africa: My cousin moved to South Africa for work last year, and she often sends us photos of wild animals.
我表姊去年搬到南非工作，她常常傳野生動物的照片給我們。
a south wind: A warm south wind was blowing this afternoon, so we took off our jackets and played outside until dinner.
今天下午吹著溫暖的南風，所以我們脫掉外套在外面玩到晚餐時間。
in the south: My grandmother lives in the south, so every winter vacation we take the train down to visit her.
我奶奶住在南方，所以每年寒假我們都搭火車南下去探望她。
go south: The birds go south every winter, but my dad also says our team's season went south after the captain got hurt.
鳥每年冬天往南飛，但我爸爸也說，隊長受傷之後，我們球隊這一季就變糟了。
the South Pole: It is so cold at the South Pole that only a few scientists live there to study the ice and the weather.
南極非常冷，只有少數幾位科學家住在那裡研究冰和天氣。
a special day: Tomorrow is a special day for our family because my parents got married on that day twenty years ago.
明天對我們家來說是個特別的日子，因為我爸媽二十年前的那天結婚。
today's special: The waiter told us that today's special is fish with rice, and it costs only one hundred dollars with a drink.
服務生告訴我們今日特餐是魚配飯，含一杯飲料只要一百元。
special needs: Some students with special needs study in our class, and we all help them with their notes and homework.
有些有特殊需求的學生在我們班上學習，我們都會幫他們做筆記和功課。
nothing special: When Mom asked what I did at school today, I said nothing special, just classes and lunch with friends.
媽媽問我今天在學校做了什麼時，我說沒什麼特別的，就是上課和跟朋友吃午餐。
a special guest: A famous baseball player came to our school as a special guest and taught us how to throw a ball.
一位有名的棒球員以特別來賓的身分來到我們學校，教我們怎麼投球。
a special offer: The shoe store has a special offer this week, so you can buy two pairs and pay for only one.
這家鞋店這星期有特價，所以你可以買兩雙只付一雙的錢。
special education: My aunt works in special education, and she teaches children who need more time and help to learn.
我阿姨從事特殊教育，她教導需要更多時間和幫助來學習的孩子。
What's so special about it?: Everyone wants this new phone, but what's so special about it when it looks the same as the old one?
每個人都想要這支新手機，但它看起來跟舊的一樣，到底有什麼特別的？
special 特別的: My grandmother gave me a special gift on my birthday: a watch that belonged to my grandfather.
我生日時奶奶送了我一份特別的禮物：一支曾經屬於爺爺的手錶。
especially 特別是（副詞）: Everyone in our class is happy about the trip, especially you, because you have never been to the beach.
我們班上每個人都為這次旅行感到高興，特別是你，因為你從沒去過海邊。
specially 專門地（副詞）: This cake was specially made for Grandpa's birthday, so it has a picture of his old house on it.
這個蛋糕是專門為爺爺的生日做的，所以上面有一張他老家的圖片。
be stingy with money: My uncle is stingy with money; he never buys a drink for anyone and always asks for the cheapest dish.
我叔叔用錢很小氣，他從不請任何人喝飲料，而且總是點最便宜的菜。
a stingy man: In the story, a stingy man keeps all his gold under his bed and never shares it with his poor neighbors.
故事裡有個小氣的人把所有黃金藏在床下，從不跟貧窮的鄰居分享。
be stingy about: Mom is never stingy about food, but she is very careful when it comes to buying new clothes and toys.
媽媽在吃的方面從不吝嗇，但買新衣服和玩具時就非常謹慎。
a stormy night: On a stormy night last week, the lights went out, so we told ghost stories by candle until we fell asleep.
上星期一個暴風雨的夜晚停電了，所以我們點著蠟燭講鬼故事講到睡著。
a stormy meeting: It was a stormy meeting at school because many parents were angry about the new rule on phones.
那是學校一場激烈的會議，因為許多家長對手機的新規定很生氣。
stormy weather: Because of the stormy weather, all the boats stayed near the shore and the fishermen went home early.
因為暴風雨天氣，所有的船都停在岸邊，漁夫們也提早回家。
a straight line: Draw a straight line across the paper first, and then write your name carefully on top of it.
先在紙上畫一條直線，然後在線上面仔細地寫下你的名字。
a straight answer: I asked my brother if he broke my camera, but he would not give me a straight answer.
我問哥哥是不是弄壞了我的相機，但他不肯給我一個直接的回答。
go straight home: After the game, I was so tired that I went straight home without stopping at the store for a drink.
比賽之後我累到直接回家，連去商店買飲料都沒停留。
keep a straight face: When my little brother told the silly joke, I tried hard to keep a straight face, but I laughed anyway.
我弟弟講那個傻笑話時，我努力想板著臉，但還是笑了出來。
get sth. straight: Let me get this straight: you want to borrow my bike for the whole weekend and return it on Monday?
讓我把事情弄清楚：你想借我的腳踏車整個週末，然後星期一還？
straight hair: My sister has long straight hair, but she wants to cut it short before her birthday party next week.
我姊姊有一頭長直髮，但她想在下週生日派對前把它剪短。
straight ahead: Walk straight ahead for two blocks, and you will see the post office on your left next to a bank.
直直往前走兩個街區，你就會看到郵局在你左手邊，銀行的旁邊。
three days straight: It rained for three days straight last week, so we could not have our PE class on the playground.
上星期連續下了三天雨，所以我們不能在操場上體育課。
set the record straight: Many students thought I cheated on the test, so I asked the teacher to help me set the record straight.
很多同學以為我考試作弊，所以我請老師幫我澄清事實。
straight A's: Linda got straight A's this year, and her parents are taking her to Japan to celebrate during summer vacation.
琳達今年拿到全優成績，她爸媽暑假要帶她去日本慶祝。
think straight: I could not think straight during the test because the students in the next room were singing loudly.
考試時我無法清楚思考，因為隔壁教室的學生在大聲唱歌。
straight 直的／直接地（形容詞與副詞同形）: Go straight down this road for five minutes, and you will find the straight path to the beach.
沿著這條路直走五分鐘，你就會找到通往海灘的直路。
strait 海峽（名詞）: The Taiwan Strait is between Taiwan and China, and our teacher said it is not the same word as straight.
台灣海峽在台灣和中國之間，老師說它和「直的」不是同一個字。
directly 直接地: After school, please go directly to the dentist, and do not go straight to the park with your friends.
放學後請直接去牙醫那裡，不要跟朋友直接跑去公園。
a strange feeling: I had a strange feeling that someone was following me home, so I walked faster and called my mom.
我有一種奇怪的感覺，好像有人跟著我回家，所以我走快一點並打電話給媽媽。
a strange place: It was hard to sleep in a strange place on the first night, but soon I got used to the new room.
第一晚在陌生的地方很難入睡，但很快我就習慣了新房間。
strange to say: Strange to say, the little cat was afraid of the mouse and ran away as soon as it saw it.
說來奇怪，那隻小貓怕老鼠，一看到老鼠就跑掉了。
feel strange: I feel strange wearing my new glasses, because everything looks bigger and the ground seems closer to my feet.
戴新眼鏡讓我感覺怪怪的，因為每樣東西看起來都變大，地面也似乎離我的腳更近。
a strange thing: A strange thing happened this morning: my dog brought me a shoe that does not belong to anyone in our family.
今天早上發生了一件怪事：我的狗帶給我一隻不屬於我們家任何人的鞋。
It's strange that: It's strange that Jenny did not come to school today, because she never misses a day even when she is sick.
奇怪的是珍妮今天沒來上學，因為她就算生病也從不缺席。
strange noises: Last night we heard strange noises in the kitchen, but it was only the cat playing with a paper bag.
昨晚我們聽到廚房裡有奇怪的聲音，但那只是貓在玩紙袋。
strange 奇怪的／陌生的: A strange man was standing outside the school gate for an hour, so the guard went over to ask him questions.
一個陌生的男人在校門外站了一個小時，所以警衛走過去問他問題。
a stranger 陌生人（名詞）: Mom told me never to talk to a stranger on the street, even if the person seems friendly and offers candy.
媽媽告訴我絕對不要在街上和陌生人說話，即使那個人看起來很友善還給糖果。
strangely 奇怪地（副詞）: Strangely enough, the strange old key we found in the garden opened the small box in Grandma's room.
奇怪的是，我們在花園找到的那把奇怪的舊鑰匙，竟然打開了奶奶房間裡的小盒子。
foreign 外國的: Living in a foreign country felt strange at first, but after a few months I made friends and enjoyed the food.
住在外國一開始感覺很奇怪，但幾個月後我交了朋友，也喜歡上那裡的食物。
strong coffee: My dad drinks a cup of strong coffee every morning because it helps him wake up before his long drive to work.
我爸爸每天早上喝一杯濃咖啡，因為這能幫他在長途開車上班前清醒過來。
a strong wind: A strong wind blew my hat into the river while we were having a picnic by the water.
我們在水邊野餐時，一陣強風把我的帽子吹進河裡。
a strong smell: There was a strong smell of fish in the kitchen, so Mom opened all the windows before dinner.
廚房裡有一股強烈的魚腥味，所以媽媽在晚餐前把所有窗戶都打開。
a strong point: Speaking in front of people is my strong point, so the teacher asked me to give the class report.
在人群面前說話是我的強項，所以老師請我做班級報告。
a strong will: Grandpa has a strong will; even after he got sick, he still walks around the park every single morning.
爺爺有堅強的意志，即使生病之後，他每天早上還是在公園裡散步。
strong feelings: Many people have strong feelings about the new park, so the city will hold a meeting to listen to them.
很多人對新公園有強烈的感受，所以市政府將舉辦會議聽取他們的意見。
a strong reason: Jack had a strong reason for missing class; his little sister fell down and he had to take her to the hospital.
傑克缺課有一個很有力的理由：他妹妹跌倒了，他必須帶她去醫院。
be strong in math: Amy is strong in math, so she often helps her friends with difficult problems before the test.
艾美數學很強，所以她常常在考試前幫朋友解難題。
be still going strong: My grandfather and grandmother got married fifty years ago, and their love is still going strong today.
我的爺爺和奶奶五十年前結婚，他們的愛至今依然強勁。
a strong team: Our school has a strong team this year, and we hope they will win the city basketball game next month.
我們學校今年有一支強隊，我們希望他們下個月能贏得市籃球賽。
strong tea: Grandma likes strong tea in the afternoon, but I always add a lot of milk and sugar to mine.
奶奶下午喜歡喝濃茶，但我總是在我的茶裡加很多牛奶和糖。
a strong voice: The new teacher has a strong voice, so even the students in the back row can hear her clearly.
新老師的聲音很有力，所以連後排的學生都能聽得很清楚。
be strong at sports: Mike is strong at sports, especially swimming and running, but he says music class is hard for him.
麥克運動很強，特別是游泳和跑步，但他說音樂課對他來說很難。
be strong in English: Sandy is strong in English because she watches movies without Chinese and reads English stories before bed.
珊迪英文很強，因為她看沒有中文字幕的電影，睡前還讀英文故事。
be strong enough to lift: My brother is strong enough to lift the heavy table by himself, so we did not ask the neighbors for help.
我哥哥夠強壯，能自己舉起那張重桌子，所以我們沒有請鄰居幫忙。
a strong hold on: The little girl kept a strong hold on her mother's hand because the night market was crowded and noisy.
小女孩緊緊抓住媽媽的手，因為夜市又擠又吵。
strong 強壯的／強烈的（形容詞）: The strong man at the show lifted a heavy car with his hands, and all the children shouted with surprise.
表演中的壯漢用雙手舉起一輛重車，所有的小孩都驚訝地大叫。
strongly 強烈地（副詞）: I strongly agree that we should start school later, because a strong body needs enough sleep every night.
我強烈同意應該晚一點上學，因為強壯的身體每晚都需要足夠的睡眠。
strength 力量（名詞）: After a month of rest, the runner was back at full strength and felt strong enough to join the race again.
休息一個月後，那位跑者恢復了全部的力量，覺得夠強壯可以再參加比賽。
a stupid mistake: I made a stupid mistake on the math test; I wrote the right answer in the wrong box and lost ten points.
我在數學考試上犯了一個愚蠢的錯誤：把正確答案寫在錯的格子裡，丟了十分。
a stupid question: Do not be afraid to ask a stupid question in class, because the teacher said that is how we learn.
不要怕在課堂上問蠢問題，因為老師說這就是我們學習的方法。
be stupid enough to: My cousin was stupid enough to swim in the river during the typhoon, and the police had to save him.
我表哥蠢到在颱風天去河裡游泳，結果警察必須去救他。
How stupid of me!: How stupid of me! I left my homework on the kitchen table, and now the teacher thinks I did not do it.
我真笨！我把功課忘在廚房桌上，現在老師以為我沒寫。
look stupid: I did not want to look stupid in front of my friends, so I acted as if I knew the answer.
我不想在朋友面前看起來很傻，所以我表現得好像知道答案。
stupid me: Stupid me, I took the wrong bus this morning and arrived at school thirty minutes late in the rain.
我真傻，今天早上搭錯公車，淋著雨晚了三十分鐘才到學校。
be successful in business: My aunt is successful in business because she works hard, listens to her customers, and always keeps her word.
我阿姨在生意上很成功，因為她努力工作、傾聽顧客，而且總是守信用。
a successful man: Mr. Lin is a successful man now, but he used to sell fruit on the street when he was young.
林先生現在是個成功的人，但他年輕時曾在街上賣水果。
a successful party: It was a successful party; everyone danced, the food was great, and nobody wanted to go home before midnight.
那是一場成功的派對，大家都跳舞，食物很棒，而且午夜前沒有人想回家。
be successful at: My sister was successful at getting into her dream school, so my parents took us all out for a big dinner.
我姊姊成功進入了她夢想中的學校，所以爸媽帶我們全家出去吃大餐。
a successful year: It was a successful year for our team; we won twelve games and lost only two in the whole season.
對我們球隊來說這是成功的一年：整個賽季我們贏了十二場，只輸了兩場。
successful 成功的（形容詞）: Everyone says my uncle is a successful man, but he tells us that his family is more important than money.
大家都說我叔叔是個成功的人，但他告訴我們，家人比金錢更重要。
success 成功（名詞）: The school fair was a big success, and our class was successful in selling all the cookies before noon.
學校園遊會非常成功，我們班也成功地在中午前賣完所有的餅乾。
succeed 成功（動詞）: If you want to succeed in English, read a little every day, and you will be successful sooner than you think.
如果你想在英文上成功，每天讀一點，你會比自己想的更早成功。
successfully 成功地（副詞）: Our class finished the big project successfully, and the teacher said it was the most successful one she had seen.
我們班成功地完成了大型專題，老師說這是她看過最成功的一個。
such as: I love sports, such as swimming, hiking, and riding my bike along the river on sunny weekends.
我喜愛運動，例如游泳、健行，以及在晴朗的週末沿著河騎腳踏車。
such a nice day: It is such a nice day today, so let's take the dog to the park and have lunch under the trees.
今天是這麼好的一天，我們帶狗去公園，在樹下吃午餐吧。
such… that: It was such a hot afternoon that we bought three bottles of cold water and finished them in ten minutes.
那個下午如此炎熱，以至於我們買了三瓶冰水，十分鐘內就喝完了。
no such thing: My brother says there is no such thing as ghosts, but he still sleeps with the light on every night.
我哥哥說沒有鬼這種事，但他每晚還是開著燈睡覺。
and such: At the night market, you can buy snacks, drinks, toys, and such, and most of them cost less than fifty dollars.
在夜市你可以買到點心、飲料、玩具等等，大部分都不到五十元。
as such: The money itself is not important as such; what I really want is for my hard work to be seen.
金錢本身就其本身而言並不重要，我真正想要的是我的努力被看見。
in such a way: The teacher explained the lesson in such a way that even the weakest students understood it right away.
老師用這種方式講解課程，連最弱的學生都馬上就懂了。
such a long time: I have not seen my best friend from my old school for such a long time, so I called her last night.
我已經這麼久沒見到以前學校最好的朋友了，所以昨晚打電話給她。
such + 名詞: Tom is such a good boy that he helps his grandmother carry the heavy bags home from the market every Sunday.
湯姆是這麼好的一個男孩，他每個星期天都幫奶奶把重重的袋子從市場提回家。
so + 形容詞／副詞: This soup is so good that I asked Mom for a second bowl, and I have never seen such a happy cook.
這湯太好喝了，我向媽媽要了第二碗，而我從沒見過這麼開心的廚師。
such a lot of: There was such a lot of homework this weekend that I could not go to the movies with my friends.
這個週末功課非常多，所以我沒辦法跟朋友去看電影。
so many / so much: There were so many people and so much noise at the show, and I had never seen such a big crowd before.
表演現場有這麼多人和這麼大的噪音，我以前從沒見過這麼大的人群。
all of a sudden: We were having a picnic in the park when, all of a sudden, it started to rain and we ran away.
我們正在公園野餐，突然開始下雨，我們就跑開了。
a sudden change: There was a sudden change in the weather this afternoon, so many students got wet on the way home.
今天下午天氣突然改變，所以很多學生在回家路上淋濕了。
a sudden stop: The bus came to a sudden stop at the corner, and the old lady almost fell down in the middle of it.
公車在轉角突然停下，老太太差點在車子中間跌倒。
a sudden death: The game ended in sudden death, and our team won when Mike scored the first goal in extra time.
比賽進入驟死賽，麥克在延長賽先進了一球，我們隊就贏了。
a sudden storm: A sudden storm hit the beach in the afternoon, so everyone picked up their things and ran to the restaurant nearby.
下午一場突來的暴風雨襲擊海灘，所以大家收拾東西跑到附近的餐廳。
a sunny day: On a sunny day like this, my family likes to ride bikes along the river and then eat ice cream.
像這樣的晴天，我們家喜歡沿著河騎腳踏車，然後吃冰淇淋。
a sunny smile: The new teacher greeted every student with a sunny smile, so even the shy kids felt comfortable on the first day.
新老師用燦爛的笑容迎接每一個學生，所以連害羞的孩子第一天也覺得很自在。
a sunny personality: Everyone likes Amy because of her sunny personality; she is always laughing and never says a bad word about anyone.
大家都喜歡艾美開朗的個性，她總是笑著，從不說別人的壞話。
the sunny side: When I failed the test, my grandmother told me to look on the sunny side and try harder next time.
我考試不及格時，奶奶告訴我要看樂觀的一面，下次再努力一點。
super busy: My mother is super busy this week because she has three meetings every day and a big report to finish.
我媽媽這星期超級忙，因為她每天有三場會議，還有一份大報告要完成。
a super idea: Having a class picnic on the beach is a super idea, and I am sure everyone will want to join.
在海灘辦班級野餐是個超棒的點子，我相信每個人都會想參加。
super cheap: The T-shirts at the night market were super cheap, so I bought five of them for less than three hundred dollars.
夜市的T恤超便宜，所以我用不到三百元買了五件。
a superstar: The young singer became a superstar after her first song, and now fans wait outside her hotel every day.
那位年輕歌手第一首歌之後就成了超級明星，現在粉絲每天都在她的飯店外面等。
a supermarket: Mom asked me to go to the supermarket after school to buy eggs, milk, and some fruit for breakfast.
媽媽叫我放學後去超市買雞蛋、牛奶和一些早餐要吃的水果。
a superman: My little brother thinks our father is a superman because he can fix the computer, cook dinner, and carry him upstairs.
我弟弟覺得爸爸是超人，因為他會修電腦、煮晚餐，還能抱他上樓。
be sure of success: Our coach is sure of success in the final game because the team has practiced hard every day for two months.
我們的教練確信決賽會成功，因為球隊兩個月來每天都努力練習。
be sure about: Are you sure about the time of the party, because the card I got says it starts at six, not seven?
你對派對的時間確定嗎？因為我收到的卡片上寫六點開始，不是七點。
be sure to lock the door: Be sure to lock the door before you leave the house, because last week someone stole a bike from our neighbor.
離開家之前一定要鎖門，因為上星期有人偷了我們鄰居的腳踏車。
make sure: Before the test begins, please make sure your name is on the paper and your phone is turned off.
考試開始前，請確認你的名字寫在考卷上，手機也關掉了。
for sure: I do not know who will win the game tomorrow, but one thing is for sure, our team will try hard.
我不知道明天誰會贏得比賽，但有一件事可以確定，我們隊會努力拚。
Sure thing!: When my mother asked me to help her carry the heavy bags from the store, I smiled and said, Sure thing!
當媽媽請我幫她把沉重的袋子從店裡搬回來時，我笑著說：當然！
Are you sure?: Are you sure the English test is on Friday, because Mr. Lin told us it would be on Thursday?
你確定英文考試是星期五嗎？因為林老師告訴我們是星期四。
When my little sister asked me where Dad put the car keys, I had to tell her, I'm not sure.
當我妹妹問我爸爸把車鑰匙放在哪裡時，我只能告訴她：我不確定。
sure enough: Grandma said it would rain in the afternoon, and sure enough, big drops began to fall at three o'clock.
奶奶說下午會下雨，果然，三點的時候大雨滴就開始落下來了。
be sure of oneself: Amy is very sure of herself when she speaks in front of the class, so everyone listens to her carefully.
艾美在全班面前說話時很有自信，所以大家都仔細聽她講。
Sure, why not?: When Tom asked me if I wanted to go to the night market with him after school, I said, Sure, why not?
當湯姆問我放學後要不要跟他一起去夜市時，我說：好啊，為什麼不？
sure 確定的（形容詞）: I'm sure I left my umbrella in the room this morning, because I remember putting it under my desk before class.
我確定我今天早上把雨傘留在教室裡了，因為我記得上課前把它放在桌子下面。
surely 肯定地（副詞）: Surely you are not going to wear those dirty old shoes to your cousin's wedding party tonight?
你肯定不會穿那雙又髒又舊的鞋子去你表哥今晚的婚禮派對吧？
certain 確定的（較正式）: I am not just sure but certain that the medicine will help, because the doctor told my father so last night.
我不只是確定，而是確信這個藥會有幫助，因為醫生昨晚這麼告訴我爸爸。
sure 好的（口語回答）: When the new student asked if she could sit next to me in the library, I looked up and said, Sure!
當新同學問她可不可以在圖書館坐在我旁邊時，我抬起頭說：好的！
be surprised at the news: Everyone in our class was surprised at the news that Miss Wang was going to move to another city next month.
我們全班聽到王老師下個月要搬到另一個城市的消息都感到驚訝。
be surprised to see: My grandfather was surprised to see so many people waiting outside the new shopping center early on Sunday morning.
我爺爺很驚訝看到星期天一大早有這麼多人在新購物中心外面等著。
a surprised look: When I told my brother that I had finished all my homework before dinner, he gave me a surprised look.
當我告訴哥哥我在晚餐前就做完所有功課時，他露出了驚訝的表情。
be surprised by: The cat was surprised by the loud sound of the door, and it ran quickly under the kitchen table to hide.
那隻貓被門的巨響嚇到，很快地跑到廚房桌子底下躲起來。
be surprised that: My parents were surprised that I woke up early on Saturday and made my bed without being asked to.
我爸媽很驚訝我星期六早起，而且沒有人要求就把床鋪好。
surprised 人感到驚訝: I'm surprised you remembered my birthday, because we have not talked to each other since last summer vacation.
我很驚訝你記得我的生日，因為我們從去年暑假以後就沒有聯絡過了。
surprising 事物令人驚訝: The surprising news about the school trip to Japan made all the students in the hall shout with joy.
關於去日本校外旅行這個令人驚訝的消息，讓禮堂裡所有學生開心地大叫。
a surprise 驚喜（名詞）: What a surprise it was to find my old friend from my first school working at the bookstore near my house!
在我家附近的書店發現我以前學校的老朋友在那裡工作，真是個驚喜！
surprise 使驚訝（動詞）: My friends wanted to surprise me on my birthday, so they hid in the dark living room and waited quietly.
我的朋友們想在我生日那天給我驚喜，所以他們躲在黑暗的客廳裡安靜地等著。
a sweet dream: After the long and busy school day, Lisa fell asleep quickly and had a sweet dream about the beach.
在漫長又忙碌的上學日之後，麗莎很快就睡著了，做了一個關於海灘的美夢。
Sweet dreams!: Mom turned off the light in my bedroom, kissed me on the head, and said in a quiet voice, Sweet dreams!
媽媽關掉我房間的燈，在我頭上親了一下，然後用輕柔的聲音說：祝你好夢！
have a sweet tooth: My little brother has a sweet tooth, so he always asks for cake and ice cream after dinner every night.
我弟弟愛吃甜食，所以他每天晚餐後總是要吃蛋糕和冰淇淋。
a sweet smile: The new teacher has a sweet smile, and all the students in our class liked her from the first day.
新老師有甜美的笑容，我們班所有學生從第一天就喜歡她。
sweet talk: Do not believe his sweet talk about buying you a new bike, because he says that every year and never does it.
不要相信他說要買新腳踏車給你的甜言蜜語，因為他每年都這麼說卻從來沒做到。
a sweet voice: My aunt has a sweet voice, and when she sings at family parties, everyone stops talking to listen to her.
我阿姨有甜美的聲音，當她在家庭聚會唱歌時，大家都停下來聽她唱。
How sweet of you!: You brought me hot soup when I was sick in bed with a cold, so I told you, How sweet of you!
我感冒躺在床上時你帶熱湯來給我，所以我對你說：你真貼心！
sweet home: After two weeks of traveling in another country, there is nothing better than coming back to our sweet home.
在國外旅行兩個星期之後，沒有什麼比回到我們甜蜜的家更好的了。
a sweet smell: When I walked into the kitchen, there was a sweet smell of fresh bread, and I knew Grandma was baking.
當我走進廚房時，有一股新鮮麵包的香味，我就知道奶奶在烤東西。
sweets: My grandmother always keeps a small box of sweets in her bag for the children when we visit her house.
我奶奶總是在包包裡放一小盒糖果，我們去她家時給小孩子吃。
a talkative boy: Jack is a talkative boy who never stops asking questions, so his teacher often asks him to be quiet.
傑克是個愛講話的男孩，從不停止問問題，所以他的老師常常要他安靜。
be talkative in class: The teacher moved Peter to the front seat because he was too talkative in class and could not pay attention.
老師把彼得換到前面的座位，因為他上課太愛講話，無法專心。
get talkative: My uncle is usually quiet, but after a cup of coffee he gets talkative and tells us funny stories about his job.
我叔叔平常很安靜，但喝了一杯咖啡後就變得多話，跟我們講他工作上的趣事。
a tall building: From the top of the tall building in Taipei, we could see the whole city and the mountains far away.
從台北那座高樓的頂端，我們可以看到整個城市和遠處的山。
a tall tree: There is a tall tree in front of our school, and the birds like to build their nests in it every spring.
我們學校前面有一棵高大的樹，每年春天鳥兒都喜歡在上面築巢。
a tall order: Finishing the whole science report in one night is a tall order, but we have no other choice now.
在一個晚上完成整份科學報告是個難以完成的任務，但我們現在沒有別的選擇。
six feet tall: My basketball coach is six feet tall, so he can easily reach the top of the board in the gym.
我的籃球教練有六呎高，所以他可以輕易碰到體育館裡籃板的頂端。
stand tall: Even after losing the final game, the players walked off the field and stood tall in front of their fans.
即使輸了決賽，球員們走下球場，仍在球迷面前昂首挺立。
How tall are you?: How tall are you now, because you look much bigger than when I saw you last summer at the park?
你現在多高？因為你看起來比去年夏天我在公園見到你時高大很多。
tall 高（人、樹、建築）: David is the tallest boy in our class, so he always stands in the back row when we take photos.
大衛是我們班最高的男生，所以我們拍照時他總是站在最後一排。
high 高（山、牆、價錢）: A tall tree grows beside the high wall around the old house, so nobody can see the garden from the street.
那棟老房子四周的高牆旁長著一棵高大的樹，所以沒有人能從街上看到花園。
height 高度（名詞）: The nurse checked my height and weight at the school health center, and I was five centimeters taller than last year.
護士在學校健康中心檢查了我的高度和體重，我比去年高了五公分。
a terrible mistake: Forgetting to bring my ID card to the big test was a terrible mistake, and I could not go into the room.
忘了帶身分證去大考是個嚴重的錯誤，我因此無法進入考場。
terrible weather: Because of the terrible weather this morning, the school sports day was put off until next Wednesday afternoon.
由於今天早上糟透的天氣，學校運動會延到下星期三下午舉行。
feel terrible: I felt terrible after I shouted at my little sister, so I said sorry and bought her an ice cream.
我對妹妹大吼之後感覺很糟，所以我向她道歉並買了冰淇淋給她。
a terrible day: Yesterday was a terrible day for me because I missed the bus, lost my wallet, and failed the math test.
昨天對我來說是糟糕的一天，因為我錯過公車、丟了皮夾，還考砸了數學。
be terrible at: I am terrible at drawing, so my pictures of animals always look like strange rocks or clouds in the sky.
我非常不擅長畫畫，所以我畫的動物總是看起來像奇怪的石頭或天上的雲。
look terrible: You look terrible this morning, did you stay up all night playing computer games again with your friends?
你今天早上看起來很糟，你又跟朋友熬夜玩了一整晚的電腦遊戲嗎？
a terrible accident: There was a terrible accident on the highway last night, and many cars had to wait for hours in the rain.
昨晚高速公路上發生了一起可怕的意外，許多車子不得不在雨中等了好幾個小時。
a terrible cold: Mary has a terrible cold, so she stayed home from school today and drank a lot of warm water.
瑪麗得了重感冒，所以她今天沒去上學待在家裡，喝了很多溫開水。
terrible 糟糕的／可怕的: It was a terrible day at the beach because it rained all afternoon and we could not swim at all.
那天在海邊真是糟糕的一天，因為整個下午都在下雨，我們完全不能游泳。
terrific 極好的（口語）: Having a picnic by the river this Sunday is a terrific idea, and I will bring sandwiches and fruit for everyone.
這個星期天去河邊野餐是個極好的點子，我會帶三明治和水果給大家。
terribly 非常地（副詞）: I am terribly sorry for being late to your birthday party, because the bus did not come for forty minutes.
我非常抱歉來參加你的生日派對遲到了，因為公車四十分鐘都沒來。
a terrific idea: Making a short movie about our school for the class party is a terrific idea, so let us start writing the story tonight.
為班級派對拍一部關於我們學校的短片是個超棒的點子，所以我們今晚就開始寫故事吧。
look terrific: You look terrific in that new blue dress, and I think everyone at the dance tonight will want to talk to you.
你穿那件新的藍色洋裝看起來很棒，我想今晚舞會上的每個人都會想跟你說話。
a terrific game: It was a terrific game last night, because both teams played hard and the score was tied until the last minute.
昨晚是一場精采的比賽，因為兩隊都很拚，比數一直到最後一分鐘都還是平手。
Terrific!: When I told my dad that I got the highest grade in the math test, he shouted, Terrific, let us eat out tonight!
當我告訴爸爸我數學考試拿到最高分時，他大喊：太棒了，我們今晚出去吃飯吧！
have a terrific time: We had a terrific time at the beach last weekend, swimming in the sea, playing ball, and eating fresh fish.
上個週末我們在海邊玩得很開心，在海裡游泳、玩球，還吃了新鮮的魚。
at a terrific speed: The train to Kaohsiung moved at a terrific speed, so the trees and houses outside the window looked like green and gray lines.
往高雄的火車以驚人的速度行駛，所以窗外的樹和房子看起來像綠色和灰色的線條。
their 他們的（形容詞）: The Lin family just moved here from Tainan, and their house is the white one next to the park on our street.
林家剛從台南搬來這裡，他們的房子是我們這條街上公園旁邊那棟白色的。
theirs 他們的東西: That big red car in front of the store is theirs, because I saw Mr. and Mrs. Chen get out of it this morning.
店前面那輛紅色大車是他們的，因為我今天早上看到陳先生和陳太太從車上下來。
there 那裡: Their new school is over there, behind the post office, so the two brothers only need to walk for five minutes.
他們的新學校就在那裡，郵局後面，所以兩兄弟只需要走五分鐘。
they're: My cousins said they're coming at noon with their dog, and now they're here, waiting at the door with a big box.
我的表兄弟說他們中午會帶他們的狗來，現在他們到了，正帶著一個大箱子在門口等。
themselves 他們自己: The kids finished the whole science project by themselves, and their parents did not help them even once.
孩子們靠他們自己完成了整個科學作業，他們的父母連一次也沒幫忙。
a thick book: The library gave me a thick book about the history of Taiwan, and it will take me a month to finish reading it.
圖書館借給我一本關於台灣歷史的厚厚的書，我要花一個月才能看完。
thick fog: There was thick fog on the mountain road this morning, so my father drove very slowly with the lights on.
今天早上山路上有濃霧，所以我爸爸開著車燈非常慢地開車。
thick hair: My little sister has thick black hair, and it takes my mother twenty minutes to wash and dry it every night.
我妹妹有一頭濃密的黑髮，媽媽每天晚上要花二十分鐘幫她洗頭和吹乾。
thick soup: On cold winter nights, Grandpa likes to make thick soup with corn and chicken, and we all eat two bowls.
在寒冷的冬夜，爺爺喜歡用玉米和雞肉煮濃湯，我們每個人都會吃兩碗。
through thick and thin: Ann and Kelly have been best friends through thick and thin since they were little girls in the same kindergarten.
安和凱莉從在同一間幼稚園的小女孩時期開始，就是同甘共苦的好朋友。
a thick skin: You need a thick skin to be a good basketball player, because people will shout at you when you miss a shot.
要當一個好的籃球員，你需要臉皮厚一點，因為當你投不進時別人會對你大叫。
thick clouds: Thick clouds covered the sky all afternoon, so we could not see the sun or take any nice photos at the lake.
厚厚的雲整個下午都遮住天空，所以我們在湖邊看不到太陽，也拍不到好看的照片。
be thick with: The air in the small kitchen was thick with smoke after my brother tried to cook fish for the first time.
我哥哥第一次試著煮魚之後，小廚房裡的空氣充滿了煙。
thick 厚的／濃的（物）: Put on a thick coat before you go out, because the weather report says it will be very cold and windy tonight.
出門前穿上厚外套，因為氣象報告說今晚會非常冷又颳風。
fat 胖的（人）: The fat man in the funny movie wore a thick winter coat in summer, and everyone in the theater laughed loudly.
那部搞笑電影裡的胖男人在夏天穿著厚厚的冬季外套，戲院裡的每個人都大笑起來。
thin 薄的／稀的: Thin paper is not good for painting with water, so the art teacher gave us some thick paper to use instead.
薄紙不適合用水彩畫畫，所以美術老師給了我們一些厚紙來代替。
thickness 厚度（名詞）: The teacher asked us to measure the thickness of the ice on the pond, and it was only about two centimeters.
老師要我們量池塘上冰的厚度，結果只有大約兩公分。
thin ice: Do not walk on the thin ice near the middle of the lake, because it may break and you could fall into the cold water.
不要走在湖中央附近的薄冰上，因為它可能會裂開，你會掉進冰冷的水裡。
thin air: In the thin air at the top of the high mountain, we got tired very fast, so we rested often and walked slowly.
在高山頂上稀薄的空氣中，我們很快就累了，所以我們常常休息，慢慢地走。
thin soup: When I had a stomachache, my mother gave me only thin soup and rice, and I felt better the next morning.
我肚子痛的時候，媽媽只給我喝清湯和吃飯，第二天早上我就覺得好多了。
a thin voice: The lost little girl spoke in a thin voice and asked the police officer to help her find her mother in the market.
那個走失的小女孩用細小的聲音說話，請警察幫她在市場裡找媽媽。
thin hair: My grandfather has thin gray hair now, but in his old photos he had a lot of thick black hair like my father.
我爺爺現在頭髮稀疏又灰白，但在他的舊照片裡，他有一頭像我爸爸一樣濃密的黑髮。
wear thin: Mom's smile began to wear thin after my little brother asked her the same question again and again at dinner.
在晚餐時我弟弟一再問媽媽同一個問題之後，她的笑容開始逐漸消失。
be thin on the ground: Good cheap restaurants are thin on the ground in this part of the city, so we often cook dinner at home.
在城市的這一區，便宜又好的餐廳很稀少，所以我們常常在家煮晚餐。
a thin excuse: He said his dog ate his homework, but the teacher knew that was just a thin excuse because he does not have a dog.
他說他的狗把功課吃掉了，但老師知道那只是個站不住腳的藉口，因為他根本沒有狗。
disappear into thin air: I put my phone on the table a minute ago, but now it seems to have disappeared into thin air, and nobody saw it.
我一分鐘前才把手機放在桌上，但現在它好像消失得無影無蹤，而且沒有人看到它。
thin 瘦的／薄的（中性）: The thin man who sells vegetables at the corner is very kind, and he always gives my mother an extra apple.
在轉角賣菜的那個瘦男人很親切，他總是多給我媽媽一顆蘋果。
thick 厚的: A thick book is heavy to carry to school every day, so I bought a thin notebook and copy down only the important parts.
每天帶一本厚厚的書去學校很重，所以我買了一本薄筆記本，只抄下重要的部分。
the third floor: Our English class is on the third floor, so we have to walk up many stairs every morning with our heavy school bags.
我們的英文教室在三樓，所以我們每天早上都要背著沉重的書包爬很多樓梯。
a third of: About a third of the students in our class ride bikes to school, and the others take the bus or walk.
我們班大約三分之一的學生騎腳踏車上學，其他人搭公車或走路。
the Third World: In class, our teacher showed us photos of children in the Third World who have to walk for hours to get clean water.
在課堂上，老師給我們看第三世界的孩子要走好幾個小時才能取得乾淨水的照片。
third-hand: This old bike is third-hand, because my uncle bought it from a friend who had already got it from his brother.
這輛舊腳踏車是第三手的，因為我叔叔是從一個朋友那裡買來的，而那個朋友又是從他哥哥那裡拿到的。
a third party: When two players could not agree about the rules of the game, they asked the teacher to be a third party and decide.
兩個球員對比賽規則意見不同時，他們請老師當第三方來做決定。
be third in line: I was third in line at the new ice cream shop, so I waited only ten minutes before I got my ice cream.
我在新開的冰淇淋店排第三，所以只等了十分鐘就拿到冰淇淋了。
be thirsty for knowledge: Mr. Huang is always thirsty for knowledge, and even at seventy he reads three books about history every month.
黃先生總是渴求知識，即使七十歲了，他每個月還是看三本關於歷史的書。
feel thirsty: After running around the school playground five times under the hot sun, we all felt thirsty and ran to the water machine.
在大太陽下繞著學校操場跑了五圈之後，我們全都覺得口渴，跑向飲水機。
thirsty work: Moving boxes up to the top floor on a summer afternoon is thirsty work, so bring a big bottle of water with you.
在夏天的下午把箱子搬到頂樓是讓人口渴的工作，所以帶一大瓶水來吧。
be thirsty for success: My sister is thirsty for success, so she practices the piano for two hours every day, even on her birthday.
我姊姊渴望成功，所以她每天練兩個小時的鋼琴，連生日那天也不例外。
thirsty 口渴的（形容詞）: The little boy felt thirsty after playing soccer, so he drank a whole bottle of water in less than one minute.
小男孩踢完足球後覺得口渴，所以不到一分鐘就喝完了整瓶水。
thirst 口渴（名詞）: Without any water in the hot desert, a person could die of thirst in only two or three days, the teacher said.
老師說，在炎熱的沙漠裡如果沒有水，一個人只要兩三天就可能渴死。
be thirsty for 渴望: Young students who are thirsty for knowledge often ask many questions and stay in the library after school.
渴求知識的年輕學生常常問很多問題，而且放學後還留在圖書館。
hungry 飢餓的: After the long hike, I was hungry for a big bowl of beef noodle soup, and Lisa was thirsty for cold juice.
長途健行之後，我渴望吃一大碗牛肉麵，而麗莎則渴望喝冰涼的果汁。
a tidy room: Grandma always says that a tidy room makes a clear mind, so she asks me to make my bed every morning before breakfast.
奶奶總是說整潔的房間讓頭腦清楚，所以她要我每天早上早餐前先鋪床。
keep the room tidy: My mother told me I could have a dog only if I keep my room tidy for a whole month without being reminded.
媽媽告訴我，只有在不用提醒的情況下保持房間整潔一整個月，我才可以養狗。
tidy up: We have to tidy up the living room before our guests arrive at six, so please put the toys back in the box.
我們必須在客人六點到之前把客廳收拾整齊，所以請把玩具放回箱子裡。
a tiny baby: My aunt came home from the hospital with a tiny baby, and his hands were so small that I was afraid to touch them.
我阿姨帶著一個小小的嬰兒從醫院回家，他的手小得我不敢去碰。
a tiny house: My grandmother and grandfather live in a tiny house by the sea with only two rooms, but it is the happiest place I know.
我的奶奶和爺爺住在海邊一間只有兩個房間的小小的房子裡，但那是我所知道最快樂的地方。
a tiny voice: The shy new student answered the teacher's question in a tiny voice, and nobody in the back row could hear her.
那位害羞的新同學用細小的聲音回答老師的問題，後排沒有人聽得到她說什麼。
tiny little: Look at this tiny little bird on the window, it is smaller than my hand and it is eating the rice I left there.
看看窗台上這隻小小的鳥，它比我的手還小，正在吃我留在那裡的米。
be tired of homework: I am tired of homework every night, so this weekend I want to go to the mountains and forget about school.
我每天晚上都厭倦功課，所以這個週末我想去山上，把學校的事忘掉。
be tired from work: My father was tired from work when he got home at nine, but he still helped me with my science homework.
我爸爸九點回到家時因工作而疲累，但他還是幫我做自然科學的功課。
be tired out: After we washed two cars and cut the grass in the hot sun, my brother and I were tired out and fell asleep on the sofa.
在大太陽下洗了兩輛車又割了草之後，我和哥哥累壞了，倒在沙發上睡著了。
get tired: Old people get tired more easily than young people, so Grandpa always takes a short rest after lunch every day.
老人比年輕人更容易變累，所以爺爺每天午餐後總是會休息一下。
a tired face: When Mom came home from working all night at the hospital, she had a tired face, so I made her a cup of hot tea.
媽媽在醫院工作了整晚回家時，臉上滿是疲憊，所以我泡了一杯熱茶給她。
too tired to move: After the long bike ride to the beach and back, I was too tired to move and just lay on my bed for an hour.
騎腳踏車到海邊再騎回來之後，我累得動不了，就在床上躺了一個小時。
tired 人感到累: I'm tired because I stayed up until one o'clock finishing my history report, so please let me sleep a little longer.
我很累，因為我熬夜到一點才寫完歷史報告，所以請讓我多睡一會兒。
tiring 事物令人累: It was a tiring day, and we were all tired because we walked around the museum for five hours and then waited in the rain.
那是令人疲累的一天，我們都累了，因為我們在博物館裡走了五個小時，然後又在雨中等車。
be tired of 厭倦: We were tired of waiting for the late bus, so we decided to walk home together and talk about the movie.
我們厭倦了等遲到的公車，所以決定一起走路回家，聊聊那部電影。
be tired from 因…而累: Peter was tired from running in the sports day race, so he sat under the tree and drank a lot of water.
彼得因為在運動會賽跑而累了，所以他坐在樹下喝了很多水。
tiresome 令人厭煩的: Washing all the dishes after a big family dinner is a tiresome job, but we take turns so nobody has to do it every day.
大型家庭聚餐後洗所有的碗盤是件令人厭煩的工作，但我們輪流做，所以沒有人需要每天做。
a total stranger: A total stranger helped me pick up my books when I fell on the wet street, and then he walked away without saying his name.
當我在溼滑的街上跌倒時，一個完全不認識的人幫我撿起書，然後沒說自己的名字就走了。
the total number: The teacher asked us to count the total number of students in the school, and we found there were nine hundred and ten.
老師要我們算學校學生的總數，我們發現一共有九百一十人。
in total: We spent three hundred dollars on tickets and two hundred on food, so the trip to the zoo cost five hundred dollars in total.
我們花了三百元買票和兩百元買食物，所以去動物園的這一趟總共花了五百元。
a total of ten: My class collected a total of ten boxes of old clothes for the poor families in the mountains last month.
我們班上個月總共收集了十箱舊衣服，要送給山區的貧困家庭。
total silence: When the teacher walked into the noisy room, there was total silence, and every student sat down quickly.
當老師走進吵鬧的教室時，一片完全的寂靜，每個學生都很快地坐了下來。
total up: Please total up how much we spent at the night market tonight, because I want to know if we still have money for the bus.
請把我們今晚在夜市花的錢加總一下，因為我想知道我們是不是還有錢搭公車。
total 全部的（形容詞）: The total cost of our class trip to Hualien is two thousand dollars for each student, including the train tickets and hotel.
我們班去花蓮旅行的全部費用是每個學生兩千元，包括火車票和旅館。
a total 總數（名詞）: A total of 100 people came to the school show last Friday night, and the music club sold all the tickets.
上星期五晚上總共有一百人來看學校表演，音樂社賣完了所有的票。
totally 完全地（副詞）: I totally agree with you that we should have a longer lunch break, because thirty minutes is not enough to eat and rest.
我完全同意你說我們應該有更長的午休時間，因為三十分鐘不夠吃飯和休息。
whole 整個的: It rained the whole day on Sunday, so we spent a total of six hours inside watching movies and making cookies with Mom.
星期天整天都在下雨，所以我們總共在家裡待了六個小時，跟媽媽一起看電影和做餅乾。
keep in touch: Even after Tina moved to America with her family, we still keep in touch by writing letters and sending photos every month.
即使蒂娜和家人搬到美國之後，我們仍然每個月寫信和寄照片保持聯絡。
get in touch with: If you want to join the basketball club, you should get in touch with Mr. Wu, because he is the teacher in charge.
如果你想加入籃球社，應該聯絡吳老師，因為他是負責的老師。
lose touch with: My father lost touch with his best friend from high school, but last week they found each other again on the Internet.
我爸爸和他高中最好的朋友失聯了，但上星期他們在網路上又找到了彼此。
a touch of salt: Grandma adds a touch of salt to her fruit juice, and she says it makes the sweet taste even stronger and better.
奶奶在果汁裡加一點鹽，她說這會讓甜味更濃也更好喝。
be out of touch: My uncle has lived on a small farm for twenty years, so he is out of touch with the new phones and games young people use.
我叔叔在小農場住了二十年，所以他和年輕人用的新手機及遊戲脫節了。
the final touch: The cake was almost ready, and Mom put a red strawberry on top as the final touch before the birthday party started.
蛋糕幾乎準備好了，媽媽在生日派對開始前，在蛋糕頂端放上一顆紅草莓作為最後的修飾。
touch and go: It was touch and go whether we would catch the last train, because we got to the station only one minute before it left.
我們能不能趕上最後一班火車真是千鈞一髮，因為我們在火車開走前一分鐘才到車站。
touch 碰觸（動詞）: Don't touch the pot on the stove, because the soup inside is still very hot and you may burn your fingers.
不要碰爐子上的鍋子，因為裡面的湯還很熱，你可能會燙到手指。
a touch 接觸／一點（名詞）: This fish soup needs a touch of pepper and a little more salt, and then it will taste as good as Grandma's.
這碗魚湯需要加一點胡椒和多一點鹽，然後就會和奶奶煮的一樣好喝。
touched 感動的: Everyone in the class was touched by the letter that the sick boy wrote to thank us for visiting him in the hospital.
全班都被那個生病的男孩寫來感謝我們去醫院看他的信感動了。
touching 令人感動的: The teacher read us a touching story about a dog that waited at the train station for its owner every day for ten years.
老師讀給我們聽一個令人感動的故事，講一隻狗十年來每天都在火車站等它的主人。
traditional Chinese: People in Taiwan write in traditional Chinese, so my cousin from another country finds our newspapers hard to read.
台灣人寫繁體中文，所以我從國外來的表哥覺得我們的報紙很難讀。
traditional food: On Chinese New Year, Grandma cooks traditional food like fish and dumplings, and the whole family eats together.
在農曆新年，奶奶會煮像魚和水餃這樣的傳統食物，全家人一起吃。
a traditional festival: The Dragon Boat Festival is a traditional festival in Taiwan, and people eat rice dumplings and watch boat races.
端午節是台灣的傳統節日，人們吃粽子、看划船比賽。
traditional music: My grandfather plays traditional music on an old instrument every evening, and the neighbors often come to listen.
我爺爺每天傍晚用一種古老的樂器演奏傳統音樂，鄰居常常來聽。
a traditional way: My grandmother still makes tea in a traditional way, using a small pot and hot water that she boils on the stove.
我奶奶仍然用傳統方式泡茶，用一個小壺和她在爐子上煮開的熱水。
traditional clothes: At the school culture day, students from different countries wore traditional clothes and taught us their dances.
在學校文化日，來自不同國家的學生穿著傳統服飾，教我們跳他們的舞。
a true friend: A true friend will tell you the truth even when it is hard to hear, and will stay with you when you are sad.
真正的朋友即使在你難以接受時也會告訴你真話，而且在你難過時會陪著你。
come true: My dream to see snow finally came true last winter, when my family took a trip to Japan during the holidays.
去年冬天我的家人在假期去日本旅行時，我想看雪的夢想終於實現了。
true love: My grandmother and grandfather have been married for fifty years, and Grandma says their true love grows stronger every day.
我的奶奶和爺爺結婚五十年了，奶奶說他們的真愛每天都變得更堅定。
true to life: The animals in that movie look true to life, so my little sister thought the lions were real and started to cry.
那部電影裡的動物看起來很逼真，所以我妹妹以為獅子是真的，開始哭了起來。
It's true that: It's true that Jerry is the fastest runner in our class, but he still has to practice hard for the city race.
傑瑞是我們班跑最快的人是真的，但他還是要為市賽努力練習。
be true to one's word: My father is always true to his word, so when he said we would go camping this weekend, I knew it would happen.
我爸爸總是守信，所以當他說這個週末我們要去露營時，我知道一定會成行。
hold true: What my grandmother told me about being kind to others still holds true today, even though the world has changed a lot.
我奶奶告訴我要善待他人的話在今天仍然成立，雖然世界已經改變了很多。
too good to be true: The man on the phone said I won a free trip to Japan, but it sounded too good to be true, so I hung up.
電話裡的男人說我贏得了免費的日本之旅，但這聽起來好到不像真的，所以我掛了電話。
a true story: This movie is a true story about a teacher who helped poor children in the mountains learn to read and write.
這部電影是一個真實故事，講一位老師幫助山區的貧困兒童學習讀寫。
stay true to: Even after he became famous, the singer stayed true to his family and friends and went home for dinner every weekend.
即使成名之後，那位歌手仍忠於家人和朋友，每個週末都回家吃晚餐。
true 真實的／忠實的（形容詞）: The book about the brave dog is a true story, and my teacher cried when she read the last page to the class.
這本關於勇敢小狗的書是真實故事，老師讀最後一頁給全班聽時哭了。
truly 真正地（副詞）: It is true that I wrote the letter to my teacher in America myself, and I ended it with Yours truly and my name.
我確實是自己寫信給美國的老師，我在信末寫了「您真誠的」和我的名字。
truth 真相（名詞）: Mom always tells us to tell the truth, because it is true that a small lie can turn into a big problem for everyone later.
媽媽總是告訴我們要說真話，因為一個小謊言以後可能變成大家的大問題，這是真的。
real 真的（非假的）: It is true that the ring Grandpa gave Grandma fifty years ago is made of real gold, and she still wears it every day.
爺爺五十年前送給奶奶的戒指是真金做的，這是真的，她現在仍然每天戴著。
an ugly scene: There was an ugly scene at the bus stop when two men started shouting at each other about who was first in line.
公車站發生了一個難堪的場面，兩個男人開始為了誰先排隊而互相大吼。
ugly weather: We planned to go hiking on Saturday, but the ugly weather with strong wind and heavy rain kept us all at home.
我們本來計畫星期六去健行，但是狂風暴雨的惡劣天氣讓我們全都待在家裡。
turn ugly: The friendly soccer game turned ugly when one player kicked another on purpose, and the teacher stopped the game.
當一名球員故意踢另一名球員時，這場友誼足球賽變得難看，老師便中止了比賽。
an ugly word: Tim said an ugly word to a girl in his class during the game, so the teacher asked him to stay after class and say sorry.
提姆在比賽中對班上一個女生說了一個難聽的字，所以老師要他下課後留下來道歉。
an ugly truth: The ugly truth is that we lost the game because we did not practice enough, not because the other team was lucky.
醜陋的真相是，我們輸掉比賽是因為我們練習不夠，而不是因為對方運氣好。
be unhappy with the result: Our team was unhappy with the result of the game because we lost by only one point in the last ten seconds.
我們隊對比賽結果不滿，因為我們在最後十秒只以一分之差輸了。
be unhappy about: Lily was unhappy about the new seat plan because she had to sit far away from her best friend in the class.
莉莉對新的座位表不開心，因為她必須坐得離班上最好的朋友很遠。
an unhappy ending: The movie had an unhappy ending, so my little sister cried all the way home and did not want to eat dinner.
那部電影的結局不圓滿，所以我妹妹一路哭回家，連晚餐都不想吃。
an unhappy childhood: The old man told us he had an unhappy childhood because his family was poor and he had to work instead of going to school.
那位老人告訴我們他有一個不快樂的童年，因為家裡很窮，他必須工作而不能上學。
make sb. unhappy: Please do not read your sister's diary, because it will make her unhappy and she will not trust you again.
請不要看你姊姊的日記，因為那會讓她不開心，而且她不會再信任你了。
a unique chance: Winning the English speech game gave Jenny a unique chance to visit a school in Australia for two weeks.
贏得英語演講比賽讓珍妮有個獨一無二的機會，可以去澳洲的學校參訪兩個星期。
a unique style: My art teacher has a unique style of painting, because she uses only blue and yellow and never draws straight lines.
我的美術老師有獨特的畫風，因為她只用藍色和黃色，而且從不畫直線。
be unique to Taiwan: Many foreign visitors love night markets because they are unique to Taiwan, and you cannot find them in most other countries.
