許多外國遊客喜愛夜市，因為它們是台灣獨有的，在大多數其他國家找不到。
a unique gift: For my mother's birthday, I made her a unique gift, a book of photos from every trip our family has taken.
為了媽媽的生日，我做了一份獨特的禮物給她，一本收集我們全家每次旅行照片的書。
a unique way: Our teacher has a unique way of teaching English, because we learn new words by singing and acting out short plays.
我們的老師有獨特的英語教學方式，因為我們透過唱歌和演短劇來學新單字。
the upper floor: My bedroom is on the upper floor of the house, so I can see the whole park and the river from my window.
我的臥室在房子的樓上，所以我可以從窗戶看到整個公園和河流。
the upper class: In the old days, only children from the upper class could go to school, but today every child in Taiwan can study.
在以前，只有上流社會的孩子才能上學，但今天台灣每個孩子都能讀書。
the upper hand: In the first half, the other team had the upper hand, but we played better after the break and won the game.
上半場對方球隊占上風，但我們休息後打得更好，贏了比賽。
the upper body: Swimming is good for the upper body because you have to use your arms, shoulders, and back to move through the water.
游泳對上半身很好，因為你必須用手臂、肩膀和背部在水中前進。
upper case: The teacher told us to write the first letter of every name in upper case, like the T in Tom and the M in Mary.
老師要我們把每個名字的第一個字母寫成大寫字母，像 Tom 的 T 和 Mary 的 M。
the upper lip: My little brother fell off his bike and cut his upper lip, so Mom put some ice on it and took him to the doctor.
我弟弟從腳踏車上摔下來，割傷了上唇，所以媽媽幫他冰敷，並帶他去看醫生。
get the upper hand: Our team got the upper hand in the second half when our tallest player scored three times in five minutes.
我們隊在下半場占了上風，因為我們最高的球員在五分鐘內得了三次分。
be useful for cooking: This big knife is very useful for cooking, because my mother can cut meat and hard vegetables with it very quickly.
這把大刀對烹飪很有用，因為我媽媽可以用它很快地切肉和硬的蔬菜。
An English dictionary is useful to students, so my father bought me a small one that I can carry in my school bag.
英文字典對學生很有用，所以我爸爸買了一本可以放進書包的小字典給我。
come in useful: Take an umbrella and a bottle of water on the trip, because they may come in useful if the weather changes on the mountain.
旅行時帶著雨傘和一瓶水，因為山上天氣變化時它們可能會派上用場。
a useful tip: Here is a useful tip for the English test, read the whole question before you look at the four answers.
這裡有個有用的小建議給英文考試，看四個選項之前先把整個題目讀完。
useful information: The school newspaper has useful information about the sports day, like the time of each race and what to bring.
學校校刊有關於運動會的有用資訊，像是每場比賽的時間和要帶什麼。
make oneself useful: Instead of playing games on the sofa, make yourself useful and help your father carry the heavy boxes into the car.
不要坐在沙發上玩遊戲，幫上點忙，去幫你爸爸把重箱子搬進車裡。
useful 有用的: A map is a useful tool when you travel in a new city, because it helps you find the train station or your hotel.
地圖是你在新城市旅行時有用的工具，因為它幫你找到火車站或旅館。
useless 沒用的: This old phone was useful five years ago, but now it is a useless thing because it cannot go on the Internet.
這支舊手機五年前很有用，但現在它是個沒用的東西，因為它不能上網。
use 使用（動詞）／用途（名詞）: Sunny weather is useful for drying clothes, so we should make use of it today and wash everything before the rain comes back.
晴朗的天氣對晾衣服很有用，所以我們今天應該利用它，在雨回來之前把所有衣服洗好。
used 二手的／習慣的: My uncle bought a used car for only fifty thousand dollars, and it is still very useful for driving to work every day.
我叔叔只花了五萬元買了一輛二手車，它對每天開車上班仍然非常有用。
be used to 習慣於: The noise from the trains was terrible at first, but now I am used to it, and the station is useful for getting to school.
一開始火車的噪音很糟糕，但現在我已經習慣了，而且車站對我上學很有用。
used to 過去常常: My grandfather used to carry a paper map everywhere, but now he says the map on his phone is more useful.
我爺爺過去常常到處帶著紙本地圖，但現在他說手機上的地圖更有用。
as usual: As usual, Dad got up at six o'clock, made breakfast for the whole family, and read the newspaper before going to work.
一如往常，爸爸六點起床，為全家做早餐，然後在上班前看報紙。
than usual: The bus came later than usual this morning because of the heavy rain, so many students were late for the first class.
今天早上因為大雨，公車比平常來得晚，所以很多學生第一節課遲到了。
the usual: When my father walked into the small noodle shop, the owner smiled and asked him, The usual, beef noodles with extra soup?
當我爸爸走進那家小麵店時，老闆微笑著問他：老樣子嗎？牛肉麵加湯？
at the usual time: Grandma eats dinner at the usual time, six o'clock, and she gets worried if anyone in the family is not home by then.
奶奶在平常的時間六點吃晚餐，如果家裡有人到那時還沒回家，她就會擔心。
It's usual for him to: It's usual for him to study in the library after school, so if you cannot find Jason, go and look for him there.
他通常放學後會在圖書館讀書，所以如果你找不到傑森，就去那裡找他。
business as usual: Although the typhoon was strong last night, it was business as usual at school this morning, and nobody got a day off.
雖然昨晚颱風很強，今天早上學校一切照常，沒有人放假。
more than usual: There were more people than usual at the night market tonight because the weather was cool and nice.
今晚夜市的人比平常多，因為天氣涼爽又舒服。
out of the usual: Nothing out of the usual happened at school today, so I just did my homework and went to bed early.
今天學校沒有發生什麼不同於平常的事，所以我做完作業就早早上床睡覺了。
usual 通常的（形容詞）: When I got on the bus this morning, someone was already sitting in my usual seat by the window.
今天早上我上公車時，已經有人坐在我通常坐的靠窗座位上了。
usually 通常（副詞）: I usually walk to school with my sister, but today we took the bus because it was raining hard.
我通常和姊姊走路上學，但今天因為雨下得很大，我們改搭公車。
unusual 不尋常的: It was an unusual day because our math teacher did not give us any homework after the test.
那是個不尋常的日子，因為數學老師考完試後竟然沒有給我們任何作業。
as usual 照常: Jack was late as usual, so his friends started eating lunch without him at the school cafeteria.
傑克照常遲到，所以他的朋友們就在學校餐廳先開始吃午餐，沒等他。
a valuable lesson: Losing the game taught our team a valuable lesson about working together and never giving up.
輸掉那場比賽讓我們球隊學到寶貴的一課：要團隊合作，永不放棄。
valuable time: Please do not waste your valuable time playing phone games when you have a big test tomorrow.
明天有大考，請不要把寶貴的時間浪費在玩手機遊戲上。
valuable information: The nurse gave my grandmother some valuable information about how to take her new medicine safely.
護士給了我奶奶一些關於如何安全服用新藥的寶貴資訊。
a valuable friend: Mary is a valuable friend because she always listens to me and helps me when I am sad.
瑪麗是個難得的朋友，因為她總是聽我說話，並在我難過時幫助我。
valuables: Before we went swimming at the beach, Dad put our phones and other valuables in a locked bag.
我們去海邊游泳前，爸爸把手機和其他貴重物品放進一個鎖好的袋子裡。
be valuable to: Your advice about studying English is very valuable to me, so thank you for taking the time to help.
你關於學英文的建議對我很有價值，謝謝你花時間幫我。
valuable 值錢的／寶貴的: My mother keeps her valuable ring in a small box because it was a gift from my grandfather long ago.
我媽媽把她那枚值錢的戒指收在小盒子裡，因為那是很久以前外公送的禮物。
value 價值（名詞）／重視（動詞）: Our teacher often talks about the value of reading, and she says we should value every book we own.
我們老師常談到閱讀的價值，她說我們應該重視自己擁有的每一本書。
worth 值…的: This old comic book is worth NT$100 now, but it is more valuable than money because my uncle gave it to me.
這本舊漫畫現在值一百元，但它比錢更寶貴，因為是叔叔送我的。
a warm welcome: The students gave the new teacher a warm welcome with a big card and a song on her first day.
學生們在新老師上課的第一天，用一張大卡片和一首歌給了她熱烈的歡迎。
a warm heart: Although he looks very serious, Mr. Lin has a warm heart and often helps poor children in town.
雖然林先生看起來很嚴肅，但他有一顆溫暖的心，常常幫助鎮上的貧困孩童。
warm colors: My sister painted her bedroom in warm colors like orange and yellow because they make her feel happy.
我姊姊把房間漆成橘色和黃色這類暖色，因為這些顏色讓她感到快樂。
warm up: Before the race begins, the players always warm up for ten minutes so they will not hurt their legs.
比賽開始前，選手們總是先暖身十分鐘，這樣才不會傷到腿。
a warm smile: The doctor gave the scared little boy a warm smile and told him that the shot would not hurt much.
醫生對那個害怕的小男孩露出溫暖的微笑，告訴他打針不會很痛。
warm clothes: Remember to bring warm clothes on the trip because it will be very cold in the mountains at night.
記得旅行時要帶保暖的衣服，因為晚上山上會非常冷。
keep warm: Grandma drinks hot tea and sits near the heater to keep warm on cold winter mornings like this one.
像今天這樣寒冷的冬天早晨，奶奶會喝熱茶並坐在暖氣旁保暖。
a warm-hearted man: Our neighbor is a warm-hearted man who fixes bikes for free and gives candy to children on the street.
我們的鄰居是個熱心的人，他免費幫人修腳踏車，還送糖果給街上的小孩。
warm and friendly: Everyone in the small village was warm and friendly, and they invited us to dinner on our first night there.
小村子裡的每個人都溫暖又友善，我們到的第一晚他們就邀我們吃晚餐。
a weak point: Spelling is my weak point in English, so I practice writing ten new words every night before bed.
拼字是我英文的弱點，所以我每晚睡前都練習寫十個新單字。
weak tea: My grandfather likes weak tea with a little sugar, but my father always drinks his tea strong and black.
我爺爺喜歡喝加一點糖的淡茶，但我爸爸總是喝濃濃的紅茶。
a weak voice: After being sick for a week, Amy answered the phone in a weak voice and said she could not come to school.
病了一個星期後，艾美用虛弱的聲音接電話，說她不能來上學。
be weak in math: I am weak in math, so my cousin comes over every Saturday afternoon to help me with the hard problems.
我數學不好，所以我表哥每週六下午都來幫我解難題。
a weak excuse: Saying that your dog ate your homework is a weak excuse, and the teacher will not believe it.
說你的狗吃了你的作業是個站不住腳的藉口，老師是不會相信的。
a weak heart: My uncle has a weak heart, so the doctor told him to stop smoking and to take a short walk every day.
我叔叔心臟不好，所以醫生叫他戒菸，並且每天散步一下。
feel weak: I did not eat any breakfast this morning, and now I feel weak and cannot even stand up straight.
我今天早上沒吃早餐，現在感到虛弱，連站都站不直。
a weak smile: When the coach asked if she was hurt after the fall, Lily gave him a weak smile and said she was fine.
教練問她跌倒後有沒有受傷時，莉莉勉強地微笑，說她沒事。
a weak team: Everyone said we were a weak team, but we practiced every day after school and won the final game.
大家都說我們是弱隊，但我們每天放學後練習，最後贏了決賽。
the weak: A good leader should take care of the weak and make sure that everyone in the group is safe and happy.
好的領導者應該照顧弱者，並確保團隊裡的每個人都安全快樂。
be weak at math: Peter is weak at math but very good at English, so he and I often help each other with homework.
彼得數學不好但英文很強，所以我們常常互相幫忙寫作業。
be weak from hunger: The lost hiker was weak from hunger when the police found him in the mountains after two long days.
警察在山裡找到那名迷路的登山客時，他已經餓得沒力了，因為過了兩天。
weak in the knees: When the teacher called my name to speak in front of the whole class, I suddenly felt weak in the knees.
當老師叫我的名字要我在全班面前說話時，我突然腿軟了。
weak 虛弱的（形容詞）: The weak old man could not carry the heavy bags by himself, so two students helped him cross the street.
那位虛弱的老人無法自己提重袋子，所以兩個學生幫他過了馬路。
week 星期（名詞）: Next week we have a big English test, and I am still weak in listening, so I will practice every night.
下星期我們有一場英文大考，而我的聽力還很弱，所以我每晚都要練習。
weakness 弱點（名詞）: Chocolate cake is my weakness, and I can never say no when my mother makes one on the weekend.
巧克力蛋糕是我的弱點，媽媽週末做蛋糕時，我永遠無法拒絕。
weaken 使變弱（動詞）: Losing our best player because he hurt his leg will weaken the team before the big game next Saturday.
我們最好的球員因為腿受傷而缺席，這會在下星期六大賽前使球隊變弱。
be welcome to use: You are welcome to use my computer if you need to finish your report before class tomorrow morning.
如果你需要在明天早上上課前完成報告，歡迎使用我的電腦。
When I thanked the kind woman for helping me find my lost wallet, she smiled and said, You're welcome.
當我感謝那位好心的女士幫我找到遺失的皮夾時，她微笑著說：不客氣。
Welcome to Taiwan!: The tour guide held up a big sign at the airport that said Welcome to Taiwan! for the visitors from Japan.
導遊在機場舉著一個大牌子，上面寫著「歡迎來台灣！」給來自日本的遊客看。
welcome news: After weeks of worrying, hearing that Grandpa could leave the hospital this Friday was very welcome news.
擔心了好幾個星期後，聽到爺爺這週五可以出院，真是個好消息。
make sb. feel welcome: The new student felt lonely at first, but our class tried hard to make him feel welcome by inviting him to lunch.
新同學起初覺得很孤單，但我們班努力邀他一起吃午餐，讓他感到受歡迎。
Welcome back!: When Dad came home after working in another city for a month, we shouted Welcome back! and gave him big hugs.
爸爸在外地工作一個月後回家時，我們大喊「歡迎回來！」並給他大大的擁抱。
a welcome change: After a week of heavy rain, the sunny weather this morning was a welcome change for everyone in town.
連下了一週大雨之後，今天早上的晴天對鎮上的每個人來說都是令人欣喜的改變。
welcome 受歡迎的（形容詞）: My grandmother always tells my friends that they are welcome here at any time, even without calling first.
我奶奶總是告訴我的朋友，他們隨時都歡迎來這裡，就算沒有先打電話也沒關係。
welcome 歡迎（動詞）: The students stood at the school gate to welcome the guests from Japan with flowers and bright smiles.
學生們站在校門口，用鮮花和燦爛的笑容歡迎來自日本的賓客。
a welcome 歡迎（名詞）: The whole town gave the soldiers a warm welcome when they finally came home after a long year away.
軍人們在外一整年終於回家時，全鎮給了他們熱烈的歡迎。
Welcome! 歡迎光臨: When we walked into the small restaurant, the owner smiled and said Welcome! before showing us to a table.
我們走進那間小餐廳時，老闆微笑著說「歡迎光臨！」然後帶我們到座位。
be well: I hope your grandmother is well now because I heard she had a bad cold last week and stayed in bed.
希望你奶奶現在身體好了，因為我聽說她上週重感冒躺在床上。
get well soon: All of my friends in class wrote Get well soon on a big card and sent it to Tom in the hospital.
我班上所有的朋友在一張大卡片上寫下「早日康復」，然後寄給住院的湯姆。
feel well: I did not feel well after eating the old sandwich, so my mother took me to see the doctor that night.
吃了那個放很久的三明治後我感覺身體不舒服，所以媽媽那晚帶我去看醫生。
look well: You look well today, so I guess the medicine the doctor gave you last week is really working.
你今天看起來很健康，我猜醫生上週給你的藥真的有效。
as well: I bought a notebook and two pens at the store, and I got a new pencil case as well for my brother.
我在店裡買了一本筆記本和兩枝筆，也幫我弟弟買了一個新的鉛筆盒。
as well as: My sister can speak Japanese as well as English, so she helps the foreign visitors who come to our shop.
我姊姊會說日文以及英文，所以她會幫忙來我們店裡的外國客人。
do well in: If you want to do well in the English test, you should read the textbook and practice listening every day.
如果你想在英文考試中表現好，應該每天讀課本並練習聽力。
well done: Well done! said the coach when our team finished the race first, and he gave everyone a high five.
教練在我們隊第一個跑完比賽時說「做得好！」，還跟每個人擊掌。
all is well: Mom called from the hospital to tell us that all is well and that the baby and Aunt Lisa are both fine.
媽媽從醫院打電話來告訴我們一切都好，寶寶和麗莎阿姨都平安。
may as well: Since it is already raining and we cannot play outside, we may as well stay home and watch a movie together.
既然已經在下雨，我們沒辦法去外面玩，不妨就留在家裡一起看電影吧。
Well, …: Well, I am not sure what to cook tonight, so let me look in the kitchen and see what we still have.
嗯，我不確定今晚要煮什麼，讓我去廚房看看我們還有什麼。
well-known: Taipei 101 is a well-known building in Taiwan, and many visitors from other countries take pictures of it.
台北一〇一是台灣有名的建築，很多外國遊客都會拍它的照片。
well-paid: My uncle has a well-paid job at a computer company, so he can travel to a different country every summer.
我叔叔在電腦公司有一份高薪的工作，所以他每年夏天都能去不同的國家旅行。
well 好地（副詞）: My little sister can sing well, so the music teacher asked her to sing alone at the school show next month.
我妹妹唱得很好，所以音樂老師請她下個月在學校表演上獨唱。
good 好的（形容詞）: Jenny is a good singer who sings very well, and she practices with her friends in the music room every Friday.
珍妮是個唱得很好的好歌手，她每個星期五都和朋友在音樂教室練習。
a well 水井（名詞）: In the old village, people still get their water from a deep well behind the temple every morning.
在那個古老的村子裡，人們每天早上還是從廟後面的一口深井取水。
the west coast: Last summer my family drove along the west coast and watched the sun go down into the sea each evening.
去年夏天我們全家沿著西海岸開車，每天傍晚看著太陽落入海裡。
a west wind: A strong west wind blew all night, and this morning there were leaves and small branches all over the road.
強勁的西風吹了整夜，今天早上路上到處都是樹葉和小樹枝。
in the west: The sun sets in the west, so if you face the sea at night, you can see the sky turn orange.
太陽從西方落下，所以如果你晚上面向大海，就能看到天空變成橘色。
the West: In the West, many families eat turkey on special holidays, but in Taiwan we often eat hot pot together.
在西方世界，很多家庭在特別的節日吃火雞，但在台灣我們常常一起吃火鍋。
go west: If you go west from the train station for about ten minutes, you will see the night market on your left.
如果你從火車站往西走大約十分鐘，就會看到夜市在你的左手邊。
West Africa: My aunt works as a doctor in West Africa, and she sends us pictures of the beautiful animals there.
我阿姨在西非當醫生，她會寄給我們那裡美麗動物的照片。
wet weather: We have had wet weather for two weeks, and my shoes never seem to get dry before I need them again.
我們已經連續兩個星期都是潮濕的天氣，我的鞋子在我再穿之前好像都乾不了。
wet paint: Be careful not to touch the door because the sign on it says Wet Paint in big red letters.
小心不要碰那扇門，因為門上的牌子用大大的紅字寫著「油漆未乾」。
get wet: I forgot my umbrella at home this morning, so I got wet on the way to school and changed my shirt.
我今天早上把雨傘忘在家裡，所以上學路上被淋濕了，還換了襯衫。
be wet through: By the time the boys got home from the baseball game, they were wet through and shaking with cold.
那些男孩從棒球賽回到家時，已經全身濕透，還冷得發抖。
a wet day: On a wet day like today, my grandmother likes to stay inside, drink hot tea, and watch her favorite TV shows.
像今天這樣的雨天，我奶奶喜歡待在家裡喝熱茶，看她最愛的電視節目。
wet behind the ears: The new worker is still wet behind the ears, so the manager asked Mr. Chen to teach him slowly and kindly.
那位新員工還太嫩了，所以經理請陳先生慢慢地、親切地教他。
wet with tears: When the movie ended, Amy turned to me with a face wet with tears and said it was the saddest story ever.
電影結束時，艾美轉向我，臉上淚濕的，說那是她看過最悲傷的故事。
a white lie: I told my aunt a white lie about loving her cooking because I did not want to hurt her feelings at dinner.
我對阿姨說了個善意的謊言，說我很愛她做的菜，因為我不想在晚餐時傷她的心。
white bread: My brother only eats white bread with butter for breakfast, but Mom says brown bread is better for his health.
我弟弟早餐只吃塗奶油的白麵包，但媽媽說全麥麵包對他的健康比較好。
go white: When the doctor said the word hospital, my father went white and had to sit down on the nearest chair.
醫生說出「醫院」這個詞時，我爸爸臉色發白，不得不坐到最近的椅子上。
white meat: The doctor told my grandfather to eat more white meat like chicken and fish instead of beef and pork.
醫生告訴我爺爺要多吃雞肉和魚這類白肉，而不要吃牛肉和豬肉。
the White House: On our trip to the United States, we stood outside the White House and took a lot of pictures with Dad.
我們去美國旅行時，站在白宮外面和爸爸拍了很多照片。
black and white: My grandfather still loves watching old black and white movies on TV every Sunday afternoon with a cup of tea.
我爺爺仍然喜歡每個星期天下午喝著茶，在電視上看老的黑白電影。
a white Christmas: My cousin in Canada says they have a white Christmas almost every year, with snow covering every roof and tree.
我在加拿大的表哥說他們幾乎每年都有白色聖誕，雪覆蓋著每個屋頂和樹木。
white coffee: My mother always orders white coffee at the shop near our school because black coffee is too strong for her.
我媽媽總是在我們學校附近的店點加奶的咖啡，因為黑咖啡對她來說太濃了。
turn white: Grandpa's hair started to turn white when he was only forty, but he says it makes him look wise and kind.
爺爺的頭髮在他才四十歲時就開始變白，但他說這讓他看起來睿智又和善。
the whole day: It rained the whole day on Sunday, so my brother and I stayed home and finished a big puzzle together.
星期天下了整天的雨，所以我和弟弟待在家裡一起完成了一幅大拼圖。
on the whole: The hotel room was small and the food was not great, but on the whole we had a happy trip to Japan.
飯店房間很小，食物也不太好，但整體來說我們的日本之旅很愉快。
the whole world: During the Olympic Games, people from the whole world watch their favorite players on TV late at night.
奧運期間，全世界的人深夜在電視上觀看他們最喜愛的選手。
as a whole: Some students in our class are noisy, but as a whole the class is friendly and works hard in every lesson.
我們班有些學生很吵，但作為整體，全班很友善，而且每堂課都很認真。
the whole time: During the long speech, the boy next to me played with his phone the whole time and did not hear a word.
在那場長長的演講中，坐我旁邊的男孩一直在玩手機，一個字也沒聽進去。
the whole family: Every Chinese New Year, the whole family comes back to Grandma's house in Tainan for a big dinner together.
每年農曆新年，全家人都回到台南奶奶家一起吃一頓大餐。
the whole story: Before you get angry with your sister, you should sit down and listen to the whole story from her first.
在你對姊姊生氣之前，你應該先坐下來聽她把事情的全貌說完。
a whole lot of: There were a whole lot of people at the night market last night, so we waited an hour to eat.
昨晚夜市有很多人，所以我們等了一小時才吃到東西。
whole milk: My little brother is still growing, so the doctor said he should drink a glass of whole milk every morning.
我小弟還在長大，所以醫生說他每天早上應該喝一杯全脂牛奶。
with my whole heart: I promise with my whole heart that I will take good care of this puppy and walk it every single day.
我全心全意地保證，我會好好照顧這隻小狗，而且每天都帶它去散步。
whole 整個的（the whole + 單數）: The whole class cheered loudly when Mr. Wang told us that we won first place in the school singing game.
當王老師告訴我們在學校歌唱比賽得到第一名時，全班都大聲歡呼。
all 所有的（all + 複數／不可數）: All the students must wear their uniforms on Monday, and the whole school has a big meeting in the morning.
所有的學生星期一都必須穿制服，而且全校早上有一場大集會。
a hole 洞（名詞）: There is a hole in the wall of our class, and a small mouse ran across the whole room during lunch today.
我們教室的牆上有一個洞，今天午餐時間有一隻小老鼠跑過整個房間。
a wide smile: When Lucy saw her best friend waiting at the airport, she gave her a wide smile and ran to hug her.
露西看到最好的朋友在機場等她時，開懷地笑了，然後跑過去抱她。
far and wide: People came from far and wide to taste the famous beef noodles at the little shop near the old temple.
人們從各地來到老廟附近的小店，品嚐那裡有名的牛肉麵。
eyes wide with surprise: The little girl stood in front of the giant birthday cake with her eyes wide with surprise and said nothing.
小女孩站在巨大的生日蛋糕前，驚訝得睜大眼睛，什麼也沒說。
a wide road: A wide road runs through the center of our town, so cars and buses can move easily even at busy hours.
一條寬闊的道路穿過我們鎮中心，所以即使在尖峰時間，汽車和公車也能順暢行駛。
wide of the mark: Tom thought the test would be about animals, but his guess was wide of the mark because it was about weather.
湯姆以為考試是關於動物，但他猜得離譜，因為考的是天氣。
worldwide: This Taiwanese singer has become famous worldwide, and her new song is now played on the radio in many countries.
這位台灣歌手已經在全世界出名，她的新歌現在在很多國家的電台播放。
wide 寬的／張大地（形容詞與副詞同形）: The dentist asked the little boy to open wide so she could look carefully at the tooth that was hurting him.
牙醫請小男孩把嘴張大，好讓她能仔細看那顆讓他疼痛的牙齒。
widely 廣泛地（副詞）: The night market in Taichung is widely known for its cheap food, so many visitors go there on weekends.
台中的那座夜市因便宜的食物而廣為人知，所以很多遊客週末去那裡。
width 寬度（名詞）: The new desk is too wide for my room, so Dad measured the width of the space by the wall.
新書桌對我的房間來說太寬了，所以爸爸測量了牆邊空間的寬度。
broad 寬闊的（較正式、抽象）: The kind old teacher gave us a broad smile, and her eyes opened wide when she saw so many new faces.
那位和善的老教師對我們露出開闊的笑容，看到這麼多新面孔時，她的眼睛睜得大大的。
wild animals: At the zoo, the guide told us that wild animals should live in the forest, not in small rooms behind glass.
在動物園，導覽員告訴我們野生動物應該住在森林裡，而不是玻璃後面的小房間。
wild flowers: On our walk up the mountain, we saw yellow and purple wild flowers growing along both sides of the path.
我們爬山的路上，看到黃色和紫色的野花沿著小路兩旁生長。
a wild guess: I did not study for the quiz, so I made a wild guess on the last question and hoped for the best.
我沒有準備小考，所以最後一題我只是胡亂猜測，然後希望有好結果。
go wild: The fans went wild when the singer suddenly jumped off the stage and started dancing with the crowd.
當那位歌手突然跳下舞台，開始和觀眾一起跳舞時，粉絲們都瘋狂地興奮起來。
be wild about: My younger brother is wild about dinosaurs, so he reads every book about them in the school library.
我弟弟迷戀恐龍，所以他把學校圖書館裡每一本關於恐龍的書都讀過了。
a wild party: The neighbors called the police because the wild party next door was still going on at two in the morning.
鄰居打電話叫警察，因為隔壁狂野的派對到凌晨兩點還在進行。
wild weather: Because of the wild weather last night, many trees fell down and the schools in our city were closed today.
因為昨晚的惡劣天氣，很多樹倒了，我們市裡的學校今天都停課。
run wild: When the teacher left the class for ten minutes, some of the boys began to run wild and throw paper around.
老師離開教室十分鐘時，有些男孩開始撒野，到處丟紙。
a wild idea: Building a tree house in the garden sounded like a wild idea at first, but Dad helped us finish it quickly.
在花園蓋樹屋起初聽起來像個瘋狂的想法，但爸爸幫我們很快就完成了。
in the wild: Pandas are hard to find in the wild today, so most people can only see them in zoos in big cities.
如今野外很難找到熊貓，所以大多數人只能在大城市的動物園看到它們。
wild with joy: When Jenny saw her name at the top of the team list, she was wild with joy and jumped up and down.
珍妮看到自己的名字在球隊名單的最上面時，她欣喜若狂，跳上跳下。
a windy day: On a windy day like this, hold your hat with both hands or the wind will blow it into the river.
像今天這樣颳風的日子，要用雙手抓住帽子，否則風會把它吹進河裡。
a windy road: The bus drove slowly along the windy road up the mountain, and some of the students began to feel sick.
公車沿著蜿蜒的山路慢慢往上開，有些學生開始覺得不舒服。
It's windy outside today, so Mom told us to close all the windows before we left for school this morning.
今天外面風很大，所以媽媽叫我們今天早上出門上學前把所有窗戶關好。
windy weather: The weather report says we will have windy weather all week, so the boat trip to the island may be put off.
氣象報告說整個星期都會是多風的天氣，所以去小島的船程可能會延期。
a wise man: In the story, a wise man lives on top of the mountain, and people walk for days to ask him important questions.
故事裡，一位智者住在山頂，人們走好幾天的路去問他重要的問題。
a wise choice: Taking an umbrella this morning was a wise choice because it started to rain heavily right after lunch.
今天早上帶傘是個明智的選擇，因為午餐後馬上就開始下大雨。
a wise decision: Studying English a little every day instead of all night before the test was a wise decision, and my grades went up.
每天讀一點英文，而不是考前熬夜整晚，是個明智的決定，我的成績也進步了。
It's wise to: It's wise to check the weather before you go hiking, because the mountain can get very cold and wet in the afternoon.
去爬山前先查天氣是明智的，因為山上下午可能會變得很冷又潮濕。
be wise about: My grandmother is very wise about money, so she taught me to save part of my pocket money every month.
我奶奶對金錢很有智慧，所以她教我每個月把一部分零用錢存起來。
wise words: Before I left for high school, my grandfather gave me some wise words about being kind and working hard.
我去上高中之前，爺爺給了我一些關於待人善良和努力的智慧之言。
be none the wiser: The teacher explained the math problem three times, but I was still none the wiser and asked my friend for help.
老師把那道數學題解釋了三次，但我還是搞不懂，只好請朋友幫忙。
a word to the wise: A word to the wise: do not leave your bike outside the station without a lock, because many bikes get stolen there.
給聰明人的忠告：別把腳踏車不上鎖就放在車站外，因為那裡很多腳踏車被偷。
wise 有智慧的（形容詞）: In the old story, the wise king listened to both the rich and the poor before he made any important decision.
在那個古老的故事裡，有智慧的國王在做任何重要決定前都會傾聽富人和窮人的意見。
wisely 明智地（副詞）: You only have one hour for the test, so use your time wisely and do the easy questions first.
考試只有一小時，所以要明智地運用時間，先做簡單的題目。
wisdom 智慧（名詞）: My grandmother never went to high school, but she is very wise, and her words of wisdom have helped me many times.
我奶奶沒上過高中，但她非常有智慧，她的智慧之言幫過我很多次。
clever 聰明的: Kevin is a clever boy who can finish a hard puzzle in five minutes, but he is not always wise about friends.
凱文是個聰明的男孩，五分鐘就能完成困難的拼圖，但他在交朋友方面不總是很有智慧。
a wonderful time: We had a wonderful time at the beach last weekend, swimming in the sea and eating ice cream under the sun.
上週末我們在海邊度過了美好的時光，在海裡游泳，在陽光下吃冰淇淋。
wonderful news: Mom came home with wonderful news: she got the new job, so we can finally move to a bigger house this summer.
媽媽帶著大好消息回家：她得到了新工作，所以今年夏天我們終於可以搬到更大的房子。
Wonderful!: Wonderful! shouted my father when he saw my report card, and he took the whole family out for pizza that night.
爸爸看到我的成績單時大喊「太棒了！」，當晚還帶全家出去吃披薩。
a wonderful idea: Having a picnic by the river on Sunday is a wonderful idea, so let me call the others and invite them.
星期天在河邊野餐是個很棒的點子，讓我打電話給其他人，邀請他們一起來。
It's wonderful to see you again after so many years, and I can't wait to hear about your life in Japan.
這麼多年後再見到你真好，我迫不及待想聽聽你在日本的生活。
a wonderful meal: Grandma cooked a wonderful meal for my birthday, with fish, soup, rice, and my favorite chicken with rice noodles.
奶奶為我的生日做了美味的一餐，有魚、湯、飯，還有我最愛的雞肉米粉。
work wonders: A good night of sleep and a glass of warm milk can work wonders when you feel tired before a test.
當你在考試前覺得疲倦時，好好睡一晚加一杯溫牛奶能產生奇效。
go wrong: Everything went wrong on the morning of the trip: I woke up late, missed the bus, and left my ticket at home.
旅行那天早上一切都出錯了：我睡過頭、錯過公車，還把票忘在家裡。
What's wrong?: What's wrong? asked my mother when she saw me crying at the kitchen table with my test paper in my hand.
媽媽看到我拿著考卷在餐桌邊哭時，問我：「怎麼了？」
the wrong way: You are holding the chopsticks the wrong way, so let me show you how my grandmother taught me to hold them.
你拿筷子的方式錯了，讓我示範奶奶教我怎麼拿。
get sb. wrong: Many people get Tom wrong because he is quiet, but he is actually one of the kindest students in our class.
很多人誤會湯姆，因為他很安靜，但他其實是我們班上最善良的學生之一。
Don't get me wrong, I like your new haircut, but I think the old one made you look a little bit taller.
別誤會我，我喜歡你的新髮型，但我覺得舊的讓你看起來高一點。
be in the wrong: After the fight, Jack knew he was in the wrong, so he went to his sister's room and said sorry to her.
吵架後，傑克知道自己有錯，所以他去姊姊的房間向她道歉。
the wrong number: A stranger called our house at midnight, but he had the wrong number and was looking for a pizza shop.
一個陌生人半夜打電話到我們家，但他打錯電話了，他其實要找披薩店。
right and wrong: Parents and teachers should help young children learn the difference between right and wrong from an early age.
父母和老師應該幫助幼童從小就學會分辨是非對錯。
wrong with: Something is wrong with my bike, because it makes a strange noise every time I ride it up the hill to school.
我的腳踏車有問題，因為每次我騎它上坡去學校時，它都會發出奇怪的聲音。
take the wrong bus: I took the wrong bus after school and ended up at the train station, so I was an hour late for dinner.
放學後我搭錯公車，結果到了火車站，所以晚餐遲到了一個小時。
be wrong about: I was wrong about the new teacher; I thought she would be very serious, but she is actually funny and kind.
我對新老師的看法錯了；我以為她會很嚴肅，但她其實風趣又和善。
There's nothing wrong with: There's nothing wrong with asking for help when you do not understand a lesson, so don't be shy in class.
聽不懂課程時請人幫忙沒什麼不對，所以上課時別害羞。
wrong 錯的（形容詞）／錯誤地（副詞）: If you answer the question wrong, don't worry, because the teacher will explain it again and give you another try.
如果你答錯了問題，別擔心，因為老師會再解釋一次，再給你一次機會。
wrongly 錯誤地（副詞）: Three words in my English letter were wrongly spelled, so my teacher asked me to write them again five times.
我英文信裡有三個字拼錯了，所以老師要我把它們再寫五遍。
a wrong 錯事（名詞）: The teacher gave Mary a chance to right a wrong by saying sorry to the girl she had laughed at in class.
老師給瑪麗一個改正錯事的機會，讓她向在課堂上被她嘲笑的女孩道歉。
false 假的: The man gave the police a false name, and it was wrong of him to lie because they soon checked his ID.
那個男人給警察一個假名字，他說謊是錯的，因為他們很快就查了他的身分證。
mistake 錯誤（名詞）: Everyone makes a mistake sometimes, so do not be too hard on yourself when you get a wrong answer on the test.
每個人有時候都會犯錯，所以當你在考試中答錯時，別對自己太苛刻。
a yellow light: When the traffic light turns yellow, you should slow down and get ready to stop instead of driving faster.
當交通號誌變成黃燈時，你應該減速準備停下，而不是開得更快。
yellow pages: Before everyone had the Internet, my father used the yellow pages to find the phone number of a doctor or a store.
在大家有網路之前，我爸爸用電話簿黃頁來找醫生或商店的電話號碼。
the yellow line: Please stand behind the yellow line on the platform and wait until the train comes to a full stop before getting on.
請站在月台的黃線後方，等火車完全停下來再上車。
yellow with age: My grandfather showed me some old letters that were yellow with age, written by his mother more than sixty years ago.
爺爺給我看一些因年久而泛黃的舊信，是他媽媽在六十多年前寫的。
yellow fever: Before traveling to some hot countries, people need a shot to keep them safe from yellow fever and other health problems.
去某些熱帶國家旅行之前，人們需要打針以預防黃熱病和其他健康問題。
young at heart: My grandmother is eighty years old, but she is still young at heart and loves to dance and try new foods.
我奶奶八十歲了，但她的心態還很年輕，喜歡跳舞和嘗試新食物。
a young man: A young man on the train stood up and gave his seat to the old lady who was carrying two heavy bags.
火車上一位年輕人站起來，把座位讓給那位提著兩個重袋子的老太太。
the young: The young today spend a lot of time on their phones, so parents often worry about their eyes and their sleep.
現在的年輕人花很多時間在手機上，所以父母常常擔心他們的眼睛和睡眠。
young children: Young children should not stay too close to the TV, and they should go to bed early so they can grow well.
幼童不應該離電視太近，也應該早點睡，這樣才能長得好。
in my young days: In my young days, said Grandpa, we did not have smart phones, so we played ball in the streets every afternoon.
爺爺說：「在我年輕時，我們沒有智慧型手機，所以每天下午都在街上打球。」
the night is young: It is only nine o'clock and the night is young, so let's walk to the night market and get some dessert.
現在才九點，夜還很長，所以我們走去夜市買點甜點吧。
look young for one's age: My mother looks young for her age because she exercises every morning and never eats too much fast food.
我媽媽看起來比實際年齡年輕，因為她每天早上運動，而且從不吃太多速食。
young and old: The lantern festival is fun for young and old, so the whole town comes out to watch the lights every February.
燈會對老老少少都很有趣，所以每年二月全鎮的人都出來看燈。
a young tree: We planted a young tree in front of the school last spring, and it has already grown taller than my brother.
去年春天我們在學校前面種了一棵小樹，它已經長得比我弟弟高了。
young 年輕的（形容詞）: The young girl who sits next to me in class is only twelve, but she can already speak three languages well.
班上坐我旁邊的那個年輕女孩才十二歲，但她已經能說好三種語言。
youth 青春／年輕人（名詞）: The youth of our town held a big beach clean-up, and more than two hundred young students came to help.
我們鎮上的年輕人舉辦了大型淨灘活動，有超過兩百名年輕學生來幫忙。
younger 較年輕的: My younger brother is two years younger than I am, but he already beats me at chess almost every time.
我弟弟比我小兩歲，但他下棋幾乎每次都能贏我。
little 小的（弟妹口語）: My little brother is only five years old, so I walk the young boy to his kindergarten every morning before school.
我的小弟弟才五歲，所以我每天早上上學前都送這個小男孩去幼兒園。
your 你的（形容詞）: Is this your bag on the chair, or does it belong to the girl who just left the class a minute ago?
椅子上這個是你的包包嗎，還是屬於一分鐘前剛離開教室的那個女孩？
yours 你的東西: The blue bag on the table is yours, and the red one next to it belongs to your cousin from Kaohsiung.
桌上那個藍色的包包是你的，旁邊那個紅色的是你高雄表姊的。
yourself 你自己: There is a lot of fruit and cake on the table, so please help yourself and do not wait for us.
桌上有很多水果和蛋糕，請自己拿，不用等我們。
you're: You're right about your weather report, so let's take our umbrellas with us before we leave for the movie theater.
關於你的天氣預報，你說得對，所以我們出門去電影院前帶著傘吧。
Yours truly: Grandma always ends her letters with Yours truly and then draws a small heart under her name.
奶奶總是在信的結尾寫上「敬上」，然後在名字下面畫一個小愛心。
yummy food: The night market near our school is full of yummy food, like fried chicken, sweet potato balls, and milk tea.
我們學校附近的夜市充滿了好吃的食物，像是炸雞、地瓜球和奶茶。
Yummy!: Yummy! said my little sister after her first bite of the strawberry ice cream, and she asked for another one.
我小妹吃了第一口草莓冰淇淋後說：「好吃！」，然後又要了一個。
look yummy: Those dumplings in the window look yummy, so let's go into the shop and buy a box to share for lunch.
櫥窗裡的那些水餃看起來很好吃，我們進店裡買一盒午餐一起分著吃吧。
a yummy cake: My aunt baked a yummy cake with chocolate and bananas for my birthday, and everyone asked for a second piece.
阿姨為我的生日烤了一個有巧克力和香蕉的好吃蛋糕，每個人都要了第二塊。
